12302317.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302317.value: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) are among the most prevalent environmental pollutants known to be involved in carcinogenesis. The long half-life of PAHs in soil, water, air, and subsequently our food makes it a persistent contaminant that can be absorbed through different exposure routes. Among PAHs congeners, benzo[a]pyrene (B[a]P) is most toxic and classified as Group I carcinogens in humans by the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC). Epidemiological studies have suggested the potential association of PAHs with human bladder cancer. Nevertheless, the mechanism underlying the potential carcinogenicity of PAHs in bladder remains poorly understood. Dysregulated metabolism has recently been acknowledged as a key hallmark of cancer. Up to date, whether B[a]P, and of PAHs more generally, can trigger metabolic shift such as “Warburg effect” in the bladder has not been assessed. Metabolomics, which measures changes in endogenous metabolites, is a powerful tool for studying global cellular metabolic responses to toxicants. In this proposal, a comprehensive mass spectrometry-based metabolomics approach will be used for the first time to explore the metabolic responses of human bladder cells exposed to B[a]P-the prototype of PAHs. Both LC/MS and GC/MS will be utilized to enable a broad coverage of the metabolites. Chemometric analysis will be performed to identify the biomarkers that associated with B[a]P exposure. The metabolite set enrichment analysis and pathway analysis will be conducted to elucidate the disturbed metabolic pathways. Moreover, the identified metabolic pathways and intermediate metabolites related to “Warburg effect” will be further validated using targeted metabolomics approach. The metabolic enzymes involved in the perturbed metabolic pathways will be confirmed by RT-PCR and western blotting assays. The obtained results are expected to provide new clues concerning the toxicological mechanisms of B[a]P in human bladder from a metabolomics perspective.

12302317.label: Realisation of objectives
12302317.value: 1) For the first objective, we have developed a large-scale targeted metabolomic profiling method for the analysis of metabolites in human samples. The method enables targeted profiling of over 400 biologically important metabolites, covering 92 critical metabolic pathways. The method also demonstrated excellent sensitivity, repeatability, and linearity. 2) For the second objective, human bladder cells (SV-HUC-1) were exposed to B[a]P with various doses, including 0.5, 2.5, 10, and 40 µM. Both apolar and polar metabolites were extracted for global and targeted profiling, using the method developed in the first objective. 3) For the third objective, partial least squares discriminant analysis (PLS-DA) and t-test were used to identify the differential metabolites between the control and exposure groups. Biomarkers associated with B[a]P exposure were selected based on the following criteria: variable importance in the projection (VIP) > 1 and p-value of less than 0.05. Metabolic network was constructed using MetaboAnalyst. Proteomics study was further conducted to verify the disturbed metabolic pathways associated with B[a]P exposure. Furthermore, we conducted additional biological assays to evaluate the toxicity of B[a]P exposure on human bladder cells, including cell viability assay, alkaline comet assay for DNA damage, flow cytometer analysis of cell apoptosis and cell cycle. Taken together, the three objectives have been well achieved.

12302317.label: Major findings and research outcome
12302317.value: In the current study, we found that B[a]P could dramatically inhibit cell proliferation, induce DNA damage, cell apoptosis and cell cycle arrest in SV-HUC-1 human bladder cells. Metabolomic profiling identified a total of 47 significantly perturbed metabolites associated with B[a]P exposure in SV-HUC-1 human bladder cells. Metabolic pathway analysis indicated that the major altered pathways were glutathione metabolism, pyrimidine metabolism, and phenylalanine metabolism. Lipidomics analysis was performed to profile the changes of apolar metabolites (lipids) in SV-HUC-1 cells in response to B[a]P. A total of 85 lipids were identified to be significantly perturbed by B[a]P exposure, including the upregulation of major phosphatidylcholines (PC), phosphatidylethanolamines (PE), three ceramides (Cer), three glucosylceramides (CerG1), and the downregulation of five lyso-phosphatidylcholines (LPC), two lyso-phosphatidylethanolamines (LPE), and eight triacylglycerols (TG). The proteomics data confirmed that the major biological processes perturbed by B[a]P exposure were mainly involved in metabolic processes. Specifically, the significant enrichment of “metabolism of lipids” were evident, supporting the altered lipid composition as a hypothetical carcinogenesis of B[a]P. Taken together, comprehensive omics analysis demonstrated that B[a]P exposure significantly induced alterations in lipid metabolism and tumor microenvironment, as well as disruption of energy homeostasis and disturbance of carcinogen detoxification.

12302317.value: The findings identified in the cell model in this study could be further validated in the animal model, and in human subjects with high B[a]P exposure.

Among PAHs congeners, benzo[a]pyrene (B[a]P) is most toxic and classified as Group I carcinogens in humans by the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC). 12302817.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302817.value: High-sensitivity near-infrared (NIR) photodetectors are crucial for applications in thermal imaging, night-vision and wellness monitoring. In comparison to the conventional technology based on inorganic semiconductors, organic phototransistors (OPTs) offer a promising alternative due to their low cost, flexible design, adaptability to various fabrications, and large area manufacturability. However, several key issues remain to be addressed, namely, the low field-effect mobility and limited NIR light absorption. One way to circumvent this hurdle is to create an organic channel film with ordered structure for mobility enhancement and a special device design to increase its NIR light absorption. Various approaches have taken this route, such as incorporating metal nanoparticles, surface plasmonic structures and a bulk heterojunction in the channel layer in OPTs. Yet all had only limited success due to technical challenges. In this application, we propose two novel approaches to alleviate this barrier: (1) to achieve high charge transport efficiency by controlling the crystalline order of the organic channel layer, (2) to incorporate photonic structures in OPTs to realize NIR light absorption enhancement by coupling with the waveguide modes in the organic channel layer. Comprehensive and systematic research on NIR OPTs, based on matrix-mediated nanowire networks of NIR-absorbing conjugate polymers and integration with organic photonic structures, is rather rare. This project utilizes a synergistic approach of theoretical simulation, experimental optimization as well as nanostructure analysis and process integration. The objective is to realize high-sensitivity, solution-processed NIR OPTs through controlling the nanostructures of the polymer channel film with improved charge transport and enhanced NIR light absorption. 高靈敏度近紅外光電探測器對於熱成像、夜視和健康監測的應用至關重要。與傳統的無機半導體器件技術相比，有機光電晶體管在設計，適應性和可打印製造等方面的特點，在低成本大面積光電器件的應用中具有廣闊的前景。然而，有機半導體材料和器件的製造仍面臨幾個關鍵技術问题有待解決，如較低的載流子遷移率以及有限的近紅外吸收能力。解決這一問題的關鍵是製備有序分子結構的半導體薄膜以提高其載流子的遷移率和通過有效的器件設計以增加其近紅外光吸收。目前已有的报道，例如在有機光電晶體管溝道層中加入金屬納米顆粒、利用其表面等離子體結構或體異質結等來改善器件性能等，都只是取得了有限的成功，在大面积可溶液加工的高性能光电器件应用方面，還面臨著不同的挑戰。 在本項目中，我們提出了兩種克服以上困難的新方法：（1）通過利用聚合物誘導形成納米線網絡实现溝道層中有機半導體分子的有序排列來實現高載流子輸運，（2）在有機光電晶體管的溝道層中引入光子結構，通過波導耦合實現近紅外光吸收增強。目前，基於誘導形成聚合物納米線網絡溝道并與有機光子晶體結構相結合的近紅外光電晶體管的研究還相當罕見。本項目將结合理論模擬，實驗優化，納米結構分析以及過程集成等方法來提高載流子輸運和增強近紅外光吸收，進而實現高靈敏度、可溶液製備的高性能近紅外光電晶體管。

12302817.label: Realisation of objectives
12302817.value: The traditional NIR light detection devices are prepared mainly using different inorganic semiconducting materials such as Si and III-V compound semiconductors. Solution-processable polymer and perovskite semiconductors have attracted many interests for applications in photodetectors including phototransistors (PTs) and photodetectors (PDs). The research work has been focused on realization of three objectives. (1) achieving high charge transport property of NIR-absorbing polymers in channel layer for attaining high sensitivity NIR PTs, (2) realizing NIR light absorption enhancement in photodetectors with photonic structures, and (3) extending the work to study polymer blend systems, perovskite, and their combination for achieving high performing NIR photo detection. The team has accomplished these tasks successfully. The achievements of the project are highlighted below: (1) Achieving high charge transport property of NIR-absorbing polymers in channel layer for attaining high sensitivity NIR PTs The photoresponsivity of PTs can be tuned by controlling the gate bias. In our work, the effect of charge carrier manipulation on performance enhancement of UV-visible-NIR PTs with an organo-lead halide perovskite/polymer heterojunction channel has been proposed and demonstrated. Compared to the performance of the polymer PTs, the PTs with a perovskite/polymer heterojunction channel exhibit a desired broadband enhancement in photoresponsivity over the wavelength range from UV to NIR. The improved performance in the heterojunction PTs is closely associated with the efficient charge separation and transfer between the perovskite and polymer functional layers in the heterojunction. At the off state, the conduction of the holes in the polymer channel is suppressed due to the absence of the holes in the channel, caused by the positive gate voltage in PTs. The high conduction of the holes in the heterojunction PTs is realized via the perovskite layer in the perovskite/polymer heterojunction, acting as an effective channel. Therefore, the photo responsivity of the heterojunction PTs is greatly enhanced, enabled by the high light absorption in the perovskite layer. While at the on state, the holes present near the vicinity of the polymer/dielectric interface, induced by the negative gate voltage in the PTs, can be transported effectively in the polymer channel. We found that the use of a bi-layer perovskite/polymer configuration helps to enhance the NIR detection, due to the efficient charge separation at the bi-layer perovskite/polymer heterojunction interface. With the success in developing the bi-layer perovskite/polymer PTs, the enhancement in NIR detection has been realized through incorporating a bulk heterojunction (BHJ) channel in the PTs. The BHJ channel was formed by blending NIR sensitive polymer donor DPP-DTT with different acceptor materials of PC60BM, PC70BM and ITIC for enhancing exciton dissociation and charge separation efficiency. The efficient exciton dissociation helps to boost the utilization of the photo generated excitons, and thereby improves the photo current. The acceptor material has much higher electron affinity as compared to that in the donor material, trapping the electrons in the acceptor domain. The electron trapping results in a longer lifetime of the minority carriers, leading to an enhanced photoconduction gain. In the meantime, the accumulation of the negative charges near the electrode helps the hole injection to the polymer channel, thereby further improving the photon to current conversion efficiency. As a consequence, the photo responsivity and sensitivity of the PTs with a BHJ channel, e.g., using one of the three D/A blend systems, outperformed that of the PTs having a donor polymer channel. (2) Realizing NIR light absorption enhancement in photodetectors with photonic structures The enhancement of the photoresponsivity of the photodetectors has been attempted through incorporation of the photonic structures in the photoactive layer. A periodic nano-grating PEDOT:PSS hole transporting layer (HTL), formed by the nano-imprinting method, has been adopted for enhancing the photo responsivity of the photodetectors. Incorporation of nano-grating in photodetectors helps to guide and redistribute the incident light to retain higher light intensity in the active layer even at a larger angle. The simulation reveals that the use of the periodic nano-grating HTL helps to improve light absorption in the active layer, caused by the enhanced light in-coupling effect. The enlarged contact area between HTL and photoactive layer in photonic-structured devices favors charge separation and transfer, thus reduces the transient photoresponse. The nano-grating HTL based photodetectors have high photo detection under a wide-angle range of incident light, due to the enhanced light absorption through in-coupling effect enabled by the photonic structures in the photodetectors. The absorption enhancement in the nano-grating based photodetectors is not dependent on the polarization of the incident light. The photonic-structured photodetectors have weak angular dependency as compared to that of the planar control photodetector. The nano-grating-based photodetectors enable an obvious improvement in photo responsivity due to an omnidirectional light absorption enhancement in the active layer. The use of photonic structures in photodetectors has the advantage for enhancing light absorption without necessary of adopting a thick photoactive layer, paving their way for potential applications in low-cost large area broadband light detection devices. (3) Extending the work to study polymer blend systems, perovskite, and their combination for achieving high performing NIR photodetection The existing commercially available III-V compound semiconductor and Si-based PDs are broadband photodetector devices. They require dedicated filters to achieve photodetection in specific spectrum window for different applications, with the limitation for use in large-area detection devices. In comparison with theses semiconductor-based NIR photodetector technology, perovskite/polymer heterojunction PDs provide an attractive option for large-area PDs, due to their solution fabrication processes, flexible design and adaptivity to the manufacturability. With the progresses made in achieving the performance of the broadband detection PTs and the PDs, we extended the work to study the perovskite/polymer heterojunction structures for realizing the filter-free spectral selective NIR photodetection. The polymer layer in heterojunction acts as a visible light depletion layer. The spectral selectivity NIR light detection can be obtained by tailoring the bandgap of the perovskites and adjusting the spectral response of the perovskite/polymer heterojunctions in the NIR PDs. In the solution-processable heterojunction PDs, the NIR spectral response window, determined by the transmission cutoff wavelength of the polymer layer and the absorbing edge of the perovskite layer. We have analyzed the performance of the solution-processable perovskite/polymer heterojunction PDs through structural modifications and device engineering. The distinct visible-blind NIR photodetection behaviors in the perovskite/polymer heterojunction photodetectors have been investigated. The narrowband NIR response in the heterojunction photodetectors is realized through the buildup of the space charges at the perovskite/polymer interface. The semiconducting perovskite layer acts as an internal NIR bandpass due to its high absorption to the visible light and high transparency to the NIR light. It also acts as an excellent hole-transporting layer, facilitating the efficient extraction of the holes generated in the low band gap NIR light-absorbing polymer blend layer. The heterojunction PDs thus demonstrated have a -3 dB cutoff frequency of 300 kHz, providing an exciting option for a plethora of applications in bioimaging, environmental detection, and security monitoring. This project has attracted two PhD students to do research in area of photodetectors with partial financial support by this project. We have published 12 high impact journal publications in the field and also filed one patent application on developing multi-mode photodetectors. This project completed successfully.

12302817.label: Major findings and research outcome
12302817.value: We have demonstrated that the use of a bi-layer channel in PTs enabling the charge separation and transfer processes at the interface of two channels is responsible for the enhancement in photoresponsivity and photosensitivity in PTs. The bi-layer channel PTs exhibit a broadband light detection from UV to NIR, taking advantages of the excellent light absorption of perovskite in the UV-visible range and polymer in the NIR region. The transient photoresponse in the bi-layer channel PTs is much faster as compared to the control PT with a pristine polymer channel. These promising characteristics indicate the importance of carrier behaviors including charge separation and transport inside the device and their impacts on device performance [Part C, publications 3, 4, 5]. An NIR-visible up-conversion device is demonstrated for pixel-less NIR imaging enabled by NIR light induced carrier injection. The up-conversion device, capable of converting the NIR light to visible light, is accomplished by the monolithically integration of a highly sensitive transparent NIR photodetector with a visible light emitting unit. The results reveal the importance of the NIR sensitive unit in achieving high on-off ratio, controlled by the NIR light induced carrier injection to the light emission unit. It is found that the efficient NIR photon to visible photon up-conversion efficiency can be realized by a combination of high NIR induced charge injection to the visible light emitting unit and enhanced visible light out-coupling through the NIR sensitive bulk heterojunction [Part C, publications 1, 2, 7, 8, 11] The rapid advancement of the solution-processable semiconductors offers an exciting opportunity for the development of spectral selective photodetectors. The development of PDs has attracted tremendous interests because of the tailored optoelectronic properties of the semiconductors and the solution fabrication processes. In addition to the progresses made in the bi-layer PTs and PDs, we have extended the work to explore spectral selective PDs. The correlation between the optical profile and the responsivity of the bias-switchable spectral selective PDs has been investigated. The filter-free spectral selective PDs have been demonstrated through managing the optical profile in the bilayer and multilayer photoactive layer [Part C, publications 6. 9, 10, 12].

12302817.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12302817.value: There are tremendous opportunities for the development and applications of solution-processable novel spectral selective photodetectors. The development of filter-free spectral selective photodetectors is an attractive research direction. Considerable research effort on visible blind NIR PDs will be carried out through theoretical simulation, experimental optimization and use of newly developed low bandgap perovskites and polymers that response to the longer wavelength range. The driving voltage of the perovskite/polymer heterojunction NIR PDs will be examined through interfacial engineering and optimizing perovskite/polymer, perovskite/perovskite, and polymer/electrode interfacial properties and material combinations. The perovskite/polymer heterojunction with well-defined spectral responses extending over the long wavelength ranges will be adopted for use in the NIR PDs. The further development of the research work relates to a high performing spectral tunable NIR PDs, realizing visible/NIR dual-mode PDs, including mechanistic study of the noise in spectral selective PDs and develop different noise reduction methods. The filter-free spectral selective NIR PDs will have a plethora of applications in bioimaging, artificial vision, artificial intelligence, security, and environmental monitoring. We anticipate that the accomplishment of this project provides an exciting opportunity for the development of new NIR PD technologies and applications.

12302817.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12302817.value: Solution processable NIR photodetectors remove the limitations of traditional wafer-based inorganic semiconductor techniques, providing an attractive device fabrication approach due to their low cost, flexible design, adaptability to various fabrications, and large area manufacturability. In this project, a comprehensive research on the development of solution-processable high-performance NIR photodetectors has been carried, through improved chemical processing routes, enhanced fabrication techniques, structural modifications, and device engineering. PDs have a stack of functional layers sandwiched between an anode and a cathode, whereas NIR PTs are three-terminal devices having an external quantum efficiency in excess of 100% and a high-sensitivity. The solution-processable high-performance NIR photodetectors with a perovskite/polymer heterojunction and a nano-grating active layer have been demonstrated. The accomplishments of this project provide a solid foundation for further development of filter-free spectral tunable photodetectors. The NIR photodetector technologies developed in this project have a plethora of applications in image sensors, light communication, wellness and security monitoring, artificial intelligence, environmental detection, and Internet-of-Things (IoTs).

12302917.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302917.value: Research on deep-sea chemosynthetic ecosystems including hydrothermal vents and cold seeps has advanced our understanding of the formation of mineral resources, origin of life, and biological adaptations in extreme environments. Nevertheless, for many macrobenthic organisms in chemosynthetic ecosystems, their phylogeography – the processes responsible for the contemporary geographic distributions – has not been studied. Given the intensified threats of human activities such as trawling and mining, it is imperative to study their phylogeography to enable scientific basis of management of these deep-sea resources. The discovery of two cold seeps in the South China Sea has provided us a unique opportunity to study their phylogeographic position, specifically the connectivity of their macrobenthos with other known populations in the subtropical to temperate Northwestern Pacific. As a large marginal sea, the South China Sea can potentially act as a source and/or sink of larvae for other regions. Previous phylogeographic studies of deep-sea animals have mainly relied on DNA sequences from one to several genes, which suffer from the lack of sensitivity required to resolve their fine genetic structure, especially for animals with a long pelagic larval period. We propose a highly sensitive approach to study the genetic connectivity between chemosynthetic ecosystems in the South China Sea and other regions of the subtropical to temperate Northwestern Pacific. Specifically, we will use a genome-wide restriction site–associated DNA genotyping method to analyze the genetic make-up of four species of representative macrobenthos (1 species of mussel, 1 species of limpet, and 2 species of squat lobsters). These animals have contrasting life-history strategies that are known to influence genetic structure. Using these data, we will calculate the amount of genetic exchange between populations, determine the source/sink of these populations, trace the history of their population expansion, and determine the genes and genomic regions that may have undergone positive selection. Our study will unveil the position of the South China Sea in the subtropical to temperate Northwestern Pacific chemosynthesis-based ecosystems, and contribute to the designation of a global network of chemosynthetic ecosystem reserves in the deep-sea. 本研究採用全基因組限制位點相關DNA基因分型方法，對亞熱帶到溫帶西北太平洋化學合成的生態系統中的大型底棲動物進行系統地理學研究。擬採集若干種具有不同生活史的大型底棲動物，探討種群間的基因流，確定種群的源與匯，追蹤種群擴張史，並確定種群間受到正向選擇的基因。

12302917.label: Major findings and research outcome
12302917.value: This project aimed to understand the phylogeography of macrobenthos in the chemosynthesis-based ecosystems of the subtropical to temperate Northwestern Pacific Ocean. Based on the deep-sea mussel, limpet and squat lobster samples we collected before and during the project implementation, we were able to complete all the proposed work. Overall, we found that the dispersal patterns of the deep-sea animals are affected by life-history characteristics, geographical barriers and ocean currents. The Luzon Strait is an effective barrier restricting the gene flow between the South China Sea and Okinawa Trough for squat lobsters whose larvae have very limited dispersal ability. However, it is not effective in restricting the dispersal of deep-sea mussels whose larvae can take advantage of the fast Kuroshio Current, resulting in an almost panmixia of the populations that are widely distributed across a large distance of ~ 3000 km. Deep-sea limpets exhibited habitat-linked genetic groups (i.e., one vent and three seep groups), with the vent group established via the invasion of a few individuals from a nearby seep group. Physical ocean modelling revealed the roles of seafloor topography and ocean currents in shaping the genetic connectivity, contemporary migration, and local hybridization of these deep-sea limpets. We also discovered and described a new species of deep-sea mussel and a species of giant clam, and provided a detailed description of a cold-seep fauna in the South China Sea, and found that a species of deep-sea gastropod has a remarkable wide distribution from The South China Sea to east Africa.

12302917.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12302917.value: During this study, we joined two research cruises. During these cruises, we collected a lot of samples, which led to the discovery of a new mussel species and a new tubeworm species. We discovered that the tubeworm samples represent a good model to study animal-bacteria symbiosis. Based on preliminary results, we proposed another study, which has recently funded by UGC/GRF. We have also secured a grants from mainland China to conducted related research. In short, this UGC/GRF project has allowed us to venture deeper in our study of deep-sea biology.

Deep-sea limpets exhibited habitat-linked genetic groups (i.e., one vent and three seep groups), with the vent group established via the invasion of a few individuals from a nearby seep group. 12303017.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303017.value: 人工代糖安賽蜜作為食品添加劑，其日常使用非常廣泛。它的化學結構十分穩定，難以經一般生活污水處理過程降解，可直接進入環境中造成持久性污染。與其它種類的人工代糖相比，安賽蜜以其最高的全球環境檢出率而引起高度關注。雖有報道指出，安賽蜜可被一些高強度的化學消毒處理手段（如紫外光解、氯化、氯胺和臭氧化等工藝）降解，但這些方法仍然存在很大的問題。有的反應效率低，不能完全降解安賽蜜；有的在降解過程中產生的消毒副產物或可控副產物/含氮副產物的毒性比安賽蜜本身毒性更強（例如產生致癌的二甲基亞硝胺副產物）。基於臭氧/過氧化氫的高級氧化工藝，即在氧化工程中使用臭氧及過氧化氫，已在歐洲（法國、義大利、希臘和瑞士）、亞洲（中國和日本）、美國及澳大利亞等地被廣泛使用和認可，将有望成為去除安賽蜜的有效途徑。然而，將臭氧/過氧化氫氧化工藝用於安賽蜜的降解，安賽蜜在氧化過程中是否會產生毒性更強的副產物是一個亟待解決的問題。至今，安賽蜜臭氧/過氧化氫消毒降解產物的環境行爲以及由此引發的環境影響仍處於空白。我們開展的初步實驗結果表明，安賽蜜經臭氧/過氧化氫消毒處理後分子結構發生漸進式改變，不僅檢測到目前已知的降解副產物，還發現了未知的降解副產物。因此，開展有關臭氧/過氧化氫氧化工藝降解安賽蜜的化學原理以及評估降解產物的生物毒性的研究對於建立安全有效的飲用水處理系統已經刻不容緩。 本項目擬追蹤安賽蜜在臭氧/過氧化氫處理後的化學結構轉化並評估轉化產物的生物毒性。首先，利用先進分析儀器（色譜-質譜聯用技術等）依次鑒定安賽蜜降解副產物的化學結構，以闡明安賽蜜經臭氧/過氧化氫氧化的降解機理。將詳細考察關鍵因素對氧化過程的影響，如過氧化氫含量、起始酸堿值以及叔丁醇的影響等。其次，將建立生物實驗綜合評估安賽蜜降解副產物的生物毒性，探究其是否對飲用水構成安全隱患。最後，在實際污水處理系統以及居民飲用水中監測安賽蜜降解副產物是否真實存在，驗證臭氧/過氧化氫處理能否在實際水樣中有效降解安賽蜜。 本項目針對安賽蜜這一持續性污染物開展其消毒降解新工藝以及其降解產物的毒性評估研究，具有十分重要的學術意義和現實意義。本研究所獲得的化學及毒理學的數據不僅將為安賽蜜在臭氧/過氧化氫消毒處理過程中可能產生的轉化以及相關的生物影響奠定堅實的科學基礎，而且會為“水”-這一重要資源的可持續發展和水消毒處理過程提供有價值的化學設計方案和方法。

12303017.label: Realisation of objectives
12303017.value: The stated project objectives have been completely and satisfactorily achieved. Laboratory simulation experiments revealed that acesulfame (ACE) were degraded and transformed to different transformation products (TPs) under the peroxone process, and were much more effective than conventional ozonation. By using the UHPLC-QTOF-MS, the suite of ACE TPs generated under the peroxone process were isolated and analyzed. Among the fifteen TPs observed, four TPs were firstly reported. Based on the molecular data obtained, the TPs’ molecular structures and transformation pathways were proposed. (refer to our published paper Chemosphere 221 (2019) 647 for details). (Objective #1) Next, the influence of peroxide dosage, initial pH and the presence of tert-butyl alcohol in the transformation of ACE under the peroxone process was investigated. It was found that the amount of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2), pH and water matrix shown to exert a significant influence on the degradation of ACE. In brief, while the addition of hydrogen peroxide can enhance the degradation of ACE through generation of more hydroxyl radical (•OH), an excess of H2O2 causes an inhibition effect. As for the pH effect, the degradation of ACE under the peroxone process will be more favorable at an alkaline pH. The significant inhibition of ACE degradation after addition of t-BuOH as •OH scavenger suggested that •OH is contributing more significantly than O3 to ACE degradation in the peroxone process. The performance of the peroxone process were further evaluated in different water matrices, in which the removal of ACE was significantly enhanced by the peroxone process as compared to ozonation. (Objective #2) Ecotoxicity test using Vibrio fischeri bioluminescence inhibition assay was studied on the suite of TPs generated by the peroxone process. An initial higher toxicity for those generated TP than the parent compound was observed. However, when the treatment process proceed, the acute toxicity decreased gradually to a level similar to the parent compound. This suggest that, unlike the other treatments, such as photolysis/photocatalysis, chlorination and/or permanganate oxidation, which typically generate TPs of even more toxic than ACE, the complete degradation of ACE upon the peroxone treatment actually generate less toxic TPs. (Objective #3)

12303017.label: Major findings and research outcome
12303017.value: In the present study, the impact of peroxone (O3/H2O2) oxidation on acesulfame (ACE) transformation was studied to assess the potential environmental and health risk associated with the degradation of ACE during water treatment. Laboratory simulation experiments revealed that ACE are degraded and transformed to different transformation products (TPs) under the peroxone process, and were much more effective than conventional ozonation. The reaction kinetics of ACE degradation was thoroughly studied on the amount of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) used, pH values and water matrix influences. Last but not the least, the ecotoxicity of generated TPs was assessed using luminescence bacteria. Combining the effect of treatment conditions, the elucidated transformation pathways, as well as the toxicity change upon peroxone treatment of ACE, these results suggest that the peroxone process appears to be one of the viable choices for safe removal of ACE. A research article addressing the above important findings were published in Chemosphere 221 (2019) 647. With the successful development of UHPLC-MS/MS and UHPLC-QTOF-MS analysis platform, the application was further extended to the determination of micropollutants in extreme trace levels. Two additional related publications using this platform for analysis were published in Water Research 187 (2020) 116419 and Environmental Pollution 286 (2021) 117551.

12303017.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12303017.value: The present study provided critical knowledge on the transformation fate of ACE upon ozone-based advanced oxidation process (O3/H2O2). As observed, upon continuous peroxone treatment, the suite of TPs generated will have the acute toxicity reduced to a level close to the parent compound (i.e., ACE). Further studies on the toxicity driver among the suite of TPs generated must be conducted in order to comprehensively assess the potential hazards of these chemicals to the environment. In addition, a systematic evaluation of applying other oxidants for different ozone-based advanced oxidation processes that may affect the transformation fate and the toxicity outcome of micropollutants has been planned – which allowed the comprehensive elucidation on the impact of different oxidants to the ozone-based advanced oxidation processes for micropollutants abatement. The ultimate goal of these studies will serve as the important basis for developing new water treatment technique that can remove micropollutants and their corresponding toxic TPs in a safe and effective manner.

12303017.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12303017.value: Acesulfame (ACE), as one of the most widely occurred artificial sweeteners, has raised attention to a potential global water contamination crisis due to its significant usage in foodstuffs and consumer products. From our present research data, it is revealed that ACE will be transformed in the presence of peroxone process, an ozone-based advanced water treatment technique. During this treatment process, ACE will be transformed into a suite of transformation products (TPs), in which some of the TPs are unique to the peroxone process. According to toxicity assessment, the generated suite of TPs were initially raised in toxicity, however, with prolonged treatment the toxicity level reduced. These findings suggested that the peroxone process might be a suitable water treatment technique to safely treat micropollutants that ubiquitously occurred in our drinking water. The entire set of transformation pathways, mechanisms and toxicity data will guide future research for further comprehensive risk assessment, as well as development of a better and safer water treatment technique to safeguard both our precious water resources and human health.

12303217.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303217.value: 光的自旋-軌道角動量為資訊編碼,經典的和量子的通訊、成像和 頻率轉換提供了重要的自由度。 因此,在光學領域中,控制激光光 源的自旋和軌道角動量是人們迫切想要實現的技術之一。 在宏觀 的激光系統中,光的自旋-軌道角動量能夠利用傳統光學方法實現 操控。 然而,傳統光學無法滿足晶片集成對器件尺寸的要求,從而 限制了激光光源的小型化。 光學超構表面的快速發展,為此提供 了新穎的解決方案。 光學超構表面是由空間變化的納米結構陣列 構成的結構化表面。 該項目旨在通過在光泵浦的有機激光器中集成超薄的介質超構表 面,使產生的鐳射具有自旋控制的軌道角動量。 光學超構表面是 由空間變化的亞波長尺寸的結構陣列構成的結構化表面。 介質超 構表面有兩個優勢,一方面自旋控制的介質超構表面相當於一個 圓偏振光分束器,能夠有效地將圓偏振光和非偏振光同時投射到 一級衍射和零級衍射;另一方面,在石英基底上加工的介質超構表 面能夠在微型激光設備上同時實現對自旋和軌道角動量的控制。 在該專案中,首先設計一種介質超構表面,使其在光泵浦的有機半導體激光器的可見光波段具有調控圓偏振特性的功能。 我們在光泵浦的有機激光器方面有多年的研究經驗,可以靈活地設計小型化的激光器。 然後,將介質超構表面集成到分佈回饋式的法布裡—珀羅腔有機激光器中實現小型化的晶片上的渦旋光的產生。 該專案的成功實施將為光學薄膜有機激光器實現晶片上的激光波前控制開闢新的途徑

12303517.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303517.value: 沿海城市受到不同類型的洪水事件威脅，例如由大量上游河道來水導致的河道洪水，由本地暴雨導致的雨洪，由風暴潮引起的海岸洪水。在特定的天氣條件下（如鋒面系統和颱風），不同類型的洪水可能同時或連續發生，在低窪地區引起比單類型洪水更嚴重的社會、經濟及環境後果。因此，研究多災害風險管理應對這種複合洪水事件對城市管理具有重要性。近年針對複合洪水的研究越來越多，但主要局限於歐美等地區，而在珠三角城市群的研究較少。珠三角城市群是中國人口最多、發展程度最高的城市帶之一，位於珠江流域下游及毗鄰南中國海，因此該地區時常受到河道洪水、雨洪和海岸洪水的侵襲，再加上近年的快速城市化、較低的城市排洪能力和更極端氣候，使得該地區不同類型洪水的風險增加。因此研究珠三角複合洪水的風險、變化及機制對於更好地適應未來氣候變化具有重要意義。本研究將建立高質量的河道徑流、降水和海平面數據庫，展開聯合風險分析估計珠三角聯合洪水事件的概率特徵及變化，通過分析不同類型洪水的天氣情況來探討這些極端事件的機制，並採用基於物理機制的水文模型和區域天氣模式來進行數值模擬討論土地利用變化對複合洪水的影響。本課題的研究目標包括：（1）評估珠三角由河道洪水、雨洪和海岸洪水構成的複合洪水風險；（2）估計氣候變化和城市化對複合洪水變化的影響；（3）探討複合洪水發生的機制。本課題的結果將有助於發展珠三角及沿海城市的多類型洪水管理與規劃。

12303517.label: Realisation of objectives
12303517.value: The project aims to investigate the risks, spatio-temporal evolutions, and physical mechanisms of compound floods from river discharge, localized precipitation and/or storm surge across the Pearl River Delta (PRD), China. The project has generated research findings that have scientific and practical significance to address three key questions: (1) what is the relationship between different flood hazards/drivers such as river discharge, localized precipitation, and storm surge, and its impact on compound flood risks? (2) how do different types of compound floods change under global warming? and (3) what are the physical mechanisms behind the occurrences and changes in compound floods? First, the research team identified and assessed compound flood hazards from multiple flood hazards/drivers based on long-term observations of precipitation, storm surge, and streamflow. The copula functions, which enable the isolations of dependency structure and marginal distributions of a multivariate distribution, were employed to construct the joint probability distribution between different flood hazards/drivers. We used the Kendall’s correlation coefficient τ to characterize the dependence between river discharge, precipitation, and storm surge. Since the extreme events are of interest, the dependences between extreme events defined using annual maxima and peak over threshold methods were estimated. A compound flood event was identified if two or more flood hazards/drivers exceed their high percentiles simultaneously or successively. Then, the empirical return period of compound floods was defined as the average waiting time between the observed compound flood events. The copula-based joint return periods were calculated based on the copula-based joint distribution with consideration of dependence between multiple flood hazards/drivers. The empirical and copula-based joint return periods were compared to better understand the joint risk of compound floods across the study area. Based on the socio-economic damage induced by tropical cyclones (TCs) in Hong Kong, we also evaluated the impact of compound floods on the society and economy. Second, the temporal evolution of different flood hazards/drivers and the co-occurrences of multiple extremes in the PRD were estimated. Considering that TCs are one of the most important extreme weather systems causing extreme precipitation and storm surge over the south coast of China, the trends of TC-induced localized rainfall totals during past decades were examined. The 90th percentiles were used to identify compound events when examining the temporal evolution of compound floods. The storm surge and precipitation data on the same calendar day were paired. A compound flood day was identified if the precipitation and storm surge on the same day exceeded the thresholds. The changes in the number of compound flood days were employed to represent the spatiotemporal evolution of the concurrent heavy precipitation and storm surge. The trends in the annual number of compound flood days were detected using the non-parametric Modified Mann-Kendall test. The Sen’s slope method was used to estimate the magnitude of the trend. The alternative thresholds of 85th and 95th percentiles were also used to identify the compound flood days to test the sensitivity of our results to the threshold selections. The precipitation under extreme storm surge (i.e., precipitation of days with storm surge exceeding the 90th percentile) and storm surge under extreme precipitation (i.e., the storm surge of days with precipitation exceeding the 90th percentile) were analyzed to examine the relationship between changes in compound floods, precipitation, and storm surge. The multivariate regression methodology was used to quantify the relative contributions of changes in precipitation and storm surge to the changes in the number of compound flood days. Third, we focused on the physical mechanisms of compound floods by analyzing the associated synoptic weather conditions, the impact of changing cyclone (i.e., TCs and extratropical cyclones [ETCs]) activities, and land-atmosphere interactions on compound flood hazards. To reveal the synoptic weather conditions associated with compound flood events, extreme precipitation without extreme storm surge, and extreme storm surge without extreme precipitation, we examined and compared the patterns of sea level pressure, wind field, and precipitable water content under these three types of extreme events. We also examined the meteorological drivers of changes in compound floods based on the changes in meteorological variables including precipitable water content, vertical wind shear, sea level pressure, and near-land wind speed. The changes in TC translation speed and its impacts on localized flood risk were examined based on both the observations and the simulations of Global Climate Models (GCMs). The Camargo and Zebiak algorithm was used to identify and track the TC tracks in the GCMs. This algorithm based on sea-level pressure, temperature at three pressure levels (850, 500, and 250 hPa), and winds at two pressure levels (850 and 250 hPa) is an objective method to search TCs in GCMs. To examine the possible linkage between climate change and the slowdown of TCs, we conducted a detection and attribution analysis using the optimal fingerprinting method based on the simulation outputs under (1) all external historical forcings combined (including anthropogenic and natural radiative), (2) natural forcing, and (3) the unforced preindustrial control runs of two GCMs (i.e., CSIRO-Mk3-6-0 and GDFL-ESM2M). The contributions of TCs/ETCs to compound floods were estimated as the ratio of the number of TC/ETC-induced compound floods to the total number of compound floods. To further estimate the impact of TCs/ETCs on the return periods of compound floods, the changes in return periods by removing TC/ETC-induced cases were estimated. Cyclones affect the return periods of compound floods by changing the dependence between precipitation and storm surge, the marginal distribution of precipitation, and the marginal distribution of storm surges. Therefore, the impact of each aspect of TCs/ETCs on compound flood was estimated by calculating the changes in return periods when changing only one of three factors at a time. We also conducted numerical experiments in the Weather Research and Forecasting model (WRF) to analyze the impacts of land-atmosphere interactions on extreme precipitation. The WRF3.9.1 was configured with three nested domains, including D01, D02, and D03, with resolutions of 27km, 9km and 3km, respectively. The extreme precipitation in different seasons and under various scenarios (e.g., different temperature levels) was simulated. The relationships of extreme precipitation with surface and atmospheric variables (e.g., soil moisture, latent heat, transpiration) in different numerical experiments were examined and analyzed.

12303517.label: Major findings and research outcome
12303517.value: Research findings of risk assessment, spatio-temporal evolutions, and physical mechanisms of compound floods from river discharge, localized precipitation and storm surge across the Pearl River Delta (PRD) have been produced. First, the risks of compound floods from multiple flood hazards/drivers have been comprehensively assessed. Lai et al. (2021a) identified the significant positive correlations between extreme precipitation and storm surges. The return periods of compound floods are < 2 years in most coastal areas of the world (the joint return period is 12 years if the marginal variables are independent). The analysis of social-economic damage triggered by tropical cyclones (TCs) in Hong Kong demonstrated that TCs that triggered compound floods are more destructive than those caused single hazards. Second, Lai et al. (2020) found a significant slowdown of TCs and inverse relationships between TC translation speeds and local rainfall totals over the coast of China. The slow-moving TCs are more likely to generate heavy rainfall of higher total amounts than fast-moving TCs. The study results of Li et al. (2020) show that climate change caused significant increases in fluvial flood peaks in the West River basin, and human activities significantly reduced the fluvial flood peaks in the East River basin. Lai et al. (2021b) found various trends in the annual number of compound flood days in different parts of the world. The increasing trends in precipitation under extreme storm surge and storm surge under extreme precipitation are found in most areas of the world, suggesting that more intense precipitation appeared when extreme storm surges occurred, and higher storm surge emerged when extreme precipitation occurred. Third, compound floods usually occur under meteorological patterns with deep low pressure, cyclonic wind, and abundant precipitable water content (Lai et al., 2021a). The changes in storm surge are likely driven by changes in sea level pressure and near-land winds, while the changes in precipitation are associated with the changes in precipitable water content and the convective activity (Lai et al., 2021b). Cyclones are the major triggers of compound floods. More than 80% of compound floods in East Asia are associated with TCs, while in mid and higher latitude areas, ETCs contribute to most compound floods (Lai et al., 2021a). Observations and numerical simulations showed that the intensity of precipitation extreme increases as temperature increases till a changing point. After that point, rising temperature causes decreases in extreme precipitation intensity.

12303517.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12303517.value: Coastal areas are frequently attacked by multiple flood hazards from river discharge, heavy precipitation, and storm surges. These multiple flood hazards are usually associated with cyclones. The flood risk faced by coastal populations is expected to increase in a warmer future climate due to the sea level rise and intensifying climate extremes. Scientific findings about the risk, spatio-temporal evolutions, and physical mechanisms of compound floods from river discharge, localized precipitation and storm surge across the Pearl River Delta have been generated in this project. These research findings can be potentially used for engineering design, flood risk management, and formulation of climate change adaptation strategies. The course of actions for the further potential development of our research includes: (1) reaching out to the public to introduce the concepts of compound flood risks and the impacts on our society based on the result findings; (2) sharing the research findings with professionals to enhance their awareness of compound floods in their works; and (3) extending the research to project the risk of compound floods for different levels of future warming, and to improve our understanding of the physical mechanisms of compound floods by further investigating the processes and interactions using hydrodynamic models.

12303517.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12303517.value: Coastal areas, including the Pearl River Delta, are under the threat of multiple flood hazards of river discharge, heavy precipitation, and extreme sea levels. During simultaneous or successive occurrences of two or more flood hazards/drivers, the interplay of the different types of extremes can exacerbate the impact to a greater extent than either of them in isolation. The risk, spatio-temporal evolutions, and physical mechanisms of compound floods from river discharge, localized precipitation and storm surge have been investigated in this project. The joint return periods of compound floods are shorter when the dependence between different flood hazards/drivers are considered. The results show higher risks of compound floods compared to previous studies in which different types of floods were treated as independent events. Our analysis based on observations and Global Climate Models shows that the slowing down of tropical cyclones can lead to higher flood risk over the coast of China by increasing local rainfall totals. We demonstrated that the meteorological patterns characterized by deep low pressure, cyclonic wind, and abundant precipitable water content are conducive to the occurrence of compound floods. The quantitative analysis shows that cyclones (i.e., tropical cyclones and extratropical cyclones) are the major triggers of compound floods.

12304117.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12304117.value: Phthalates are synthetic compounds that have been extensively used as plasticizers in various industrial and consumer products. Prenatal exposure to environmental endocrine disruptors (EDCs) may significantly increase the risk of various diseases and adverse birth outcome. Liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) is a powerful tool for the analysis of organic pollutants in environmental and biological samples. This project will develop MS-based methods and apply to investigate the possible influence of phthalates embryo exposure associated with adverse birth outcomes from endocrine disruption. The main research focuses include: (1) Development of a LC-Orbitrap MS (high resolution) method for the identification of phthalates in human urine; (2) Development of a rapid, sensitive and high-throughput method of UPLC-triple quadrupole MS for quantifying phthalates and metabolites in maternal urine samples; (3) Investigation of correlation of the phthalates exposure with birth outcome changes (birth weight, gestational age, etc). The differences among groups with various phthalate exposure levels, and groups of adverse birth outcomes vs controls will be compared. The correlation analysis among the urinary phthalate concentrations in pregnant women and adverse birth outcome cases such as premature delivery and low birth weight will be investigated. Comparisons of the determined level of phthalates in the maternal urine with the known birth outcome data may benefit better understanding on the influences of developmental programming induced by prenatal exposure to phthalates and other EDCs. This project may provide important information for further investigation of EDCs associated toxicity.

12304117.label: Realisation of objectives
12304117.value: We have accomplished the four objectives proposed in the project. Firstly, we utilized ultra-high performance liquid chromatography (UHPLC) coupled to high resolution mass spectrometry (MS) for identification of phthalates and their possible metabolites in human urine samples. Phthalates were identified from the information of chromatographic retention time, protonated or deprotonated molecular ions and MS/MS fragments. Structural identification of the phthalates and their metabolites were achieved from the interpretation of obtained data of accurate m/z values for the determination of elemental composition of both parent and the product ions from MS/MS analysis. Through the analysis of fragment ions and their elemental compositions, the MS/MS fragmentation pathways corresponding to the structural moieties in the molecule were explained. The detection of the phthalates in the human urine samples were ultimately confirmed with the analysis of authentic standards under the same conditions. Secondly, we developed a rapid, sensitive, and high-throughput method of UPLC-triple quadrupole MS for quantifying phthalates and metabolites in maternal urine samples. Sample preparation procedure were established for the extraction and cleanup of the urine sample matrix. We have also optimized chromatographic separation conditions (e.g., mobile phases and gradient program) and mass analyzer parameters (e.g., collision energy, sheath gas, aux flow, ion transfer tube temperature and vaporizer temperature). The analytical procedures were validated and applied for investigating maternal urine samples collected from case and control groups. Thirdly, we have analyzed and compared the results of maternal urine samples from controls and adverse birth outcome cases including low birth weight, preterm birth and small for gestational age. Maternal urinary phthalates levels were analyzed as categorical variables based on the tertile distribution of phthalates concentrations in the controls. The association between maternal exposure of phthalates and birth outcome information (such as birth weight, birth length and gestational age), the demographic data (e.g., maternal age at delivery), socioeconomic data (e.g., education, occupation, household income), and lifestyle factors (alcohol and tobacco exposure) were investigated. Unadjusted and creatinine-adjusted (or SG-adjusted) odds ratios (ORs) and their 95 % confidence intervals (CIs) were estimated comparing the lowest and highest tertile of phthalates levels to the medium tertile. Finally, we have investigated the correlation of urinary phthalates exposure and adverse birth outcomes. Here we defined the low birth weight for cases that mothers gave birth to a live singleton infant with birth weight less than 2500 g. Premature delivery (preterm birth) was defined as birth at less than 37 gestation weeks. The adverse birth outcomes cases (including premature delivery and low birth weight) vs controls were analyzed using multiple linear regression analyzes, which were adjusted for age, education, poverty level, alcohol consumption and smoking. Then we examined the effects of co-exposure to multiple phthalates using cumulative risk assessment.

12304117.label: Major findings and research outcome
12304117.value: This proposed project aims to interrogate the exposure levels, metabolism, and health risks of phthalates among pregnant women in Wuhan, China. Our established MS methods enabled identification and quantitation of series of phthalates, including diethyl (DEP), diisobutyl (DiBP), di-n-butyl (DnBP), di-(2-ethylhexyl) (DEHP), and benzyl butyl phthalate (BBzP) in maternal urine samples. We have calculated estimated the daily intake and hazard index of these contaminants. The results found that about 24.9% of participants were at health risks with hazard index > 1. The largest health risks were driven by one specific phthalate (DnBP or DEHP).We found that lower urinary levels of phthalate metabolites in winter. Elevated levels were also detected in mothers with higher education levels or those employed. In addition, mothers who got pregnant on purpose had lower phthalate concentrations than those got pregnant by accident. More recent exposure to phthalates was observed among groups of mothers giving birth to girls, or those who got excessive gestational weight gain. Our results also indicated that younger mothers were more susceptible to phthalate exposure. Taken together, our findings suggested that the intervention should be taken to limit application and production of DnBP and DEHP, and typical demographic factors should be taken into account in demographic studies.

12304117.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12304117.value: The protocols and methods developed for phthalates can be extended to the analysis of other endocrine disrupting chemicals (EDCs) and their disease-associated toxicity. The outcome of this research may be helpful for investigations of EDCs-induced diseases and study on toxicological mechanism. As an important application for further development of the research, we have measured the exposure levels of enzotriazoles (BTRs) and benzothiazoles (BTHs) in pregnant women and evaluate the potential health risks of these chemicals in relation to gestational diabetes mellitus. In addition, The outcome of this research may be helpful for investigations of EDCs-induced diseases and study on toxicological mechanism. It may provide useful information for investigating phthalates (and other EDCs) related diseases.

12304117.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12304117.value: Phthalates are synthetic compounds that have been extensively used as plasticizers in various industrial and consumer products. Prenatal environmental exposure to environmental endocrine disruptors may significantly increase the risk of various diseases and adverse birth outcome. In this study, we developed liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry methods for measurement of phthalates in maternal urine samples and investigate the possible influence of phthalates embryo exposure associated with adverse birth outcomes from endocrine disruption. The correlation analysis among the urinary phthalate concentrations among pregnant women and adverse birth outcome cases such as premature delivery and low birth weight were analyzed. Our results found that mothers who got pregnant on purpose had lower phthalate concentrations than those got pregnant by accident and younger mothers were more susceptible to phthalate exposure. These findings suggest that government intervention should be taken to limit application and production of phthalates, especially dibutyl phthalate and di-(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate.

12500117.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12500117.value: 銀行存款準備金率、資本管制與中國貨幣政策

12500117.label: Project Objectives
12500117.value: To build a coherent model of Chinese monetary policy under capital controls that incorporates bank reserve requirements together with the policy interest rate as monetary policy instruments. To study whether and to what extent the use of reserve requirement ratios as a policy instrument improves welfare in the steady state and over the business cycle. To explore the stabilisation role of reserve requirements as China undergo further exchange rate and capital account liberalisation.

12500117.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500117.value: 中國貨幣政策，相對於標準貨幣政策文獻，有兩大特色。其一、除了政策利率以外， 中國也用存款準備金比率作貨幣政策工具。其二、中國貨幣政策，受匯率和資本賬戶政策約束。在這些外在限制約束下，存款準備金比率是否最佳的貨幣政策工具？ 本文提議建立一個兩國動態隨機一般均衡(DSGE)模型 ，以研究中國貨幣政策。模型中將明確包含以上兩項特徵。在這模型中，中國視為半開放經濟體(Jeanne, 2013)，政府可在國際金融市場買賣資產，民間則不可。另外，銀行系統實行雙軌制。國企雖然生產效率較低，但可透過正規銀行貨款。正規銀行雖獲政府保證，但須繳付存款準備金。私人企業只能向非正規銀行借貸。決策者須選擇政策利率及存款準備金比率，為社會謀最大福利。 依據此理論，本文將研究，在穩定狀態及商業周期，使用存款準備金比率作為貨幣政策的優劣。存款準備金比率，應既有助穩定宏觀變量，又能改善國企與私企的分配效率。本文將推導訂立存款準備金比率的最佳法則，以及其對福利的影響。再者，本文會探討，當匯率及資本賬戶進一步自由化，中國還有沒有需要以存款準備金比率作貨幣政策工具。

12500117.label: Realisation of objectives
12500117.value: We build a two-country DSGE model of Chinese monetary policy. The model features two key novelties relative to the literature as stated in the research proposal. First, the model has a semi-open capital account. Following Chang et al. (2015), we model households who face high portfolio adjustment costs so they do not hold large amounts of foreign assets. This is a key feature of the Chinese economy. Second, the model has a dual-track banking structure with financial frictions. Following Chang et al. (2018), we assume SOEs and PEs borrow from commercial banks and shadow banks. Each of them are subject to financial frictions as in Bernanke, Gertler and Gilchrist (1999), in which each type of firms maximise their expected profits subject to a participation constraint of their respective banks, and taking into account the prospect of receiving a government bailout. They choose the funds intermediated and the contractual interest rates. The rest of the model is fairly standard. Homogenous utility maximizing households in China consume, supply labour and save by buying domestic bonds and depositing to banks. Profit maximising SOEs and PEs produce with capital and labour. Price-setting is subject to nominal rigidities a la Calvo (1983). Final goods are a mixture of Chinese and foreign production. We calibrate the model by using Chinese data and referring to other calibrated models in the literature. We set calibration targets regarding the SOEs and PEs, such as the relative productivity of SOEs and PEs, the share of capital used in these two sectors and their default rates to match empirical counterparts. We conduct steady-state analysis regarding the effects of varying the reserve requirement ratio (RRR), conditional on the calibration issues discussed above. We find that as RRR increases from 0% to 50%, the steady-state welfare shows a hump-shaped pattern, with the welfare maximised at some intermediate value of RRR, indicating that there are tradeoffs associated with high or low levels of RRR. Chang et al. (2018) show with a closed economy model that (1) a rise in RRR increases the cost of borrowing of commercial banks, leaving the shadow banks unaffected, which means that the less-productive SOEs will face a higher cost of fund. This shifts resources to the more productive PEs. This rebalancing improves overall productivity and is good for welfare; (2) for a similar reason, a rise in RRR increases default probability of the SOEs, which increases resources wasted through monitoring, which reduces welfare. By incorporating the semi-open economy feature of China, we introduce a novel, additional effect: (3) since required reserves pay interest, the central will hold more foreign exchange reserves in the steady state to fund these interest payments. The increased savings in the public sector can pay for more imported goods, which improves productivity of the Chinese economy. We then allow the RRR to be a cyclical instrument. Specifically we study a ‘policy rule’ for RRR so that it varies with the size of foreign assets and the domestic interest rate (both are indicators of sterilization costs). We approximate the model up to the second model and compute the unconditional welfare. Relative to an economy in which the RRR is held constant at its steady state, we find that the policy rule is welfare enhancing. By making RRR more responsive to fluctuation in the interest rate parity, the central bank guarantees itself higher flexibility in setting the policy rate, which makes it more effective in macroeconomic stabilization. To meet the third objective, we conduct an exercise to see what happens when the degree of capital control varies. Specifically, we assumed that households can purchase domestic and foreign assets, but there is a reduced-form portfolio adjustment cost when households rebalance their asset allocations. We proxy capital account liberalization as a reduction of the portfolio adjustment cost. We find that more liberalization improves welfare. The intuition is apparent. Suppose a productivity shock leads to domestic currency depreciation. This encourages the households to purchase more foreign assets in the portfolio. Their welfare would be more severely dampened given high portfolio adjustment cost or under tighter capital control policy.

12500117.label: Major findings and research outcome
12500117.value: We have built a two-country DSGE model of Chinese monetary policy. The model features two key novelties relative to the literature as stated in the research proposal. First, the model has a semi-open capital account, a key feature of the Chinese economy. Second, the model has a dual-track banking structure (following Song et al. (2012) and Chang et al. (2018)) with financial frictions, modelled using Bernanke, Gertler and Gilchrist (1999). The model is calibrated using Chinese data and referring to other calibrated models in the literature. Our first finding comes from the steady-state analysis, in which we investigate the effects of varying the reserve requirement ratio (RRR). By incorporating the semi-open economy feature of China, we show that RRR has a novel effect: since required reserves pay interest, the central will hold more foreign exchange reserves in the steady state to fund these interest payments. The increased savings in the public sector can pay for more imported goods, which improves productivity of the Chinese economy. Our second finding is related to using RRR to be a cyclical instrument. Specifically we study a ‘policy rule’ for RRR so that it varies with the size of foreign assets and the domestic interest rate (both are indicators of sterilization costs). Relative to an economy in which the RRR is held constant at its steady state, we find that the policy rule is welfare enhancing. By making RRR more responsive to fluctuation in the interest rate parity, the central bank guarantees itself higher flexibility in setting the policy rate, which makes it more effective in macroeconomic stabilization. Lastly, we find that more liberalization improves welfare. The intuition is apparent. Suppose a productivity shock leads to domestic currency depreciation. This encourages the households to purchase more foreign assets in the portfolio. Their welfare would be more severely dampened given high portfolio adjustment cost or under tighter capital control policy. We have presented the paper in a few conferences and received numerous helpful comments. We are preparing to submit the paper in decent macroeconomic journals.

12500117.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12500117.value: There are two areas which are interesting. One issue with the model is that it is large, so the channels is not obvious. One interesting extension is to write a simple analytical model to illustrate the argument clearly. It is not obvious how to do it because of the intricate nature of the Chinese economy, but it is worth pursuing. A second extension is the opposite. Given that we have built the apparatus to analyze the Chinese monetary policy regime, it would be interesting to conduct quantitative analysis with the model. To the best of my knowledge there is no structural estimation of the Chinese economy with an emphasis on its monetary policy regime. Available of data may be a major challenge.

12500117.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12500117.value: This research builds a medium-sized open-macroeconomic model with Chinese characteristics to shed light on the conduct of monetary policy in China. China’s monetary policy regime is interesting because it has multiple instruments and multiple objectives. In particular, bank reserve requirement is a frequently used monetary policy tool. The Peoples Bank of China (PBC) has adjusted bank reserve requirements for more than 40 times since 2003. Industry economists have long speculated that the PBC uses reserve requirement ratios instead of the more conventional nominal interest rate as policy tool because a rise in the interest rate would imply higher sterilization costs. Since early 2000s, the PBC has used sterilised interventions to mop up excess liquidity in the Chinese economy, which resulted in a sharp accumulation of foreign exchange reserves. We are the first to explicitly model these channels into the central bank balance sheet and incorporate it in a macroeconomic model. We find in our model that there is indeed welfare enhancement associated with using bank reserve requirements as a policy instrument. Furthermore, using bank reserve requirements as a cyclical tool can ease the policy rate’s burden on sterilization costs, which makes it more effective in inflation control.

12500217.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12500217.value: 創意樂趣或壓力？ 工作日常創意，情緒轉移及成效氛團

12500217.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500217.value: In this project, we develop and test hypotheses about how employees use short-term task choice at work to facilitate emotional recovery from two kinds of negative moods over the course of the workday. Specifically, we suggest that engaging in a creative task may help employees move from a high arousal negative mood (e.g., worried, frustrated) in the morning to a positive mood later in the day. We draw on literature suggesting that creative activities can be inherently enjoyable, result in solutions to worrisome problems, and distract individuals from ruminating on unpleasant situations. All of these mechanisms could result in an “affective shift” from negative to positive mood. However, when the initial negative mood is low in arousal (e.g., depressed, sad), the individual may not have the energy to successfully engage in creative activity and may find efforts to do so even more draining. In this case, an alternative and more effective means of mood repair might be to perform a routine and undemanding task, allowing a period of mental recovery leading to a more positive mood later in the day. We also suggest that organizational climate has the capacity to undermine the effectiveness of these mood recovery strategies. In particular, we focus on instrumental climate for creativity - climate perception that being creative is instrumental for maximizing self-interest (e.g., reward, recognition) at work. We suggest that this climate may “kill the joy” of engaging in creative activities as well as “reduce the relief” of engaging in routine tasks, making it more difficult for employees who experience a negative mood in the morning to shift to a positive mood in the afternoon. Our hypotheses will be tested via two field studies using experience sampling methodology. This method allows us to track mood and activity changes within the same employees over the course of five to ten working days and provides strong external validity. A subsequent laboratory study in which we manipulate mood, task, and climate will allow for causal conclusions and strong internal validity. Our results may inform employees about how to effectively manage their moods at work as well as provide advice to employers about the possible detrimental effects of an instrumental climate for creativity in increasingly stressful workplaces. The results extend our past research on linkages between mood and creativity, contribute to the literature on emotional well-being, and enhance understanding of the self-regulation of emotions in the workplace. 這項目研究員工如何在日間工作中經驗情緒的恢復 。我們認為投入具創意的工作任務能幫助員工從一天較早的負面心情（例如擔心，受挫）轉移到稍後的正面情緒。藉鑑文獻，我們認為具創意的活動本質上是喜樂的，並可分散個人在不愉快情況下的反復負面沉思。這些都可帶來情緒的恢復。然而，若早上的負面心情屬於低動能時（例如，憂愁，鬱悶），創意任務就不一定能帶來後來的情緒恢復和轉移。在這種情況下，投人一些常規和要求不高的任務更可緒恢負面心情。 此外，我們認為組織的氛團—成效氛團 — 能破壞這些情緒恢復策略的有效性。成效氛團使創意任務的成效與員工自親利益（例如獎勵，認可）綁在一起。我們認為成效氛團 能“盜取”創意任務帶來的樂趣，以及削減常規任務能帶來的緩解。這項研究以"經驗抽樣方法學"進行。 這項研究有助員工和管理人員更了解自我情緒調節的策略和組織氛團所帶來的影響，提高我們對職場情緒健康的認識和關注。

12501017.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12501017.value: The detrimental effects of organizational politics have been well documented. In our paper “Perceptions of organizational politics: A need satisfaction paradigm” published in Organizational Science 2014, a needs-based paradigm was identified to explain the negative effects of perceived organizational politics. In particular, comparing and contrasting the two predominant theoretical perspectives (i.e., the stressor and social exchange relationship paradigms) that have emerged to explain the destructive effects of organizational politics on employee outcomes, we found that they share a common basis – both are associated with satisfaction (or thwarting) of basic psychological needs at work. Across four independent empirical studies, we found evidence that the needs-based paradigm better accounted for the effects of organizational politics on employee work behavior over the stressor and exchange relationship paradigms. Our paper thus provided a unifying theoretical framework, one with considerable breadth and predictive power, to explain the effects of workplace politics on employee outcomes. In the current study, we extend the need satisfaction paradigm to explain a neglected phenomenon in this literature - the cross-level effects of organizational politics as a group-level phenomenon. At the team level, we propose that (a) political climate hinders performance through deterring team behavioral integration and (b) supervisor empowering leadership mitigates the negative effects of team political climate on team behavioral integration. At the individual level, we propose that (a) team political climate triggers individual team member’s counterproductive work behavior through diminishing his/her organizational identification and (b) supervisor empowering leadership serves as an antidote to reduce the negative effect of team political climate on member organizational identification. The underlying rationale is that team political climate interferes with the satisfaction of the three basic needs proposed by the need satisfaction paradigm (i.e., need for relatedness, competence and autonomy) and supervisor empowering leadership mitigates this negative effect because it alleviates the dissatisfaction of these three needs. This represents the first attempt examine the effect of team political climate on both team- and individual-level outcomes and processes, though prior research suggests that such research is necessary to fully comprehend the effects of workplace politics on employee and organizational outcomes. We plan to test our model with a multisource and longitudinal research design across multiple samples in different cultures. In sum, this study will contribute to the organizational politics literature by developing theory and utilizing a rigorous, multi-study research design to develop insight into effects of workplace politics as a group-level phenomenon. 組織政治的危害人所共知並已經被詳細記錄。2014年，我和我的合作者們在Organizational Science發表了一篇名爲《感知組織政治：需求滿足模型》的文章，在文中我們發展了一個名爲需求滿足的模型來解釋組織政治的負面影響。通過比較兩個最權威的解釋組織政治對員工毀滅性影響的理論視角（應激物模型和社會交換模型），我們發現它們有著一個共同的基礎 – 兩者都是關於對工作基本心理需求的滿足或阻礙。通過四個獨立的實證研究，我們發現需求滿足模型比應激物模型和社會交換模型更好地解釋組織政治對員工工作行爲的作用。因此，我們的文章對解釋職場政治對員工的影響提供了一個的有相當評估能力的統一的理論框架。 在目前這個研究裏，我們將進一步擴展需求滿足模型並將其用於解釋一個在文獻中被忽視的現象 – 組織政治作爲一個團隊層面的現象的跨層次作用。在團隊層面，我們假設1. 政治氛圍通過阻礙團隊行爲整合降低團隊績效；2. 主管的授權型領導緩和團隊政治氛圍對團隊行爲整合的負面作用。在個體層面，我們假設1. 團隊政治氛圍通過降低成員的組織認同引發成員的反生產工作行爲；2. 主管的授權型領導緩和團隊政治氛圍對成員組織認同的負面影響。這其中的原理是：根據需求滿足模型，團隊政治氛圍妨礙三個基本需求的滿足（自我相關性需求、自我效能需求、自決性需求），而主管的授權型領導能夠緩和這些不滿足感從而減輕團隊政治氛圍的負面影響。雖然學者們一直强調這個研究對全面理解職場政治對員工和組織的影響非常必須，遺憾的是這方面的研究卻是一片空白。本研究是探討團隊政治氛圍對團隊和個體作用以及中介的第一個嘗試，而且將會采用多源和不同文化的多樣本的縱貫性研究設計，因此將對組織政治作出重大貢獻。 ，

12501017.label: Realisation of objectives
12501017.value: Firstly, a theory-guided examination of the cross-level effects of team level political perception was conducted. Workplace politics is a group level phenomenon in nature (e. g., Chang, et al., 2009; Drory & Romm, 1990; Lucas, 1987). Although Maslyn et al. (1998) had studied the effect of group level politics on member organizational citizenship behaviors, and Darr and Johns (2004) had examined the discipline, department, and individual level antecedents of political climate level, group level or cross level investigation of organizational politics is lacking. Taking into account the prevalence of politics in organizational environment, it is very important to look at it as a group level phenomenon to see whether it has the same detrimental influence on both individual and work group, and at the same time figure out whether there is any contingent factor that can strengthen or weaken this negative effect at both levels. This study thus answers the call from organizational politics researchers and closes the gap in related literature, by looking at how the team politics operationalized as aggregated employee perceptions, influences workplace outcomes at both individual and team levels. Secondly, the need satisfaction paradigm of organizational politics was advanced and refined. The destructive effects of organizational politics have been well documented. In the paper “Perceptions of organizational politics: A need satisfaction paradigm” published in Organizational Science 2014, a needs-based paradigm was identified to explain the unfavorable effects of perceived organizational politics (Rosen et al., 2014). In particular, comparing and contrasting the two predominant theoretical perspectives (i.e., the stressor and social exchange relationship paradigms) that have emerged to explain the destructive effects of organizational politics on employee outcomes, it was found that they share a common basis – both are associated with satisfaction (or thwarting) of basic psychological needs at work. Across four independent empirical studies, evidence was found that the needs-based paradigm better accounted for the effects of organizational politics on employee work behavior over the stressor and exchange relationship paradigms. The need satisfaction paradigm thus provides a unifying theoretical framework, one with considerable breadth and predictive power, to explain the effects of workplace politics on employee outcomes. The current study builds upon recent workplace politics research by extending the need satisfaction paradigm to explain team-level perception of organizational politics and its cross-level effects, together with contingent and intervening variables. Thirdly, the mechanisms that link organizational politics to work outcomes were explored. In order to have a complete picture of the cross-level effect of team politics, it is necessary to find out a contingent factor that can influence how the team as well as the individual reacts to the politics within the group. Specifically, we (a) linked team politics with team performance and member counterproductive work behavior, (b) considered the role of team behavioral integration and organizational identification in mediating the effects of team politics on group (i.e., team performance) and individual behavioral outcomes. Fourthly, the moderating role of supervisor abusive supervision strengthening the negative effects of team politics was examined, thus proved that leaders play a critical role in influencing how politics in the workgroup exerts its impact. Accordingly, our study extends organizational politics literature which has mainly studied employees’ personal factors as the primary boundary condition of politics-outcome relationship. As the first attempt to explore the cross-level effect of team politics, the current study not only broadens our understanding of the concept itself but also fertilize work team research in various theoretical streams. Fifthly, given the detrimental cross-level effects of team politics on team and individual outcomes, how can organizations address these issues? I believe our findings are practically salient. Our research suggested that employees’ perceptions on team political environment negatively influence team performance through hindering the team to engage in mutual and collective interaction. Therefore, for teams seeking to boost the integrative ability of a team, politics should be avoided. Our study also confirmed the linkage between perceptions of team politics and individual member’s identification with the organization, which then causes their counterproductive work behaviors, indicating the need to build a politics-free working environment. Although it is almost impossible and unrealistic to avoid suffering from organizational politics, our findings yielded valuable recommendation for managers who intend to, and this recommendation is applicable at both team and individual levels. That is, managers should be aware of their abusive behaviors towards subordinates. In particular, employees will be more vulnerable to the adverse effect of team politics when they are ridiculed, told stupid, given silent treatment, put down in front of others, reminded of their past mistakes and failures, blamed, made negative comments about, treated rudely, told incompetent, and being lied to. The rationale is obvious – targets may attribute the unfairness treatment from the team leader to the team itself, which then strengthens their negative perceptions of the team especially when the team is with a high level of politics. The findings of the present article are furthermore practically important because abusive supervision was found to enhance the negative effect of team politics on both team and individual level outcomes. Our study thus provides a straightforward and explicit approach to solve the problem.
