14503317.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503317.value: Discrete univariate time-series models are used to model many dynamic economic and financial variables (such as equity returns, interest rates, unemployment rates, foreign exchange rates, and GDP series). In particular, the class of linear autoregressive moving-average (ARMA) processes has been reasonably successful as a practical tool for characterizing and forecasting these variables. However, many nonlinear time-series models have been proposed in the literature. Nonlinear time-series processes often have the advantage of being able to capture jumps, asymmetries, volatility clustering, and time irreversibility, which are “stylized” facts observed in many economic and financial time series. Recently, economic globalization and the advancement of computer technologies have accelerated the development of “big data” analysis. Many time-series data are collected automatically from the Internet and machine transactions at possibly mixed frequencies. The problem of temporal aggregation arises when time-series data are collected at a lower frequency than the data generation frequency of the underlying basic model. The resulting aggregated series, which contain less information, may lead to an erroneous view of the true model and flawed decisions. Therefore, it is important to study the effects of temporal aggregation and avoid making possibly improper decisions that are based on distorted information from the aggregated data. In the proposed study, we will probe the effects of temporal aggregation on some nonlinear time-series models. More specifically, we will study three types of nonlinear time-series models, namely, the Markov switching Gaussian (MSG) models, the bilinear (BL) model, and the self-exciting threshold autoregressive (SETAR) models. Various statistical tests for linearity in univariate time-series are available in the literature. It is well-known that temporal aggregation is inclined to simplify nonlinearity. In this study, we will consider three commonly used SETAR-type tests for nonlinearity. We will also conduct Monte Carlo experiments to compare the degrees of nonlinearity detected by these tests under the influence of temporal aggregation. In econometrics and statistics, it is important to distinguish between quantities that are flows and those that are stocks. Examples of flow variables include equity return and income time-series. Alternatively, stock variables, such as time-series of stock market indices, can only be measured at a specific point in time. Analogous to the temporal aggregation of flow variables, systematic sampling of stock variables is often of interest to analysts. In this study, we will extend the temporal aggregation results to the theme of systematic sampling. 近來，經濟全球化和計算機技術進步加快了“大數據”分析的發展。 許多時間序列數據是從互聯網自動收集的，並以可能混合的頻率進行機器交易。 當時間序列數據以比基礎模型頻率低的環境收集時，便可能出現依時性加總之問題。 依時性加總序列數據包含較少的信息，可能會導致對真實模型誤解並作出錯誤的決策。 因此，研究依時性加總的影響是重要之課題，避免決策者依賴基於依時性加總的失真數據。 在這研究項目中，我們將探討依時性加總對一些非線性時間序列模型的影響。 更具體地說，我們將研究三種類型的非線性時間序列模型，即馬爾科夫切換高斯（MSG）模型，雙線性（BL）模型和門限自回歸（SETAR）模型。 現今有大量文獻提供單變量時間序列線性度的各種統計檢驗。 眾所周知，依時性加總傾向於簡化非線性，將非線性模型誤定為線性。 在本研究中，我們將考慮三種常用的非線性SETAR型測試。 我們還將進行蒙特卡洛實驗，以比較這些測試在依時性加總影響下檢測到的非線性度。

14503517.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503517.value: What is the role of money in politics and vice versa? How do businesses and business owners take part in this process? We conduct empirical analyses using U.S. data partly because of the extensive disclosure requirements which make possible such an investigation, and also because it allows us to benchmark our findings against prior research using the same setting. In this research project, we plan to focus on the link between corporate contributions to political election campaigns and the subsequent receipt of government grants. Prior research documents a positive cross-sectional association between firms’ contributions to political campaigns and future abnormal returns. Despite the strong and robust positive association documented, one important and unresolved question is why only around 7% of all publicly traded firms in the US engage in these activities in any typical year. We hypothesize that simply contributing money to politicians is not enough, but another important factor to ensure the subsequent flows of benefits in this non-contractible arrangement is access to those politicians’ networks. We focus on the role played by venture capitalists (VCs) because they are powerful and well-connected financiers. Using data on political contributions and on awards of government grants, we will compare the campaign contributions of firms at several stages of their lifecycle: before and after going public, before and after VC investment (for VC-backed firms). We will also examine the likelihood of receiving government grants at the different lifecycle stages and we will investigate whether the presence of VC investors affects the patterns observed. 金錢與政治之間到底存在著怎樣的關係？企業和企業所有者又是如何參與其中的？ 在本研究中，我們關注於公司在政治競選活動中的捐贈以及隨後期獲得的政府補助。以往研究表明，公司在政治競選活動中的捐贈與未來的異常回報存在正向的橫截面關係。儘管該正相關關係顯著且穩健，但仍然存在一個重要且未解決的問題，即為什麼每年僅有大約7%的上市公司參與這些活動。儘管我們可以假定單純對政治家的金錢捐贈是不夠的，但是另一個重要因素是確保這些非契約協議中的利益在隨後期流入了政治家的網絡中。我們關注於風險投資者所發揮的作用，因為他們是更有實力且人脈廣泛的融資者。 採用美國政治捐贈和政府補助的數據，我們比較了公司在其生命週期不同階段的政治競選捐贈行為：包括公開上市前後和接受風險投資前後（對於收到風險投資的公司）。另外，我們還檢驗了公司在不同生命週期階段獲得政府補助的可能性，以及風險投資者的存在是否會影響上述結論。

14503917.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503917.value: Product bundling, a practice of including two or more products within a package, is commonly seen in a diverse range of industries, with examples including fast food (e.g., combo meals at McDonald's), telecommunication (e.g., cable TV and internet services), and technology and content (e.g., monthly plan of Netflix). The focus of this project is to develop quantitative models to study how different consumer behaviors impact the optimal product bundling and the corresponding pricing strategies. First, when a firm sells its products to strategic consumers who compare their inter-temporal utilities when making purchase decisions, how shall it set the product prices over time and which bundling strategy (i.e., pure components, pure bundling, mixed bundling) will give it the highest profit? Does correlation in consumer valuations make product bundling more or less effective in the dynamic setting? We study these questions by developing a two-product, two-period model and examine the firm's optimal pricing and bundling strategies when consumers' valuations of the products are either correlated or independent. Meanwhile, we investigate how price commitment strategy interacts with the bundling strategy in the presence of strategy consumers. Second, when consumers make purchase decision of a product based on its relative standing in the choice set, they may choose different products as the choice set changes. This behavior is called context-dependent preferences. As a firm's bundling strategy changes consumers' choice set, we study how consumers' context-dependent preferences affect the firm's bundling strategy in a competitive environment. Specifically, we will consider two firms, firm 1 and firm 2, where firm 1 (the focal firm) is a monopolist of one product while competing with firm 2 on another product. Firm 1 aims to determine the optimal bundling strategy and prices of its products to maximize the profit. After solving the equilibrium solutions, we will conduct comparative analysis with the case without context-dependent preferences. Moreover, we will discuss how the impact of such behavior changes as the competitive environment varies. The outcomes of this project will provide new insights and guidance on how firms shall design their bundling strategies when these behaviors are observed from their target customers. 產品捆綁銷售，把兩個或多個產品打包一起銷售，是一種在不同行業常見的促銷手段，如快餐業(如麥當勞的套餐產品)，電訊業（如有綫電視和網路打包服務)， 和技術和内容業（如Netflix的月度方案）。本項目的重點是建立定量的模型來研究不同的消費者行爲如何影響產品的捆綁和相應的定價策略。首先，儅一家企業面對會比較不同階段購買產品的效用的策略型消費者時，它應該如何設置產品價格和選擇產品的捆綁策略（產品作爲單一元件銷售，只有組合產品而沒有組合中的元件單獨出售，同時銷售組合產品和當中的元件）？在動態設置下，消費者對產品估值的相關性是否使得產品捆綁銷售更加有效？我們開發一個兩階段，兩個產品的模型對以上問題進行研究，著重審視儅消費者產品估值獨立及相關的情況下，企業的最優定價和產品捆綁策略。同時，我們將探究價格承諾策略如何與產品捆綁策略相互作用。其次，儅消費者基於產品在可選組合中的相對位置做出購買選擇時，他們往往做出不同的選擇儅可選組合發生變化時。這種行爲稱作場景依賴的偏好。由於一個企業的產品捆綁策略改變了消費者的可選組合，我們研究消費者的場景依賴的偏好如何在競爭的環境下影響企業的產品捆綁策略。具體來説，我們考慮兩家企業，公司1和公司2，公司1(主要研究的公司)在一個產品上處於壟斷地位同時和公司2在另一產品上競爭。公司1需要決定捆綁和定價策略從而最大化它的利潤。在解出均衡解之後，我們將和沒有場景依賴偏好的情況進行對比。而且，我們將討論此種行爲的影響如何隨競爭環境的變化而改變。本項目的產出將為企業，尤其是那些面臨有以上行爲的消費者群體，如何設計其產品捆綁策略提供新的洞察和指引。

14503917.label: Realisation of objectives
14503917.value: During the project period, the PI has conducted research closely following the project proposal and achieved the project objectives satisfactorily. There are two working papers and one published paper related to this project. In these papers, we develop and analyze quantitative product bundling models that incorporate consumer choice behavior, market competition, distribution channel structures, and other operational features. We derive optimal bundling and pricing strategies of firms and discuss the managerial insights. In the following, we provide some details on what we have done to achieve the project objectives. In paper “Add-On Pricing in a Distribution Channel,” we consider add-on pricing in a distribution channel where a retailer sells a base good and an add-on, supplied by two manufacturers respectively, to consumers. The retailer decides whether to sell the two products through either bundling or add-on pricing and set the corresponding retail prices. Each manufacturer, if independent of the retailer, sets the wholesale price. Under four channel structures differed by whether either manufacturer is independent of the retailer, we specify the scenario that is optimal for the retailer to adopt add-on pricing and show the contrasting impact from the two manufacturers. When all three firms are integrated, the retailer in general prefers add-on pricing to bundling when the cost of base good is low and the cost of add-on is high. Using this case as the benchmark, we show that add-on pricing is more (less) likely to be adopted when the add-on (base) manufacturer is independent, and add-on pricing is again more likely to be adopted when all three firms are independent. In addition to the demand smoothing effect of bundling, we identify two drivers from the supply side: the margin squeezing effect of bundling from the add-on manufacturer and the margin smoothing effect of bundling from the base manufacturer, where the former encourages add-on pricing whereas the latter discourages it. The interplay of these drivers largely influences the retailer's add-on strategy and renders the preceding results. Several extensions are discussed, including correlated base good and add-on valuations, alternate decision sequence, knowledgeable consumers (about add-on price), simultaneous offering of bundling and add-on pricing, and bilateral monopoly. We find the main insights are mostly robust to these extensions. Product bundling can change the consumer's choice set and affect the consumer's purchase decision when consumers have context-dependent preferences (CDPs). It is ex ante unclear how CDPs affect a firm's bundling decision. In paper “Bundling Strategy with Context-Dependent Preferences,” we investigate how consumers' CDPs affect the firm's optimal bundling strategy (pure-component selling, pure bundling or mixed bundling) in various competitive contexts. We first consider a market where firm 1 is a monopolist in product category A but competes with a higher-quality firm 2 in product category B, and then extend the model to a perfectly competitive category B (i.e., firm 2's product is priced at its marginal cost due to competition) and a monopoly category B (i.e., firm 1 is a monopolist in both categories). We highlight two interesting findings. First, consumers' CDPs can indeed change the firm's optimal bundling strategy. In the duopoly model, without CDPs, pure bundling is optimal if the firms are not very differentiated in category B; otherwise pure-component selling or mixed bundling is optimal. By contrast, with CDPs, pure-component selling is always dominated by mixed bundling, and either pure bundling or mixed bundling is optimal, depending on whether the context-dependence effect is large enough. The effect still holds when category B is perfectly competitive, so CDPs encourage firm 1 to introduce the bundle. Second, the context-dependence effect is reversed if firm 1 is a monopolist in both categories: CDPs make pure-component selling more profitable than pure bundling and mixed bundling, hence discouraging the introduction of the bundle. In the third paper titled “Multilocation Newsvendor Problem: Centralization and Inventory Pooling,” we study a multilocation newsvendor model with a retailer owning multiple retail stores, each of which is operated by a manager who decides the order quantity for filling random customer demand of a product. The store managers and the retailer are all risk-averse while the managers are more risk-averse than the retailer. We adopt conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) as the performance measure and consider two alternative strategies to improve the performance of the system. First, the retailer centralizes the ordering decisions. Second, the managers still decide the order quantity for their own store whereas their inventories are pooled together. We analyze and compare the optimal order quantities and the resulting CVaR values of the systems and study their comparative statistics. For centralization, we find that each store has a higher inventory level in the centralized system than in the decentralized system, and centralization brings positive benefits to the retailer as long as some store manager(s) is strictly more risk-averse than the retailer. When there is inventory pooling, the ordering decisions in the decentralized system depend on how the additional profit from pooling is allocated among the stores. We consider a weighted proportional allocation rule and characterize the Nash equilibrium of the resulting ordering game among the store managers. Our key finding is that as long as the store managers are sufficiently more risk-averse than the retailer or the demands are very heavy-tailed, inventory pooling brings less benefit than centralization. We further derive a lower bound on the value of centralization and two upper bounds on the value of inventory pooling. Finally, our analytical results are illustrated using a data set from an online retailer in China and various comparative statics are further examined via extensive numerical experiments. In summary, the objectives of the project have been successfully achieved.

14503917.label: Major findings and research outcome
14503917.value: The main research outcomes include two working papers and one published paper. We mainly summarize the main findings of the two working papers, which are more closely related to the project. In paper “Add-On Pricing in a Distribution Channel,” we consider a retailer sells a base good and an add-on, supplied by two manufacturers respectively, to consumers. The retailer decides whether to sell the two products through either bundling or add-on pricing. Under four channel structures differed by whether either manufacturer is independent of the retailer, we specify the scenario that is optimal for the retailer to adopt add-on pricing and show the contrasting impact from the two manufacturers. In addition to the well-known demand smoothing effect of bundling, we identify two drivers from the supply side: the margin squeezing effect of bundling from the add-on manufacturer and the margin smoothing effect of bundling from the base manufacturer, where the former encourages add-on pricing whereas the latter discourages it. The interplay of these drivers largely influences the retailer's add-on strategy. This paper is now under second round revision at Productions and Operations Management (POMS). In paper “Bundling Strategy with Context-Dependent Preferences,” we investigate how consumers' CDPs affect optimal bundling strategy (i.e., pure-component selling, pure bundling or mixed bundling) of firms selling products A and B in various competitive contexts. We highlight two interesting findings. First, consumers' CDPs can indeed change the firm's optimal bundling strategy. In the duopoly model, without CDPs, pure bundling is optimal if the firms are not very differentiated in category B; otherwise pure-component selling or mixed bundling is optimal. By contrast, with CDPs, pure-component selling is always dominated by mixed bundling, and either pure bundling or mixed bundling is optimal, depending on whether the context-dependence effect is large enough. Second, the context-dependence effect is reversed if the firm is a monopolist in both categories: CDPs make pure-component selling more profitable than pure bundling and mixed bundling, hence discouraging the introduction of the bundle. This paper is currently under revision and we plan to submit it to Journal of Marketing Research.

14504117.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14504117.value: While there is a consensus that media plays a positive role in capital markets by disseminating information, the effect of media in disseminating misinformation or biased information is not well understood. By investigating the effects of media in disseminating misinformation on capital markets, we attempt to broaden our understanding of the role of media in shaping firms’ information environment. The media has incentives to provide incomplete and biased information (Holstein 2008; Gurun and Butler 2012). It plays a significant role in disseminating misinformation to the public because news organizations typically pass on misinformation without adding value (Silverman 2015). Although misinforming by media has been a serious issue, little has been known about the economic consequences of the phenomenon. We aim to extend the literature by investigating whether and how press coverage of accounting disclosure is associated with firms’ mispricing. In order to test this, we examine how media disseminates non-GAAP earnings disclosed by managers. Investors view non-GAAP earnings to be the most value-relevant among earnings metrics (Bradshaw et al. 2016). In addition, prior literature identifies the motivation for informative and opportunistic use of non-GAAP earnings, allowing us to discern information from misinformation. Using informative vs. opportunistic non-GAAP earnings disclosure, we test whether investors under- or over-react to the announcements of non-GAAP earnings disclosure and whether media coverage influences investors’ mispricing. In this project, we attempt to examine the primary, unconditional effects of media’s role of broadcasting misinformation disclosed by managers. Our study will, therefore, contribute to the literature on the role of media as an information intermediary and may potentially lead to a call for market participants to verify information rather than naively rely on information disseminated by the business press. 現有研究表明新聞媒體因其資訊傳遞功能而在資本市場中發揮著積極作用。那麼，如若媒體傳遞了虛假資訊或有偏資訊，那麼又會對資本市場產生何種影響呢？本文通過探討新聞媒體虛假資訊傳遞對資本市場的影響，豐富了媒體在公司資訊環境中所扮演角色的相關研究。Holstein（2008）與Gurun et al.（2012）指出新聞媒體具有強烈動機向大眾提供不完全甚至是有偏的資訊。Silverman（2015）發現由於新聞機構通常向大眾傳遞並沒有增加任何價值的錯誤資訊，因此其在散播錯誤資訊中起到推波助瀾的角色。雖然媒體的虛假資訊傳遞現象已然成為一項非常嚴重的問題，但仍鮮有文獻較為系統地檢驗這一現象的經濟後果。本文致力於探究有關會計資訊披露的新聞報導是否以及如何影響到上市公司錯誤定價，以填補這一領域的研究空白。 為此，我們分析並探討了新聞媒體如何向大眾傳遞上市公司管理層所披露的non-GAAP（Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, 簡稱GAAP，一般公認會計原則）盈餘資訊。一般而言，投資者通常認為non-GAAP盈餘測度是最具價值相關性的盈餘度量方式（Bradshaw et al., 2016）。此外，以往研究將non-GAAP盈餘資訊的價值增量式披露與投機式披露區分開來，這使得我們能夠清楚辨別價值資訊與虛假資訊。通過使用價值增量式non-GAAP盈餘披露與投機式披露，我們檢驗了投資者對上市公司non-GAAP盈餘公告是否存在反應不足或者反應過度，以及媒體跟蹤報導是否顯著影響了投資者對公司的錯誤定價。 總之，本文試圖分析並檢驗新聞媒體在傳播管理層所披露的虛假資訊的過程中對資本市場最主要及非限定性的影響。本文的研究貢獻在於：拓展了媒體所扮演的資訊仲介角色的相關研究，同時呼籲市場參與者在做決策時要更加理性地辨別資訊真偽而不是天真地僅依賴於商業媒體所傳遞的資訊。

14504117.label: Realisation of objectives
14504117.value: The objective 1,2, 3 have been achieved. In terms of project objective 1, using aggressive non-GAAP earnings disclosure as a proxy for financial misinformation, we find a stronger initial market reaction to aggressive non-GAAP earnings when the business press covers non-GAAP earnings. However, this stronger initial market reaction to aggressive non-GAAP earnings subsequently reverses soon after the earnings announcement, consistent with media coverage exacerbating the mispricing of financial misinformation. In cross-sectional analyses, we further document that the mispricing is intensified for firms with low analyst coverage and institutional ownership. Our findings provide important new insights into the information dissemination role of the business press in capital markets. We expand the literature that examines the role of the business press in disseminating financial information to investors. The prior literature documents numerous positive effects associated with media coverage, including: reduced cost of capital and volatility (Kothari et al. 2009); reduced cash flow mispricing (Drake et al. 2014); quicker identification of accounting irregularities (Miller 2006); and reduced profits from insider trading (Dai et al. 2015). Bushee et al. (2010), who find that media coverage is associated with lower spreads and greater depths, conclude that “the press helps reduce information problems around earnings announcements.” Conversely, our findings show that information problems may be intensified the business press widely disseminates misleading financial information to investors. This new evidence provides an alternative view of the role that the media may play in price discovery and may be useful in developing a more complete theory of the media in financial markets, as recommended by Miller and Skinner (2015). With respect to Objective 2, we do not find evidence consistent with strategical use of media in disseminating opportunistic non-GAAP earnings. Given that our inability to find the supporting evidence is due to inappropriate research design and no such relation, we decided to not discuss this in the paper. With respect to Objective 3, our results suggest that media coverage intensifies the informational frictions associated with non-GAAP reporting and should be of particular interest to regulators, who continue to express concerns regarding the potentially misleading use of non-GAAP earnings (SEC 2018).

14504117.label: Major findings and research outcome
14504117.value: In our main analysis, we find that the short-window (-2, +2) investor response to non-GAAP quarterly earnings surprises is significantly positive, consistent with findings in the prior literature. However, this initial reaction is followed by a subsequent return reversal when there is media coverage of the non-GAAP earnings news, consistent with a market overreaction to non-GAAP disclosure when it is widely disseminated through the business press. More importantly, we find that investor mispricing of non-GAAP earnings news is entirely driven by opportunistic non-GAAP earnings disclosure, i.e., when non-GAAP earnings disclosure is used strategically to meet earnings forecasts that would otherwise be missed. These findings hold for both full news article as well as “flash news” headline dissemination and suggest that the business press plays a significant role in exacerbating mispricing associated with financial misinformation. In our cross-sectional tests, we examine whether market mispricing associated with business press coverage varies with characteristics of firms’ information environments. We find that the relationship between mispricing and business press coverage on non-GAAP earnings is significantly stronger for firms with low institutional ownership and with low analyst following, consistent with unsophisticated investors being more likely to misprice information contained in non-GAAP earnings. We further explore this issue by also examining the association of press coverage with abnormal trading volume. Following Blankespoor, deHaan, and Zhu (2018) and Bushee, Cedergren, and Michels (2019), we assume abnormal retail trading volume indicates trading activity by relatively less sophisticated investors and abnormal large trade volume indicates trading by relative more sophisticated investors. Our findings reveal that business press coverage of non-GAAP disclosures is significantly positively associated with abnormal retail trading volume, especially when non-GAAP earnings are more likely to be opportunistically biased upwards and potentially misleading to investors. In contrast, we find no association between business press coverage and abnormal large trade volume. These results are consistent with Bhattacharya et al. (2007), who find that individual investors are more likely to be misled by non-GAAP earnings than other investors. Our findings reveal that business press coverage further exacerbates this problem. In additional analysis, we control for potential selection bias related to the press’ decision to cover a particular non-GAAP earnings disclosure. Similar to Drake et al. (2014), we estimate a Heckman selection model of the determinants of non-GAAP press coverage using the independent variables in our main analyses with two instrumental variables added; the Inverse Mills Ratio is used as a control in our second stage regressions. We also use a propensity score matching procedure. Our findings are robust to both methods of addressing potential selection bias, indicating that our results are unlikely to be driven by unobservable factors correlated with the press coverage decision.

14505117.label: Project Objectives
14505117.value: By analyzing customers' selection history in this car sharing service, we aim to measure the degree of range anxiety that the drivers have on EVs and CE vehicles. We will then examine how different the behavioral characteristics are over these two technologies. We aim to analyze how drivers' range anxiety on EVs evolve over time. This will inform us about drivers' learning patterns. The quantified range anxiety enables us to make predictions, based on which we aim to assess the economic and environmental impact of the mass adoption of EVs. We will estimate the demand rate of the rental cars. By comparing the demand rates of EVs and CE vehicles, we plan to quantify the demand loss in the EV market. This will then be used to measure the customers' welfare loss due to their range anxiety on EVs. Our estimation results will enable us to perform important counterfactual analyses. We might be able to measure how the adoption rate or the welfare loss change if we alleviate the drivers' range anxiety on EVs by expediting their learning through, for example, educational campaigns.

14505117.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14505117.value: 近年來，汽車製造商和政府正在大力投資電動汽車（EV），以取代造成環境問題的傳統的內燃機（CE）車輛。最近的技術進步也使得電動汽車在經濟上更具吸引力。然而，儘管電動汽車具有經濟和環境優勢，我們仍然面臨著電動汽車廣泛使用的顯著阻礙 - 典型電動汽車的行駛範圍有限。有限的行駛範圍引起了潛在的司機的憂慮，阻止他們購買電動汽車。雖然現在電池容量有所改善，但研究表明，這種偏見的觀念仍然存在，對行業產生重大影響。因此，理解這種心理恐懼，又被稱為範圍焦慮，對大規模採用電動汽車的成功至關重要。 在這個項目中，使用汽車共享公司的珍貴數據，我們的目標是實證測量駕駛員對電動汽車的範圍焦慮。具體來說，我們使用離散選擇模型來結構性地估計是選擇附近的可用車輛還是走更遠的距離以選擇具有較高燃料水平的車輛來確保足夠的行駛範圍之間的權衡。從數據中，我們知道每個選定的汽車附近的所有可用汽車以及它們的燃油量。因此，駕駛員的範圍焦慮可以從他們的選擇歷史中被確定和量化。 我們使用簡單的選擇模型進行了初步分析，結果是有希望的。結果確實顯示了對電動汽車的顯著的範圍焦慮。平均而言，電動汽車用戶走他們使用CE車輛時路程的四倍至十倍，來獲得多1％行駛範圍。我們的研究結果進一步表明，即使進行很短的旅程，焦慮程度仍然很大。基於此，我們將進一步完善選擇模式和我們的估算策略。 量化電動汽車的範圍焦慮具有重要的管理意義。估計範圍焦慮可以在電動汽車製造商和決策者確定電池容量和對基礎設施進行投資時提供更多信息。我們還可以研究客戶的行為隨時間的變化，這將有助於我們更好地了解客戶的學習模式及其影響。最後，測量的焦慮將使我們能夠進行重要的反事實分析。總的來說，我們堅信這個項目將會對EV行業以及可持續經營的文獻做出重要貢獻。

14505117.label: Major findings and research outcome
14505117.value: Although Electric vehicles (EVs) are an important technology for curbing the carbon footprint of road transportation, mass adoption of EVs has yet to happen in major auto markets. Among the major short-comings of EVs on the market is the limited range and long recharging time, creating psychological concerns to drivers called range anxiety and making them reluctant to adopt EVs. In this work, using a novel data set collected from an on-demand car sharing system, we empirically identify and quantify the effect of a car’s effective driving range on its attractiveness to drivers on a single-trip basis, and contrast the ﬁndings for EVs with those for traditional combustion engine (CE) vehicles. We conduct three com-plementary econometric analyses i) to identify drivers’ aggregate preferences on fuel type; ii) to show that a key attribute that may account for such difference is the range; and iii) to quantify drivers’ prefer-ence for longer range by evaluating the trade-off between a car’s fuel level versus the cost of access. Our estimates suggest that EVs substantially decrease the service demand (by 20 25%) and the fuel level has a statistically signiﬁcant effect on the demand rate only for EVs–a 10% increase in fuel level enhances the probability of rental by up to 4% for an EV. Moreover, we find that drivers renting EVs are willing to walk up to forty times as far as they would do for CEs for the same amount of additional range even when they are making very short trips. These are signiﬁcant ﬁndings as they reveal that range anxiety is not merely a matter of purchase behavior, but also one associated with day-to-day usages. This work is the first in the literature that considers a synchronized EV routing and shuttle routing problem with general cases of charging infrastructure availability. Our extensive numerical study using real FFEVS data shows that the synchronized decision making improves the total shuttle route length up to 15% relative to the sequential approach. This is when both the approaches use our efﬁcient path-based formulation. Therefore, it is expected that the performance gap could be higher if compared with a sequential approach using other computationally less efﬁcient formulation such as link-based ones. When accumulated over time, this improvement can be a signiﬁcant beneﬁt for the operation.

14505117.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14505117.value: We conduct a case study using real data from the car2go service in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. Our ﬁndings from extensive full-scale numerical experiments, summarized below, inform several impor-tant operational decisions. 1. Our results suggest that, in most cases, increasing the number of shuttles is more cost effective than increasing the number of drivers on each shuttle. In particular, it is especially the case when the service area is large or when the charging requirements are low (e.g., the initial battery levels are high). In many cases, we find that pairing a separate shuttle with each driver and have the shuttle only to support that driver’s movement, is optimal. 2. Our results also show that reducing the number of shuttles, and therefore, increasing the number of drivers per each shuttle can be beneﬁcial when the service area is small, and the charging requirement is high. In particular, when the charging requirement is high (e.g., the initial battery levels are low), adding more shuttles may not be cost effective as it can only increase each shuttle’s wait time to pick up the drivers.

14505217.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14505217.value: Consumer’s personal information is the keystones of the modern digital economy: although they provide the means for identity verification, personalization, and targeted marketing, they are also the means by which identity theft, fraud, and hacking are perpetrated. We propose a programmatic study of the behavioral underpinning of susceptibility to phishing, the criminal mechanism used to steal personal identity data and account credentials, by empirically studying what drives information disclosure under risky contexts. In particular, we propose to map the likelihood of inappropriate information disclosure for different types of information, systematically test for differences in contextual effects to uncover clues on decision making process, and to predict who is most vulnerable to such attacks in different social networks. To overcome empirical challenges inherent in the topic, we will use a unique experimental platform that combines the ability to run field experiments with customers of a major Chinese telecommunications carrier and individual-level customer information and mobile-phone metadata. Our basic field-experiment-design strategy is to conduct telephone surveys in which we ask customers (for whom we have data) to disclose personal information (e.g., birthday, name, address, etc.), which unbeknownst to them, we already know. This will generate a verifiable measure of information disclosure behavior with high ecological validity - since the customer would not be able to distinguish our calls from an actual spear phishing attempt. Our ability to combine verifiable behavioral data with large quantities of theoretically relevant predictor variables from mobile metadata also allows for the application of machine learning and social network analysis; the former will supplement traditional logistic regressions to (as we show) more precisely explore multiple hypotheses of an open question, while the latter will allow us to gain deeper insights on the social contextual factors that may influence private information disclosure. Our predictive models will allow us to find the most significant drivers of information disclosure (e.g., contextual factors, demographic differences, and social network factors) and identify who is most vulnerable to phishing (particularly in relation to their position within social network structure). Any findings will be interest to anyone interested in counteracting phishing, including computer security services, firms and organizations seeking to improve data security, and policy makers. Since the behavior of interest is similar to marketing information disclosure behavior (of consumer preferences), marketers could potentially use the ‘reverse’ of our findings to increase information disclosure or identify those who are most willing to share information with firms. 消費者的個人資訊是現代數字經濟的基石。一方面,它們為消費者身份驗證,個性化和定制化市場行銷提供了可靠依據;另一方面,它們也成為了身份竊取,欺詐和駭客攻擊的目標。在此背景下,我們提出對網路釣魚易感性的行為基礎的研究。網路釣魚,是一種竊取個人身份資訊和帳戶資料的犯罪行為,本課題通過實證研究的方式探討消費者在網路風險背景下的資訊披露機制。我們將系統地描繪消費者在不同資訊類型下的資訊披露傾向,通過對比消費者在不同情境下的資訊披露傾向來揭示消費者決策過程,並預測在不同的社交網絡中哪些消費者最容易遭受網路釣魚攻擊。為克服實證資料的局限性,本課題採用獨特的實地實驗方式,我們擬對中國的一家主要的電信運營商的顧客進行實地實驗,並將實驗資料與顧客的個人資訊以及移動互聯網資料相結合。我們將採用電話調查的方式進行實證實驗,在電話調查裡要求顧客披露其個人資訊(例如生日,姓名,住址等)。在實地實驗中，由於客戶無法區分我們的電話調查与實際生活中遇到的網路釣魚,我們的電話調查將提供具有高可信度和可驗證度的消費者資訊披露的量度。 通過將可驗證的行為實驗數據與來自移動大數據的有廣泛理論支持的預測變量相結合,我們也能將機器學習和社交網絡分析應用到消費者資訊披露這一領域中來。機器學習將補充傳統的邏輯回歸模型的不足並更準確地驗證多個尚未有定論的假設,而社交網絡分析將允許我們更深入地瞭解可能影響消費者個人資訊披露的社會背景因素。 我們的預測模型能帮助我們找到消費者資訊披露的重要驅動因素(例如情境因素,人口特徵差異和社交網絡变量),並確定最容易遭受網絡釣魚的消費者人群(特別是與他們在社會網絡結構中的位置有關)。任何對抵製網絡釣魚有興趣的人或组织都會對我們的課題成果感興趣,包括在電腦安全服務領域那些致力于提高數據安全性的公司和組織,以及決策者等等。由於消費者的個人興趣披露行為類似於個人資訊披露行為(消費者偏好),營銷人員也可以舉一反三,利用我們的研究結果“反向”來增加消費者的資訊披露或確定最願意與企業分享資訊的消費者。

Jia, Yiwei Lee, Ning Yijian, Nicholas A. Christakis, Jianmin Jia Relates to Objective 3 Overview: In conducting the original research, several two steams of research emerged. Besides the originally proposed hybrid mobile phone data and behavioral research, I also conducted separate streams of research using only mobile phone data and only behavioral research, which have yielded multiple publications. Of particular note, the experience we gained from the grant (and telecom data) allowed us to quickly complete a paper that used mobile phone data to predict the spread of COVID-19, which we published in Nature (Jia et al 2020, “Population Flow Drives Spatio-Temporal Distribution of COVID-19 in China”, Nature). Mobile big data-driven research: Individual-level telecom data was the basis of the grant. Since we were able to purchase mobile telecom data for our field experiments, we took the opportunity use the funding to support other mobile telecom-data-based research and buy additional datasets. I have a series of papers based on a dataset using mobile telecom data from the 2013 Ya’an earthquake. The first paper of the series was published in Nature Communications (2021); there are several other works in progress including one working paper attached. Although the substantive topic is not related to phishing, it helps accomplish the grant’s strategic goal of gaining expertise in mobile and social network data. Indeed, this research stream was crucial for us to establish our reputation with the social network and basic social science community. Methodologically, this series of research combines natural experiments (instead of field experiments) with mobile telecom/social network data to study human behavior. The wider topic is also human behavior under risk or risk management, which this grant supports. We also purchased a separate dataset that linked Chinese high-speed rail usage data and mobile phone data at an individual-level to study the relationship between physical mobility and social networks. What is special about the dataset is that it takes advantage of a natural experiment where a high-speed rail line was constructed in 2016; this line connected some prefectures but not others, which created a perfect natural experiment for difference-in-difference analysis. We used the data to test a basic theory question of how social networks and human mobility are related. We, like many other social network researchers, moved into this area partly because it was an up and coming topic, and because mobile phone data maps both social networks and physical movement (from cell tower data). Our moves paid rich dividends in 2020 when we leveraged our experience to write our COVID-19 paper using mobility data. Mobility research has since become an even hotter topic (because of its proliferation during COVID-19). Our research question (which is a completed working paper) about the fundamental relationship between social and mobility networks has also become even more important and timely because of the pandemic (social and mobility networks are what causes diseases to spread). Behavioral research: I also directed more behavioral research on topics related to the original grant proposal. I became curious about why people respond to phishing attacks, which has some similarities to persuasion attempts, which is a major topic in social psychology. I thus continued attitudes and persuasion research with colleagues, which yielded a publication in Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin in 2020. In this paper, I created new paradigms for persuasion research that are tools for future research on phishing attacks. Whereas previous persuasion research om [sucjp;pgy typically measures attitudes, our studies rely heavily on ‘click through’ experiments, where we track whether lab and online participants actually click a link that we provide. Although the study context of our paper was persuasion, it is directly adaptable to phishing contexts (e.g., ‘what kind of persuasion strategies generate curiosity which lead to vulnerability to phishing?’). We also continued work using Facebook-based click through field studies, which was pioneered in social psychology research in one of my previous papers (Tormala, Jia, and Norton 2012). In addition, I invested resources in building visual research capabilities, partly because we had access to commercial eye-trackers and support systems in the HKU behavioral lab. Eye tracking can be helpful in allowing us to study the visual process behind people’s decision making, and we plan to use these capabilities in the future to study people’s visual information processing for fraudulent behaviors. We kick started this stream with a project that is now published in Journal of Marketing Research (Yin, Jia, Zheng 2021; the other authors are my PhD students whose work have been supported by this grant). In this work, we investigated how much people trust online influencers depending on the dynamic visual properties of visual information (videos and livestreaming). Research on how people evaluate strangers’ trustworthiness is fundamentally linked with the general topic of how, when, and why people are vulnerable fraud (and also when they are able to defend against fraud or identify untrustworthy actors). Original hybrid approach: We also continued our proposed hybrid research methodology of combining telecom messages and individual-level mobile phone data in 3 projects, one of which is a completed working paper and attached. In that paper, we use a mobile -experimental platform to study what social network features predicts people’s willingness to respond to and help strangers. We apply the same paradigm to study people’s response to phishing attacks as detailed in the grant. We also a separate project looking at whether respondents respond to social cues about the person they are communicating with. In particular, we look at whether status moderates willingness to engage with strangers, which we find evidence of in the attached working paper, but is also a novel contribution for social psychology research.

14505217.label: Major findings and research outcome
14505217.value: The grant funded multimethod approaches to studying people’s vulnerability to phishing, and related topics. Using the proposed paradigm, we found that social network variables, and digital trace data (from mobile phones), can directly predict vulnerability to phishing and propensity to respond to strangers’ requests for personal information. We find this occurs in numerous social contexts in text- and voice- based communications settings, and also find moderators based on demographic background. In particular, social status matching predicts responsiveness to strangers’ solicitations, which points to people’s vulnerability to social engineering (based on social status or background matching) in communications and information security contexts. We also developed behavioral research paradigms, to identify psychological heuristics and potential social engineering strategies behind generating click-throughs on hyperlinks. We identify specific framing based on uncertainty can generate higher propensity to click through on persuasion contexts. The same experimental paradigm can be applied to studying phishing and general information security related behaviors (e.g., click through). In addition, we have created new visual and eye-tracking based paradigms to study how people respond to human actors in video and online contexts (e.g., live streaming); we find that visual presentation dynamics (e.g., video speed) can directly change how much people trust or become wary of actors. These findings also provide insight on how we may trigger ‘defensive mindsets’ so that people are wary of risky persuasion attempts (whether for unsolicited commercial or criminal intent). These finings expand our research output to general consumer contexts. In providing resources to acquire more more mobile phone and social network data, this grant has also facilitated wider research using mobile phone data. We have studied the communications dynamics or victims of natural disasters such as earthquakes and more generally how social networks respond to risk events. We have also used mobile big data to study fundamental scientific questions about human mobility, and have demonstrated that such data can predict the spread of diseases such as COVID-19 and provide immediate estimations of the geographical spread of disease risk, ahead of the virus. Overall, the grant has supported research using behavioral, mobile big data-driven, and hybrid methods to study other socially important issues in the domain of “Human dynamics or risk management”, as evidenced by multiple publication on socially relevant topics.

14505217.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14505217.value: From the proposed stream of research, we ended up opening more research projects than we could complete in a 2-3 year period, and have many opportunities to develop all three streams of research. In the hybrid research domain, we hope that the popularization of mobile data and rapid growth of computational social science will make journals more receptive to our working papers using mobile data to predict real behavior. We plan to expand the behavioral contexts of our research, particularly for the phishing and fraud related research. For the behavioral research streams, I plan to directly expand our attitudes and persuasion click-through experimental paradigm to fraud and phishing contexts. The visual and eye-tracking paradigms we developed can be extended to study visual processes behind phishing vulnerability. Finally, our telecom data-based research has expanded to many streams of research varying from studying how social networks and populations respond to risk, to studying mobility dynamics (particularly in pandemic contexts), and also studying the fundamental relationship between social and mobility networks.

14505217.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14505217.value: This grant has supported the development of a multi-method set of research projects that all use mobile phone big data and behavioral theory to study human behavior in risky contexts. We show the value of mobile big data in predicting vulnerability to social engineering (which is a major component of phishing attacks and digital fraud), and that social dynamics play and important role in explaining individuals’ vulnerability. We also studied the psychology behind people’s interest in clicking on links, and the visual psychology of how people trust virtual actors (such as actors and live streamers on the internet). Finally, we use mobile big data in multiple disaster contexts, including using mobile phone data to understand how families respond to natural disasters and effectively leverage their social resources, and also using mobile phone-derived movement data to predict movement and even the spread of COVID-19. The resources provided by the grant have been crucial in developing expertise in the academic areas of social networks, psychology, digital economy, and digital experimentation. Substantively, this has contributed to our (local) expertise in using big data to study human dynamics and provide risk management solutions across a range of contexts.

14505617.label: Project Objectives
14505617.value: We will quantify the impact of operating vs. non-operating activities, thus timing and non-timing accruals, on the diminishing negative correlation between accruals and CFO. Relative to the timing role of accruals, the non-timing role of accruals is under explored. Specifically, we decompose Accruals into two components: accruals related to CFO (“CAccruals”) and accruals not related to CFO (“NCAccruals”; i.e. related to investing, financing activities and non-cash activities). The former component (“CAccruals”) captures the timing role of accruals (relative to CFO) while the latter component (“NCAccruals”) is aimed to measure the non-timing role of accruals. We identify two sources of diminishing timing role of accruals. We conjecture the declining negative relation between CFO and CAccruals, together with the increase proportion of NCAaccruals, which shows nonnegative relation with CFO are the two sources of the Bushman et al. (2016) findings The current accounting literature focus on the shift of various earnings properties over time. We will be the first study to provide evidence of shift of balance sheet and cash flow statement structures over time. Our decomposition of Accruals may have implications to other documented trends of earnings properties in the literature. For example, if non-CFO related accruals account for larger portion of expense over time, it may help to explain the worsening matching between revenue and expenses and declining return earnings relation. Our decomposition of Accruals may have implications to other accruals related literature. 14505617.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14505617.value: Accruals represent the non-cash adjustment of cash flow from operations (“CFO”) to derive earnings, the summary performance metrics produced under financial accounting system. Dechow (1994) points out that the key implication of timing role of accruals accounting is the negative correlation between cash component and accruals component of earnings. A recent paper, Bushman et al. (2016) find that such negative correlation significant weakens over time and almost disappears after 2000. They further argue that the increase in non-timing related accruals largely accounts for the findings. Their findings have far-reaching implications for accounting literature and education, especially on the assessment of earnings quality. Bushman et al. (2016) adopt the time-series approach. The time series method provides interesting and preliminary evidence, however it has several caveats. First, utilizing only 51 annul observations, it loses the rich information in the firm-level data. Second, the time series correlation from two trended variables could be spurious (Hamilton 1991). The premise of negative correlation between Accruals and CFO is that accruals will eventually turn into either preceding or future period cash flow from operations (CFO). However, many income statement items arise from investing and financing activities. Accruals may relate to other period cash flow from investing activities. For example, depreciation and amortization are generated from prior period cash flow from investment. Accruals may also relate to other period cash flow from finance. For example, the amortization of premium or discount of bond payable, an accrual item, corresponds to cash inflow from financing activities when bonds are issued. In this project, we extend Bushman et al. (2016) to study the sources of diminishing timing role of accruals. We conjecture the declining negative relation between CFO and CFO related Accruals, together with the increase proportion of non-CFO related accruals, which show nonnegative relation with CFO are the two sources of the Bushman et al. (2016) findings. 計項目是指經營活動產生的現金流量（“CFO”）的非現金調整，以及財務會計製度提供的績效指標。 Dechow（1994）指出，應計會計時間作用的關鍵含義是現金成分與應計利潤組成部分之間的負相關。最近的一篇文章，Bushman et al。 （2016）發現，這種負相關顯著性隨著時間的推移而逐漸下降，並且在2000年後幾乎消失。他們進一步認為，非時間相關應計利潤的增長在很大程度上取決於調查結果。他們的研究結果對會計文獻和教育尤其是對收益質量的評估具有深遠的影響。 布什曼等人（2016）採用時間序列方式。時間序列方法提供了有趣的和初步的證據，但是它有幾個注意事項。首先，只使用51次的觀察結果，它會丟失公司級數據中包含的豐富信息。其次，兩個趨勢變量的時間序列相關性可能是虛假的（Hamilton 1991）。 應計項目與首席財務官負相關的前提是應計項目最終將變成前期或未來期間經營現金流量（CFO）。然而，許多利潤表項目來自投資和融資活動，反映了前面討論過的權責發生額的其他兩個職能。應計項目可能與投資活動的其他期間現金流量有關。例如，折舊和攤銷來自投資活動的前期現金流量。應計額也可能與融資活動的其他期間現金流量有關。例如，應付債券的溢價或貼現的攤銷，即應計項目，相當於債券發行時融資活動的現金流入。 在這個項目中，我們擴大了Bushman等人（2016年）研究權責發生製時間作用遞減的來源。我們推測CFO與CFO相關應計項目之間的負相關關係下降，加上與CFO相關的應計項目的增長比例，與CFO相關的非負關係是Bushman等人的兩個來源。 （2016）調查結果。

14505617.label: Major findings and research outcome
14505617.value: Major findings: The timing and matching role of accruals can manifest as four distinct types with different implications for the contemporaneous accruals-CFO relation; negative for the smoothing role, positive for the spreading and conservatism roles, and a push towards zero for the measurement error role. Business operations influence the relative strength of these roles, and the consequent net accruals-CFO relation. We hypothesize that operating cycle length increases the importance of the smoothing role, extreme positive and negative performance shocks enhance the spreading role, whereas extreme negative performance induces the conservatism role. Since non-working capital accruals relate to CFI or CFF, and not CFO, their inclusion in the accruals measure induces measurement error in the estimation of the accruals-CFO relation. In panel and time-series regressions, we find evidence consistent with these predictions. The growing importance of spreading and conservatism roles relative to the smoothing roles of working capital accruals exert a first-order effect on the declining negative accruals-CFO relation. Outcome: the paper has been accepted by the American Accounting Association 2020 conference. Currently, we are actively revising it to submit it to a top rank journal in accounting.

14505617.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14505617.value: This project motivates me a subsequent project to study the inverted U relation between accruals and future returns documented by a couple of studies in the recent period. The inverted-U accruals—future returns relation in the recent period provides a unique setting to examine the causes and demise of the accruals anomaly. We first show that the lack of accruals—CFO relation in the recent period is an artifact of assuming linearity in a nonlinear (i.e., inverted-U) relation. In the cross-sectional tests, using the four economic indicators in the current project to measure the ex-ante negative relation between accruals and CFO, we show that the accruals anomaly is stronger for firms with higher profitability, higher ERC, higher covariance between accruals and employment growth, lower idiosyncratic volatilities, no analyst forecasts of cash flows, and larger size is because these firms have a stronger negative accruals—CFO relation, controlling for other known explanations.

14506117.label: Major findings and research outcome
14506117.value: We develop and empirically validate a flexible diffusion model to accommodate distinctive features in the diffusion process of mobile applications. Specifically, we have revealed that for apps on a popular platform or apps that have previous versions, the diffusion needs to be modeled with the self-referencing effect. This finding may be due to the large promotion effect from the platform or the immediate adoption by the loyal segment to the previous version. For apps in utility categories, the diffusion needs to be modeled with the within-category dependency effect. The effect is significant and negative for those apps because when there is an overlap in functions for a given task, users will stick to the utility app which provides better functions. Lastly, we initially conjecture that for social apps that share the same friend network, should be modeled with the within-category dependency effect, because such effect would be significant and positive due to the positive network effect from the user network. However, empirical results suggest that there is no such positive network effect for these apps.

14506117.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14506117.value: Regarding social apps, we just focused on game apps that share the friend network of a popular chatting platform in Korea (Kakao). Contrary to our previous expectation, the positive network effect from the user network was not found for these game apps. That could be because the user may hide their gaming from their friends in their social network. If we investigate social apps in other categories, the network effect could be found significant.

14506117.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14506117.value: In this research, we develop a new diffusion model of mobile applications and empirically validate the model. Our modeling strategy and empirical findings make contributions to the research stream of diffusion modeling in IS and provide significant managerial implications to practitioners in the mobile application market. Due to the several distinctive features of mobile application adoption, modeling the mobile application diffusion is not trivial. Many mobile applications are subject to self-referencing, which refers to the strong leverage by other IT products or platforms in the adoption process. The self-referencing can cause the early peak in the adoption density, which makes a sharp contrast to the typical Gaussian diffusion curve. We employ the dual market framework to address the issue of an early peak in the mobile application diffusion. There exist realized early markets for apps on a popular platform or apps that have previous versions. We also need to address the issue of within-category dependency, when modeling the diffusion of mobile apps. The codiffusion parameter captures such dependency, and is found to be signifiacnt for utilitarian apps.

14600117.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600117.value: This is the first scholarly investigation into the emergence of male-medicine (nan-k’o 男科) in late imperial China. As a three-year research project, it intends, first, to collect and examine the seven key texts of male-medicine from the 16th to the 19th centuries, for a detailed philological and textual study, to elucidate the conceptual as well as contextual bases for the growth and development of male medicine in medical theory, clinical practices, and market demands. Second, this finding will be cross-examined with the primary sources of and against current understanding on the related but earlier developments in pediatric medicine (yu-k’o 幼科) together with gynecology and obstetrics (fu-k’o 婦科), in order to produce a comprehensive, multi-faceted, and rounded understanding in reproductive medicine for this period from the respective angles of men, as well as children, and women. Third, further research into its working relations within the framework of family, gender relations, religion, materiality, and daily life will reveal the enduring economics and socio-cultural circumstances that nurtured, demanded, consumed thus sustained this literature, profession, and expertise. This study provides an indispensable missing link for proper understanding of traditional Chinese reproductive medicine. Distinct nature of the textual evidence of male medicine requires specialized training and academic familiarity with its counterpart in Chinese gynecology and pediatrics. Furthermore the sensitive nature of the subject plus its close association with the Taoist pursuits of “life preservation,” longevity, and alchemy generated a semi-secretive and obscure language within which this sub-specialty operated. Its frequent mixing with religious practices and ritual activities, as well as with medical-technical knowledge and herbal pharmaceutical recipes, demands careful interpretation. Additionally the current Chinese policy allowing the birthing of a second child per household adds practical significance of this historical understanding of Chinese reproductive mentality and behavior. One conference paper (in Chinese), one refereed article (in English), and one book-length monograph will be produced as academic outcomes of this project. 本計劃以中國近世男科醫學的發展為研究對象。首先，本計劃打算收集從16到19世紀有關男科的關鍵文獻，進行詳細的文獻及歷史研究，發掘有關男科的概念的發展，追索其文化脈絡以及其臨床行為和市場需求。其次，以上研究的結果，將會與目前關於幼科以及婦科在較早時期的發展做一對比，目的在形成一個對此一時代生育醫學的全面了解。第三，本研究將更進一步討論在家庭及性別關係，宗教及物質文化，以及日常生活的架構之下，經濟及社會情況如何滋養及助長了男科的知識以及專業發展。本研究提供了適當了解傳統中國生育文化的不可或缺的關鍵知識。由於男科醫學文獻的特殊性質，研究者必須具有專業的訓練，以及對於其相對的婦科和幼科的深入了解。同時，此一主题的敏感性質以及其與道家的養生，長生，及練丹術概念之間密切的關係，使得男科的論述使用了一種半祕密以及誨澀的語言。由於這種文獻時常涉及宗教行為以及儀式，又和醫學技術知識以及本草藥方相關，因而必須仔細的研究及解釋。目前中國政府開始實行允許每家生育第二胎的政策，也加重了此一有關中國傳統生育文化研究的當代意義。

14600117.label: Realisation of objectives
14600117.value: The realization and fulfillment of this originally set to be a 3-year research project can be documented and understood in two phases: First, after the project was granted with considerable budget cuts, it was agreed that 2 peer-reviewed research articles and book chapters plus conference presentations and related activities should be the accepted outcome of the project. The academic goal of which has been more than adequately satisfied with the publication of two peer reviewed works in 2020 and 2021, namely the book chapter entitled “Technology of the Body: Male Medicine and Reproduction in Early Modern China, in Luiz Oosterbeek ed., Tangibility: Designing Future Landscapes. Mação: Instituto Terra e Memória, s.ARKEOS, vol. 53. (2020), and “Aspire to Procreate: Medicine, Ethics and Artistic Representation in Late Imperial China.” Humanities, Arts & Society, Issue 2 (Jan, 2021). Both essays break clear grounds conceptually, in seeing the development of Chinese male medicine as a force in seeking and devising new approaches to the technologies of the human body, also such endeavours, aspiring to procreate with additional pathways require elucidation of art history materials as well as ethical consideration to bring out its socio-cultural and demographic, historical ramifications. To highlight the full implications of this research in the overall re-assessment of late imperial Chinese reproductive culture, new monographic publications on pediatric medicine (《幼醫與幼蒙》), the translation of A Tender Voyage (慈航, forthcoming), and reprint of 《童年憶往》of subjects keenly related to this field of study were also published as indispensable though indirect academic results of this research process. The second stage of this project was influenced, as all scholarly undertakings, by the surprising attack of a global pandemic. For two plus years COVID-19 not only interrupted the original plan of presenting the outcomes of this project in international conferences but also anticipated research trip to consult rare original source materials in the latter phase of the project. Aided by the joining of a Co-I (Prof. Cheung Hiu-yu, now the PI of the project), and a 6-month extension of the project in the final year, it is also evident that additional publications on medical history and comparative public health issue revealed in the potential of this research and the extended significance this very project demonstrated cannot but led to invitation, and publications of health history at large. Scholarly works in both English“Notes from a Historian”and Chinese (“回到未來：重訪世界史上之疫病”;“警訊:橫世而出的疾疫與歷史”), together with broader analyses to connecting issues (熊秉真，陳秀熙編，《種族，偏見與歧視》) can be seen as important contributions of this research, unanticipated but no less significant during this second turn of professional development.

14600117.label: Major findings and research outcome
14600117.value: This 3 year project when submitted in 2017 and approved in 2018, a good 4-5 years ago, had some broader aspirations in addition to the focused research and mining of rare archival materials. Specifically, as laid out in the original application, the project was to uncover the “male medicine” in late imperial China as a textual tradition and social, clinical practice. Usual activities of primary research and philological exercises for the 7 leading texts took much of the time, which led to the two publications in the English academia, as listed. But in order to raise awareness and understanding of the background of a lack of interest in reproductive health in the Chinese tradition, we realize that a wider recognition of the socio- cultural context of Chinese relationship in handling body related to personal gratification will need to be put in place. Disciplinarily this requires a much closer working relationship between history, humanities and health sciences. For which we had the fortune to collaborate with the colleagues at the College of Public Health at National Taiwan university (Chiang Tung- Liang, Chen Hsiu-Hsi) in developing “Health Humanities” as a new field, with summer classes, a website, and a few workshops during the past few years. On the humanities side, it’s also useful to nurture activities that cross intellectual borders to reach out to new areas of interest beyond established topics. As this project is making progresses, Professor Hsiung Ping-chen as the Co-I was pleased to be awarded the CIPSH Chair of New Humanities in 2018-2023, to devote to this goal of continuous renewal of fresh history and humanities subjects (CIPSH represents The International Council of Philosophy and Human Sciences). For such topics of broader topics of longitudinal concerns to be accepted, which carry obviously cross-cultural and global significance, Professor Hsiung Ping-chen now have been given a UNESCO Chair on Global Asia, 2022-2026, to labor for the cause, for which results of this project is but one particular case. Thus even though somewhat interrupted and compromised by limiting mobility for the last phase of the project due to the COVID pandemic, we were able to press on with outcomes of this project sharing, also communicating with colleagues on the implications of mining buried archival sources to show the excitement of establishing new scholarly engagements.

14600117.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14600117.value: Now two years beyond the date of the original date of completion of our project, COVID 19 is nowhere near its finishing line. We are compelled to and have decided to conclude this project , with both anticipated and unexpected results. All along, Prof. Hsiung as the Co-I was aware that this project represents the last UGC research project for her research career. She is pleased that it was able to be carried out as planned, albeit with some unexpected conditions (thus the 6 months extension). Now we are satisfied to report that related outcomes will continue to be shared in conferences as academic meetings resume worldwide (such as AAS and AHA). Related publications will also flow out bearing due acknowledgment to this GRF project.

14601017.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601017.value: The aim of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness of a mindfulness based intervention - MYmind (Mindfulness for Youth) - for children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and their parents. ADHD affects a significant number of children worldwide and is among the top 3 neuropsychiatric disorders among children globally. Although medication is the main treatment of choice for ADHD, side effects and low compliance with medications call for innovative interventions that can integrate and improve both children and parent behavioural outcomes. Cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) is an important treatment for ADHD, however, not all children and their families accept and respond to CBT and exploration of innovative alternative interventions is needed. Mindfulness based interventions are evidence-based group interventions which have been shown to improve physical and mental well-being for adults with chronic health problems. Recently, an innovative mindfulness based intervention-MYmind, tailored for children with ADHD, was piloted in children and their parents with promising results. The intervention consists of an 8-week mindfulness training programme that is run concurrently for children with ADHD and their parents. In this proposed study, 138 children aged 8 to 12 years diagnosed with ADHD and one parent of each child will be recruited from the community and will be randomised to either the mindfulness intervention or CBT, and be followed up to 6 months. The primary and secondary outcomes will include children’s attention, impulsivity, behaviours and executive function measured by validated objective and parent’s reported instruments. Parents’ parental stress, parenting styles, ADHD related symptoms, well-being, self-compassion and mindfulness levels will also be measured. This project will be the first of its kind using MYmind mindfulness training targeting both children and parents in a family context in Hong Kong. This will also be one of the very few studies which employ an active control group with a relatively large sample size and will be the first study to be conducted in Hong Kong using mindfulness based intervention specifically for ADHD children aged 8-12 years and their parents. Objective measurements for assessing improvement in attention and related problems for children will be used to add to the robustness of the research findings. Furthermore, potential mediators between the intervention and results will be explored. Since MYmind is a group intervention which targets both children and parents, findings will be beneficial for the provision of potential treatments for families affected with ADHD in Hong Kong and overseas.

14602017.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14602017.value: 20世紀70年代至90年代，香港政府先後建立了三代新市鎮，以緩解市區快速增長的人口及隨之帶來的住房壓力。新市鎮發展的縂用地面積稍微大於70年代前的城市建成區，達133平方千米，並吸引了大約330萬居住人口（或總人口的47%）。鑑於快速的城市增長和擴張，香港的用地和交通系統在滿足人們日常出行和活動需求方面受到了嚴峻的考驗。然而，我們對新市鎮的系統研究則相當不充分，尤其關於新市鎮是否實現了自足程度較高的社區，是否促進了更可持續的出行模式，以及最終是否提高了人們生活質量。這一知識上的缺失可能會阻礙我們對新市鎮規劃的評價及製定恰當的措施來引導香港未來的發展。 該項目旨在通過調查工作可達性，通勤及非通勤出行模式及基於工作生活平衡的身心健康水準來填補上述的知識缺失。這些調查將特別關注香港新市鎮和市區的對比。該項目包括四個研究目標，以探索：（1）工作可達性（即接觸到工作機會的難易程度）；（2）工作可達性對通勤和非通勤出行模式的影響；（3）來自不同家庭結構的通勤者的身心健康狀態；及（4）工作可達性和通勤及非通勤出行模式關係的縱向變化。為了實現我們的研究目標，我們將使用定量（即可達性的計算，線性回歸模型和結構方程模型）和定性方法（即焦點組訪談）。 通過對最新的家庭出行調研和人口普查數據進行分析，我們將全面瞭解香港新市鎮通勤者的工作可達情況，交通出行模式及工作生活平衡。這些調查研究將會帶來一組寶貴的數據，以幫助我們評價新市鎮的空間規劃，及考慮是否需要採取措施來減少工作與住房的空間不匹配，從而減少過度通勤，刺激地方經濟，並提高人們的總體生活質量。通過這一系列的評估，該項目旨在為香港建設更具經濟活力和社會公平的新市鎮和新發展區提供政策，規劃和設計方面的建議。

14602017.label: Realisation of objectives
14602017.value: The four objectives have been 100% achieved. To achieve the first objective, which has been achieved by the mid-term report, we collected GIS data and census data to calculate job accessibility and map out the distribution of jobs in Hong Kong of 2000 and 2015. These indicators were used in objectives 2-4. We also used spatial statistical methods to identify employment subcenters in Hong Kong to understand if Hong Kong has formed any major economic agglomerations in new towns. A paper reporting this finding has been published in Habitat International (He et al., 2020b). To achieve the second objective, we retrieved Hongkongers' travel patterns from the 2001 and 2011 Hong Kong Characteristics Travel Survey (CTS) and to model the effect of job accessibility on transport mobility patterns and work-life balance. This exercise has produced two journal articles, He et al., (2020a), Tao and He (2021). To achieve the third objective, we designed a questionnaire survey and collected first hand data with new town residents vis-à-vis urban residents. We used some of the most widely adopted scales to retrieve people's well-being in connection to their home location and the during of their commute trips and time for non-commute trips. A working paper has been submitted to a journal and is currently under review (He et al., n.d.). (Note: due to the effect of COVID-19, our survey was delayed. For this reason, the PI requested a 12-month extension of this project. With the team’s efforts, we eventually managed to collect a targeted sample size for this objective). To achieve the four objectives, we took into consideration the findings from objectives 1-3 and some indicators developed for this project, such as the population-jobs ratio of all neighborhoods in Hong Kong from 2000-2015 and the independent index for all of the nine new towns and urban areas of 2001 and 2011, we concluded that there is a lot of room for improvement to further examine the spatial planning in new towns. We included our views and policy suggestions in the published works/working papers aforementioned.

14602017.label: Major findings and research outcome
14602017.value: From this project, we reported our findings in four papers (including three published journal articles and one working paper). In He et al. (2020a), “Evaluating Hong Kong’s Spatial Planning in New Towns From the Perspectives of Job Accessibility, Travel Mobility, and Work–Life Balance”, we find that a) there is a disparity in self-containment and access to job opportunities between these towns and urban areas, b) job accessibility strongly influences commute duration, and c) prolonged commutes can reduce noncommute travel duration, particularly for public transportation users, suggesting that this may harm work–life balance for workers with long commutes. In He et al. (2020b), “New towns and the local agglomeration economy”, our results reveal that only a few of these primary employment centres exhibit strong location agglomeration: the proportion of jobs in the long-established urban core remained stable, while the agglomeration economies in new towns have not gained much momentum in attracting a larger proportion of the city's total employment. The new towns' sub-centres also indicate a similar industrial composition, and seemingly fail to foster local specialisation-based economies. In Tao and He (2021), “Job accessibility and joint household travel: a study of Hong Kong with a particular focus on new town residents”, we find that: (1) longer working hours were associated with a lower probability of joint household travel and activities for new town and urban-area commuters alike; (2) longer commute and working hours significantly reduced the time window for joint household activities; (3) and job accessibility played a more important role in affecting the opportunities for discretionary joint household activities among new town commuters than urban-area commuters. In He et al. (working paper), “Long commute, work-life balance and well-being: A study of new town residents in Hong Kong with a mixed method approach”, we analysed questionnaire surveys and semi-structured interviews using a mixed method approach. Our structural equation model showed that new-town commuters experienced lower levels of travel satisfaction, work-life balance and subjective well-being. The qualitative analysis of interview transcripts further revealed that new town residents chose to endure longer commutes in exchange for lower housing prices in suburban areas; however, inferior access to other public facilities in the new towns still negatively affects the well-being of residents.

14602017.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14602017.value: Based on the findings from this project and various issues that we have identified to be associated with Hong Kong’s new towns, we believe that there is potential for further development of this line of research. We have identified two directions for further study. First, the data we used for this GRF project were based on relatively old data (albeit they are the latest data of their kind in HK). We plan to submit a GRF proposal in near future to seek an extension of this study with new data and new research questions. Second, this GRF project focuses more on job accessibility but from the working paper for which we conducted face to face interviews with residents living in new towns, we came to realize that access to non-work facilities are also important to ensure the quality of life of new towns residents, forming an opportunity for further research. In summary, we will continue to use accessibility as an indicator and a research perspective to examine the spatial planning of new towns in Hong Kong.

14602017.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14602017.value: This GRF project was motivated by the fact that very little is known about how well the new town planning has performed at achieving more self-contained communities, which is an important step to promote more sustainable mobility patterns and ultimately and improve people’s overall quality of life. This knowledge deficit may hinder our ability to assess the effect of new town planning, and more importantly, develop appropriate measures to guide the future development of Hong Kong. In this project, we addressed this deficit by investigating the job accessibility, commute and non-commute patterns and well-being associated with work-life balance with a particular focus on comparing new towns with the urban areas of Hong Kong. Based on our findings, we pointed out an important problem of Hong Kong’s new towns, which is severe jobs-housing imbalance. Moreover, we linked this spatial, geographic issue to individual and household-level travel behavior outcome and well-being status. Such framework can better highlight the human mobility and public health impact of new town planning. The findings provide a value reference for the spatial planning of new towns and suburbs. Our publications appeared in top journals in urban planning and transport studies, reflecting the quality of our research outputs.

14603117.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14603117.value: Dr Cheng , Hak Land Grand Dr Lam, Chun Bun Ian

14603117.label: Project Objectives
14603117.value: We will investigate whether intergenerational discrepancies in basic and political values will contribute to family conflict over political issues; We will investigate whether selective exposure to online materials and the agreeableness, openness, and neuroticism personality traits will moderate the effect of intergenerational discrepancies in values on such family conflict; We will investigate whether family conflict over political issues will predict important outcomes including life satisfaction, family satisfaction, and political attitude polarization; We will investigate whether Age and constructive response style will moderate the effects of family conflict on the aforementioned outcomes.
