16210517.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16210517.value: Over a decade of rapid expansion later, the market of smart devices is expected to continue growing and the current trend is to create even more compact designs. In this trend, numerous discrete modules are integrated on a single chip into what is known as a system-on-a-chip (SoC). A practical SoC usually enters the idle mode by lowering the supply voltage, which even though can effectively extend the battery lifetime, poses challenges to circuit operation. When the supply voltage converted from the battery by a switching (buck) converter is ultralow (e.g., 0.5 V), the low dropout regulators (LDRs), which are essential to generate the finely regulated supply from a noisy output rail, are unable to adequately reject the noise from its input. Such low-voltage, low-current LDRs are said to be working in the retention mode. The poor power supply rejection (PSR) will render the SoC vulnerable to switching noise from the buck converter. Conventional techniques improve the PSR by boosting the loop gain or bandwidth for noise suppression, or using a feed-forward path for supply noise cancellation. Such techniques require either a sufficiently high supply voltage or an expensive power budget, which is not available in retention mode operation. Therefore, methods of enhancing the PSR especially for retention mode LDRs must be developed. This proposed project will come up with a new design of the analog/digital hybrid control-based LDR with enhanced PSR over a frequency range of tens of megahertz. The hybrid scheme inherits the merits of higher accuracy and insensitivity to power supply noise from the analog control, and the advantages of low supply voltage operation and faster response under a low power budget from the digital control. In particular, two variations, namely the analog-assisted digital controller and the digital-assisted analog controller, will be developed and compared to gain insights for designing the proposed retention mode LDR. Furthermore, a comprehensive analysis on the stability of the main and auxiliary regulation loops will be conducted to motivate both hybrid designs. This project will also try to reduce power consumption further with ultra-low-power applications in mind, as well as implementing a two-step power conversion system. The high PSR LDR will be characterized in various real application scenarios for a complete evaluation of the proposed PSR enhancement techniques developed in this project. 經過十年的快速擴張，智能設備市場預計將持續增長並且目前的發展趨勢是產生更緊湊便攜的設計。在這種趨勢下，大量的分立模組被集成到單個晶片上，這就是眾所周知的片上系統。一個實用的片上系統通常通過降低工作電壓進入空閒模式從而有效延長電池使用壽命，但也給電路工作帶來了挑戰。當開關電源轉換器從電池降壓產生的電壓很低時（比如0.5V），從有雜訊的電源電壓產生精准電壓的低壓差線性穩壓器將不能夠有效抑制電源雜訊。這種低電壓低電流的低壓差線性穩壓器被稱作工作在保留模式。低電源雜訊抑制將導致片上系統容易受到開關電源的開關雜訊的影響。 提高電源雜訊抑制的通常技術是提高環路增益或者頻寬來抑制雜訊，或者通過前饋通道來抵消雜訊。這類技術需要足夠高的的電源電壓或者需要消耗大量功耗，不適合保留模式的運行狀態。因此，必須發展新的提高電源雜訊抑制的方法，尤其是低壓差線性穩壓器工作在保留模式時。 本提議的項目將會設計一個新的類比數位混合控制的低壓差線性穩壓器，它在幾十兆赫茲的頻率範圍內有更高電源雜訊抑制效果。這個混合控制方案兼有類比控制的高精准度和高電源雜訊抑制的優點以及數位控制的低電源電壓低功耗下更快回應速度的優點。特別地，類比輔助數位控制器和數位輔助類比控制器兩種形式都會被設計和比較，從而得到更多的靈感來設計提議的保留模式低壓差線性穩壓器。此外，主回路和輔助回路穩定性的綜合分析也將促進兩個混合結構的設計。 考慮到超低功耗應用，本專案也將嘗試降低功耗，以及構建一個兩步電源轉換系統。在不同的真實應用場景下，採用本項目提出的電源雜訊抑制技術的低壓差線性穩壓器將會得到全面的評估。

16210517.label: Realisation of objectives
16210517.value: The main objective of this project is to develop a retention mode analog/digital hybrid low dropout regulator (LDR) with high power supply rejection (PSR). Several aspects were investigated (as listed in the Objectives 1 to 3) before the final design of retention mode LDR (Objective 4) can be successfully implemented. In Objective 1, PSR from the analog part and digital part of the hybrid LDR have been analyzed. The PSR from digital-part is founded to be much worse than the analog-part and thus our hybrid LDR will reduce the weight of using the digital-part in hybrid regulation scheme in order to achieve high PSR. The PSR from the analog-part is also analyzed in details and the results were used to estimate the PSR of the final hybrid LDO design. The analysis was published in an international conference in May 2019 [C1] and the detail analysis was submitted to IEEE Trans. on Circuits and Systems – I [J3] and under review. The multi-loop stability analysis in Objective 2 was studies. In particular, a novel control mechanism of the digital-assisted analog LDR was developed and can achieve a fast-transient response without instability issues. The digital-assisted analog LDR employs an analog control scheme in steady state while a digital control scheme is invoked upon transient events for speed enhancement. A fast-transient digital-assisted analog LDR was implemented and measured to demonstrate the effectiveness of the developed control scheme. The design was published in IEEE Journal of Solid-State Circuit [J2]. Several digital-assisted analog LDRs and analog-assisted digital LDRs were designed, and their performances were compared and analyzed in Objective 3. Since the PSR is one of the key performance parameters of the retention mode LDR, based on the analytical results from Objective 1, it is concluded that the digital-assisted analog LDR will be topology used for the retention mode LDR. Moreover, in order to provide a low-power reference voltage for the LDR operating at retention mode, a nano-watt range low-power resistor-less bandgap reference was developed. Without a resistor, this bandgap reference can active a small active chip area and low noise performance that is suitable for providing reference voltage to the retention mode LDR. The reference design is published in IEEE Solid-State Circuits Letters [J1]. Finally, for Objective 4, a digital-assisted analog retention mode LDR with high power supply rejection ratio has been developed based on the founding of the previous research in Objectives 1 to 3. An adaptive noise cancellation circuit is also introduced into the digital power transistor array for power supply rejection ratio (PSRR) improvement and achieves at least –28.3 dB PSRR across full spectrum at maximum load current. The design will be submitted to IEEE Trans. on Circuits and Systems – II [J4] for publication.

16210517.label: Major findings and research outcome
16210517.value: To make this project success, several novel ideas, algorithms and techniques have been investigated, analyzed, proposed and developed. The key consideration is how to strike a good balance of hybrid low dropout regulator (LDR) with both analog and digital controls. In this research, a novel digital-assisted analog hybrid LDO (DA-ALDO) regulator is proposed. It is the first digital-assisted analog hybrid LDO regulator ever published, and it outperforms previous analog-assisted digital hybrid LDO regulator architectures. The DA-ALDO combines the advantages of tight regulation and wide load current range from analog control scheme with the merits of area-efficient power transistor utilization and fast transient speed from the digital control scheme. The effectiveness of the digitally assisted analog hybrid architecture is verified in a 65-nm CMOS process [J2]. A transfer function analysis of the power supply rejection ratio of LDRs and the feedforward ripple cancellation scheme is investigated. An efficient and accurate model is proposed to facilitate the analysis. Based on the simplified model, the transfer function, poles, and zeros are derived. The analytical results are verified by comparing the numerical plots to the simulation results. Significant conclusions are obtained for IC designer towards a well-instructed design methodology of high-PSRR LDRs [C1], [J3]. A resistor-less bandgap reference based on the topology of a single-branch floating proportional-to-absolute temperature (PTAT) voltage is developed. The PTAT voltage is generated by flowing the leakage current generated by a zero-VGS PMOS into series diode-connected PMOS. With this high impedance current biases, the PTAT voltage can be added to the complementary-to-absolute-temperature (CTAT) voltage without using resistors. The proposed topology can achieve an ultra-low power consumption, which is 8.26 nW at 1.4-V supply voltage, and a small chip area of 0.017 mm2 [J1]. Finally, a digital-assisted analog retention mode LDR with improved PSRR is developed. The retention mode LDR adopts a novel digital-assisted analog hybrid architecture so that the dominant pole is located at the output node without using a bulky off-chip output capacitor. An adaptive noise cancellation circuit is introduced into the digital power transistor array for PSRR improvement. The digital-assisted analog retention mode LDR is verified using a 65-nm CMOS process [J4].

16210517.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16210517.value: In this project, a novel digital-assisted analog hybrid LDO (DA-ALDO) regulator was invented, which outperforms previous analog-assisted digital hybrid LDO regulator architectures in some respects. We found that this DA-ALDO is particularly suitable for realizing retention mode LDR with high power supply rejection. We believe the concept of this DA-ALDO regulator architecture has a lot of room for improvement. Further research can be done to apply this DA-ALDO to other LDR applications with better performance.

16210517.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16210517.value: Low dropout regulators (LDRs) are essential for generating a finely regulated supply from a noisy input power rail and can adequately reject the noise from its input. When the LDR is idling, it is said to be working in retention mode. At retention mode, the output current of the LDR is very small, the previous techniques used to improve the power supply rejection (PSR) are no longer effective. In this project, a hybrid analog/digital controlled LDR was developed, which can enhance the PSR capability of the LDR in both the retention mode and normal mode operations. This allows the use of a single LDR in many power management circuit designs instead of using 2 separate LDRs, one for normal mode operation and the other for retention mode operation.

16210617.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16210617.value: Ensuring process flexibility is an important way to achieve high operational performance in both the manufacturing and service industries. The problem of ensuring flexibility arises in a system with multiple types of products (or service requests), each type of demand requiring a different facility to process. To cope with the demand fluctuation effectively without incurring too much cost, we can add some limited flexibility to the facilities so that each facility can process more than one type of demand. A typical example is the so-called long chain where facilities form a chain structure for providing flexibility. In the literature, extensive research has been conducted to analyze the effectiveness of long chain and other low-cost limited-flexibility designs. In most such work, an aggregated demand model is an implicit assumption, where the demand for each type can be arbitrarily split and assigned to alternative compatible facilities. This is a useful model for designing the process, but it may overlook some complexity at the operational level. In many practical cases, each type of demand consists of orders from multiple customers; such orders are differentiated by priority, deadline, etc. At the operational level, we need to determine how to allocate each order to a compatible facility, leading to a scheduling and sequencing problem. Because of the additional factors considered, the optimal operational schedule may conflict with the plan generated assuming aggregated demand. This will raise concerns about the real performance of a long chain and other low-cost flexible designs. In this project, we propose to study operational scheduling problems for a long chain and other similar designs. The work will make two contributions to the field of process flexibility. First, we will develop algorithms for scheduling, providing operational solutions to support process flexibility; second, we will further validate the designs by using the operations schedule to investigate the realized performance. Our work will also contribute to the field of scheduling by identifying a new type of model. In fact, the problem we consider can be regarded as a special case of some existing scheduling models such as parallel unrelated machines and dedicated machines; but these models do not capture the special structure of low-cost flexible designs. Our preliminary study shows it possible to design special algorithms for some problems in a long chain that are more efficient than the algorithms for general scheduling models. Hence we foresee great research opportunities for the field of scheduling. 在制造业和服务产业中，系统过程的柔性是实现高运营绩效的重要途径。柔性的问题最早在需要满足多种产品（或服务）的系统中出现。在这类系统中，每种产品需要不同的加工设备。为了以低成本方式应对需求变动，我们可以给设备增加一定的柔性，使得每个设备可以满足多种需求。在一个典型的例子中，多个设备被组成链状结构来提供柔性。这种结构被称为“长链”。 在文献中，长链和其他低成本、有限柔性结构的性能得到了广泛的研究。大多数此类研究预先假设了一个集成需求模型，在此模型中每种类型的需求都可以被任意分离出来并指派给其它可适用的设备。在产能设计中这是一个有效的模型。但在运作层面，这个模型可能会忽略一些复杂的情况。 在许多实际应用中，每种需求都包含来自多个客户的订单；这些订单有不同的优先级、交货期等。在运作层面，我们需要决定怎样给每个订单分配适应的设备，这会带来调度和排序问题。由于需要考虑这些附加因素，最优的运作计划可能会与需求集成假设下得到的计划相冲突。这引发了对长链和其他低成本柔性结构设计的实际性能的担忧。 在这个项目中，我们计划研究长链和其他类似结构的运作调度问题。这项研究对工序柔性领域主要有以下两个方面的贡献。第一，我们将建立调度算法，在运作层面提供支持工序柔性的解；第二，我们将利用运作计划来研究其实际性能，从而验证设计的有效性。 从调度研究领域的角度看，我们的工作提出了新型问题模型，这将有助于调度领域的研究。事实上，我们研究的问题可以被视为一个现有调度问题的特例，如独立平行机器和专用机器问题；但这类模型并未考虑低成本柔性设计的特殊结构。我们的前期研究表明，在一些长链问题中，我们有可能设计出比一般调度算法更加有效的特殊算法。

16210617.label: Realisation of objectives
16210617.value: Objective 1 is to study the scheduling problem for a long chain where each server is configured to be able to handle two types of demands. The typical objective is to maximize the throughput of the system. We have developed a two-layer dynamic programming algorithm to solve the operational scheduling problem. Experimentation shows that when the operational scheduling decision is required, the resulting performance may be 5-10% lower than the designed one. This finding gives some guidance for designers to plan capacity of the system. Another more serious concern is the worst-case scenario, in which the performance could be up to 30% lower. These results are included in Part C Item 10, Chapters 2 and 3, and Item 9.3. Objective 2, following the concern about the worst-case performance of a long chain, is to study other types of flexible systems with higher level flexibility. We have considered three-chain systems in different forms. The curse of dimensionality causes time inefficiency in designing algorithms by extending the above dynamic programming. So, we have turned it into an integer programing formulation and use commercial software to solve it. Experimentation shows that the resulting performance may be 2-3% lower than the design one. More importantly, the worst-case performance is contained in 5% lower than the designed one. This shows the importance of the higher level of flexibility (Part C, Item 10, Chapter 3). Objective 3 is to have a detailed analysis for the chain structure and make some general guidance. The work in the above objectives 1 and 2 has partially addressed this objective. To summarize, we find that when the operation scheduling decisions are involved, the long chain may not be able to achieve the designed one. Specially, when the worst-case performance needs to be considered. A higher level of flexibility should be taken. In addition, we demonstrate how to design the server configuration to ensure the high flexibility with low cost (Part C Item 9.2). Objective 4 is to explore other related models that involve the flexibility in system design or planning, and the realized performance that can be achieved in operational scheduling. We address this objective from different perspectives. The first one is a box sizing problem encountered in the packing and shipping process of e-commerce companies. This is a variation of long chain systems. Specifically, in an automatic packing system, each packing line is configured for using fixed-width card boards to make boxes for shipping, where a large box can be used to ship smaller sized packages. The design of the widths of card boards will affect the shipping efficiency and the complexity of management. To address this problem, we have developed a proper model and designed dynamic programming algorithm (Part C, item 9.1, and Part C, Item 10, Chapter 4). Computational study shows that it can effectively enable the warehouse managers to make the tradeoff in designing the automatic packing line. The second one is on the scheduling problem with flexibility of order taking, where the scheduler can use pricing to influence the order placement of clients (Part C, Item8.1). In most operations management models, the demand quantity of a product is formulated as a function of price, which garners the company flexibility to obtain tradeoff between revenue and cost. Such a price-demand function may not be suitable for make-to-order products with heterogeneous demands. To address such an issue, we study the price quotation and scheduling problem where a manufacturer receives multiple order inquiries from customers, and needs to quote a price for each inquiry. The quoted price will affect the probability of which the customer will accept the price and confirm the order. Then the manufacturer determines a schedule for processing the confirmed orders. We develop algorithms for making quotations and order scheduling. The third one is on the service bundle design, where some flexibility can be exploited to form scheduled event into service packages (Part C, Item 8.2). In the service industry, a service provider may sell a collection of service activities as a package, also known as a service bundle. Empirical studies indicate that the customer’s ex-post perception of a service bundle depends on not only the utility of each activity, but also the sequence of the activities being delivered. The latter can be measured by certain sequence effects, such as the utility of the peak activity, the utility of the end activity, and the trend of utility change over the activities. This phenomenon gives a service provider an opportunity to optimize a service bundle by manipulating the activities and their sequence. Such a service bundle design problem can be formulated as a 0–1 sum-of-ratios problem. To solve the problem, we design a novel geometric branch-and-bound algorithm. The algorithm divides the objective function into several dimensions, and repeatedly strengthens the bounds of each dimension. This enables us to convert the 0–1 sum-of-ratios problem into a series of 0–1 quadratic optimization problems. Computational experiments show that the algorithm can solve the service bundle design problem efficiently.

16210617.label: Major findings and research outcome
16210617.value: The primary goal of this project is to investigate the possible operational performance deterioration for those chain based flexible systems, in particular for problems where operational scheduling decisions are involved. In doing this project we confirm the existence of the performance cap between what is designed and what is realized, and an optimized scheduling can reduce the gap. Generally speaking, different mathematical models have been developed to show that a lower degree of flexibility can already achieve high performance closer to those of full flexibility systems. However, all these models have an assumption that the orders are homogenous within a type. This is a reasonable approach in the design stage, especially for the large volume of demand or a longer planning cycle. However, it raises some concerns about whether the design premise can be achieved when the orders are heterogenous in the same type. For example, each order may have a different size, value, and due date. Our first contribution of this project is to develop algorithms to optimize the production schedule for those heterogenous orders. We have developed dynamic program to efficiently solve the problem. Furthermore, our computational study shows the existence of the performance gap, between 5-10% for long-chain systems. This gap can be lower to 5% or less when the level of flexibility increases, such as three chains and Lev structure (Part C. Item 10, Chapters 2 and 3, and Item 9.3). This gives some assurance when designing the chain-based flexible systems (Part C, Item 9.2). Inspired by the above work, we have also studied several extended research. One is the boxing size design problem for e-commerce companies, which is a variation of a standard chain structure. We design efficient algorithms to solve the problem (Part C, item 9.1, and Part C, Item 10, Chapter 4). Another one is on the scheduling problem with flexibility of order taking, where the scheduler can use pricing to influence the order placement of clients (Part C, Item8.1). The third one is on the service bundle design, where some flexibility can be exploited to form scheduled event into service packages (Part C, Item 8.2). The above work addresses flexibility in scheduling with planning from different angles. The box size problem is to integrate scheduling and design, the order-taking problem is about the flexibility together with the scheduling, and the last one concerns the flexibility after the schedule is made.

16210617.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16210617.value: One of the directions we are going to pursue is the box sizing problem, which is important to e-commerce companies. For example, Walmart.com has reported on the value of such a project in their daily operation. We have contacted several e-commerce companies, such as Amazon.com, and confirmed that this is indeed a practical problem they need to handle. So, we are looking for the opportunity to materialize our work and apply it to the industry.

16210617.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16210617.value: In designing a manufacturing or service system, different mathematical models are often used to analyze the system performance. Such models and analysis need some simplified assumption, such as using aggregate demand information. This is a reasonable choice at the design stage, but it leaves some concern on the operational level performance, e.g., when the demand is placed with different sizes and due dates. In this project, we address this concern and confirm the existence of the gap between the design performance and the achieved performance at the operational level. We further show the gap is usually within 5%. In addition, we have studied some variation of the existing flexibility model, such as the box size design in e-commerce. This provides some guidance for those e-commerce companies to balance the tradeoff between efficiently using the shipping capacity and reducing the complexity of managing the packing facilities. Our project also investigates some other types of flexibility, such as order taking decisions, and offers solution schemes.

16211117.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16211117.value: Integrated coal gasification combined cycle (IGCC) is a very important process in the coming future to increase the efficiency of power generation from coal, in the meantime reduce emissions. An IGCC is an integration of a air separation unit (ASU), a coal gasification reaction unit and a combined cycle power plant. The ASU separates O2 from air. Coal is then gasified by reacting with O2 with the existence of high pressure steam to produce combustible gases that contains H2, CO and CH4. The gases after cleaning are used as fuel to drive a combined cycle power plant to produce electricity. The overall process is very complex and the units are highly integrated. The objective of this research was to investigate how mathematical models can be applied to improve this integration and the performance of the process. In the last few years, some new modeling techniques have been proposed for rigorous distillation and multi-stream heat exchanger, that are the major processing units in ASU; simplified models for IGCC; convexification methods to reduce the computational difficulty in solution, etc. A research student is still working on this project and expect to complete the project in September 2022.

16211217.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16211217.value: In a transit-oriented metropolis, such as Hong Kong, where buses carry over 51% of the daily 11 million passenger trips, emissions from heavy-duty diesel vehicles, mostly buses, could constitute up to 80-90% of roadside emissions (EPD, 2013). It is difficult to address the air quality problem without addressing the emissions from buses. Electric buses (EB) are often considered as an important part of the solution, albeit EB deployment encounters major obstacles, such as limited range, scarcity of charging facilities, and of course, vehicle cost. How to route and schedule EB under range and recharging constraints is a key problem to be tackled. Moreover, the EB driving range is subject to uncertainty, which may vary with congestion, passenger loading, etc. Their efficient utilization requires an explicit treatment of this range uncertainty in their routing and scheduling plan. Furthermore, it may be beneficial to maintain a mixed fleet of buses, EB and other clean-energy buses, to complement each other for range coverage, vehicle and operating costs, and emissions reduction. EB deployment also hinges on the provision of charging stations. It may be that extensive EB deployment would not naturally occur based on the operator’s own cost-benefit analysis if the benefit from emissions reduction is ignored. Thus, it may be sensible for the government to subsidize their deployment for enhanced financial viability, with the subsidy commensurate with the benefit of the associated emissions reduction. This proposal will investigate the interplay among three stakeholders in the development of sustainable mixed-bus fleet management strategies: operator, passengers, and government. Such an understanding will facilitate the development of bus fleet management strategies and subsidy policies for ensuring their financial viability, maintaining passenger travel convenience, and reducing emissions. In this project, firstly we will formulate the scheduling and routing of a mixed-bus fleet jointly with charging stations. The key will be to incorporate the range constraints precisely using the time-space network approach. Secondly, we will optimize the fleet management strategies while treating the driving range uncertainty explicitly using the stochastic programming approach. The question is how to design the routing and scheduling of EB to properly balance their fuller utilization and the risk of en route stranding. Thirdly, we will investigate the need of subsidy policies for progressively phasing in EB and other cleaner buses over time. 16211417.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16211417.value: Simulation is used extensively to facilitate decision making processes in many areas including health care, finance, manufacturing, logistics, telecommunication, etc. However, simulation models are often computationally expensive to execute, severely restricting the usefulness of simulation in settings such as real-time decision making and system optimization. Metamodeling has been actively developed in the simulation community to alleviate computational inefficiency. The basic concept is that the user executes the simulation model only at a small number of carefully selected “design points”. A metamodel can be built to approximate the true response surface by interpolating the simulation outputs. The responses at other points are then predicted by the metamodel without running the simulation at all, thereby substantially reducing the computational costs. However, existing metamodels usually treat the simulation model as a black box, discarding the structural properties of the response surface. Therefore, they often fail to capture highly nonlinear response surfaces, which may lead to a misleading decision concerning a stochastic system of interest. The proposed research will address this defect of simulation metamodeling in order to give more reliable simulation-based decisions in dynamic environments. We propose a new metamodeling technique called regularized stochastic kriging, which builds on two central concepts. One is to incorporate an analytical model that admits a closed-form solution at the cost of (overly) simplifying assumptions. Representing the domain knowledge of the stochastic system, this analytical model is expected to provide a rough approximation of the nonlinear trend, removing a great portion of variation of the response surface. The other is to use general-purpose basis functions to characterize the “detrended” surface, i.e. the difference between the analytical model and the true response surface. We will use regularized regression to select the significant basis functions automatically from a potentially large collection to avoid overfitting. In this project, we will develop a comprehensive methodology for the new metamodel. First, we will develop a penalized maximum likelihood estimation (PMLE) scheme for estimating the unknown parameters. Second, we will establish the large-sample properties of PMLE, including sparsity and asymptotic normality. The sparsity will guarantee that insignificant basis functions would be excluded asymptotically. Third, we will devise efficient algorithms for computationally solving the PMLE problem. Finally, we will show that the PMLE scheme can substantially reduce the variance of the prediction at the cost of introducing a small bias, thereby improving the overall prediction accuracy in terms of the mean squared error. 仿真作為一種輔助決策的工具被廣泛運用於 健康、金融、生產、物流、通信等諸多領域。然而，仿真模型通常需要較高的計算成本，這一缺陷嚴重限制了仿真在實時決策和系統優化等領域的應用。 近年來在仿真研究領域，“元建模”作為一種可以有效降低仿真模型計算成本的技術得到了廣泛關註。這一技術的主要基礎如下：仿真模型的使用者只在有限少數幾個經過仔細選擇的設計點計算仿真模型，然後通過擬合在這幾個設計點上得到的仿真模型輸出量來構造一個關於真實未知函數的元模型。隨後其他任意設計點上的未知函數值就可以通過這個元模型簡單計算得出，無需再計算仿真模型，從而大幅降低了計算成本。現有的元模型一般把仿真模型當做一個“黑箱”，不考慮真實未知函數的任何可能的結構信息。因此，這些元模型不能很好的擬合高度非線性的真實未知函數，造成隨後的決策失準。 本研究計劃的目標就是解決仿真元建模的這個缺陷，從而提供一個更加可靠的能應用於動態決策環境中的仿真輔助決策工具。我們將提出一種新的元建模技術叫做“正則化隨機克裏金差值” 。該技術建立在兩個關鍵想法上：一、在元建模時包含一個簡單的解析模型。這個解析模型能代表一個隨機系統的領域知識，我們預期它能夠粗略地體現未知真實函數的某種非線性趨勢，從而可以去除該函數曲面的大部分變化。二、應用一般的基函數組來刻畫“去趨勢”的函數曲面。我們將使用正則化回歸方法來從一大類候選基函數中自動地選擇有價值的基函數。 我們將為這個新的仿真元模型開發一套完整的方法輪。第一，我們會研究一種正則化最大似然估計方法來估計元模型的未知參數。第二，我們將建立這個參數估計方法的大樣本性質，例如疏性和近似正態性。其中疏性能夠保證沒有價值的基函數在大樣本的時候能夠被自動排除。第三，我們會提出高效的方法來解決參數估計中的計算問題。最後，我們會證明這套正則化最大似然估計方法能夠大幅降低元模型預測的方差，而付出的代價僅僅是在稍微增加的估計偏差，整體的效果則是可以大幅提高預測的準確性。

16211417.label: Realisation of objectives
16211417.value: Regarding objective (i): To analyze the behavior of a complex stochastic system, one runs a simulation model that characterizes the performance measure (i.e., response surface) of the system as a function of the design variables. For example, when simulating queueing systems, the design variables may include service rates and the number of servers, while the response surface may be the steady-state expected number of customers in the system. Despite of the popularity, simulation models are often time-consuming to run, which severely restricts the usefulness of simulation in settings such as real-time decision making and system optimization. A standard method to address this shortcoming of simulation models is metamodeling. That is, one runs the simulation model only at a small number of carefully selected “design points”, and then fit the simulation data to a statistical model, which becomes the metamodel (i.e., model of the simulation model). The metamodel is then used to predict the responses at other design points without running the simulation model, thereby substantially reducing the computational burden. However, most metamodels do not take into account domain knowledge that one might have about the system, and thus they often fail to capture highly nonlinear response surfaces. We focus on Gaussian process-based metamodels that are widely used in simulation literature. A Gaussian process (GP) is characterized by two elements: mean function and covariance function (i.e., kernel). Our approach to enhancing metamodeling is to consider a stylized model that yields an analytical expression for the performance measure of interest, and then incorporate the analytical expression as part of the mean function of the GP. A stylized model—however crude it may appear—represents the domain knowledge and may capture the general trend of the response surface, particularly those parts with high nonlinearity. The “detrended” surface has a substantially lower level of variations, and thus it is easier to predict. We apply this new GP-based metamodel to various practical problems including patient flow management and air cargo operations. The improvement in prediction accuracy is significant. We also apply it to accelerate the convergence of metamodel-based algorithms for simulation optimization. Regarding objective (ii): One may incorporate the analytical function inspired by the stylized model to a set of generic basis functions (e.g., polynomials) and use the linear combination of the augmented set of basis functions as the mean function of a GP. We follow a Bayesian perspective, which is consistent with GP modeling, to estimate the coefficients associated with these basis functions in the linear combination. That is, we assign a prior on these coefficients and use the posterior as their estimates. In this Bayesian formulation, the GP with a linear mean function is equivalent to a GP with a kernel modified by the basis functions. Thus, from a modeling point of view, selecting a set of basis functions is equivalent to selecting a kernel. This insight allows us to focus on kernels and conduct principled analysis, instead of somewhat ad hoc treatment related to basis functions. If the decision variable is multidimensional, which is often the case in practice, more simulation data are needed to fit a GP than the one-dimensional case. Because at the heart of GP-related computations lie numerical inversion of kernel matrices, the more data are involved, the larger the kernel matrices are, and the more computationally challenging the matrix inversion becomes. Our novel approach to addressing this common issue is to construct a new class of kernels, called tensor Markov (TM) kernels. Thanks to the Markov property, GPs with TM kernels admit an orthogonal expansion in the form of an infinite sum of independent normal random variables. Taking advantage of this expansion, we can show in a large-sample asymptotic regime, predictions of a GP with TM kernel converge to the true value at a rate that does not deteriorate quickly as the dimensionality of the design space grows. This theoretical result is complemented with extensive numerical studies to showcase that the new GP-based metamodel does not suffer much from the curse of dimensionality and can become a variable option for high-dimensional metamodeling. Regarding objective (iii): Not only do TM kernels yield sample efficiency in high dimensions, they also make the related GP computations fast. The Markov property induces a sparse structure in the inverse kernel matrix, provided that the design points are selected according to the so-called sparse grid experimental design. We show that the proportion of nonzero entries decays to zero as the size of the matrix grows. Moreover, the positions of most of zero entries can be identified and the nonzero entries can be calculated in closed form. These properties, combined with the use of sparse linear algebra, result in highly efficient algorithms for both training the GP-based metamodel and performing subsequent predictions. We demonstrate through various numerical examples that our method is significantly faster (sometimes by orders of magnitude) than typical methods in the literature. Regarding objective (iv): In general, the prediction capability of a GP-based metamodel depends on three aspects—the mean function, the kernel, and the experimental design. Through this project, we have developed news metamodels from all these aspects—leveraging stylized models to construct a better mean function, developing the class of TM kernels, and using sparse grid designs. We apply these metamodels in a variety of problems, including queueing simulation, nested simulation, and simulation optimization. The advantages of our metamodels are rigorously proved in theory. For example, in the setting of nested simulation, we prove that using metamodel can increase the cubic root convergence of the standard nested simulation to the square root convergence. For another example, in the setting of simulation optimization, we prove that the joint use of TM kernels and sparse grid designs yields algorithms that are both computationally fast and converge to a global optimal solution at a rate that does not suffer much from the curse of dimensionality. All these theoretical properties are accompanied with extension numerical experiments, which exhibit the superior performance of our methods relative to common practice.

16211417.label: Major findings and research outcome
16211417.value: First, we develop a new Gaussian process-based metamodel for queueing simulation. The new metamodel uses stylized queueing models to form the mean function of a Gaussian process that represents the unknown response surface associated with the queueing system. The domain knowledge encoded in stylized queueing models can capture the highly nonlinear part of the response surface, thereby substantially improve the prediction accuracy of the new metamodel. This work was published in 2018 in IISE Transactions (“Stochastic kriging for queueing simulation with stylized models”). Second, we further consider a more practical situation where both real data and simulation data are available, and develop a new metamodel to integrate both types of data. This metamodel can capture the modeling error of the simulation model relative to the real system. The working paper “Stochastic kriging for inadequate simulation models” is under revision for Naval Research Logistics. Third, we find that in the presence of many basis functions, the computation of Gaussian process-based metamodels is often subject to numerical issues related to matrix inversion. This motivates us to construct tensor Markov kernels, a new class of kernels for Gaussian processes. The resulting metamodels are numerically stable and computationally fast. The working paper “Scalable stochastic kriging with Markovian covariances” is under revision for Operations Research. An extension of this work was published in the Proceedings of the 2018 Winter Simulation Conference (“A scalable approach to enhancing stochastic kriging with gradients”). Fourth, we apply the regularization idea from statistical learning to construct a metamodel and use it to solve problems involving nested simulation, particularly those from financial risk management. The use of the metamodel significantly improves the convergence rate of the nested simulation. The working paper “Smooth nested simulation: Bridging cubic and square root convergence rates in high dimensions” is under review in Management Science. Lastly, we explore the use of metamodels in simulation optimization. This results in two papers. One is a book chapter “Surrogate-based simulation optimization”, published in 2021 in the INFORMS TuORials series. The other is to use the aforementioned tensor Markov kernels to construct metamodels to solve simulation optimization problems in high dimensions. We show both in theory and through numerical experiments that this method can substantially mitigate the curse of dimensionality. The working paper “High-dimensional simulation optimization via Brownian fields and sparse grids” is under revision for Operations Research.

16211417.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16211417.value: A key idea of this project is to leverage domain knowledge of the stochastic system of interest to improve prediction accuracy of a metamodel. In this project, the domain knowledge takes the form of an analytical model for the stochastic system. However, domain knowledge can be encoded in other forms, such as convexity or smoothness. We may take advantage of such structural information to further improve the prediction accuracy of metamodels. Another future direction is to develop new metamodels for modern parallel computing environments. Although simulation experiments are slow to run, different experiments are usually independent and can be run on different computer processors. It is of great interest to investigate how to combine simulation data from different processors to build a good metamodel without suffering much from communication costs among the processors. Lastly, an emerging decision-making paradigm in e-commerce is optimization with covariates. One does not seek a single optimal decision, but an optimal policy that prescribes the optimal decision dependent on the covariates. We may build a metamodel to capture the relationship between the performance measure of interest and the pair of covariates and decision variables, and then optimize it to identify a good policy.

16211417.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16211417.value: Simulation is used extensively to facilitate decision making processes in areas such as healthcare, finance, and supply chain management. However, running simulation models are often time-consuming. A popular solution is metamodeling: one runs the simulation model only at certain carefully selected design points, and then approximate the true response surface by fitting the simulation outputs to a statistical model. Existing metamodels usually discard the structural properties of the response surface and suffer from inaccurate predictions. We have developed a new metamodeling approach that is built on two ideas: (i) exploiting domain knowledge of the stochastic system to remove removing a great portion of variation of the response surface, and (ii) using regularization to improve prediction accuracy via a trade-off between data fitting and model complexity. In addition to the enhanced prediction capability, the new approach is computationally much faster. Both properties have rigorous theoretical supports. We have also demonstrated the advantages of the new approach in a variety of challenging problems, particularly in high-dimensional settings.

16211617.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16211617.value: Infrastructure decay is a big problem faced by many countries around the world. For reinforced concrete, which is widely used for the construction of civil infrastructure, corrosion of steel reinforcements is the major cause of deterioration. In the presence of water, expansion of rust leads to spalling of the concrete cover, thus exposing the steel directly to the environment. With greatly increased corrosion rate, the rapid loss in steel area will eventually affect the safety of the structure. The most common repair approach is to splice a new piece of steel to the corroded reinforcement. To provide sufficient lap length for stress transfer, a large volume of sound concrete on both sides of the corroded steel needs to be removed. This particular step significantly increases the time and cost of the repair process. The proposed study will focus on a new repair methodology based on the use of a pseudo-ductile fiber reinforced mortar that can carry tensile stress of 8-10 MPa after yielding occurs in the steel reinforcement. With the tensile load carrying capacity of the pseudo-ductile mortar compensating for the loss due to steel corrosion, splicing of additional steel reinforcement is no longer necessary. Due to the strong bonding between the repair mortar and steel, the amount of concrete removed to provide the bond length can be significantly reduced. To develop and verify this new repair approach, basic research has to be conducted at both the materials and structural component levels. Specifically, while high strength pseudo-ductile cementitious materials have been reported in the literature, a composition satisfying the requirements of the repair application, including low shrinkage, simple curing process and strong bonding to existing concrete, is yet to be developed. For corroded longitudinal steel reinforcements, the required bond length of the repair mortar is an important design parameter governed by the bond-slip relation at the steel/mortar interface, which will be determined with a combined experimental/numerical approach. To compensate for corroded shear reinforcements, experiments will first be performed to derive an empirical equation for the shear strength of the repair mortar. After obtaining the bond-slip relation and shear strength equation, their applicability will be verified by designing and testing repaired specimens with corroded flexural and shear reinforcements. Successful completion of this project will provide the scientific basis for a new methodology that can significantly enhance the efficiency of infrastructure repair while reducing the associated cost.

16211617.label: Realisation of objectives
16211617.value: All the objectives have been fully achieved. For the first objective, we have developed various compositions of Pseudo-ductile Cementitious Composites (PDCC, also commonly referred to as Engineered Cementitious Composites, ECC, or Strain Hardening Cementitious Composites, SHCC) with tensile strength above 10MPa and tensile strain capacity (i.e., the strain at the end of the tensile strain hardening regime) above 2%. With such mechanical performance, the PDCC can be used as a repair mortar to compensate for the reduction in load carrying capacity of a corroded steel reinforcement. As the water/binder of the mix is very low, shrinkage can be an issue in practice, especially when the material is used for repair because the underlying concrete is already very mature and will not shrink further. To reduce the shrinkage of the PDCC, both shrinkage reducing admixture (SRA) and calcium sulfoaluminate (CSA) cement were employed at different dosages to study their effects on (i) the shrinkage reduction under different conditions and (ii) the mechanical performance. Testing was performed under two different conditions – sealed at all times and with drying started at 3d age. Shrinkage development throughout a duration of 10 weeks was compared among different mixes. The test results show that SRA can effectively reduce the shrinkage of high strength SHCC and there exists an optimal dosage beyond which the reduction stays about the same. For CSA, the shrinkage of OPC can be offset effectively only when the final set of the mix occurs prior to the completion of the expansive hydration of CSA cement. The combined use of SRA and CSA cement can produce even lower shrinkage, but synergistic effect (i.e. total shrinkage reduction much higher than the sum of individual reductions) is not observed. The use of SRA reduces short-term compressive and tensile strength slightly, but has little influence on long-term compressive strength. On the other hand, CSA cement results in a larger reduction in both compressive and tensile strength, although it can provide high early strength. For the second objective, the bond behavior between steel rebars and PDCC has been studied through a combination of experimental testing and numerical modeling. Bond test in direct tension was performed on prismatic specimens made of PDCC or concrete, with rebars protruded from both sides for the application of tensile loading. The effects of materials, cover thicknesses and rebar sizes on the bond behavior were first studied experimentally. For the numerical simulation, instead of using a detailed model that would involve complex geometry and comprehensive bond mechanisms, a simplified finite element model was adopted. In the model, all non-linear behaviors were integrated into spring elements linking the PDCC and steel rebar elements. The spring behavior is back-fitted according to the experimentally determined load-displacement relation. Using the spring behaviour derived from a particular set of tests, the experimental results for other tests (with different bond length and cover thickness) could be predicted with good accuracy. The effectiveness of the modelling process is hence verified. To verify the possibility to repair concrete beams with the PDCC repair mortar, reinforced concrete beams containing steel rebar with reduced area over part of its length (to simulate corrosion) were prepared. The region around the reduced steel area was patched with PDCC mortar extending beyond the ‘corroded’ zone by the proper bond length. Experimental testing revealed that the load carrying capacity of a member containing a 20mm diameter high yield steel rebar with 25% reduction in cross sectional area can be fully recovered with the use of PDCC as patching material. The addition of a new piece of rebar is hence no longer necessary. For the third objective, two different approaches for the shear strengthening of reinforced concrete beams with high strength PDCC have been investigated. In the first approach, beam members with two different shear span/depth ratios (1.5 and 2.5), and reduced shear reinforcement area (i.e., smaller shear stirrups) on one side were prepared to simulate the situations with (i) uniformly corroded shear stirrups repaired by patching of repair mortar alone, or (ii) change of loading condition (e.g., increased traffic loading on a bridge) so the shear capacity has to be increased. To strengthen the member, two layers of high strength PDCC was applied to the opposite lateral surfaces of the weak span. The beams were then loaded to shear failure, together with control beams without the PDCC layers. The effective shear strength of PDCC was determined and the value was found to be lower for the case with higher span/depth ratio. Finite element modeling was also carried out and very good agreement between experimental and numerical results was achieved. Further simulations with the finite element model were therefore performed to study the effects of (i) shear span/depth ratio and (ii) PDCC thickness on the increase in shear load capacity. Based on the results, the strengthening with PDCC plate is found to be most effective when the span/depth ratio is between 1.5 to 2.5. For the aspect ratios of 1.5 and 2.5, empirical equations for the increase in shear capacity with the use of PDCC are proposed. In the second approach, beams were designed to have the same number (and size) of stirrups on the two sides, but the area of 3 adjacent stirrups on one side of the member was reduced by 50% or 100% (fully cut) over a significant part of their lengths to simulate very severe corrosion. The beams were then repaired by filling the space around the ‘corroded’ stirrups with high strength PDCC. Testing was performed on (i) beams with full reinforcement, (ii) beams with ‘corroded’ stirrups and PDCC, and (iii) beams with ‘corroded’ stirrups cast inside (which were not repaired with PDCC). From the test results, the effectiveness of PDCC as repair material was clearly observed. For both 50% and 100% steel area loss in the stirrups, the shear capacity can be recovered to over 95% of the original value with the use of PDCC mortar alone without the additional of new steel reinforcements. The results are also confirmed by the results of finite element analysis, as the simulated load vs displacement curves were close to the test results though the predicted peak load was slightly higher due to the assumption of perfect bonding between steel reinforcement and PDCC.

16211617.label: Major findings and research outcome
16211617.value: The completion of the various research tasks leads to the following findings: (1) With the use of low water/binder ratio, silica fume, fine sand and polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) fiber, pseudo-ductile cementitious composites (PDCC) with high compressive strength (>130MPa) and tensile strength (around 10MPa) can be prepared. The high shrinkage (~1500x10-6) of such mix can be effectively reduced by the use of calcium sulfoaluminate (CSA) cement, shrinkage reduction admixture (SRA) or a combination of both. The use of SRA has less effect on strength but the shrinkage reduction is also not as high as that for CSA. The combined use of SRA and CSA is found to be effective in optimizing the strength and shrinkage performance of PDCC. Details can be found in Paper 2 of Section C. (2) For flexural members with steel reinforcement corroded along part of its length, high strength PDCC is shown to be a very effective repair material. Specifically, for a 20mm rebar with up to 25% area loss, the load carrying capacity can be fully recovered by filling the space around the rebar with high strength PDCC, without adding a new piece of steel reinforcement. The experimental study is reported in Paper 1 of Section C. (3) The bond-slip relation between steel rebar and PDCC is a critical ‘parameter’ for designing the repair as it governs the amount of concrete that needs to removed on both sides of the corroded region to enable sufficient stress transfer to the PDCC. To determine this relation, a combined experimental-numerical method has been developed. The derived bond-slip relation from one set of specimens is found to be able to predict other results (for different bond length and cover/rebar size ratio) accurately. The general applicability of the bond-slip relation is hence verified. Details are found in paper 3 of Section C (4) For shear strengthening of concrete beams with uniformly corroded reinforcements over a large region along the span, experimental and numerical studies have shown that the application of a layer of high strength PDCC on the surface is an effective way to recover the load carrying capacity. This work is reported in paper 4 of Section C. For beams with severe localized corrosion (e.g. for several adjacent stirrups), PDCC applied around the corroded steel stirrups (similar to the case for flexural reinforcements) can recover a large portion of the strength loss.

16211617.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16211617.value: In the completed project, we have successfully developed a new repair method for reinforced concrete members with corroded steel reinforcements. With the use of high strength PDCC as repair mortar to recover the load carrying capacity, the addition of a new rebar and is no longer required. However, based on our calculations, the approach is only applicable to high yield steel rebars with area loss of 20% to 25% (depending on the rebar size and concrete cover). For cases with even more severe steel corrosion up to 50% loss of reinforcement area, the repair concept can be extended by the incorporation of a carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) strip into the SHCC. For the proper design of this composite repair system, studies need to be conducted on the interaction between SHCC and the embedded CFRP strip. Specifically, the shear stress vs displacement relation at the CFRP/SHCC interface has to be derived and various failure mechanisms of the repair system, such as CFRP debonding and cover separation failure, need to be fully understood. A GRF proposal (RGC16204421) on structural repair with CFRP/SHCC was submitted to RGC in 2020 and funding to conduct the work was approved in summer 2021.

16211617.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16211617.value: Reinforced concrete structures make up a large proportion of civil infrastructure around the world. For many cities in coastal regions (such as Hong Kong), where sea spray carries salt to the structure surface, or cold regions, where salt is employed for de-icing, corrosion of steel reinforcements and the resulting loss of steel area will affect structural safety. To renovate the structure, the conventional approach is to add a new piece of steel reinforcing bar to compensate for the steel area loss. This would require a large amount of sound concrete to be removed on both sides of the corroded region for loading transfer between the existing and new rebars. The present study develops high strength pseudo-ductile cementitious composites (PDCC) which can be applied around the corroded steel rebar to recover the load carrying capacity without adding a new piece of steel. With strong bonding with the existing steel rebar, a very short bond length is sufficient for stress transfer so the amount of concrete to be removed, and the associated time and cost, is greatly reduced. The developed technology can hence effectively facilitate structural repair and maintenance to extend the life of the existing civil infrastructure.

16212017.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16212017.value: Organosulfates are ubiquitous components of particulate matter (PM) in the atmosphere, formed from organic compounds or their oxidation products interacting with acidic sulfate particles. The Pearl River Delta (PRD) is a fast-developing and heavily polluted region in South China, burdened with excessive emissions of sulfur dioxide (precursor of PM sulfate) and volatile organic compounds (VOCs). In addition, the PRD has an active biosphere contributing significant emissions of biogenic VOCs (BVOCs). As a result, organosulfates are likely an important contribution to PM pollution in the PRD. Quantitative field data such as total organic sulfur (OS) content and abundance of individual organosulfates are needed for assessing their environmental impact but these data are lacking. The bottlenecks are a lack of a proper method for determining total OS and a shortage of authentic standards for quantification of individual OS compounds. We propose to develop a suitable analytical scheme to directly measure OS by removing the inorganic sulfate first followed by separate quantification of water-insoluble OS and water-soluble OS. Once the method is developed and tested, it will be applied to analyze the total OS in archived filters that we have collected at four locations of different atmospheric pollution characteristics in the PRD. The results will allow us to assess the mass contributions of OS compounds to PM2.5 pollution and spatiotemporal variations in the region. The lack of authentic standards will be initially tackled through organic synthesis of a series of BVOC-derived organosulfates due to their importance in the PRD. Four monoterpene-derived organosulfates have already been synthesized and more will be made through this project. The secure and sufficient supply of these synthetic standards will enable us to provide standards for their absolute quantification using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometric analysis. Efforts to quantify individual OS compounds will focus on the BVOC-derived organosulfates with synthetic standards and the newly discovered alkyl sulfates for which commercial standards are available. The quantitative capability for individual organosulfates will be used to study their diurnal variation characteristics. Such studies could offer insights into major factors (such as aerosol liquid water content, type of atmospheric oxidants) influencing the sulfonation process. The atmospheric research community will benefit from the synthetic methods for the preparation of organosulfates and analytical methods to be developed through this research. This in turn will facilitate understanding of the environmental and health impact of PM pollution in city clusters of China. 有机硫酸酯类化合物是大气颗粒物中普遍存在的组分，其形成来自有机化合物或其氧化产物与酸性硫酸盐颗粒之间的化学反应。珠三角地区经济发展迅速，伴随着区域资源和能源的消耗，多种大气污染物包括二氧化硫（硫酸盐颗粒的前体物）和挥发性有机化合物高强度集中排放。此外，珠三角地处亚热带，活跃的生态系统有利于生物源挥发性有机化合物的排放。因此，有机硫酸酯类化合物可能是该地区大气颗粒物污染中的重要组成。目前对于大气有机硫酸酯的了解相当有限，要进一步研究其形成机理和环境影响，获得准确的大气有机硫酸酯浓度水平数据无疑是一项关键的基础工作。当今量化大气有机硫酸酯的瓶颈主要在于缺乏直接检测大气颗粒物中总有机硫的分析方法和用于定量有机硫酸酯化合物的标准物质。 本研究致力于开发大气颗粒物中总有机硫的直接分析方法，研究难点包括样品前处理中先去除无机硫酸盐然后分离非水溶性和水溶性有机硫进行定量。我们计划利用所研发的方法分析在珠三角不同大气污染特征站点收集到的颗粒物膜样品。研究数据将使我们能够量化评估有机硫酸酯化合物对珠三角颗粒物污染的质量贡献及其区域时空变化。 本研究的另一目标是合成一系列重要的生物源有机硫酸酯化合物，将其作为标准物质结合高效液相色谱/质谱联用技术从分子结构上定性定量大气有机硫酸酯，以研究不同种类大气有机硫酸酯的形成机制和影响因素（如大气颗粒物的酸度及含水量、大气氧化剂的类型等），也为进一步研究大气有机硫酸酯对环境、气候和健康的影响提供坚实的数据基础。

16212017.label: Realisation of objectives
16212017.value: Objective 1: We explored two analytical approaches to assess the total OS quantity. The first one is a subtraction method, with OS taken to be the difference between the total S measured by X-ray fluorescence (XRF) spectrometry and the S associated with inorganic sulfate measured by ion chromatography. The OS quantity by this approach is actually non-sulfate sulfur (NSS), which provides an upper bound estimate of total OS, as we there might be other inorganic sulfur chemical forms (e.g., sulfite). A disadvantage with this approach is the inherent large uncertainty associated with the difference quantity of two large numbers. The second approach is to approximate the total OS as the sum of OS associated with the water-soluble HULIS fraction and the water-insoluble S. The HULIS fraction is obtained by passing aerosol water extracts through a solid-phase extraction step to remove inorganic sulfur ions, and HULIS-S is quantified using inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometer (ICP-OES). The water-insoluble S is obtained by carrying out XRF analysis of water-washed residue filters. We also explored the feasibility of quantifying the fraction OS that is extractable with organic solvent, which has turned out to be unsuitable due to difficulty for ICP-OES to handle organic solvents and the generally poor reproducibility. Objective 2: PM2.5 samples collected in urban Guangzhou throughout 2012 were subjected to the various chemical analyses in related to S, including total S and water-insoluble S by XRF, sulfate-S by ion chromatography, and HULIS-S by ICP-OES. The difference method reports an annual average of OS at 0.503 ± 0.497µgS/m3, accounting for 13±7% of total S. In comparison, HULIS-S has an annual average of 0.060 ± 0.046 µgS/m3. Overall, the results indicate that organosulfur compounds constitute a significant part of particulate matter pollution. Objective 3: This objective has been realized fully, with the effective collaboration with Prof. Rongbiao Tong, a seasoned organic synthesis chemist and the project co-I. We developed a unified synthetic approach to synthesize 26 α-hydroxy organosulfates derived from eight monoterpenes and two sesquiterpenes (see Fig.1 in Wang YC et al, 2019). The synthetic route involved a two-step sequence: (a) sharpless asymmetric dihydroxylation of monoterpenes/sesquiterpenes and (b) sulfation with sulfur trioxide-pyridine complex (SO3·py) to afford the O-monosulfate products in 22−95% yield. The employment of AD mix-β in Sharpless asymmetric dihydroxylation, in which the bulky chiral ligand [(DHQD)2-PHAL] bound to OsO4, effectively differentiates the two faces of the alkene (absolute configuration) and thereby achieves excellent diastereoselectivity. The diol intermediates and the major organosulfate products in the crude synthetic reaction mixtures were purified by flash column chromatography on silica gel using gradient eluents and followed by characterization by 1H NMR, 13C NMR, and distortionless enhancement by polarization transfer (DEPT)-135. The minor organosulfate isomers (regioisomer and/or diastereomer) were not isolated but could be confirmed by LC/MS and MS/MS spectra, and such analytical information is valuable for identification of the relevant organosulfates in ambient samples. We have also applied the knowledge and skills acquired in this work to synthesize nitrooxy organosulfates derived from select terpene compounds (Wang YC et al, 2021). Objective 4: The availability of authentic α-hydroxy monoterpenes-derived organosulfate standards opens the door for their positive identification and accurate quantification in ambient samples. The presence and abundance of the six monoterpene-derived OSs and one sesquiterpene-derived OS were identified and quantified in ambient PM2.5 samples collected from five sites in the Pearl River Delta and in a site in urban Shanghai. The average concentration of individual organosulfates was at the level of 4.5−266 pg/m3. The highest concentration for individual organosulfates varied from 89 pg/m3 (Δ3-carene-derived organosulfate) to 459 pg/m3 (limonene-derived organosulfate). With the positively identified organosulfates serving as critical references in the chromatogram, we also confirmed the presence of 14 additional organosulfates that are derived from other monoterpenes or re-arrangement products of α-hydroxy monoterpenes-derived organosulfates (Wang YC et al., 2019). The synthetic standards were also shared with Prof. Hartmut Herrmann’s group in Leibniz Institute for Tropospheric Research (TROPOS) in Germany. This collaborative effort has permitted quantification of the total concentrations of known and unknown organosulfates derived from monoterpenes and sesquiterpenes in rural Germany and in northern China using a combined targeted and untargeted approach of high-resolution chromatography-Orbitrap mass spectrometry (Bruggemann et al., 2019).

16212017.label: Major findings and research outcome
16212017.value: Inorganic sulfate, predominately formed from atmospheric oxidation of sulfur dioxide, has long been recognized as a major constituent of particulate matter pollution (Xue et al., 2019). The co-existence of the reactive inorganic sulfate and a myriad of organic compounds in the atmosphere produces numerous organosulfur (OS) compounds. This work has addressed two issues related to quantifying the presence of OS in atmospheric aerosols, namely a shortage of authentic standards for quantifying of individual OS compounds and a lack of a proper method for determining the bulk total OS quantity. Tackling both issues are needed for assessing the environmental impacts of OS compounds. We have developed a unified synthetic approach to synthesize α-hydroxy organosulfates, starting from dihydroxylation of commonly available alkene materials followed by monosulfation with the sulfur trioxide-pyridine complex. Using this synthetic method, we substantially expand the OS standard library by creating 26 α-hydroxy organosulfates derived from terpenes, a group of important volatile organic compounds emitted by the nature (Wang YC et al, 2019). The experience in this synthetic work has contributed to success in synthesizing nitrooxy organosulfates, a group of synthetically more challenging compounds (Wang YC et al, 2021). The availability of authentic α-hydroxy monoterpenes-derived organosulfate standards yields definitive knowledge of the tandem mass spectrometric characteristics and chromatographic retention times, which is critical for the positive identification and accurate quantification of individual organosulfates in ambient samples. Using these newly created standards, we have positively identified six monoterpene-derived OSs and one sesquiterpene-derived OS in ambient PM2.5 samples and accurately quantified their concentration levels (Wang YC et al, 2019, Wang YJ, 2019; 2020). The quantitative knowledge of individual organosulfates further allows the comparative study of key influential factors of their atmospheric formation in an urban site and in a regional site (Wang YJ et al., 2020). It was revealed that organosulfates would play more important roles in aerosol properties as inorganic sulfate decline in abundance due to effective controls. Analytical methods for bulk total OS quantities were also explored, producing useful constrains on the upper bound estimate and also semi-quantitative assessment of the relative importance of inorganic sulfate-S and OS. Application of the bulk OS methods to PM2.5 samples collected in urban Guangzhou indicates organosulfur compounds constitute a significant part of particulate matter pollution.

16212017.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16212017.value: This research can be further developed in the following perspectives. First, the authentic organosulfate standards made available through our organic synthesis work permits the study of the atmospheric stability and reactivity of these compounds. For example, my research group is collaborating with Prof. Man Nin Chan in the Chinese University of Hong Kong to probe the heterogeneous oxidation reaction of 2-hydroxy α-pinene organosulfate with OH radical. The preliminary results indicate that the heterogenous oxidation of this α-pinene-derived organosulfate leads to production of other organosulfates but does not generate inorganic sulfate, the latter is different from the chemistry of methyl sulfate. Such work provides basic information on the atmospheric transformation of organosulfates, which is required in developing predictive ability for aerosol chemical and physical properties. Second, the new standards can be used to quantify biogenic VOCs-derived organosulfates in a wider range of atmospheric environments. Joint with other related measurements such as biogenic VOCs, inorganic sulfate, such field measurements will shed light to interlocking interactions between the biosphere and anthroposphere.

16212017.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16212017.value: Particulate matter (PM) is among the most serious atmospheric pollutants that threat public health. Inorganic sulfate, predominately formed from atmospheric oxidation of sulfur dioxide, has long been recognized as a major constituent of PM pollution. The co-existence of the reactive inorganic sulfate and a myriad of organic compounds in the atmosphere produces numerous organosulfur (OS) compounds. Quantitative knowledge of OS, such as its extent in PM and abundance of individual OS molecules, is lacking yet essential in assessing its contribution to PM pollution. This work has addressed two issues related to quantifying OS in atmospheric aerosols, namely a shortage of authentic standards for individual OS compounds and a lack of a proper method for determining the bulk total OS quantity. We succeeded in creating 26 α-hydroxy organosulfates derived from terpenes, a group of important volatile organic compounds emitted by the nature. Using these newly created standards, we have positively identified seven terpene-derived organosulfates in ambient PM2.5 and accurately quantified their concentration levels. These terpene-derived molecules could potentially be used to track the degree of biosphere-anthroposphere interactions. Applications of the analytical method for bulk OS developed through this work also indicates that OS compounds constitute a significant part of PM pollution.

16212117.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16212117.value: Market making is the service provided by market makers for investors who would like to buy or sell certain securities in the financial market immediately. Market making plays an important role for the effective and efficient operation of the financial markets. Through market making, market makers provide liquidity to the financial markets and facilitate the price discovery of the securities. Market makers provide both the bid prices and the ask prices and are obligated to buy at the bid prices and sell at the ask prices if there are investors who are willing to trade with them at the provided prices. When there is substantial imbalance in the supply and demand of a security from investors, the financial markets rely on the market makers to provide the liquidity needed by investors who cannot find other investors who are willing to trader against them at that particular moment. Market makers face two main kinds of risk: the risk of being adversely selected by informed traders and inventory risk. When the bid (ask) prices of the limit orders submitted by the market maker are too high (low), those orders may be executed against the orders from informed investors and result in losses to the market maker. A market maker may accumulate a substantial position of a security in his or her inventory which may cause losses when the market value of the securities in the inventory change in the unfavorable direction. In this project, I plan to propose a new market making model in which the midprice of a stock is modeled as a Hawkes jump diffusion process. In contrast to the existing literature in which the midprice is modeled as a diffusion process or a Poisson jump diffusion process, the new model better captures two empirical features: (i) the arrival of market buy and sell orders tend to incur the arrival of more market buy and sell orders, which can be better described by the Hawkes process; (ii) the arrival of market orders have price impact on the midprice, as the midprice of a stock jump up (down) immediately when a large market buy (sell) order arrives. I plan to solve the stochastic control problem for the optimal market making strategy. I also plan to carry out empirical studies on the effectiveness of the market making strategy and compare it with some strategies in the existing literature. 做市是金融機構為希望立刻在金融市場上買進或者賣出證券的投資者提供的一種服務。做市服務為金融市場的有效運作起到了重要的作用。通過提供做市服務，金融機構為金融市場提供流動性，並且有助於更及時有效的發現和確定證券的合理交易價格。做市機構在做市時需要同時提交買入和賣出的限價單到證券交易所等待交易，當投資者提交的交易指令和這些限價單相匹配時，做市機構有義務按照限價單指定的價格與投資者進行交易。當金融市場上某隻證券的來自投資者的供給量和需求量的差異較大的時候，投資者需要依賴做市機構提供的流動性才能立刻買進或者賣出，否則他們可能要等待較長的時間才能找到願意以他們可接受的價格和他們進行交易的另外一些投資者。做市機構在提供做市服務時，主要面臨兩類風險。一類是做市機構可能會被擁有更優質或更及時信息的交易對手反向選擇的風險。當做市機構提交的限價單的價格過高或者過低以至於過度偏離了證券的當前實際合理價值的時候，這些限價單會被擁有更優質信息的交易對手提交的市價單匹配交易（也就是被選擇），這樣會導致做市機構以不利的價格進行交易，因此造成損失。另一類風險是做市機構的庫存風險。做市機構在做市過程中的買進和賣出的證券的數量很可能不匹配，這樣就會逐漸累積相當數量的持有或者賣空的庫存量。當證券的市場價格向做市機構的庫存量的不利方向變化的時候，庫存量就會給做市機構帶來損失。 在這個項目中，我計劃研究一個新的做市策略的模型。在該模型中，我提出用霍克斯跳擴散模型來描述證券的中間價格隨時間的隨機變化。在已有的學術文獻中，證券的中間價格是用擴散過程或者泊松跳擴散過程來描述的。這個新的模型能夠比已有的模型更好的描述中間價格隨機變化的兩方面的實證特征：一是證券買賣過程中，市價買單和市價賣單的隨時間的到達過程具有自激發的特征，就是當某個時間段有較多市價單到來時，下一個時間段有較多市價單到來的可能性也會比較大。這一自激發的特征可以用霍克斯過程來描述，但泊松過程就不能體現這一特征。二是市價單的到來對中間價有較大的價格影響。當市價單的下單量較大時，市價單會與最優價格的所有限價單進行交易，從而引起證券中間價的跳躍。這一特性可以用跳擴散過程來描述。這個新的做市策略有助於更好的管理做市時面臨的風險。
