16302617.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302617.value: The ability to install a remote functional group in a stereocontrolled fashion in organic molecules is of fundamental importance since it represents the power of controlled organic synthesis toward more applications. However, remote stereocontrol control has been limitedly achieved so far. In this proposal, we aim to achieve a number of such examples that have not been straightforward with conventional strategy. Catalytic asymmetric conjugate addition is a well-known family of useful reactions for chiral molecule synthesis. However, the majority of currently known examples are 1,4-addition. Although some advances have been achieved with stereocontrolled 1,6-addition, here we plan to achieve the almost unkown asymmetric 1,8-addition employing para-quinone methides and aza-para-quinone methides as the key unit. Another part of this proposal is the use of strained rings, particularly oxetanes as the electrophilic unit, upon activation, to receive nucleophilic attack at the adjacent double or triple bond, thereby entailing remote stereocontrol on the resulting chiral products. The realization of these catalytic symmetric processes not only represents fundamental advances in organic synthesis, particularly remote asymmetric catalysis, but also leads to potentially important applications in human life, such as chiral drug and functional material synthesis. 在合成中使用遠程立體控制安裝功能組是至關重要的，因為它代表了具有更廣應用價值的定向合成手段。然而，到目前為止這種遠程立體控制仍然很有限。在本項目中，我們的目標是實現一些具有挑戰性的遠程控制。催化不對稱共軛加成是手性分子合成中的一大類反應。然而，目前大多數已知的實例是1,4-加成。雖然立體控制的1,6-加成已經取得了一些進展，但是在本項目中計劃實現的更遠程不對稱1,8-加成基本沒有實現。該項目的另一部分是在活化時使用張力環，特別是氧雜環丁烷作為親電單元，以在相鄰的雙重或三重鍵處接受親核攻擊，由此導致所得手性產物的遠程立體控制。這些過程的實現不僅代表了有機合成中遠程不對稱催化基礎研究的進步，更重要的是它們在人類生活和健康領域具有潛在的重要應用，如手性藥物和功能材料的合成。

16302617.label: Realisation of objectives
16302617.value: In this project, we have successfully developed a range of catalytic asymmetric processes for the synthesis of useful chiral building blocks. Specifically, remote stereocontrol in several reactions has been achieved, including 1,8-conjugate addition to quinone methides and aza-quinone methides as well as 1,10-conjugate addition. Excellent enantioselectivity has been achieved in all these cases. These reactions provide rapid access to previously in accessible chiral building blocks. The objectives of this proposal have been realized as expected. (1) Highly efficient enantioconvergent asymmetric 1,8-additions of para-QMs and aza-para-QMs has been developed. In the presence of a suitable chiral phosphoric acid catalyst, racemic aniline- or phenol-incorporated propargylic alcohols reacted to generate the (aza-)para-QM intermediates in situ and then underwent 1,8-addition by diverse nucleophiles to furnish a range of chiral allenes. It is remarkable to have the intermolecular C-C and C-heteroatom bond formed so efficiently between an axially chiral allene unit and a congested all-carbon quaternary stereocenter. The remote stereocontrol was also very noteworthy as demonstrated by the high enantioselectivity and diastereoselectivity. Mechanistically, we believe that the acid serves as a bifunctional catalyst to activate both reactants. (2) In another case, an organocatalytic enantioconvergent synthesis of chiral tetrasubstituted allenes by means of remote asymmetric 1,8-addition of the in situ-generated indole imine methide has also developed. With suitable chiral phosphoric acid catalysts, a range of racemic indole-substituted propargylic alcohols reacted smoothly with nucleophiles to provide mild and efficient access to a series of enantioenriched allenes with high yields and enantioselectivities. The product utility was also demonstrated by gram-scale synthesis and axial-to-central chirality transfer. Careful control experiments and kinetic studies excluded the SN2’ pathway with dynamic kinetic resolution, but suggested a remotely controlled addition to the key imine methide intermediate via a highly organized bifunctional transition state. (3) Asymmetric 1,10-conjugate addition is a formidable challenging in asymmetric synthesis. We have successfully achieved a rare example of this type. By suitable stabilization of 2-thiophenyl carbocation with an indole motif in the form of an extended indole imine methide, chiral phosphoric acid serves as a superior bifunctional catalyst to promote intermolecular C−C bond formation with excellent chemo-, regio- and enantioselectivity as well as the product double bond Z/E ratio. This protocol can be extended to the asymmetric dearomatization of selenophenes and furans. Control experiments and DFT calculations illustrated a possible pathway in which multiple hydrogen bonding interactions plays a crucial role in achieving excellent stereocontrol.

16302617.label: Major findings and research outcome
16302617.value: In this project, we have developed the following new organocatalytic processes leading to the synthesis of useful chiral privileged molecules. (1) We developed the first organocatalytic approach for direct conversion of racemic diarylmethanols to valuable chiral diarylmethylamines. (2) we developed a new organocatalytic addition of azlactones to quinone methides for the efficient synthesis of chiral β,β-diaryl-α-amino acid derivatives. (3) We have developed the first general trifluoromethylation at the γ position of carbonyl compounds by NHC-catalysis. (4) We developed a mild catalytic synthesis of 2-oxazolines via oxetane ring-opening: leading to a diverse family of natural products (5) We have developed the first catalytic asymmetric functionalization of unactivated benzylic C(sp3‒H) bonds of indoles. (6) We developed a catalytic enantioconvergent House‒Meinwald rearrangement for the synthesis of both cyclic and acyclic ketones bearing all-carbon quaternary stereocenters. (7) A highly efficient enantioconvergent asymmetric 1,8-addition of aza-para-QMs has been developed (8) We achieved a new catalytic asymmetric approach for the synthesis of chiral tetrahydrothiophenes and tetrahydroselenophenes, both are highly useful structures with limited efficient access previously. (9) We studied of the reactivity and selectivity of (aza-)quinone methides in selective C6-alkylations of indoles (10) We developed a new catalytic asymmetric approach for the synthesis of chiral α-amino ketones, which is particularly useful for the less accessible acyclic α-tertiary cases. (11) We discovered a new [3+2] annulation for the robust asymmetric synthesis of chiral pyrrolidinones, which complements their conventional synthetic strategies, particularly in view of the establishment of three consecutive stereogenic centers. (12) For the first time, we systematically demonstrated 3-aminooxetanes as versatile 1,3-amphoteric molecules. A range of cycloaddition reaction were developed based on this feature. (13) We developed the first catalytic enantioselective synthesis of chiral tetraarylmethanes, a unique family of spherical molecules without direct access previously. (14) We developed the first organocatalytic kinetic resolution of aziridines by sulfur nucleophiles. (15) We developed an efficient organocatalytic enantioselective dearomatization of thiophenes in the context of asymmetric 1,10-conjugate addition. (16) We disovered the first catalytic asymmetric formal cross dehydrogenative coupling for the efficient synthesis of enantioenriched chiral tetraarylmethanes

16302617.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16302617.value: As an extension of this project, the development of additional useful organocatalytic asymmetric processes will continue to be our topic of pursuit in this area. In particular, we will continue to explore and push the boundary of remote stereocontrol in the framework of quinone methides and indole imine methides. Moreover, remote stereocontrol in strained ring opening has still been challenging. We will spend more efforts in this direction in the future.

16302617.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16302617.value: In this project, we have discovered a range of new organic processes with excellent efficiency and selectivity. These processes utilized organocatalysts that do not involve metals, which are environmentally friendly. These catalysts showed excellent performance in the construction of highly useful structural motifs in many drug molecules, ie., stereocenters. More importantly, their function in these reactions can be effective in a long distance. These findings will contribute to the advances in drug discovery and environmental protection.

16302717.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302717.value: Following the remarkable progress made in understanding and controlling the electronic properties of graphene, researchers have turned their attention to finding other atomically thin two dimensional (2D) crystals obtainable from layered materials. The family of 2D materials is expanding including metals, semiconductors, and insulators, and covers a broad range of physical properties including superconductivity and ferromagnetism. The large number of 2D materials available today offer us the opportunity of stacking several 2D materials to form so-called van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures. These vdW heterostructures can reveal entirely new physical phenomena which can lead to various functionalities. In this project we will obtain vdW heterostructures using two approaches. One is the mechanical assembly of exfoliated 2D materials, the other is a combination of exfoliation with the direct growth of 2D materials using the chemical vapor deposition method. We will focus on vertical vdW heterostructures formed by a single or few layers of insulating hexagonal boron nitride, semiconducting transition metal dichalcogenides, semiconducting group-III monochalcogenides GaX and InX, and group-IV monochalcogenides SnX and GeX, where X is a chalcogen like S, or Se. We will study the tunneling, charge transfer and coupling, excitonic, and optoelectronic effects. We aim to explore new phenomena and new functionalities of these structures for potential application in devices. 在理解並控制石墨烯的電學性質方面取得了非凡的進展之後,研究人員已將注意力轉向 尋找其它可從層狀材料中獲得的具有原子級厚度的二維晶體。 二維材料系列正在擴展,包括了金屬、半導體和絕緣體,並呈現 出諸如超導性和鐵磁性在內的豐富的物理性質。 基於目前多種 可用的二維材料,可以對其中幾種進行堆疊形成范德華異質結。 這些范德華異質結可以揭示全新的物理現象,並實現不同的 功能。 在本申請專案中,我們將使用兩種方法制造范德華異 質結。 一種是將剝離的二維材料進行組裝,另一種是將剝離 與化學氣相沉積(CVD)生長二維材料相結合。 我們將專注于 由單層或幾層絕緣六方氮化硼、半導體性過渡金屬二硫屬化物、 半導體性III-族單硫族化物GaX和InX,以及IV-族單硫屬化物SnX 和GeX組成的縱向范德華異質結,其中X為硫屬元素S或Se。 我們將對隧穿效應、電荷轉移和耦合、激子、和光電效應等 展開研究。 我們致力於探索上述結構中的新現象和新功能, 以及在器件中的潛在應用。

16302717.label: Realisation of objectives
16302717.value: We have successfully synthesized InSe single crystal and obtain its 2D flakes by mechanically exfoliation. TEM, Raman, and PL characterizations indicate the good quality of samples. Bandgap engineering offers opportunities for tailoring the properties of semiconductor materials for desired applications in microelectronics and optoelectronics. Alloys of different semiconductor materials can lead to the continuously tuning of the bandgap. Then, we have engineered the electronic properties of InSe single crystals by substituting the Se atoms with S atoms. We have carried out XRD and Raman spectroscopy measurements to verify the formation of InSxSe1−x single crystal alloy with x ≤ 0.3. As S composition increases from 0 to 0.3 in the alloys, we have observed the blue shifts from ∼1.27 to ∼1.42 eV in PL spectra peak position which is consistent with the bandgap shifts calculated by density functional theory. We have tried to form quantum well vdW heterostructures using InSe and InSxSe1−x exfoliated flake. Due to the flakes are too thick this does not work as expected. However, our findings of engineering the electronic properties of InSe may open an intriguing avenue in understanding the fundamental physics in the III−VI layered semiconductor materials and their potential applications in optoelectronic devices. In addition, we have formed the vdW heterostructures using graphene and WS2 through the mechanical exfoliation and dry transfer technique to study charge transfer and interaction effects related to optoelectronic properties. In this heterostructure we have found the hole-trion bound state, i.e. excited-state biexciton, due to the charge transfer and exciton dissociation at the hetero-interface. We carried out excitation-power dependent, helicity-resolved, and time-resolved photoluminescence measurements. Our results will benefit to further understanding the complex multi-carrier interactions in 2D semiconductors and related vertical van der Waals heterostructures. Furthermore, we have fabricated the vdW heterostructures using 2H-TaS2 and NbSe2 through the mechanical exfoliation and dry transfer technique to investigate the superconducting proximity effect in the heterostructures and to engineer superconductivity at the interface. We have found the enhanced superconductivity in 2H-TaS2 flakes with increased superconducting transition temperature by about 0.8 K and the increased critical current of the superconducting transition of NbSe2 flakes arising from the interfacial coupling between NbSe2 flakes and 2H-TaS2 flakes. Our findings provide insight into the superconducting proximity effect in the vdW heterostructures. Finally, we have extended our research to InGaN/GaN heterostructures and tightly aligned CH3NH3PbBr3 cuboids thin films (the typical organic−inorganic halide hybrid perovskite). We have studied their optoelectronic properties. Our results provide a promising path for their applications in high-performance optoelectronic devices.

16302717.label: Major findings and research outcome
16302717.value: We have carried out the bandgap engineering in layered InSe single crystals by substituting the Se atoms with S atoms. The formation of InSxSe1−x single crystal alloy with x ≤ 0.3 is evidenced by the X-ray diffraction and resonant Raman spectra. The photoluminescence (PL) spectra peak position blue shifts from ∼1.27 to ∼1.42 eV as S composition increases from 0 to 0.3 in the alloys, which is consistent with the bandgap shifts calculated by density functional theory. Temperature dependence of the PL spectra indicate that the presence of S atoms decreases the strength of the electron−phonon interaction but increases the average phonon energy in InSxSe1−x alloys. The work is published in Cryst. Growth Des. We have found a strategy to generate the hole–trion bound state, i.e. excited-state biexcitons, in a graphene/WS2 van der Waals heterostructure, the formation of which is attributed to the charge transfer and exciton dissociation at the hetero-interface. The biexciton nature is confirmed by excitation-power dependent, helicity-resolved, and time-resolved photoluminescence measurements. Moreover, the emission behavior of the excited-state biexcitons can be tuned by modifying the charge transfer process at the hetero-interface via electrostatic gating. Our results will benefit to further understanding the complex multi-carrier interactions in 2D semiconductors and related heterostructures. The work is published in Nanoscale. We have fabricated the van der Waals 2H-TaS2/NbSe2 heterostructure through the mechanical exfoliation and dry transfer technique. Enhanced superconductivity in 2H-TaS2 flakes with increased superconducting transition temperature by about 0.8K is observed. Such enhancement is believed to be related to the leakage of the Cooper pairs from NbSe2 flakes to 2H-TaS2 flakes. In addition, the critical current of the superconducting transition of NbSe2 flakes is also increased in the heterostructures, which is related to the strengthened pairing strength of Cooper pairs in NbSe2 flakes arising from the interfacial coupling between NbSe2 flakes and 2H-TaS2 flakes. The work is published in Applied Physics Letters. We have detected a strong correlation between the lasing thresholds and the sidewall roughness of the InGaN/GaN QDs microdisk lasers, found both well-vertically aligned and well-separated InGaN NR arrays sandwiched by GaN layers using the method of selective PEC etching, and obtained tightly aligned CH3NH3PbBr3 cuboids thin films photodetectors with promising photoresponse and fast response speeds. These are published in Applied Physics letters, J. Vac. Sci. Technol. B, and ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces.

16302817.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302817.value: 宇宙中物質—反物質不對稱性是當下最有趣的謎題之一。根據大爆炸理論，早期宇宙中物質和反物質應當是等量產生的。但根據地球和衛星的觀測結果，可觀測的宇宙當中並沒有大量反物質的存在；可見宇宙幾乎只由普通物質組成。因此，物質和反物質之間的對稱性應該在宇宙形成的初期被破壞掉了。導致觀測到的不對稱性的假設機制是重子產生過程：在這個過程中，由三夸克成分組成的重子的產生速率遠高於反重子的產生速率。這一過程發生的必要條件是在宇宙形成后的最初一秒內存在電荷宇稱破缺──即電荷共軛與空間反演對稱性的破壞。儘管電荷宇稱破缺已經在基本粒子的弱相互作用中被觀測到，它的數量級比觀測到的物質—反物質不對稱所需的數量級要小很多；因此，需要有新的電荷宇稱破缺來源來解釋這一現象。 目前正在研究最近新發現的希格斯玻色子的性質。為確定新發現的粒子是否與目前用於描述粒子相互作用的理論──標準模型的預測，科學家們需要用幾年的時間來採集數據。這項工作的一個重點就是確定在希格斯玻色子與標準模型費米子的相互作用的過程中是否存在電荷宇稱破缺。若在希格斯玻色子參與的相互作用中發現了電荷宇稱破缺的現象，則至少可以在部分解釋宇宙中觀測到的物質—反物質的不對稱性的同時，揭示出超越標準模型的新物理存在的可能性。研究電荷宇稱破缺效應和決定希格斯玻色子是否是電荷宇稱本征態的最好方法之一就是在基於H→ττ 的衰變中進行。這一方法的優點是費米子與希格斯玻色子的奇電荷宇稱成分和偶電荷宇稱成分的耦合相等。在這一項目中，我們計劃在基於大型強子對撞機(LHC)的超環型儀器(ATLAS)實驗探測器上研究在希格斯玻色子衰變到兩個濤子的過程中的電荷宇稱破缺。目前，通過結合ATLAS和緊湊緲子線圈(CMS)實驗分析的結果，我們已經觀測到了5.5倍的標準偏差，因此，這也是我們第一次直接觀測到希格斯玻色子與費米子的相互作用。 這個項目建立在我們香港基礎物理聯合組(JCFP)在基於LHC的ATLAS實驗為期兩年多的研究經驗的基礎上。在這些年裡，我們組訓練了在希格斯物理，濤子重建，相互作用頂點重建，處理大數據以及高亮度分析等各方面的研究專家。組內的成員目前已經在希格斯玻色子的性質測量中擔任了一些重要角色，並且已經準備好去挑戰希格斯玻色子衰變到濤子對的研究。在這一新的充滿挑戰的項目里成為核心成員將有助於在ATLAS合作組裡使我們JCFP組的研究範疇變得更多樣化。因此，針對這一項目，我們需要增加一個高級研究助理和一個研究式的碩士研究生，他們將會專注于在希格斯玻色子的參與的相互作用中研究電荷宇稱破缺現象，以及將獲得的成果推廣到如CEPC等未來的粒子加速器中。

16302817.label: Realisation of objectives
16302817.value: The first objective has been completed to 100%. The data sample required for the analysis was collected and reconstructed during the LHC Run 3. The total size of the dataset available for th eanalysis is about 137 fb -1. The analysis strategy for studies of CP-violation in H to tau tau decay was successfully developed, including the angular distribution of the final state particles and the event rates as the observables. Several Machine Learning techniques were tried out in order to make analysis more sensitive. Additional sensitivity was obtained but developing methodology to perform the measurements in fully hadronic and semi-leptonic final states. The final analysis represents now a combination of all reasonably easily accessible and reconstructible final states of the tau decay. The analysis strategy is fully optimised and ready to be deployed on the dataset. In parallel to the analysis preparation, the group members have contributed to the ATLAS operation, acquisition and reconstruction of the dataset. The second objective has been completed to 100%. The dataset available for the study was extended up to the full dataset available after the LHC Run 3: 137 fb-1. The Monte Carlo analysis was fully developed, the expected limits on the possible CP-violating contributions in the H-> tau tau process were set. The estimates were performed on the analysis sensitivity after inclusion of data of the Run-3 of the LHC and of the future High-Luminosity LHC dataset. Due to the COVID-19 pandemics, the start of the LHC Run-3 was delayed until February 2022. The analysis of the LHC Run 2 data is currently undergoing the review process by the ATLAS Collaboration. The results based on the corresponding dataset will be published in peer-reviewed journal before the end of 2021. The third objective has been completed to 100%. During the analysis of the LHC Run 2 dataset it was found that the main attention for this analysis should be diverted from inclusion of the additional Higgs boson production channels, such as ttH to inclusion of all possible final states reconstructible in H to tau tau decay. This change allowed to obtain the maximal sensitivity to the CP-violation effects at the current stage of the analysis. The preliminary investigation of the possibility of inclusion of the ttH production channel with Higgs decaying into two photons was also performed. It is expected that such combination will become possible for the analysis of the LHC Run 3 data. The results of this project will be used as a solid foundation for this future work.

16302817.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16302817.value: The accomplished project has as its goal to reveal additional sources of matter-antimatter imbalance present in our Universe. In most of the known interactions of elementary particles, the particles and anti-particles are produced with the same rate. The violation of this rule observed in the weak interaction is too small to explain why our Universe is currently composed of matter and where all the anti-matter particles went. The Higgs boson is the last discovered elementary particle. Since its discovery in 2012 many of its properties were measured to the limits allowed by the presently available datasets. The precision of these measurements can still be improved with bigger datasets available for this project and those to appear in years to come. The interaction of the Higgs boson with other elementary particles is currently one of the least studied corners of the modern particle physics. Here there is still some room for discovery of new processes, contribution to the observed matter-anti-matter imbalance. Precision studies of the Higgs interaction with tau-leptons, accomplished in this project, allow us to set an upper limit on the presence of such processes or to discover them directly.

16302917.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302917.value: Polymer nanometer films and structures are used in a myriad of applications, including photolithography, nanoimprinting, polymer photovoltaics, and membrane separation. Experiments over the past three decades have shown that the dynamic properties of polymer films or structures could become different from the bulk when one of the sample dimensions is reduced to the nanometer range. A large body of work suggests that the anomalous properties arise from a balance between the perturbations brought about by the free and substrate surfaces to the local properties of the polymer. The former tends to cause enhancement to the local mobility while the latter tends to suppress or have a neutral effect on it. Depending on which surface effect dominates, the dynamics of the films can be enhanced or suppressed. However, despite these and other findings regarding how the two surface effects modify the dynamic properties of polymer films, relatively little is known as to how their effects balance to produce the changes in properties observed. Technologically, one might like to harness the surface effects to produce polymer films with desirable properties upon confinement. Here, we propose a program to control the confinement effect on the flow dynamics of polymer films by mixing two polymers that exhibit antagonistic confinement effects, namely one that shows increases and the other decreases in the flow dynamics upon confinement. By adjusting the composition of the mixture, polymer films with a variety of confinement effects could be produced. Upon generating mixture films possessing a variety of confinement effects, studies will be carried out to understand how the different confinement effects are produced. We expect the results to allow us to distinguish two probable scenarios, namely whether it is the average concentration of the polymer components or the onset of percolation of one polymer component through the relevant region of the film that determines individual surface effects. In the long term, we hope to develop microscopic models to describe individual surface effects and how they balance each other. 随着纳米薄膜和纳米结构的聚合物在光刻、纳米压印、光伏和膜分离等领域的广泛应用，其物理化学性质越来越受到关注。过去三十年的研究显示，当某一维度的尺寸降低到纳米级时，聚合物膜或结构可能呈现与本体不一致的动力学性质。大量的研究工作表明，产生这种异常动力学性质的原因是自由界面和基底界面引起了聚合物膜局部性质的扰动。自由界面倾向于增强局部聚合物分子的运动能力，而基底界面则倾向于抑制或对其运动能力无影响。取决于哪种界面效应占优势，聚合物膜的流动能力可以得到增强或抑制。关于两种界面效应如何改变聚合物膜动力学性质的问题，尽管已经有了许多研究和发现，然而对两种界面效应如何相互抵消而产生膜整体性质变化的理解依然模糊。理论技术上，人们能够利用界面效应生产所需性质的受限聚合物膜。 在此，我们提出一种以混合有相反受限效应（即一种聚合物在受限态下流动能力增强、而另一种则减弱）的两种聚合物以控制聚合物膜动力学性质的方法。通过调整混合物的组成，我们可以制备有各种受限效应的混合聚合物膜，并将对混合膜进行动力学研究以探究产生不同受限效应的物理机制。预期结果可以印证两种设想，即受限效应是取决于聚合物组分的平均浓度，或是取决于某一聚合物组分的浓度在相關的表面區域是否已达到渗透阈值。从长远来看，我们希望能够建立一个描述各个界面效应以及效应如何相互抵消的微观模型。

16302917.label: Realisation of objectives
16302917.value: Objective 1: We have realized this objective for thin films of the random copolymer P(S-r-4MeOS), comprising polystyrene (PS) and poly(4-methoxy styrene) (P4MeOS) supported by silica. For pure PS (where the P4MeOS content, x_MeOS = 0), effective viscosity of the films decreased with decreasing film thickness (h). For pure P4MeO (x_MeOS = 1), which interacts more strongly with the silicon substrate than PS does, effective viscosity of the films increased with decreasing h. When x_MeOS was increased from 0 to 1, the thickness dependence of the effective viscosity of the copolymer films changed steadily from decreasing to increasing with decreasing h, as predicted in the proposal. This objective has been realized through a fruitful collaboration with Prof. Binyang Du’s group in Zhejiang University who had synthesized the copolymers. Objective 2: We have repeated the study for thin films of the random copolymer P(4tBS-r-4AS), comprising poly(4-tert-butyl styrene) (P4tBS) and poly(4-acetoxystyrene) (P4AS) supported by silica with different P4AS contents, x_AS. (These copolymers were also synthesized by Prof. Du’s group.) We found that the 4AS component interacted so strongly with the silicon substrate that no flow dynamics was measurable for nanofilms containing any amount of 4AS. This result also affirms the principle of the current proposed approach for effective viscosity adjustment, namely, if the overall polymer-substrate interaction of the substrate-phile component is stronger, the effective viscosity would be enhanced more. In the case of P(4tBS-r-4AS) films supported by silica, the effective viscosity is enhanced so much that the dynamics becomes undetectable. Then we switched our attention to applicability of the proposed strategy for glassy dynamics in the P(4tBS-r-4AS) films. Specifically, we measured the h dependences of the glass transition temperature, Tg, of the films with different x_AS. We found that the h dependences of the Tg also varied with x_AS in a manner consistent with that found for the effective viscosity of the P(S-r-4MeOS) films with x_MeOS. This shows generality of the proposed approach to adjust the Tg of the polymer films. Objective 3: We have identified the metric for the free surface effect to be M_t, the unperturbed surface mobility and the metric for the substrate surface effect to be h_d, thickness of the so-called dead layer or the near-substrate polymer layer that was effectively immobile for the dynamics concerning effective viscosity and l_t, the propagation length by which the substrate causes M_t to diminish to zero. Our result indicates that both h_d and l_t increased steadily rather than abruptly with x_MeOS. At an intermediate x_MeOS of 10%, the effective viscosity of the films varied non-monotonically with h, indicating that the surface effect dominated at large h while the substrate effect dominated at small h. This shows that the mechanism by which one component dominates the effective viscosity of the film must not be by forming a percolation network in the film for otherwise the change in the h dependence with x_MeOS should be abrupt and the h dependence should be monotonic, corresponding to whether or not the films are percolating with the dominant component. Because variations of the h dependence of the effective viscosity with x_MeOS were describable in terms of how metrics of the substrate effect (h_d and l_t) vary with x_MeOS alone, it indicates that the substrate effect dominates the surface effect. This observation is understandable. For dynamics relevant to effective viscosity, thickness of the surface mobile layer was been found in our earlier study to be only 2-3 nm (Yang et al., Science, 328, 1676 (2010)), which is smaller than the values of l_t found in here (i.e., ~5 - ~20 nm). Objective 4: We confirmed that the h dependence of the effective viscosities of polymer films containing pristine PS and UVO-modified PS could also be systematically adjusted by adjusting the polymer-substrate interaction of the substrate-philic component (i.e., UVO-modified PS) or the substrate-phobic component (i.e., pristine PS) in the films. Similarly to what we had found above for the P(S-r-4MeOS) films, the effective viscosity of thin films supported by substrate surfaces with a weaker (stronger) polymer-substrate interaction is depressed (enhanced) more from the bulk value.

16302917.label: Major findings and research outcome
16302917.value: The main goal of this program is to explore the strategy to control the flow dynamics of polymer films by mixing two polymers that exhibit antagonistic confinement effects in a film. We demonstrated that it worked in two systems: (1) random copolymer films of PS and P4MeOS supported by silica and (2) pristine PS and UVO-treated PS films supported by silicon covered by Si-OH and Si-H groups. In system (1), dynamic control was realized by adjusting the concentrations of the two polymers in the films. In system (2), dynamic control was realized by adjusting the concentrations of the Si-OH and Si-H surface groups and thereby the polymer-substrate interaction. In either case, we found that the thickness dependence of the effective viscosity of the films changed systematically when the control parameter (i.e., the polymer composition or substrate surface chemistry) was varied. We have also explored the strategy for thin films of random copolymers of P4tBS and P4AS supported by silica. We found that the P4AS component always dominated the flow dynamics; as such the flow dynamics was not adjustable by varying the polymer composition. Nevertheless, confinement effect on the glass transition temperature – another common dynamic property of polymers – was adjustable by varying the polymer composition. This finding demonstrates that the proposed strategy is applicable for not only the control of flow dynamics but also that of glassy dynamics, provided the two antagonistic confinement effects have comparable strengths. Our results have also enabled us to distinguish whether the changes found in the confinement effect with the control parameter was caused by variations in the average concentration of the polymer components in the films or the onset of percolation of one polymer component that determines the confinement effect. Because the confinement effects of all three systems we studied had varied steadily rather than abruptly with the control parameter, we conclude that what underpins our observations must not arise from formation of a percolation network in the films. This program has generated nine refereed journal articles and twelve conference presentations. Two of the presentations were invited talks while ten were given in international conferences. It has provided training for one postdoctoral fellow, one Ph.D. student, and three undergraduates. Upon completion of the project, all have gone on to pursue a careers in academia or industry or graduate programs in STEM fields.

16302917.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16302917.value: As discussed in Section 5.3, our research reveals that the substrate effect dominates the free surface effect in the flow dynamics of polymer films upon nanoconfinement. We ascribe this finding to the shorter distance (~2 nm) by which the free surface effect propagates is able to propagate towards the inner region of the films compared to that for the substrate effect to propagate. But the situation can be different for other kinds of dynamics. Specifically, the propagation distance for the free surface effect have been found to be longer for both glassy dynamics and diffusive dynamics, which are 40 nm and up to ~100 nm, respectively. An interesting further development would be to study these dynamics in systems in which we may adjust the strengths or propagation distances of the free surface effect and substrate effect, and investigate how these effects interact upon film thickness reduction for a variety of films. It will also be interesting to study how the interaction between the surface and substrate effects may vary as their relative strengths or propagation distances are adjusted. To enable exploration of these developments, we have recently submitted a grant proposal to the RGC, which is pending approval.

16302917.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16302917.value: A general approach was successfully developed to control how the dynamics of polymer nanofilms varies with the film thickness. In this approach, polymer nanofilms comprising two polymer components, with one component exhibiting enhancements in the effective viscosity (a key measure for the flow property of a film) and the other depressions with reductions in the film thickness are employed. We found that by adjusting either the concentration of the components in the films or their relative interaction strengths with the substrate surface, the thickness dependence of the effective viscosity can be variably controlled. Besides effective viscosity, we demonstrated that the thickness dependence of the films’ glass transition temperature - another common dynamic property – could also be controlled with the same approach, demonstrating its applicability in general. Polymer nano films and structures are used in a myriad of applications, including photolithography, nanoimprinting, polymer photovoltaics, and membrane separation, etc. The current development of a robust approach to control the thickness dependence of the dynamics of polymer films paves the way for designing polymer nano films and structures with desirable properties on demand.

16303117.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16303117.value: Chemically and physically induced damage to the genomic DNA produced a broad spectrum of mutagenic DNA lesions and is associated with the development of many human diseases, including cancer. Understanding the biological fate of these damage products would allow better understanding of disease progression and assist in the estimation of disease risk. Among the DNA lesions, the abasic (AP) sites formed by spontaneous hydrolysis of modified and native nucleobases are among the most abundant and mutagenic lesions. Accumulating evidence suggests that lesion-induced interstrand DNA-DNA and DNA-protein cross-links (DPCs) have profound biological consequences. For example, it has been demonstrated that interstrand cross-links interrupt normal DNA metabolic processes such as transcription, replication, and repair. Although AP sites are among the most predominant DNA lesions and are in close proximity with the histone proteins that they wrapped in the nucleosomes, we know very little of its DPCs, such as their chemical structures or biological consequences. This proposed project addresses the chemical and biological properties of AP site–associated DPCs using a chemical approach. We will approach these objectives by developing liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry methods to study i) the rate of accumulation of AP site–associated DPCs, ii) their half-life in the cellular environment, and iii) the toxicant specificity and dosage-dependency of DPC formation in purified DNA and in DNA isolated from toxicant–exposed human cells. It is expected that the frequencies of DPCs in DNA will correlate directly with the level of toxicant exposure, thus acting as an indicator for disease risk assessment. It is also anticipated that the results will allow better understanding of the roles of DPCs in oxidative stress–related human diseases, such as Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s diseases, and cancer. Successful completion of these studies will also lay a foundation for future studies to investigate organ-specific information on oxidative stress–induced DPC formation in an animal model. 不論是化學或物理因素都能夠對基因組造成破壞，從而引起一系列DNA損傷、並引發疾病，例如癌症。透過瞭解這些DNA損害性產物不僅能夠深入了解疾病的發生進程，並能基於此對疾病進行風險評估。在所有種類的DNA損傷中，以缺鹼基位點 (AP位點) 最為普遍。它可以通過自發性水解天然或被修飾的鹼基而產生。越來越多的研究證實，DNA損傷而誘導的DNA-DNA和DNA-蛋白質交鏈 (DPCs)會造成嚴重的不良後果。例如，由AP位點引發的DNA鏈間交聯會中斷正常的DNA轉錄、複製及修復等代謝過程。雖然AP位點是最主要的DNA損傷、並與蛋白極其臨近，但我們對AP位點與蛋白相互作用的化學及生物學影響的瞭解依然非常片面。而該研究計劃則擬利用化學手段拓展對AP位點參與的DPCs的化學、生物學特性的認知。 我們將利用液質聯用法研究i) 由AP位點產生的DPCs的生成速率ii) 在細胞中的反應半衰期iii)以純化的DNA或分離的來自於毒物環境中人類細胞的DNA為對象，研究導致DPC形成的毒性物質的結構特徵和劑量關係。預期毒性物質劑量的多少與DPCs生成頻率有著直接的關係，因此可以發展為疾病的風險預測標準。不僅如此，我們可以更加瞭解DPCs在氧化應激相關的人類疾病中扮演的角色，包括阿茲海默症、帕金森症及癌症等。這項研究也為將來利用動物模型探究氧化壓力下DPC在不同器官中的發生特徵而奠定基礎。

16303117.label: Major findings and research outcome
16303117.value: Using our developed isotope-dilution liquid chromatography−tandem mass spectrometric (LC−MS/MS) method, in combination with the newly developed sample preparation approaches, including protein hydrolysis, DNA isolation and digestion, sample clean-up and enrichment, we identified a novel DNA-Protein Cross-Link (DPCs) product, apurinic/ apyrimidinic (AP) sites - cysteine adduct, through reaction of AP sites from DNA with cysteine residues in proteins. Also, the level of the DPCs in vitro and in HeLa cells exposed to alkylating agent methylmethanesulfonate (MMS) were quantified with the newly developed method. A dose-dependent formation of the adduct, as shown from the results of our study, suggest the possibility to use this adduct as a potential biomarker for oxidising and alkylating agents exposure. In addition, the results also provide new knowledge for better understanding of the potential biological implications of this DPCs. These novel findings were published in a peer-reviewed journals paper, Anal. Chem. (2019, 91, 4987-4994). Besides, we have also developed a sensitive and selective LC−MS/MS approach to quantify AP sites - lysine adduct in biological systems. The method combines masking of unbonded AP sites by treatment with hydroxylamine, followed by protein and DNA digestion to release the DPCs, which are further derivatized with fluorenylmethoxycarbonyl chloride (Fmoc-Cl). Although AP sites - lysine adduct formed in vitro reaction was reported, the previous method is not sensitive enough to detect the adduct in biological systems for assessing the biological fate of it. The newly developed method increases the stability of the adduct for detection and provides a mean of using AP sites - lysine for disease risk assessment. These results were written in a peer-reviewed journals papers, Anal. Chem. (Under Review). By using a shot-gun proteomics approach, we further identified DNA-binding proteins transcription-associated proteins, in particular, histone H2B3B and poly(rC) binding protein 2 are the most frequent DPC-forming proteins, in MMS exposed human cells. These findings were published in top toxicology journal Chem. Res. Toxicol. (2020, 33, 2739−2744).

16303117.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16303117.value: Results of the present studies showed quantitatively that alkylating agent-exposed human cells contain elevated level of DPCs. Because many alkylating agent are known to be cancer-causing, further studies can focus on investigating the possible role of DPCs in the pathophysiology of human degenerative diseases, such as cancer. This can be achieved by identifying the proteins and genome hotspots that are involved in DPCs formation. Furthermore, the developed methods shall facilitate future studies that explore the repair mechanism of these DPCs in biological system and the potential use of these DPC products as biomarkers of disease risk.

16303117.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16303117.value: There is growing evidence that interstrand cross-links formed by DNA lesions play a critical role in genotoxicity. For example, the covalent cross-linking of lesion-containing DNA to neighbouring DNA/proteins creates a challenge to the DNA metabolic machinery by blocking transcription and producing mutations during cell replication. However, these DNA cross-linking processes, in particular the DNA-protein interstrand cross-links, have received far less attention than other types of DNA lesions, partly attributed to the lack of sensitive and selective analytical method to detect and quantitate these cross-link products in cells. We have developed a liquid chromatography coupled tandem mass spectrometry-coupled with stable isotope-dilution methods to quantitate the DPCs formed by reacting the lysine and cysteine residues of proteins with abasic sites, which being one of the most abundant DNA lesions. After validation using synthetic standards, the methods were used to quantitate these 2 DPC products in alkylating agents-exposed human cells. It is anticipated that the developed methods shall facilitate future studies of using these DPCs as biomarkers of disease risk assessment and for investigating the fate of these DPC products. Beside, the enzymes that were involved in removing these lesions from the cells can also be investigated.

16303417.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16303417.value: Narrowband biphoton generation research is an essential ingredient for the realization of reliable quantum information processing, such as time-frequency entanglement for quantum cryptography with long-coherence time. In the conventional methods, the biphoton pairs generated from a nonlinear crystal only persist for about pico-second time scale, due to their THz scale broad bandwidth. To obtain narrowband biphoton pairs down to 10 MHz, a nonlinear crystal should be placed inside a cavity. The cavity method, however, requires a complicated apparatus, and places limits on the mode of biphoton operation. In our research scheme, we propose to do without a cavity, and instead to generate narrowband biphotons from the silicon-vacancy centers in diamond crystal. In that case, the electromagnetic waves do not need to be confined by a cavity, or selected by the cavity mode. Furthermore, instead of using cold atomic ensembles, we propose to perform the first biphoton generation based on the spontaneous four-wave mixing (SFWM) process, and on electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) in a solid-state system. This approach will be used to realize a bandwidth that is even narrower than that of the natural linewidth of the solid-state sample (only a few MHz), as has been previously accomplished in an atomic ensemble. Our proposed research project will pave the way for the implementation of a narrowband biphoton generator, which will eventually produce integrated photonic chips for quantum information processing. 窄帶糾纏光子對產生的研究是實現可靠量子資訊處理的重要組成部分，比如長相干時間的時間-頻率糾纏光子對對於量子密碼學具有重要意義。傳統方法是從非線性晶體中產生的糾纏光子對，但這只有皮秒量級的相干時間，因為其太赫茲量級的寬譜頻寬。為了獲得小於10兆赫茲窄頻寬的糾纏光子對，非線性晶體必須放置於光學諧振腔中。然而利用諧振腔的方法不僅需要複雜的實驗裝置，同時也會限制光子對的操控。在我們的研究方案中，我們計畫從矽空穴的金剛石晶體產生窄頻寬的糾纏光子對，而非利用光學諧振腔。在這種方案下，電磁波無需被限制在光學諧振腔中，也無需由諧振腔模式來選擇。詳細來說，我們參考冷原子系統的方案，計畫在固體系統中利用電磁誘導透明和四波混頻過程產生糾纏光子對。這種方法產生的糾纏光子對的頻寬甚至可以比固體樣品的自然線寬（約兆赫茲）還要窄，並且這已經在冷原子系統中實現。最後，該研究將會為窄帶糾纏光子對發生器的實現，以及最終量子資訊處理所需的集成光晶體晶片的研究打下重要根基。

16303417.label: Major findings and research outcome
16303417.value: We have achieved the following major findings and research outcomes: (1) Theory of electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) and biphoton generation from an ensemble of solid-state quantum emitters We have developed and completed the theory of EIT and biphoton generation from an ensemble of solid-state quantum emitters, which will serve as the theoretical foundation of the project. From our theoretical investigation, we identified the four distinct energy levels of silicon-vacancy in diamond defect centers (SiV-) for EIT-based spontaneous four-wave mixing. The theory shows it is possible to achieve narrow EIT window below lifetime-limited linewidth (several hundred MHz) of a SiV− for producing biphotons with a few tens of nanosecond coherence time without a cavity. The theoretical study also shows that a realization of negligible ground-state dephasing of a solid-state sample will be a crucial step toward generation of narrowband biphotons with a coherence time of more than a hundred nanosecond and a subnatural atomic linewidth of a few MHz. This work has been published by Journal of Optical Society of America B [1]. (2) Experimental with SiV samples Collaborating with Na Young Kim’s group at University of Waterloo, in the past one year we have successfully grown the first SiV sample and performed some primary measurements. We have characterized the first sample by measuring its photoluminescence, and set up a confocal optical setup to measure the optical depth and EIT. Improving the sample quality and its optical properties is still going on to meet the criteria of narrowband biphoton generation. Meanwhile, we have set up single photon counting apparatus for characterizing the time-frequency entanglement of the biphotons. Representative Publications: [1] J. Opt. Soc. Am B 36, 646 (2019) (3) delta-quench measurement of a pure quantum-state wave function We theoretically proposed a direct measurement strategy based on a delta-quench probe for measuring a pure quantum-state wave function. 16303617.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16303617.value: Penostatins are structurally unique and complex natural products, which were isolated in 1996-1999 from the fungal strain Penicillium sp. All members of the penostatins except for penostatin D have been found to possess significant in vitro cytotoxic activity against P388 leukemia cells. In addition, penostatin C has displayed potent and selective protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B inhibition with IC50 of 0.27 μM, which is 2.4 times more potent than the positive control of sodium orthovanadate. The promising bioactivity of penostatins coupled with their novel structural skeleton has triggered our interest in studying this family further. In this proposal, we conceive a new and general strategy for the collective synthesis of five members of the penostatins: A-D and G. Notably, four out of these five penostatins (except for penostatin B) have not yet been synthesized and our work will be the first synthetic effort on these members including the most structurally complex penostatin G. Our synthetic strategy features an unprecedented intramolecular Diels-Alder reaction of 6-alkyl-3-hydroxy-2-pyrone, which yields the common tricyclic intermediate for the synthesis of the five penostatins. To implement this new strategy, we propose a four-stage research plan: i) development of a new and efficient route for the synthesis of 6-alkyl-3-hydroxy-2-pyrones, which are difficult to prepare using existing synthetic methods; ii) model studies of the intramolecular Diels-Alder reaction of 6-alkyl-3-hydroxy-2-pyrone and its optimization for desired better exo/endo selectivity, which has rarely been studied systematically to rationalize the opposite selectivity under different conditions; iii) examination of various methods such as ring closing metathesis and Prins cyclization for the construction of the C ring of penostatins; and iv) late-stage functional group manipulation and decarboxylation for the collective synthesis of penostatins A-D. This proposal also provides some preliminary results from the first and second stages of research, verifying the viability of some key transformations essential to the success of our new strategy. However, substantial efforts are still needed to address fully the efficiency, scalability, and underlying chemistry required to make this collective synthesis venture practically useful. Finally, a transannular Diels-Alder reaction of macrocyclic 2-pyrone is proposed to construct the tetracyclic core of penostatin G in a single step, which is significantly more challenging, but if successful, would be the most concise and efficient synthesis. Penostatins是结构上独特和复杂的天然产物，它们在1996 - 1999年从真菌菌株青霉属中分离出来。除了penostatin D以外，已发现的所有penostatin成员对P388白血病细胞具有显着的体外细胞毒性。此外，Penostatin C已经显示了有效和选择性的蛋白酪氨酸磷酸酶1B抑制，IC50为0.27μM，比正钒酸钠的阳性对照强2.4倍。有应用前景的生物活性加上其新颖的化学结构，引起了我们进一步研究这个家族的兴趣。在这个提案中，我们设想了一个新的总体合成策略用于集体式合成五个成员：penostatins A-D和G。值得注意的是，这五个天然产物中的四个（除了penostatin B除外）尚未全合成的报道，我们的工作将是这些成员的第一个综合性合成研究，包括最结构复杂的penostatin G。我们的合成策略特点是用以前未曾报道的6-烷基-3-羟基-2-吡喃酮作为底物发生分子内Diels -Alder反应，其产物作为共同的三环中间体用于合成五种penostatins天然产物。为了实施这一新合成策略，我们提出了一个四阶段的研究计划：1）由于难以用现有的合成方法制备所需的6-烷基-3-羟基-2-吡喃酮，我们首先开发新的和有效的方法学合成6-烷基-3-羟基-2-吡喃酮; 2）由于鲜有文献系统的研究6-烷基-3-羟基-2-吡喃酮的分子内Diels -Alder反应以及不同的选择性问题，我们将建立模型来研究6-烷基-3-羟基-2-吡喃酮的分子内Diels -Alder反应，及所需更好的外切/内切选择性的优化; 3）研究各种C环的构建方法，如烯烃闭环复分解和Prins环化反应; 4）后期功能团转化和脱羧，用于集体合成penostatins A-D。该提案提供了第一和第二阶段研究的初步结果，验证了我们新合成策略成功至关重要的一些重要反应的可行性。然而，仍然需要大量努力才能解决效率，可扩展性和潜在的化学问题以使这种集体合成工作得到具体实施。最后，我们大胆的提出了大环2-吡喃酮的跨环Diels-Alder反应，在单一步骤中构建了penostatin G的四环核心，这显然更具挑战性，但如果成功，将是最简洁高效的合成。

16303617.label: Realisation of objectives
16303617.value: Objective 1: We have developed a new method for the synthesis of 6-alkyl-3-hydroxy-2-pyrones. The utility of this new method is demonstrated with 5 examples (additional 6 examples in the PhD thesis) and by total synthesis of penostatins A and C. This method (only 6 steps with one column purification) features Achmatowicz rearrangement and Wharton rearrangement and allows for diversity-oriented synthesis of 3-hydroxy-2-pyrones. Objective 2: We have thoroughly studied the intramolecular Diels-Alder reaction of the 2-pyrones and found that the endo/exo selectivity was only moderate (2.3:1). Surprisingly, the cycloaddition product was extremely unstable and tended to undergo concomitant retro-Diels-Alder reaction by releasing carbon dioxide. We fully leveraged this cascade processes (Diels-Alder/retro-Diels-Alder) in our synthesis of penostatins. Objective 3: We have accomplished the collective total syntheses of penostatins A-D and published two members only because the other two members (B and D) contained inseparable impurity. While there existed many unexpected synthetic challenges (i.e., difficulty of dehydration of alcohol) in the course of our total syntheses, we solved them eventually and completed the total synthesis. Objectives 4 and 5: Penostatin G is the structurally most complex member and presents the daunting challenge. In the study of Diels-Alder reaction of 3-hydroxy-pyrones (objective 2), we realized that the bridged tricyclic Diels-Alder product was unstable (decarboxylative retro-Diels-Alder reaction), which forced us to concentrate on the penostatins A-D. After completion of total syntheses of penostatins A-D, we initiated the total synthesis of penostatin G by re-investigating the Diels-Alder reaction of 3-hydroxy-2-pyrones. We found that the protecting group on the 3-hydroxy of the 2-pyrones played in key role for the stability of the bridged tricyclic Diels-Alder products. Now we are able to isolate this key tricyclic intermediate and the total synthesis is completed, which will be published in a due course.

16303617.label: Major findings and research outcome
16303617.value: In this project, one of the major findings is the development of a new method for synthesis of 6-alkyl-3-hydroxy-2-pyrones, which represents the first synthetic method for this specific class of pyrones. Our new method significantly expands the synthetic utility of 2-pyrones in organic synthesis and drug discovery. The second major finding is the development of new synthetic strategy flexible for the collective total syntheses of penostatins. We demonstrated this strategy in the first asymmetric total synthesis of penostatins A and C, and believed other members of penostatins could also be synthesized using this strategy. Notably, we have also achieved the total syntheses of Penostatins B and D. However, their spectra were not clean enough for publications and thus their syntheses were published in the PhD thesis. The third major finding is the development of the first palladium-catalyzed arylation of Achmatowicz rearrangement products, which will find wide applications in organic synthesis and drug discovery since the tetrahydropyrans and piperidines (from (aza-) Achmatowicz rearrangement) are privileged heterocycles in bioactive natural products and small molecule drugs. The fourth major finding is the discovery of green oxidation protocols (oxone-halide) for oxidation of furans, indoles, and aldoximes. This green oxidation protocols greatly reduced the risk of carrying out these important reactions and eliminate the organic wastes that previously derived from organic oxidants.

16303617.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16303617.value: Since penostatins have shown cytotoxicity and inhibition activity against protein-tyrosine phosphatase 1B (an ubiquitously expressed enzyme that negatively regulates growth-factor signalling and cell proliferation), we believe that penostatins have great potential to be developed into clinically used drugs for treatment of cancers. In the future, we will study the biological activity of the synthetic penostatins and intermediates. If excellent bioactivity is identified, we will further investigate the potential target of this family of natural or nonnatural products, which will lay the grounds for further development of new drugs for treatment of cancers. Additionally, the newly established green oxidation method (oxone-halide) will be further applied to other oxidation reactions to advance green chemistry in organic synthesis and drug discovery.

16303617.value: Penostatins are structurally unique and complex natural products, which were isolated in 1996-1999 from the fungal strain Penicillium sp. All members of the penostatins except for penostatin D have been found to possess significant in vitro cytotoxic activity against P388 leukemia cells. In addition, penostatin C has displayed potent and selective protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B inhibition with IC50 of 0.27 μM, which is 2.4 times more potent than the positive control of sodium orthovanadate. The promising bioactivity of penostatins coupled with their novel structural skeleton has triggered our interest in development of chemical synthesis of penostatins. 16303817.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16303817.value: 社会选择、众包排序和霍奇(Hodge)理论

16303817.label: Project Objectives
16303817.value: A new Hodge Decomposition on Vector Bundles at Graph Edge Set will be proposed, which makes it explicit to study annotator-specific variations and still bears the basic structure of orthogonal decomposition: ‘pairwise ranking = global ranking + cycles’, where cycles split into different geometric scales. Traditional generalized linear models for binary paired comparisons will be extended by the Hodge Decomposition, which models both the common consensus ranking and conflicts of interests in cycles. For better budget control, active sampling strategies will be investigated under the principle of information maximization with the HodgeRank framework. This particularly includes two aspects: unsupervised sampling by Fisher’s information maximization is related to sequential constructions of expander graphs; and supervised sampling by Bayesian information maximization leads to a simple online algorithm. To allow for individual diversity beyond social choice, a parsimonious mixed-effects HodgeRank will be proposed that assumes that while most participants in crowdsourcing experiments may follow a common ranking or social utility (fixed effect), there is a sparse set of deviations (random effect) capturing multicriteria in annotator judgement and abnormal behavior.

16303817.value: 社会选择，又被称为偏好集成或者排序集成，是现代科学技术中的重要课题。特别是曾荣获诺贝尔经济学奖的诸多不可能定理，表明在足够复杂的社会环境中获得整体一致的排序注定要与个人偏好产生矛盾冲突。因此如何定量分析偏好数据中的矛盾，同寻找一个整体排序一样重要。最近我们提出了基于组合霍奇（Hodge）理论的新方法，用于将基本的比对偏好数据分解成整体排序(梯度流)和与之正交的矛盾冲突(旋度流)，因此为定量分解排序数据中的整体一致性及矛盾提供了基础。霍奇理论作为连接拓扑、几何与分析的重要数学工具，也因此在当代信息技术上获得广泛的应用。然而目前霍奇理论在社会选择的应用中都假设了选择人或者用户是相似的，而基于互联网的众包排序获得的大量数据表明选择人或者用户具有各种各样的特异性。因此如何将这些特异性引入现有的霍奇排序方法中是本项目的主要挑战。为应对之我们这里提出以下的研究方向：(1) 基于图向量丛表示的霍奇分解，用来表示选择人或者用户空间；(2) 广义线性统计模型的推广；(3) 主动采样方法; (4) 多尺度个性化排序模型。

16303817.label: Major findings and research outcome
16303817.value: This project extends the existing Hodge Theory in ranking to a new landscape to meet the new challenges in crowdsourcing. To deal with heterogeneity in crowdsourcing annotators, a new Hodge decomposition theorem on graph vector bundles is proposed that explicitly incorporates annotator-specific variations. To deal with binary comparison data, Hodge Theory will be further married with generalized linear models to create a new family of statistical models that take into account both global consensus ranking and conflicts of interests. Active sampling strategies based on the information maximization principle in HodgeRank are presented to boost the sampling efficiency against the budget constraint. Finally, as a departure from the classical social choice theory, we propose a family of parsimonious models ranging from social choice to personalized individual rankings, which can capture an annotator's diversity in multicriteria and abnormal behavior, a source of heterogeneity in crowdsourcing experiments.

16303817.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16303817.value: Future directions will be general subjective visual property learning, utility learning, and especially with modern deep neural network models.

16303817.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16303817.value: Social choice, also known as preference or rank aggregation, is an important topic in science and technology. The celebrated impossibility theorems by Nobel Laureates in Economics have shown its fundamental limitations in which a pursuit of global consensus ranking is doomed to meet conflicts of interests. Hence, a quantitative description of the conflicts of interests within preference data is even more important than merely pursuing a global ranking. However, all of the traditional studies on this topic assume complete preference data with homogeneous voters who are treated in an equal way. Crowdsourcing is a rising technology from which human annotated data can be obtained on the Internet. Although it provides us with an explosive growth of preference data, it is highly incomplete, noisy, and heterogeneous over annotators or voters due to the diversity in crowdsourcing experimental conditions. These new features impose a great many challenges for data analysis. In this project we show that the Hodge Theory in mathematics enables us a new landscape to meet the new challenges in crowdsourcing and bring new analytic tools for crowdsourced ranking data in areas such as multimedia, computer vision, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.

16303917.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16303917.value: Ternary organic solar cells (OSCs) have attracted much research attentions, as they can maintain the simplicity of the single-junction device architecture while broadening the absorption range of OSCs using three light absorbing materials. Intensive research efforts in the OSC community have led to several cases of highly efficient ternary OSCs with best PCE exceeding 10%. Despite these progresses, material selection and morphology control remain to be challenging tasks for ternary OSCs, as the BHJ morphology involving three donor and acceptor materials is extremely difficult to characterize and to control. Developing an effective approach to control the morphology of ternary OSCs would expedite the development of this field. To develop an effective approach to control the morphology of ternary OSCs, we propose ternary OSCs based on a donor polymer with strong temperature dependent aggregation (TDA) properties blended with two non-fullerene small molecular acceptors (SMAs) that exhibit similar surface tensions and that can thus form an alloy phase. The TDA polymers have been previously demonstrated to be able to control the polymer:fullerene morphology effectively and have led to multiple cases of efficient OSCs with PCEs higher than 10%. When processing the hot solutions of such polymer:fullerene blends, the TDA polymers can pre-aggregate in solution and form highly crystalline and pure yet reasonably small polymer domains. The pre-aggregation of the TDA polymers also exclude fullerene molecules that can subsequently form a pure and crystalline fullerene domain. This approach can yield a controllable and high-performance morphology. These TDA polymers should be applicable to ternary OSCs if fullerene acceptor is replaced with two non-fullerene SMAs that can form alloys. Similarly, a hot spin-coating process will be used, in which the TDA polymer would first aggregate into a highly crystalline and pure phase. The two SMAs should have good solubility and similar surface tension to form one phase of organic alloy. This approach may create a near two-phase-type morphology that is similar to that of polymer:fullerene blends, hence simplifying the morphology control for ternary OSCs and allowing for the selection of multiple material sets for efficient ternary OSCs. Following this general approach, we have obtained preliminary results on ternary OSCs with > 11 % efficiencies and partial evidence that supports the formation of an organic alloy phase by the two SMAs. Given our previous successes and promising preliminary results, the proposed approach should be feasible, and, if fully explored, would accelerate the development of the ternary OSC field. 近年来，有机太阳能电池得到了飞速的发展，单层和多层太阳能电池的光电转换效率均已突破10%。为了在保持单层结构的同时拓宽吸收范围，科研工作者们发展了三元体系的太阳能电池。在该电池中，使用一个给体材料与两个受体材料或者两个给体与一个受体材料共混的方式可以得到更高的光电转换效率。尽管其效率得到了很大的提升，但对于这一体系的机理研究却鲜有报道。造成这一情况的主要的原因在于，三元体系中三种材料的共同存在形成了更加复杂的形貌，无法控制的形貌给研究造成很大困难。因此，目前对三元体系的研究多是研究体系中的单一组分，缺乏综合性。 我们过去的研究发现，具有很强的温度依赖聚集特性的聚合物材料可以在加工过程中有效控制体系的形貌。因此使用这些聚合物材料可以有效解决上述三元体系中的难题。研究中，我们将具有很强的温度依赖聚集特性的聚合物材料与两个小分子受体共混，以有效控制并优化三元体系中的形貌。体系中使用的两个小分子具有相近的表面能，因此可以有效共混形成同一相，也称之为有机合金。由于该体系的形貌主要是由聚合物控制的，我们可以筛选不同的小分子组合，而不会破坏形貌。比如可以使用高LUMO的小分子来提高合金的LUMO，也可以使用低表面张力的小分子来增强给受体之间的相互作用。 使用如上的设计思路，我们将可以在多个高效三元体系的研究中取得很大的进展。考虑到我们以往的研究成果，相信这一项目具有很高的可行性。对这些体系的研究所揭示出的设计策略，也将为领域内对三元太阳能电池的机理研究提供指导意见，有助于进一步提升太阳能电池的性能。

16303917.label: Realisation of objectives
16303917.value: Ternary organic solar cells (OSCs) have shown tremendous potential in improving the photovoltaic performance of single-junction OSCs. Here, a series of ternary OSCs are fabricated with PM7:ITC-2Cl as the host system and an ultra-low bandgap acceptor named IXIC-4Cl that has an absorption edge reaching 1000 nm as the third component. The optimal ternary OSC shows a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 15.37%, which is significantly higher than those of the binary counterparts based on PM7:ITC-2Cl (13.72%) or PM7:IXIC-4Cl (12.01%). The excellent PCE is mainly attributed to the increased short-circuit current (JSC), which mainly arises from the complementary absorption of the third component and thus the overall broadened absorption profile. In addition, the addition of IXIC-4Cl into the PM7:ITC-2Cl binary system suppresses bimolecular recombination, improves charge dissociation and the collection efficiency, balances charge transport and reduces the domain size, which are responsible for the enhanced JSC. Noticeably, the optimized ternary device shows a PCE over 15% with a quite small energy loss, which are the best results for ternary OSCs to date. These results offer more insight into the role of an ultra-low bandgap non-fullerene acceptor as the third component in promoting the device performance of ternary OSCs. we reported a promising new π-bridge, 3,4-di-methoxylthiophene (DMOT), with which a new FREA, named as IEICF-DMOT (2,2′-((2Z, 2′Z)-((5,5′-(4,4,9,9-tetrakis(p-hexylphenyl))-4,9-di-hydro-s-indaceno[1,2-b:5,6-b′]dithiophene-2,7-diyl)bis(3-(3,4-di-methoy)thiophene-5,2-diyl))bis(methanylylidene))-bis(5,6-difluoro-3-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-indene-2,1-diylidene-))dimalononitrile) (Fig. 1)is synthesized and reported herein. Theπ-bridge mediates the electron-coupling between the D and A units and the co-planarity increase, for example, by non-covalent interactions between the bridge and the D and A units helps to tune the optical, electrochemical, and photovoltaic properties of the acceptor. In comparison to IEIC (2,2′-((2Z,2′Z)-((5,5′-(4,4,9,9-tetrakis(p-hexylphenyl)-4,9-dihydro-s-in-daceno[1,2-b:5,6-b′]dithiophene-2,7-diyl)bis(3-(2-ethylhexyl)thio-phene-5,2-diyl))bis(methanylylidene))-bis(3-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-in-dene-2,1-diylidene))dimalononitrile), the O⋯S non-covalent interaction between the 2-ethylhexoyl O on the bridged thiophen-3-position and the fused-thiophene S of the electron-rich core in IEICO helps to enhance the intramolecular charge transfer (ICT), which tunes the energy levels of FMOs. The use of a strong electron-accepting unit such as IC-2F (2-methylene-5,6-di-fluoro-3-(1,1-dicyanomethylene)indanone) yields IEICO-4F with a much narrow optical bandgap(Egopt). However, the highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) level of IEICO-4F is about−5.4 eV, and therefore, IEICO-4F can be only considered to pair with a donor polymer having a higher-HOMO-levelthan−5.4 eV. However, its deep lowest unoccupied molecular orbital(LUMO), about−4 eV, greatly limits the possibility to obtain a large Voc, for example, only a value of 0.69 V has been obtained when paring with PBDTTT-E-T, though the device Jsc reached 22.3 mA/cm2. It is widely known that the miscibility between donor and acceptor is a crucial factor that affects the morphology and thus device performance of non-fullerene organic solar cells (OSCs). In this Letter, we show that incorporating a third component with lower miscibility and higher lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO) level into the state-of-the-art PM6:Y6 system can significantly enhance the performance of devices. The best results of the ternary devices are achieved by adding a small molecular acceptor named ITCPTC (∼5% w/w), which significantly improves the power conversion efficiency (PCE) of the host system from 16.44% to 17.42%. The higher LUMO of the third component increases the open-circuit voltage (VOC), while the low miscibility enlarges the domains and leads to improved short-circuit current density (JSC) and fill factor (FF). The efficacy of this strategy is supported by using other non-fullerene third components including an asymmetric small molecule (N7IT) and a polymer acceptor (PF2-DTC), which play the same role as ITCPTC and boost the PCEs to 16.96% and 17.04%, respectively. Our approach can be potentially applied to a wide range of OSC material systems and should facilitate the development of the OSC field.

16303917.label: Major findings and research outcome
16303917.value: Good result has been obtained in this project. First, we studied a ternary OSC system with a donor polymer (PM6) and two structurally similar non-fullerene acceptors (named ITCPTC and MeIC). MeIC is a SMA with strong crystallinity, which results in excessive phase segregation and large domain size for the PM6:MeIC binary blend. By adding a structurally similar and less crystalline SMA (ITCPTC) into the binary blend, the domain size and morphology of the blend are much improved without sacrificing the electron mobility of the blend. As a result, the optimal blend ratio of PM6 : ITCPTC : MeIC (1 : 0.4 : 0.6) led to an impressive FF of 78.2% and PCE of 14.13% [Publication 1]. Second, we employed a small-molecule acceptor (SMA) named N7IT with a high LUMO energy level and a redshifted absorption spectrum as the third component in the PM6:IT-4F-based binary host. The champion ternary device (PM6: IT-4F: N7IT = 1:0.7:0.3) demonstrates an outstanding PCE of 15.02%, significantly higher than its binary counterparts. This strategy is further validated in PM6:Y6 blends, where the addition of SY3 featuring near-infrared absorption and high LUMO effectively boosts the PCE from 16.49% to 17.07%. Our result proves the effectiveness of an appropriate third component and demonstrates the potential of red-absorbing, high-LUMO SMAs in further promoting the efficiency of single-junction binary OSCs [Publication 7]. Thirdly, we report a highly efficient quaternary blend system (q-OSCs) using two polymer donors (PM6 and PTQ10) and two acceptors (N3 and PC71BM) as the photoactive layer. The quaternary system (PM6:PTQ10:PC71BM:N3) can achieve an efficiency of 17.73%, which is significantly higher than that of the binary and ternary control systems. Compared to the binary and ternary blends, the quaternary system showed significant improvement in the JSC of the devices without compromising on VOC and FF, demonstrating a synergistic interaction between the four functional components. Our morphology study reveals that PC71BM is the crucial component that enables the functional hierarchical (multi-length scale) morphology and, thus, the better performance, which is evidenced by better-excited state dynamics in the quaternary system. Our results show that, through proper selection of materials and device engineering, quaternary OSC blends can lead to a more favorable morphology and better performance than binary or ternary OSCs [Publication 8].

16303917.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16303917.value: Further development of this project can explore the chemical structures that enable the temperature-dependent aggregation property. There are two famous polymers in this field. One is the PM6, the other is the PffBT4T-2OD. Both of them have temperature-dependent aggregation property but the chemical structures that enabled this property are different. For PM6, it is likely due to the steric hindrance between the thiophene and carbonyl groups. For the other polymer, it is because of the branched side chain. So systematic study needs to be carried out to clarify and to pin down the exact chemical structure that caused the temperature-dependent aggregation property, and so that we can further improve the property by modifying the chemical structures.

16303917.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16303917.value: In the past few years, the field of bulk-heterojunction (BHJ) organic solar cells (OSCs) has witnessed significant progress with power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) surpassing 17%. The emergence of non-fullerene small-molecule acceptor (SMA) materials plays an important role in promoting device performance due to the synthetic flexibility that offers easily tunable chemical structures, electronic and optical properties to these materials. To date, most of the state-of-the-art single-junction BHJ OSCs comprising one acceptor and one donor in the active layer, which is called a “binary” system, are based on the combination of a conjugated polymer and a non-fullerene SMA. Recent research has demonstrated that adding a third component into the binary system to make a ternary OSC can provide multiple benefits to the device and thus enhance the performance. Apart from the original goal that the third component broadens the absorption spectra, it has been shown by different material systems that the ternary strategy could result in many other favorable properties such as ameliorating exciton dissociation, enhancing charge carrier transport and collection, modifying material crystallinity and improving both the bulk morphology and vertical phase segregation.

16304017.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16304017.value: Organoborons are extremely useful as reagents and intermediates in organic synthesis leading to compounds for pharmaceuticals, agrichemicals and organic materials. Thus, development of methods to synthesize organoborons has become a very hot topic in current chemical research. Extensive research has led to many breakthroughs in this research area. The most notable ones in recent years are discoveries of transition metal complexes that are capable of catalyzing borylation of carbon-hydrogen and carbon-halide bonds in alkanes and arenes. Most excitingly, catalytic processes involving earth-abundant transition metals such as iron, cobalt, nickel, copper and zinc have become possible very recently. Compared with that of catalysis involving copper, iridium, rhodium and palladium metals, our understanding of catalysis, especially the relevant reaction mechanisms as well as many interesting experimental observations, involving iron, cobalt, nickel and zinc, is much limited. More extensive studies are required to clarify the related scientific issues. Preliminary research results indicate that the reaction mechanisms related to these earth-abundant metals are very different from those related to other more commonly studied metals such as iridium, rhodium and palladium. In this proposed project, theoretical studies via density functional theory calculations will be undertaken to explore the reaction mechanisms for these newly discovered borylation reactions involving earth-abundant transition metals. This research will provide guidelines for the experimental work, including the development of new catalytic processes and applications in organic synthesis. 有機硼化物是有機合成的重要試劑和中間體。 在藥物，農藥和有機材料的合成應用很廣。 對於它們的製備方法有很多研究，最近研究發現，很多金屬絡合物可催化碳氫硼化和烷基鹵化物硼化。 最有趣的發現是：地球上豐度很高的金屬，如鐵鈷鎳銅鋅等，可以作為金屬催化劑。 儘管有這些發現，很多有關的實驗現象及其反應機理，人們的理解有限。 本計畫主要是對這些最近發現的烷基鹵化物硼化的反應機理進行理論研究。 由此， 希望對一些重要的實驗現象進行解釋，從而對發展更好的催化劑提供理論基礎。

16304017.label: Major findings and research outcome
16304017.value: The detailed mechanisms have been investigated for the reactions of highly Lewis acidic tetra(o-tolyl) diborane(4) with CO, tBuNC and XylNC. The reactions afforded (1) a mixture of boraindane and boroxine by the cleavage of the CO triple bond, (2) an azaallene, and (3) cyclic compounds by direct C-H borylations, respectively (See 8(1)). DFT calculations were performed to investigate the reactions of boroles with alkynes, in which boranorbornadiene, borepin and/or boracyclohexadiene can be formed depending on the substituents on the borole and alkyne. DFT calculations have also been performed to study the diverse reactivity of pentaphenylborole toward different epoxides. The results allow us to systematically understand how different substituents on borole, alkyne and epoxide influence the reaction outcomes (See 8(2) and 8(5)). DFT calculations have been carried out to study the reaction mechanism of copper-catalyzed three-component boracarboxylation of alkene with CO2 and diboron. The competing reaction pathways involving two components have also been investigated for comparison. Through this theoretical study deep mechanistic insight on this multicomponent reaction is provided (See 8(3)). DFT calculations have been carried to understand the pathway leading to the formation of benzoborirene, which has been found to occur via benzyne Zr complex formation, B−Br/C(benzyne)−Zr σ-bond metathesis, and a Cp2ZrBr2 elimination/ring-closing process. We have also carried out studies on reactivity of the borylgold complex (IPr)AuB(o-tol)2 toward carbonyl compounds and found that nucleophilic reactivity of the gold metal center. These studies allow us to gain insight into how different metal centers mediated boron-related reactions (see 8(4) and 8(7)). We have carried out mechanistic studies on rhodium-catalyzed deoxygenation and borylation of ketones and found that deoxygenation and dehydrogenative borylation processes are responsible for the reactions (See 8(6)).

16304017.value: Over the years, transition metal-catalyzed borylation reactions have been found applications in synthetic organic chemistry. New catalytic processes involving borylation continues to be developed. The insights obtained from this project contribute significantly to this expanding development. We are continuing to focus our effort to understand recently reported borylation reactions.
