16602117.label: Major findings and research outcome
16602117.value: The GRF grant under discussion contributed to a number of major research findings regarding the social and spatial origins of China’s educated elite, especially in the first half of the twentieth century, published in English in Bamboo, Liang, and Lee 2020 and Lee, Ren, and Liang 2020 and summarized in Chinese in our forthcoming book Liang, Ren, and Lee 2020 which has been accepted for publication in late 2021 or early 2022 by 中国社会科学文献出版社. The above publications take advantage of three new big historical datasets to identify among other findings four salient features of the Chinese academe during the Republic of China. First, it was highly international in terms of training. Second, the proportion of female students was unexpectedly large relative to other developing and even some developed countries. Third, there was a heavy emphasis on STEM subjects. Finally, the social and spatial origins of China’s university students and university faculty members changed from a national population of civil servant families to business and professional families largely from Jiangnan and the Pearl River Delta. The datasets are the China University Student Dataset – Republic of China, which includes almost half of all students to graduate from a Chinese university during the first half of the 20th century; the China University Student Dataset – Overseas, which includes the vast majority of all Chinese students to graduate from an North American, European or Japanese university during this same period; and the China University Employee Dataset, which includes almost all university faculty members in China, 1941–1950. Since the CBDB and related databases are continuously growing, we continue to have more to do to complete the objective item 1 (80%). Due to COVID Restrictions, we could not perform the survey for objective item 3 (0%).

16602117.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16602117.value: In addition to the above, the GRF grant under discussion helped fund important ongoing research on the social and spatial origins of China’s educated elite in the entire twentieth century which is already yielding major research discoveries contrasting the social and spatial origins of some 5000 elected academicians to the Chinese Academy of Science (CAS) and Chinese Academy of Engineering (CAE) and certified experts in science and technology by the Chinese Association of Science and Technology (CAST), who constitute China’s supra educated elite during most of the twentieth century, with the social and spatial origins of 300,000 graduates from China’s elite or 双一流大学 or Double-First Universities during this same period. These results which we hope to submit in 2021 and 2022 (acknowledging the important contributions of RGC GRF 16602117) contrast the distinctive and different social and spatial patterns of cognitive ability, socio-economic resources, and individual motivation of academicians with students in China’s best universities, and have wide-ranging implications that go beyond Chinese studies and should be of wide interest to the global academe.

16602117.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16602117.value: The research funded by RGC GRF 16602117 on the social and spatial origins of China’s educated elite, 1865-2014 describes in detail the evolution of China’s educated elite from a group of aspirant 科举 civil service examination candidates to China’s current educated professionals with special emphasis on those working in Science Technology Engineering and Math, that is the STEM disciplines. We document the gradual opening up of China’s educated elite from a group of relatively closed civil service elite families 科举家族 to business and professional families largely from Jiangnan and the Pearl River Delta in the first half of the twentieth century and to a much larger population of qualified students from less educated working-class backgrounds in the second half of the twentieth century. In addition, in our ongoing research initiated during the grant period we identify and contrast the distinctive and different social and spatial patterns of cognitive ability, socio-economic resources, and individual motivation of China’s highest educated elite, CAS and CAE academicians and CAST experts, with students in China’s best universities. The results have wide-ranging implications that go beyond Chinese studies and should be of wide interest to the global academe.

16602217.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16602217.value: 發展中國家的多邊貸款和腐敗：以國際貨幣基金組織為例

16602217.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16602217.value: How successful are international financial institutions (IFIs) at tackling corruption in developing countries? This question is important for several reasons. Corruption, defined as the abuse of political authority or public power for private benefit, has been shown to hinder economic growth in many developing countries. Despite some observations that corruption can promote economic growth in certain contexts (Leff 1964; Huntington 1968), the literature largely acknowledges that corruption increases the cost of business and investment, reduces the productivity of public expenditure, and distorts the allocation of resources (Brunetti 1997; Mauro 1997; Poirson 1998; Mo 2001). Numerous IFIs, most notably the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank, have actively promoted efforts to combat corruption in developing countries since the 1990s. However, anecdotal evidence suggests that existing programs have not been successful in many of the recipient countries even after years of implementation. It is therefore important to systematically assess the effectiveness of IFI lending in reducing corruption and to analyze the factors that contribute to success. With these goals in mind, this study specifically focuses on the IMF, one of the most important IFIs. We expect the effectiveness of the IMF programs to depend crucially on the domestic political conditions of the recipient countries and the governance of the IMF itself. Despite the IMF’s potentially significant influence on the governance and economic growth of developing countries, the literature on this topic is sparse. We will therefore investigate the following questions: how effective have existing IMF programs been at reducing corruption in borrowing countries? Specifically, how effective are the governance-related conditionalities (GRCs) at tackling corruption, after controlling for other determinants? What political factors make the lending programs more successful in some countries than in others? To what degree can the effectiveness of GRCs be attributed to domestic political conditions and to the IMF’s own governance problems? To answer these questions, we will code the GRCs of the IMF programs from 1997 to 2010 using the IMF database of Fund arrangements. We will obtain measures of corruption and government transparency from various sources--such as Transparency International, the World Bank, the International Country Risk Guide, Hollyer et al. (2014), and the Quality of Government Institute--and analyze them using models to address potential endogeneity problems between IMF lending and corruption. Finally, we will conduct country case studies and interviews of authorities related to IMF programs to better understand GRC design and the determinants of successful program implementation. 國際金融機構在發展中國家中處理腐敗有多成功？此問題在幾個方面來說十分重要。腐敗，即濫用政治權威或公共權力謀取私利，已被發現會阻礙許多發展中國家的經濟增長。雖然有研究指出在特定情況下，貪污腐敗可以促進經濟增長（Leff 1964; Huntington 1968），但已有的文獻大部分都認為腐敗會增加商業和投資的成本，降低公共開支的生產力，和扭曲資源配置（Brunetti 1997; Mauro 1997; Poirson 1998; Mo 2001）。 眾多國際金融機構，特別是國際貨幣基金組織(International Monetary Fund [IMF]）和世界銀行，自上世紀九十年代起就積極致力于打擊發展中國家的腐敗。然而，有證據顯示現存的項目即使在受援國執行多年之後都並沒有取得成功。因此，系統地評估國際金融機構借貸對於減少腐敗的效力和分析打擊腐敗的成功因素十分重要。 帶著這些目的，此研究主要關注最重要的國際金融機構之一，即國際貨幣基金組織。我們預估IMF項目的效力關鍵取決於受援國的國內政治狀況和IMF自身的治理。儘管IMF對於發展中國家的治理和經濟增長有潛在的重要影響，相關研究卻很缺乏。因此，我們將探究以下問題：現有的IMF項目對于借貸國減少腐敗有何成效？具體地說，在控制其他決定因素后，與治理有關的貸款條件（governance-related conditionalities [GRCs]）在處理腐敗上效力如何？在何程度上，GRCs的效力可歸因于國內政治狀況和IMF本身的治理問題？ 要回答這些問題，我們將會使用IMF貸款計劃的數據庫，對1997年至2010年的IMF項目里關於治理的貸款條件整理編碼。我們也會從多種渠道獲取評估腐敗和政府透明度的方法，例如參考透明國際、世界銀行、國際風險指標、Hollyer等学者的研究（ 2014）、和政府質量研究所，然後使用模型處理IMF貸款和腐敗的潛在內生性問題并進一步分析。最後，我們將進行國家個案研究和採訪IMF項目相關的權威人士，以更好地理解GRCs的設定和項目成功執行的決定因素。

16602617.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16602617.value: “新常态”下中国城市化的政治经济学

16602617.label: Project Objectives
16602617.value: Build an original database of administrative reorganization cases between 2010 and 2015. Identify patterns of urbanization through administrative reorganization in China. Conduct case studies of administrative reorganization in a centrally-administered municipality, a provincial capital, a separately-planned city, and a regular prefecture level city. Analyze the dynamics and consequences of competition among vertical levels of government (province, muncipality, prefecture, and county). Ascertain the implications of administrative reorganization for the achievement of Beijing's urbanization objectives.
rows: Build an original database of administrative reorganization cases between 2010 and 2015.
Identify patterns of urbanization through administrative reorganization in China.
Conduct case studies of administrative reorganization in a centrally-administered municipality, a provincial capital, a separately-planned city, and a regular prefecture level city.
Analyze the dynamics and consequences of competition among vertical levels of government (province, muncipality, prefecture, and county).
Ascertain the implications of administrative reorganization for the achievement of Beijing's urbanization objectives.

16602617.label: Realisation of objectives
16602617.value: 1. We have built an original database of administrative reorganization covering all the counties that were converted into urban districts during 2010 and 2016 (78 cases in 68 cities were recorded). The database includes each county’s population rank; fiscal budgetary revenue rank; GDP rank and land area rank among all the administrative entities under the same prefecture-level city’s jurisdiction. This database enables us to understand the nature of competitive dynamics of administrative reorganization from a national-level overview. Meanwhile, we have also collected the “Publicity before Official Appointments (官员任前公示名单)” announcements from all the counties, county-level cities, and urban districts of prefecture-level cities in each province, and compiled a database indicating the personnel reach of provincial governments. This enabled us to demonstrate the provincial governments’’ extension of its reach in personnel appointments from “one-level-down” to “two-levels-down” in recent years. However, information from Inner Mongolia, Guangxi, Tibet, Xinjiang, Hebei and Hainan provinces/autonomous regions is currently unavailable. 2. Based on the database we created according to the first objective, we have identified three patterns of urbanization through administrative reorganization: 1) Prefecture-level cities have sought to incorporate counties into their urban districts, especially after 2010 when the central government started to highlight the key role of prefecture-level cities in China’s urbanization blueprint. 2) Provincial governments have sought to take counties away from prefecture-level cities, especially counties with the strongest fiscal revenue. 3) Centrally-administered municipalities have been at the forefront of incorporating counties into urban districts; Beijing, Shanghai and Tianjin have managed to convert all of their counties into urban districts and Chongqing is also accelerating its pace of such conversion. In addition, we have also analyzed 13 exceptional cases in which non-provincial prefecture-level cities successfully converted counties with the strongest fiscal power, and put these exceptional cases under two general categories: 1) The phenomenon of “one district, many counties,” and 2) Narrowing regional development gap. 3. We conducted various fieldtrips to Shanghai (centrally-administrated municipality), Hangzhou (a provincial capital), Ningbo (a separately-planned city), Suzhou (a regular prefecture-level city) and Huzhou (a regular prefecture-level city). We interviewed scholars from Fudan University, Zhejiang University, Ningbo University, Nottingham Ningbo China, etc., and local officials who are familiar with the decision-making process of administrative reorganization from Development and Reform Commission, Statistical Bureau, Land Bureau etc. We also visited local experts who participated in the administrative reorganization process, and country/district level officials in Ningbo, Suzhou and Huzhou. This fieldwork enabled us to develop detailed case studies of these cities and provide insights into China’s vertical intergovernmental dynamics. Apart from independent case studies of these five localities, we also conducted a comparative analysis between Hangzhou and Ningbo. 4. Based on the objectives above, we have delineated intergovernmental dynamics and consequences in China’s urbanization process. During the early reform era, a popular provincial strategy for boosting GDP figures took the form of enhancing the authority of economically strong counties. This entailed placing counties in a dual-reporting relationship to both prefecture-level and provincial governments. Gradually, conflicts emerged as prefecture-level cities and provinces pursued divergent strategies to eliminate dual reporting on the part of counties. In centrally-administered municipalities, the counties are equivalent to prefecture-level cities, which means that they are not in a dual-reporting relationship. Provincial capitals are expected to face fewer obstacles in converting counties because they generally have the highest level of urbanization within a province. Separately-planned cities have a dual reporting relationship with both the provincial and the central government. However, they may lack provincial support, given that they do not remit fiscal revenues to provincial governments. Structurally, we expect that regular prefecture-level cities will face the greatest constraints in urbanization due to vertical competition with provincial governments. Meanwhile, our database of provincial personnel reach indicates growing provincial authority, which further foreshadows the consequence that provincial capitals will receive more provincial support than regular prefecture-level cities at a similar economic scale. These patterns reflect dynamics of vertical intergovernmental relations facing cities at different administrative rank. 5. Interviews with officials who are familiar with the decision-making process of administrative reorganizations in various cities give us a clear sense of Beijing’s evolving urbanization objectives, and how such objectives have been achieved at the local level. To further comprehend China’s urbanization targets, we collected relevant central documents that indicate its developing urbanization vision since the 2000s. Meanwhile, at the local level, we also collected central/provincial documents that indicate the strengthening of province-county relations, which in turn, potentially threatens the central government’s recent blueprint to rationalize intergovernmental relations among provinces, prefecture-level cities and counties/urban districts. The institutional dynamic of provincial activism highlighted in this project is especially relevant for understanding the developmental trajectory of second- and third-tier cities that constitute the preponderance of urban China. Moreover, as provincial governments take over the counties that generate the most fiscal revenue, the resources available to prefecture-level cities are diminished significantly. One of the risks is that they may rely more heavily on land revenues in compensation, which is not consistent with the central government’s mandate of developing a new urban growth model.

16602617.label: Major findings and research outcome
16602617.value: During the initial decades of reform, a popular yet underexplored provincial strategy for boosting GDP figures took the form of enhancing the authority of economically strong counties. Although counties traditionally fell under the purview of prefecture-level cities, since 1992 provincial governments have been building direct linkages with counties to improve the alignment of the political status of counties with their economic performance. With the rise of provincial activism, an increasing number of counties now report select issues directly to provinces, bypassing prefecture-level city governments. However, the context of China’s political economy has changed in recent years. The present leadership’s strategy prioritizes the urban economy. Meanwhile, prefecture-level cities have played an important economic role in China’s urban transition. Relatedly, incorporating counties into urban districts has a more positive impact on China’s urbanization process than placing counties under the direct administration of provincial governments, which explains the recent wave of administrative reorganization. Conventional studies in general presume China’s administrative structure to be explicitly “layer-by-layer,” such that prefecture-level governments are able to incorporate counties into urban districts smoothly. But the role of provincial activism has been hitherto neglected. This research reveals that three patterns of administrative rationalization have emerged as prefecture-level cities and provinces have pursued divergent strategies to eliminate dual reporting on the part of counties. On the one hand, provincial governments seek to convert counties into “provincially-administered counties.” On the other hand, prefecture-level city governments fear losing administrative control of their subordinate counties and thus attempt to convert counties into urban districts. Meanwhile, centrally-administered municipalities have been at the forefront of incorporating counties into urban districts as they do not have another “provincial authority” above them. This competitive dynamic often trumps economic logic in explaining variation in the urbanization patterns of prefecture-level cities. These patterns reflect fiscal implications of vertical competition among different levels of government in the process of urbanization and identifies a dominant pattern whereby provincial governments favor provincial capitals and cities that are lagging in urban development. Meanwhile, cities that have been performing well economically, but are not provincial capitals, are lagging in urbanization due to vertical competition between prefecture-level cities and provinces.

16602617.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16602617.value: As dual-reporting structures create fiscal conflicts between prefecture-level cities and provinces over counties, cities that have a legacy of economically stronger counties may be constrained by provincial governments in terms of resource allocation throughout the entire jurisdiction, regardless of the dynamic economic growth they have achieved. Going forward, further research is required to understand the developmental prospects of second-tier cities that are approaching the GDP level of the 'Big Four' first-tier cities, but have different reporting structures through detailed case studies/comparative analysis. These represent broader developmental constraints beyond those faced in the course of urbanization. Furthermore, our study observes growing provincial authority in terms of resource allocation and even personnel reach. As such, how the central government manages centrifugal forces under growing provincial authority merits further exploration. Andrew Mertha (2005) has observed the emergence of “soft centralization,” such that a growing number of regulatory bureaucracies are being consolidated up to the provincial level. This has eroded the authority of sub-provincial governments over the economy within their jurisdictions, as provinces are becoming a centralizing node in multiple spheres of regulatory governance. The extent to which this serves the intentions of the present leadership’s centralizing efforts in practice warrants additional research.

16602617.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16602617.value: China’s first-tier cities have attracted considerable resources from the central government, international interest, and also scholarly attention. Yet these vibrant, cosmopolitan first-tier cities are exceptional rather than representative of the majority of China’s urban areas. This study explores the structural challenges faced by second and third-tier cities whose reform-era growth has been supported by rural industrialization in the counties under their jurisdiction. The study also highlights the process of how factors that contributed to economic success of these cities (e.g., having economically strong counties), have become barriers to further development. Meanwhile, the growing role of provincial governments makes it challenging for prefecture-level cities in China to steer their own urbanization process. A growing number of provincial governments have been skipping the prefecture level below them and appointing civil servants at the county level. In addition, provincial governments are playing an increasingly active role in converting rural counties into urban districts.

17100317.label: Project Objectives
17100317.value: To determine the effects of celastrol on the lipid metabolism, oxidative stress and inflammation in diet-induced obese mice. Our pilot experiments suggest that celastrol may promote weight loss via inducing lipolytic and antioxidant enzymes while inhibiting lipogenesis and inflammation. We will determine the effects of celastrol on the expression of key biomarkers in lipid metabolism, redox homeostasis and inflammation in diet-induced obese mice by Western blotting and qRT-PCR. We will analyze lipid composition by GC-MS technique. To measure the impact of covalent celastrol-PKM2 conjugation on the cellular signals involving PKM2, HIF-1α and IL-1β in macrophages and adipocytes. We discovered that celastrol not only formed covalent conjugate with PKM2 but also suppressed the expression of HIF-1α and phospho-STAT3 in macrophages. We hypothesize that celastrol may attenuate hypoxic and inflammatory signals via covalent inhibition of PKM2. We will examine the effects of celastrol-PKM2 conjugation on PKM2 dimerization by cross-linking and molecular simulation. We will further investigate the signaling cross-talk between PKM2, HIF-1α and IL-1β. To discover the in vivo effects of celastrol-PKM2 conjugation on macrophage reprogramming and adipocyte tissue remodeling in diet-induced obese mice. We postulate that in vivo celastrol-PKM2 conjugation may regulate macrophage reprogramming and adipose tissue remodeling. We will focus on three experiments: 1) Detecting covalent celastrol-PKM2 conjugate in obese mice; 2) Examining the effects of celastrol on macrophage polarization and adipose tissue remodeling; 3) Investigating the anti-obesity activity of celastrol-PKM2 conjugation.

17100317.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100317.value: 慢性炎症是肥胖和相關疾病（包括2型糖尿病，動脈粥樣硬化，高血壓和急性心肌梗塞）的發病機制。M1巨噬細胞持續產生促炎細胞因子（例如TNF-α，IL-1β），从而诱发脂肪組織炎症和胰島素抵抗。該項目的長期目標是研究治療肥胖和心血管疾病的中藥及其分子机制。在GRF（例如，17120915,17146216）的資助支持下，我們已经發現了幾種天然產物在心肌梗死模型中可以將促炎M1型巨噬細胞轉為抗炎M2型。因此，我們拟擴大對中藥调控巨噬細胞的认識，阻止脂肪組織的不健康擴張。哈佛科學家奧茲坎博士最近从超過1000種小分子筛选到植物來源的celastrol，可以最有效改善肥胖症。依次思路，我們前期工作表明，celastrol不僅減少了飲食誘導的肥胖小鼠的脂肪量，而且降低了鼠巨噬細胞中炎症介質（如TNF-α，IL-1β）。為了闡明该药的抗肥胖機制，我們合成了一種新型的N-炔丙基雷公藤红素酰胺，通過藥物处理细胞，通過点击化學“疊氮-炔基環加成”成功向相关蛋白质引入了生物素。再经親和力富集，我們通過蛋白質組學分析鑑定出丙酮酸激酶M2（PKM2）為celastrol的潛在靶標。眾所周知，PKM2是癌症Warbur效应中的一種糖酵解酶，但PKM2也通過與缺氧誘導因子1（HIF-1α）和促炎細胞因子IL-1β的信号交流在缺氧和炎症中起重要作用。基于這些結果，我們假設：celastrol可以通過破壞PKM2，HIF-1α和IL-1β之間的信号交流來改善飲食誘導的肥胖症中的代謝功能障礙，氧化應激和炎症反应。为了验证這一假設，我們將实现以下三個具體目標：1）確定雷公藤红素對飲食誘導的肥胖小鼠脂質代謝，氧化應激和炎症反应的影響; 2）确定celastrol与PKM2共價结合后對巨噬細胞和脂肪細胞中PKM2，HIF-1α和IL-1β的細胞信號的影響; 3）在体研究Celastrol-PKM2結合對飲食誘導的肥胖小鼠巨噬細胞重編程和脂肪細胞組織重塑的影響。該項目的結果將 促进开发新型PKM2抑製劑以应對日益增加的肥胖患病率。最終，該項目將促進发现中藥针对巨噬細胞重編程和脂肪組織重塑的减肥新機制。

17100317.label: Major findings and research outcome
17100317.value: We pursued three specific aims and obtained the following results: 1) We evaluated the anti-obesity effects of celastrol in diet-induced obese mice, analyzed a panel of specific biomarkers and discovered that celastrol promoted weight loss via inducing lipolytic and antioxidant enzymes while inhibiting lipogenesis and inflammation. We demonstrated that celastrol dictated macrophage polarization through modulating MAP kinases (e.g., ERK1/2, p38, JNK), NF-κB pathway and Nrf2/HO-1 pathway. These results were published in Aging-US (Luo D et al. Aging (Albany NY). 2017 Oct 16;9(10):2069-2082). 2) We synthesized a novel N-propargyl celastrol amide as small molecule probe and identified PKM2 as a potential target for celastrol. To map the binding site, we prepared recombinant mouse PKM2 in E coli and investigated celastrol binding to recombinant PKM2. As results, celastrol readily formed covalent conjugate with PKM2 while LC/MS revealed that celastrol bound to the cysteine residue in ta peptide of GSEFMPKPHSEAGTAFIQTQQLHAAMADTFLEHMCR. 3) We further examined the effects of celastrol the cross-talks between PKM2, HIF-1α and IL-1β. Cealstrol-PKM2 conjugation did not affect the enzyme activity of PKM2 while inhibited the enzyme activity of PKM2 at extremely high concentrations (e.g., 100 and 500 μM). However, celastrol promoted the formation of PKM2 tetramer but attenuated the formation of PKM2 dimer. Consistently, celastrol reduced the phosphorylation of PKM2, the nuclear translocation of HIF1α and PKM2 and the expression of HIF-1α and IL-1βin a concentration-dependent manner. These results strongly suggested that covalent celastrol-PKM2 conjugation not only affected the biological functions of PKM2 but also played a critical role of in glycolysis and inflammatory response. 4) We examined the effects of celastrol-PKM2 conjugation on macrophage polarization, inflammation and metabolic homeostasis. We obtained several key findings as follows: a) Celastrol markedly skewed macrophage polarization towardfs anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype and reduced inflammation via regulating Nrf2/HO-1, MAP kinase and NF-κB pathways. The results were published in Aging (Luo D et al Aging (Albany NY). 2017 Oct 16;9(10):2069-2082). b) Celastrol effectively reduced the expression of HIF-1α, PKM2 and GLUT-1against HFD in mice. c) We examined the effects of celastrol on macrophage polarization in RAW264.7 cell culture. As results, celastrol reduced M1 macrophages and increased M2 macrophages in a concentration dependent manner. Consistently, celastrol inhibited lactate production while increased oxygen consumption. d) We synthesized a celastrol analogue with Azide moiety and attempted to detect celastrol-bound proteins in mice through Click chemistry cyclo-adduction although celastrol labeling was not visualizable due to unstable and reversible conjugation.

17100317.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17100317.value: Obesity is rapidly emerging as a major pathological risk factor for various health problems including diabetes, cancers, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases. M1 macrophages persistently produce proinflammatory signals to promote inflammation and metabolic dysfunctions in obesity. With the support of several GRF grants (e.g., 17120915, 17146216), we discovered several natural products for skewing macrophage polarization towards anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype in myocardial infarction. Thus, the present project was designed to target macrophage polarization with Chinese medicine celastrol against inflammation and metabolic dysfunctions in diet-induced obesity. As results, we discovered that celastrol formed covalent conjugate with PKM2 and thereby attenuated inflammatory response and metabolic dysfunctions in animal models and RAW264.7 macrophage cell culture. Thus, the present project not only revealed covalent celastrol-PKM2 conjugation as a new anti-obesity mechanism but also paved avenue to develop new PKM2 inhibitors against obesity. Future work should be directed to discover the potent PKM2 inhibitors and evaluate the anti-obesity effects in diet-induced animal models. Ultimately, the best PKM2 inhibitors should be further evaluated as anti-obesity drugs in clinical trials and benefit the community.

17100317.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17100317.value: The present project was designed to discover the potential of Chinese medicines to target macrophage polarization, inflammation and metabolic dysfunctions in obesity. Plant-derived celastrol was discovered as the best candidate for fighting obesity. Indeed, we verified that celastrol not only reduced fat mass in diet-induced obese mice but also suppressed the production of inflammatory mediators in murine macrophage cells. To elucidate the anti-obesity mechanisms, we synthesized N-propargyl celastrol amide as small molecule probe and identified pyruvate kinase M2 (PKM2) as a potential target for celastrol. PKM2 is a well-known glycolytic enzyme and plays an important role in hypoxia and inflammation via cross-talking with hypoxia-inducible factor 1 (HIF-1α) and proinflammatory cytokine IL-1β. We pursued three specific aims: 1) to determine the effects of celastrol on the lipid metabolism, oxidative stress and inflammation in diet-induced obese mice; 2) to measure the impact of covalent celastrol-PKM2 conjugation on the cellular signals involving PKM2, HIF-1α and IL-1β in macrophages and adipocytes; 3) to discover the in vivo effects of celastrol-PKM2 conjugation on macrophage reprogramming and adipocyte tissue remodeling in diet-induced obese mice. Our results revealed covalent celastrol-PKM2 conjugation as a new anti-obesity mechanism. This project paved avenue to develop new PKM2 inhibitors against obesity.

17100717.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100717.value: Obesity-driven adipose tissue inflammation predisposes a cluster of cardiometabolic diseases including atherosclerosis and diabetes. Obesity induces adipose tissue macrophage (ATM) polarization from M2-anti-inflammatory into M1-inflammatory phenotype, which leads to systemic low-grade inflammation and insulin resistance. Metabolic reprogramming from mitochondrial oxidation to aerobic glycolysis is a hallmark of M1 macrophage, whereas M2 macrophages display mitochondrial metabolism. Interestingly, obese adipose tissue with inflammation exhibits increased glycolysis but diminished mitochondrial metabolism in humans and rodents. Nonetheless it is unknown how obesity causes metabolic reprogramming in ATM and whether metabolic reprogramming in ATM triggers adipose tissue dysfunctions. The oncogene MDM2 is a major negative regulator of p53. The MDM2-p53 signalling axis is crucial for prevention of tumor development, at least in part, by fine-tuning multiple metabolic pathways including glycolysis and mitochondrial metabolism. Here we identify a new aspect of the MDM2-p53 axis in controlling macrophage activation and reprogramming. We have shown that expression of MDM2 is markedly increased in stromal vascular fraction of obese adipose tissue and M1 macrophages. Inhibition of MDM2 pharmacologically or by genetic haplo-deletion in myeloid cells abolishes the endotoxin lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced M1 polarization and inflammation in primary macrophages and mice but have no obvious effect on M2 macrophage polarization. Mechanistically, MDM2 appears to control M1 macrophage polarization via metabolic reprogramming but not the traditional NF-κB-dependent pathway. Expression of MDM2 is induced by LPS in a glycoytic dependent manner in macrophages, and this induction is mainly controlled at a post-transcriptional level. Based on these preliminary findings, we propose MDM2 as a crucial signalling mediator connecting metabolic pathways and inflammation in macrophages. Obesity promotes expression of MDM2 in ATM, and shifts the metabolism from mitochondrial oxidation to glycolysis, leading to M1 macrophage activation and subsequent adipose tissue inflammation and its related cardiometabolic disorders. In this project, we will determine whether myeloid-specific inactivation of MDM2 protects against obesity-induced adipose tissue inflammation and metabolic disorders and attenuates LPS-induced sepsis in mouse models. We will delineate the underlying mechanism by which MDM2 connects metabolism and immune response in macrophages. We will prove the concept that aberrant metabolism is a major contributor to M1 macrophage polarization in obese adipose tissue. Apart from traditional NF-κB pathway, our data will provide additional information for explaining how macrophage is activated in obesity via metabolic reprogramming and how immunity and metabolism is connected. The results will enable a better understanding of the pathogenesis of adipose tissue dysfunction in obesity.

17101017.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17101017.value: In Hong Kong, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the fourth leading cancer and the third common cause of cancer-related death. Liver transplantation is the best surgical treatment for HCC patients because it allows removing both the tumors and the diseased liver tissues. However, a major challenge facing HCC recipients after liver transplantation is a risk of HCC recurrence which cannot be predicted and treated. Recipients with recurred HCC after liver transplantation always died in a very short period. Induction of liver graft injury is an unavoidable consequence during early-phase after liver transplantation. Our previous experimental and clinical evidences have revealed that a higher hepatic injury at early-phase after liver transplantation promotes late-phase tumor progression, invasion and metastasis, suggesting that the problem of post-liver transplantation HCC recurrence can be tackled by governing the early-phase hepatic injury. To delineate how early-phase hepatic injury is responsible for late-phase HCC recurrence after liver transplantation, we collected both tissue and blood samples from HCC recipients at 2 hours after reperfusion during liver transplantation. This is the unique time-point to access early-phase hepatic injury. We applied RNA-sequencing technology to analyze the global expression profile of the liver tissues of HCC recipients at early-phase after liver transplantation. A gene encoding glutathione S-transferase A2 (GSTA2) was identified to be the most up-regulated gene at early-phase of HCC recipients with late-phase HCC recurrence. We aimed to investigate its clinical significance and functional roles in HCC recurrence after liver transplantation. We found that up-regulation of GSTA2 at early-phase was significantly correlated with accelerated hepatic injury. Higher level of early-phase plasma GSTA2 protein was significantly associated with late-phase HCC recurrence after liver transplantation, suggesting that it may be a potential non-invasive biomarker for early prediction of HCC recurrence. In a rat liver transplantation model, a higher expression level of GSTA2 was detected in more aggressive liver tumors after liver transplantation, indicating its role in promoting HCC progression after liver transplantation. Importantly, we found that GSTA2 could protect HCC cells from high reactive oxygen species (ROS)-induced apoptosis and promote HCC progression at low ROS condition, suggesting that GSTA2 is important for HCC cells to adapt the dynamic oxidative stress environments after liver transplantation. Our study will provide fundamental knowledge of why increased early-phase hepatic injury increases the risk of late-phase HCC recurrence after liver transplantation. From that, novel predictive and therapeutic strategies can be developed to combat HCC recurrence after liver transplantation. 在香港，肝癌是第四位發病數目最多和第三位導致死亡率最高的癌症殺手。因為肝臟移植可以將肝癌腫瘤和病變的肝組織一起切除並且換上了一個新的正常的肝臟，肝臟移植被視為最好的手術治療方法。但是，肝臟移植手術後腫瘤復發是一項未解決的難題。因為目前還沒有有效的預防及治療方法對付肝臟移植手術後腫瘤復發，所以肝癌病人一旦發生肝臟移植手術後腫瘤復發，他們的成活率一般都非常低。 肝臟損傷是肝臟移植手術後早期引起的不可避免的結果。從我們以前的臨床數據分析及動物實驗結果獲知，肝臟移植手術後早期肝臟損傷的加重會加速手術後晚期腫瘤的進展，侵入及轉移。這也提示了我們，調控手術後早期肝臟損傷的程度是一個降低術後晚期腫瘤復發的可行方法。 為了全面了解肝臟移植手術後早期肝臟損傷是如何影響手術後晚期腫瘤的復發，我們在肝臟移植手術後2小時收集了病人的血液和肝組織進行研究分析。這是唯一能獲取肝臟移植手術後早期的肝組織的時間點。我們運用RNA測序法對這些肝組織進行了全局基因表達式的分析。通過分析比較手術後腫瘤復發和沒有腫瘤復發的病人的全局基因表達式，我們發現穀胱甘肽S-轉移A2(GSTA2)在有腫瘤復發病人的移植手術後早期比沒有腫瘤復發病人的移植手術後早期有最顯著性的升高。因此，我們進一步探討GSTA2在肝臟移植手術後腫瘤復發上的臨床意義及功能上的作用。 我們的初步結果發現，GSTA2的上調是和肝臟移植手術後早期的肝損傷有正相關的關係。早期血漿的GSTA2蛋白水平和肝臟移植手術後腫瘤復發有顯著性正相關。這顯示了GSTA2蛋白有潛值發展成為非侵入的生物標誌物。再者，從大鼠的肝臟移植試驗中發現，高侵襲性的肝癌腫瘤組織比低侵襲性的肝癌腫瘤組織表達更高水平的GSTA2 mRNA。更重要的是，我們發現GSTA2在功能上既可以保護腫瘤細胞去抵抗高活性氧導致的細胞凋亡，也可以在低活性氧下促進腫瘤細胞生長。故此，我們推測GSTA2在功能上有利于腫瘤細胞適應肝臟移植手術後不斷改變的活性氧濃度。 我們的研究將促進了解肝臟移植手術後早期肝損傷如何影響晚期腫瘤的復發，有利於將來發展有效的預測和治療方法去解決肝臟移植手術後腫瘤復發的難題。

17101017.label: Realisation of objectives
17101017.value: The proposed objectives of the study have been achieved. The details of findings for each objective are addressed as follows: Objective 1: To investigate the clinical significance and prognostic value of GSTA2 in HCC recurrence after liver transplantation 1.1. Early-phase circulating GSTA2 (EPCGSTA2) protein was an indicator of hepatic injury and a prognostic biomarker of HCC recurrence A significantly higher level of EPCGSTA2 protein was detected in HCC recipients (N=106) compared to the healthy donors and in pre-transplant plasma of the recipients. A significantly higher level of EPCGSTA2 protein was detected in HCC recipients (N=106) compared to the healthy donors and in pre-transplant plasma of the recipients (Fig. 2A). The EPCGSTA2 protein was not significantly correlated with the pre-transplantation clinicopathological characteristics of the recipients, but significantly correlated with the duration of warm ischemic time, the levels of AST and ALT, ROS level, IL-10 and IL-8 proteins in early-phase plasma of HCC recipients. Recipients with post-LT HCC recurrence were detected with a significantly higher concentration of EPCGSTA2 protein compared to recipients without developing HCC recurrence. The EPCGSTA2 protein could significantly discriminate post-LT HCC recurrence with the area under curve (AUC) value of 0.752 (P=0.000). High EPCGSTA2 protein was a significant predictor of post-LT HCC recurrence (p=0.003). Among those significant factors, EPCGSTA2 protein and UCSF criteria were independent predictors in predicting HCC recurrence. Moreover, high EPCGSTA2 protein was significantly associated with poor disease-free survival of HCC patients after liver transplantation. These results indicated that EPCGSTA2 protein is a potential non-invasive biomarker not only for the indication of post-LT early-phase hepatic and systemic injury but also for the prediction of HCC recurrence and survival of HCC recipients. 1.2. GSTA2 S112T polymorphism associated with HCC recurrence and survival There were 12 differential single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in GSTA2 transcript identified by RNA sequencing between recipients with and without HCC recurrence. Sanger sequencing analysis of full length of GSTA2 cDNA (encoding 222 amino acids) was conducted on the liver biopsies collected from the early-phase of 60 HCC recipients. Four SNPs were detected at the positions of 28(T>A), 329(C>T), 335(G>C), and 629(A>C), which were either heterozygous or homozygous non-synonymous SNPs. Among all the detected SNPs, the G335C SNP which results in residue S112T substitution was found to be significantly different between HCC recipients with and without HCC recurrence (p=0.002). The percentage of heterogeneous SNP G335C in the recipients with HCC recurrence was nearly 5-fold higher than the recipients without HCC recurrence. Importantly, G335C heterogeneous G/C alleles of GSTA2 transcript were significantly associated with poor overall (P=0.017) and disease-free survival of HCC recipients (p=0.007). These results indicated that polymorphism of GSTA2 transcript of the liver grafts could be an influential factor of HCC recurrence after liver transplantation. Objective 2: To characterize the role and mechanism of GSTA2 in HCC recurrence after liver transplantation. 2.1. GSTA2 positively associated with aggressiveness of HCC The expression of GSTA2 mRNA in tumor or non-tumor tissues was significantly higher than in healthy donors. There was a significant upregulation of GSTA2 mRNA in the tumor tissues compared to the paired non-tumor issues of HCC patients. The expression of GSTA2 mRNA in HCC tumor tissues was significantly correlated with the size of the HCC tumor and the presence of venous infiltration. The expression of GSTA2 mRNA in the more aggressive rat liver tumors was significantly higher than in the less aggressive tumors. 2.2. Overexpression of GSTA2 promoted HCC growth and aggression The GSTA2-overexpressing HCC cells grew significantly faster than the control cells. Administration of recombinant GSTA2 protein could significantly speed up the growth rate of the HCC cells. The colony-forming ability of the HCC cells was significantly enhanced by either endogenous overexpression of the GSTA2 gene or administration of recombinant GSTA2 protein. The invasion ability of the HCC cells was enhanced when upregulation of GSTA2 either by endogenous or exogenous means, while the migration ability of the HCC cells remained similar. An increased level of GSTA2 could upregulate the expression of EMT-associated proteins including N-cadherin, vimentin, claudin, beta-catenin, and snail. 2.3. Suppression of GSTA2 inhibited the growth and metastasis of HCC cells. We further investigated whether targeted inhibition of GSTA2 can achieve anti-tumor and anti-metastasis on these malignant HCC cells. Suppression of GSTA2 could significantly reduce the proliferation rate (Fig.5B) and invasion ability of HCC cells (Fig.5C). Agreed with the in vitro finding, the size of the subcutaneous in GSTA2-suppressing cells was significantly smaller than the control cells. Importantly, no metastatic tumor was detected in the lung tissue in the GSTA2-suppressing cells, while 3 out of 8 nude mice (37.5%) were found to develop metastatic tumors in the lung in the control group. 2.4. The protective role of GSTA2 for HCCs against high oxidative stress-induced cell death The administration of human recombinant GSTA2 protein could help the normal hepatocytes to compensate for the H2O2-induced upregulation of ROS and reduce the anti-proliferative effect under a high ROS condition. Meanwhile, administration of recombinant GSTA2 protein or forced overexpression of GSTA2 gene in HCC cells could contribute a compensation effect on H2O2-induced ROS elevation. HCC cells with either an increased level of exogenous or endogenous GSTA2 exhibited a significantly higher proliferation rate than the control cells under a high-ROS condition. Apoptosis assay revealed that the upregulation of GSTA2 expression, either by exogenous or endogenous means, could protect the HCC cells against high H2O2-induced apoptosis. In addition, suppression of GSTA2 expression in the metastatic HCC cells further intensified the effect of H2O2, leading to a significantly higher intracellular ROS level and lower proliferation rate. 2.5. GSTA2 regulated ROS metabolism of HCC Two important ROS-mediating signaling pathways were characterized in GSTA2-overexpressing and GSTA2-suppressing HCC cells. Overexpression of GSTA2 in HCC cells suppressed its ROS-mediated activation of the JNK pathway, while suppression of GSTA2 enhanced the activation of the JNK pathway of HCC cells under an increased ROS condition. Overexpression of GSTA2 in HCC cells enhanced the activation of the AKT pathway under ROS-stimulation, while suppression of GSTA2 inhibited the activation of the AKT pathway in HCC cells. The effect of GSTA2 on the expression of 84 ROS-associated genes under the H2O2 environment was studied by RT2 PCR array analysis. By comparing their expressions between MHCC97L-shGSTA2 and MHCC97L-control cells, there were 5 up-regulated and 10 down-regulated genes related to oxidative stress were identified in MHCC97L-shGSTA2 cells under H2O2 condition. Altogether, our results demonstrated the possible mechanism of GSTA2 in HCC recurrence after liver transplantation. Elevated early-phase hepatic IRI after liver transplantation contributes to a high ROS environment which would cause harmful effects on HCC cells. GSTA2 is induced by IRI and upregulated in the liver and in the circulation subsequently provides protective advantages for HCC cells to survive against high ROS-induced damage. When ROS level decreased along with the recovery of hepatic IRI during later time point of liver transplantation, GSTA2 provides anti-oxidative benefits for HCC cells to initiate the growth and progression in an earlier period.

17101017.label: Major findings and research outcome
17101017.value: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) recurrence after liver transplantation remains a significant clinical problem. Ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI) occurred inevitably at the early-phase after liver transplantation (LT) spawns a significant risk on HCC recurrence. However, their linkage and IRI-derived risk factors for HCC recurrence remain exclusive. Understanding the mechanism of post-transplantation early-phase hepatic injury could provide new strategies to prevent the later event of HCC recurrence. Here, we decipher that upregulation of early-phase glutathione S-transferase A2 (GSTA2) after liver transplantation significantly enhances the risk of HCC recurrence. We demonstrated that GSTA2 expression was significantly associated with early-phase hepatic and systemic injury and ROS level after liver transplantation. Early-phase circulating GSTA2 protein was a significant predictor of HCC recurrence and survival. Heterogeneous single nucleotide polymorphism at G335C of GSTA2 was significantly associated with poor survival of HCC recipients. Functionally, endogenous or exogenous upregulation of GSTA2 could promote HCC growth and invasion through activating the epithelial-mesenchymal-transition process. Targeted inhibition of GSTA2 could suppress HCC growth and metastasis. Enhancement of GSTA2 could protect HCC cells against H2O2-induced cell death by compensating for the elevated ROS stress. We also demonstrated that GSTA2 played crucial roles in regulating the ROS-associated JNK and AKT signaling pathways and ROS metabolism in HCCs in responding to a dynamic ROS environment. GSTA2 could be a novel prognostic and therapeutic target to combat HCC recurrence after liver transplantation.

17101017.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17101017.value: Our finding indicated that upregulation of circulating GSTA2 during liver transplantation might contribute to a potential risk on the late phase HCC recurrence in HCC recipients, implying that it is a non-invasive biomarker for risk assessment of HCC recipients. Future validation of this biomarker in other liver transplantation cohorts should be essential for the future development of GSTA2 to be a prognostic biomarker in HCC recipients. Moreover, targeted suppression of GSTA2 in HCC could inhibit the growth and metastasis of HCC, indicating its therapeutic potential for targeted therapy of HCC. Future development of effective strategies for suppressing the intracellular and extracellular level of GSTA2, such as GSTA2 inhibitors, are necessary for development of effective therapeutic methods for prevention and treatment of HCC recurrence after liver transplantatation.

17101017.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17101017.value: Liver transplantation is the best surgical treatment for patients with early HCC under selection criteria. However, HCC recurrence after liver transplantation is the major obstacle leading to poor prognosis of HCC recipients. Currently, there are no effective predictive and preventive strategies to overcome HCC recurrence after liver transplantation. Our findings revealed that upregulation of circulating GSTA2 after liver transplantation could contribute an increased risk on the late phase HCC recurrence. Targeted inhibition of GSTA2 could significantly reduce the growth and metastasis of HCC cells. Therefore, our study has demonstrated that GSTA2 could be an important predictive and preventive target to combat HCC recurrence after liver transplantation.

17102017.value: 精確的基因複製是細胞遺傳和生物發展的基礎。當中，DNA複製的地方就是複製叉。它會經常被重塑及修補，確保DNA複製順利進行。雖然我們不完全明白複製叉重塑的機制，但是複製壓力因子進入複製焦點與複製叉重塑的時機卻恰巧吻合。另一方面，DNA複製時，基因夾PCNA會引導DNA複製和重塑因子到複製焦點。可是，有關PCNA如何推動受壓複製叉重塑和重組的分子基礎，則未被發掘。 我們會研究 TRAIP蛋白在精準基因複製中的角色 。DNA 複製壓力會令TRAIP蛋白從核仁中釋放，並在受壓的複製叉與PCNA產生作用 。相反， 如果 TRAIP 蛋白突變而失效，會導致細胞更容易受 DNA複製壓力影響，而出現 DNA變異。塞克爾綜合症的病人正正出現 TRAIP蛋白突變，但當中原理未被發掘，而且TRAIP蛋白引導PCNA到DNA 的機制仍然有待查考。 是次研究將闡明TRAIP蛋白如何重塑複製叉和影響基因複製、了解PCNA在複製叉的定位及探討兩者的相互關係。此外 ，我們亦會探討 TRAIP蛋白與其他蛋白的相互作用 ，了解 TRAIP 相關的DNA損害反應機制。最後，我們會看TRAIP蛋白變異、塞克爾綜合症和癌症的關係，了解蛋白變異如何影響 DNA複製和細胞對複製壓力的應對能力 。

17103417.value: 目前，90%的癌症相關死亡可以歸因於癌轉移，因此了解癌轉移背後的分子機制顯得尤為重要。上皮間充質轉化（EMT）作為其機制之一，指的是上皮細胞失去胞間連接，並向間質表型轉化，從而獲得較高浸潤性和遊走遷移能力的現象。 EMT的發生是腫瘤轉移早期至關重要的一步，另外它還參與誘導腫瘤細胞的干性、耐藥性和免疫逃避性狀的發生。然而，目前對EMT的研究主要集中在其下游轉錄因子，EMT上游調節機制的研究尚不充分。 p70S6K是PI3K/AKT信號通路的下游效應因子，由於在人類腫瘤中常發現其存在活化突變，因此成為一個潛在的治療靶點。最近，我們第一次發現，p70S6K除了有已被充分證明的促腫瘤生存生長作用外，也參與調控了腫瘤發展的其他環節，如腫瘤轉移。而且，我們進一步發現p70S6K是通過誘導EMT的發生促進腫瘤轉移。需要強調的是，儘管p70S6K通常被當作一個細胞質蛋白，我們卻發現，p70S6K的腫瘤轉移調控功能與它的核定位相關。而異生胞核核糖核蛋白hnRNP A2/B2 （一個剪接體的重要組成部分）很有可能是p70S6K在細胞核中的作用蛋白，值得注意的是，我們的基因組分析也得到了一致的結果。目前已有證據顯示在一些正常細胞系中有核p70S6K的表達，但在癌組織中是否有核p70S6K的表達仍然缺少直接證據，而且，其入核機制也未見任何報導。在此，我們提出一種理論假設，即p70S6K通過在細胞核中調控mRNA前體的剪接產生不同的致癌變異體，誘導腫瘤細胞EMT的發生，進而促進腫瘤轉移。 通過體外體內方法，我們將（1）闡明hnRNPA2/B1蛋白的功能和它在核p70S6K表達腫瘤細胞中的促轉移機制； （2）澄清p70S6K的核轉移機制；（3）揭示hnRNPA2/B1在核p70S6K誘導的EMT中發揮在mRNA前體剪接方面的作用。 此研究不僅可以揭示腫瘤轉移前期的重要動態調控機制，也將會為腫瘤靶向治療的發展再添新的科學理論基礎。

17103417.label: Realisation of objectives
17103417.value: Objective 1: To date, there is no study assessing the direct expression and function of p70S6K in the nucleus. We showed that nuclear localization of p70S6K increases with ovarian metastatic progression in human ovarian tumor samples and ovarian cancer cell lines, suggestive of its involvement in the regulation of nuclear functions. We showed that p70S6K is indeed a nucleo-cytoplasmic shuttling protein, and the nuclear import of p70S6K is required for efficient epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT). We further identified hnRNPA2/B1 as a novel nuclear p70S6K interaction partner. hnRNPA2/B1 siRNA, but not with nonspecific siRNA, exhibited a discernible reduction in the mesenchymal phenotype, with a concomitant decrease in N-cadherin/vimentin expression and an increase in E-cadherin expression. These data demonstrate an essential role of hnRNPA2/B1 in the regulation of EMT downstream of nuclear p70S6K Tumor xenografts in mice and patients’ clinical samples corroborate these findings in vivo. Percentage achieved: 100% Objective 2: Whether or not p70S6K needs to be phosphorylated for entering the nucleus is controversial. Our findings confirm an involvement of phosphorylation in regulating p70S6K nuclear localization upon stimulation of cytokines/growth factors that are highly expressed in ascitic fluid of ovarian cancer patients, such as hepatocyte growth factor. Interestingly, the kinase activity of p70S6K is indispensable for its nuclear translocation. First, the kinase-inactive p70S6K also underwent nuclear translocation. Second, overexpression of constitutively active mutant of p70S6K enhanced nuclear localization. Importin a1, a3 and a4, but not a2, and b1 could interact with p70S6K. Silencing Ran with siRNA caused a significant reduction of nuclear p70S6K. These data together demonstrate the active nucleocytoplasmic shuttling of p70S6K depending on exportin-1, importin, and Ran, rather than the presence of two static pools of p70S6K separated in the cytoplasm and the nucleus. Percentage achieved: 100% Objective 3: Pre-mRNA splicing is important in generating oncogenic variants with cancer-specific functions. p70S6K can be alternatively spliced to h6A and h6C isoforms. We showed that h6A and h6C were potent inducers of EMT, and h6A and h6C generation is a pre-requisite of p70S6K-mediated EMT. Moreover, with the Iso-seq, a significant increase in the splice variants of CASP9, BIN1, and RON, which have been previously implicated in the progression and metastasis of ovarian cancer, as well as new spliced variants were observed. Despite the absence of a consensus p70S6K phosphorylation motif, a non-consensus phosphorylation site (serine residue at position 73/85 (A2/B1) is on hnRNPA2/B1. Percentage achieved: 100% These findings not only reveal a previously unrecognized role for p70S6K in the nucleus, but also unveil a novel role for nuclear p70S6K in mediating the metastatic cascade through alternative splicing, which has been recognized as the prime driving event in almost all hallmarks of cancer. Nuclear p70S6K and its signaling molecules may represent more precise targets with potential therapeutic advantage for metastatic ovarian cancer. 17103417.label: Major findings and research outcome
17103417.value: Objective 1: Here, using cancerous tissues and isogenic ovarian cancer cell models with opposite metastatic abilities, we provide the first evidence the presence of nuclear p70S6K, and also indicate a positive association between nuclear p70S6K level and metastatic tendency. Nuclear p70S6K promotes epithelial-to-mesenchymal (EMT) phenotypes and cell migration, and enhances peritoneal metastasis in mice, which is uncoupled from the growth stimulating function of cytoplasmic p70S6K. We further identify hnRNPA2/B1, a critical spliceosome component, as a novel nuclear p70S6K-interacting protein in EMT and metastasis. Publication: Journal article: #1 Conference proceeding: #4, 5 Objective 2: p70S6K is indeed a nucleo-cytoplasmic shuttling protein. On exploring how the p70S6K translocates into the nucleus, we show that the nuclear localization of p70S6K is phosphorylation-dependent, whereas its kinase activity is not necessary. Furthermore, we uncovered a potential nuclear localization signal and the active nucleocytoplasmic shuttling of p70S6K depends on exportin-1, importin a1, a3, a4 and b1 and the Ran GTPase, rather than the presence of two static pools of p70S6K separated in the cytoplasm and the nucleus. Publication: Journal article: #1 Conference proceeding: #4, 5 Objective 3: To explore the molecular mechanisms of nuclear p70S6K in promoting EMT, we have identified hnRNPA2/B1. We have demonstrated a critical role of hnRNPA2/B1 in the nuclear p70S6K-mediated EMT via modulating alternative splicing of RPS6KB1 pre-mRNA, h6a and h6c. With Iso-seq, a significant increase in the splice variants of CASP9, BIN1, and RON, which have been previously implicated in the progression and metastasis of ovarian cancer, as well as new spliced variants were observed. Despite the absence of a consensus p70S6K phosphorylation motif, a non-consensus phosphorylation site is on hnRNPA2/B1. Tumor xenografts mice and detection of both nuclear p70S6K/hnRNPA2/B1 and p70S6K short isoforms in patient samples indicate therapeutic potential of targeting these signaling molecules in vivo. Publication: Journal article: #1 Conference proceedings: #4, 5 Taken together, our findings not only shed new light on a new direction for understanding the oncogenic roles of p70S6K in ovarian cancer, but may also be extended to other cancers with inappropriate activation of p70S6K. Selective targeting of nuclear p70S6K activity or its downstream signaling represents a promising strategy to specifically target metastatic cells, and at the same time minimize the adverse side effects caused by mTOR inhibitors (e.g. rapamycin) that downregulate cytoplasmic p70S6K. 17103417.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17103417.value: We reveal the novel identification of a nuclear role for p70S6K in both alternative splicing and EMT that have pivotal roles in the metastatic progression of ovarian cancer. This reveals a new direction for understanding the oncogenic role of p70S6K in ovarian cancer metastasis and implicate that p70S6K could be a promising therapeutic target. Given the potential side effects of mTOR inhibitors, it is of great interest to develop a safe and effective therapeutic approach. We and others have demonstrated the use of siRNA to efficiently and specifically downregulate “undruggable” genes. However, one major limitation is targeted RNA delivery. We have developed vesicle-like nanostructures based on dendrimers as effective carriers for siRNA delivery in novel RNAi therapeutic applications (Ma et al., 2018, Mol. Ther. 26: 70-83). We are actively pursuing in this direction. The repurposing of approved or investigational drugs for other non-oncology diseases (e.g. metabolic diseases) for cancer therapy is emerging as a very effective strategy for drug discovery as it is with reduced time, cost and risk. In our pilot study, we show that riluzole, a FDA-approved drug for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, could effectively suppress the nuclear p70S6K/hnRNPA2/B1-mediated EMT phenotype. We will continue to unravel the underlying mechanisms of action and explore its development with rationally designed drug combinations. Active p70S6K has also been detected in patients with breast, gastric, and colon cancer. To expand our understanding of the nuclear p70S6K, we plan to examine if this nuclear translocation is also seen in other tumor types in which active p70S6K is an important pathological process. These findings should highlight the functional importance of nuclear p70S6K in impacting aggressive malignant cell behavior and implies important clinical implications.

17103417.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17103417.value: One of the greatest unmet needs compromising the successful treatment of cancer is metastasis. No effective therapy is currently available, with a poor 5-year survival rate (<25%). Thus, there is a need for new therapeutic targets and a better understanding of the molecular mechanisms underlying the progression of ovarian cancer. Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) is an early key step in metastasis and that it could be a promising therapeutic target. (i) We show for the first time a new nuclear location of p70S6K, despite it is generally considered to be a cytoplasmic protein. (ii) We also present evidence suggesting this nuclear translocation of p70S6K in the EMT. (iii) We identify hnRNPA2/B1, a critical splicesome component, is a specific and novel p70S6K-interacting protein in the nucleus which generates distinct oncogenic variants that may underlie the EMT, metastasis, and poor outcome in ovarian cancer. These results reveal a new direction for understanding the oncogenic roles of p70S6K and highlight its importance as a viable therapeutic target. Targeting p70S6K nuclear activity may thus be a useful approach in the treatment of ovarian cancer metastasis.

17104617.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17104617.value: Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection is believed to be an important etiological factor in the development of nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC), which is a common cancer in Southeast Asia including southern regions of China and Hong Kong. However, the research on the basic mechanisms underlying the exact roles of EBV infection in NPC development and progression has been severely hindered by the continuous loss of EBV genomes from initial EBV-positive NPC cells in vitro. Eventually, all previously reported NPC cell lines (except only one) have become EBV-negative. To date, the mechanisms underlying the long-term EBV retention in NPC cells are largely undefined. Since EBV-positive NPC cell lines are fundamental cell models in preclinical studies on new therapeutic approaches of NPC management, the extreme scarcity of EBV-positive NPC cell lines has been the major hurdle in the field of NPC research worldwide. One of the reasons for the loss of EBV from initial EBV-positive NPC cells is presumably due to insufficient activation of multiple necessary host signaling pathways for EBV retention. With our continuous effort in the past years, we have recently established multiple novel EBV-positive NPC cell lines that can retain EBV genomes throughout prolonged propagation (for more than 100 population doublings). This success was achieved based on our prediction that multiple signaling pathways are required for EBV retention in NPC cells, and these can be activated by extra supplements in our newly designed culture medium. Specifically, we hypothesize that the novel recipe of our culture medium may function to promote cell cycle progression of EBV-harboring NPC cells, to facilitate EBV replication and tethering of EBV genomes to host chromosomes, and to enhance the capacity of anti-differentiation which favors long-term latent persistence of EBV infection. This proposal aims to test those hypotheses and define the molecular mechanisms underlying the successful retention of EBV in NPC cells. Deciphering the molecular mechanisms for the long-term retention of EBV in NPC cells will provide an essential platform for understanding the roles of EBV infection in pathogenesis of NPC, and may open up new opportunities for identification of specific targets for intervention of EBV-associated NPC or for development of therapeutic drugs to improve the clinical management of NPC. 鼻咽癌(NPC)是在東南亞地區，包括中國南部地區和香港的一種常見癌癥。Epstein Barr病毒（EBV）感染被認為是NPC發生、發展的重要致病因素。 然而，EBV感染在鼻咽癌中確切作用的基本機制研究因為NPC細胞在體外持續丟失EBV基因組而受到嚴重阻礙。到目前為止，所有先前報道的鼻咽癌細胞系（除一個例外）都變成了EBV陰性。迄今， EBV在鼻咽癌細胞長期存留的機制, 在很大程度上尚未明了。由於EBV陽性鼻咽癌細胞系是鼻咽癌治療新方法的臨床前研究中的基本細胞模型，EBV陽性鼻咽癌細胞系的極度匱乏一直是世界範圍內鼻咽癌研究的主要障礙。EBV陽性鼻咽癌細胞丟失EBV的原因之一可能是由於缺乏必要的多個宿主信號通路激活, 而無法維持EBV存留。我們通過過去幾年持續不斷的努力，最近建立了多個新的EBV陽性鼻咽癌細胞系。 這些細胞系在長期培養過程中（超過100倍細胞數倍增）均可保留EBV基因組。這一成功正是基於我們的如此預判: EBV在鼻咽癌細胞長期存留需要激活多個信號通路; 這些信號通路可通過我們新設計的培養基中的補充元素而激活。具體來說，我們的假說是: 新培養基配方有如下新功能: 可能促進EBV陽性鼻咽癌細胞的細胞周期進程，促進EBV基因組在宿主染色體上的粘合和EBV復制，並增強細胞抗分化能力, 以有利於EBV在細胞中潛伏, 從而維持持久性感染。本研究旨在驗證這些假說，並確定EBV在鼻咽癌細胞中成功存留的分子機制。闡明EBV在鼻咽癌細胞存留的分子機制對於理解EBV長期感染在鼻咽癌發病機理中的作用提供重要的平臺，可以為EBV相關的NPC的幹預提供的具體標靶, 或也為提高鼻咽癌的臨床治療和藥物開發提供新機遇。

17104617.label: Realisation of objectives
17104617.value: Objective 1: To define the cooperative roles of EGF/EGFR and IL-6/IL-6Ra signaling activation in EBV retention in NPC cells. "Finding 1.1: Establishment of new EBV-positive NPC cell lines for investigations" Nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) cell lines are long known to be difficult to establish in culture. Even if successful in rare conditions, the EBV episomes which are closely associated with patient NPC were rapidly lost (within 10-20 subcultures). Even worse, many of the commonly used “NPC” cell lines established from early studies (e .g. HONE1, CNE2 and others) were found to have contamination with HeLa genome. The difficulty to establish EBV-infected NPC cells and their authentication represents a major obstacle in understanding the role of EBV infection in pathogenesis of NPC. Until our recent reports on establishment of two new EBV-infected NPC cells (NPC43 and C17), the c666-1 NPC cell line (established by Hong Kong investigators was the only available and authenticated EBV-infected NPC cell line available for investigation. The NPC43 is a mixed population of EBV-infected and uninfected NPC cells responsive to dynamic study of EBV persistence in NPC cells. "Finding 1.2: EGF/EGFR did not selectively stimulate EBV-infected NPC cells." We first examined the effects of EGF/EGFR signaling in EBV persistence in NPC43 cells. In contrast to the proliferative effects of EBV infection in B lymphocytes, we were not able to observe any enhancement of cell proliferation in EBV infected NPC cells. In contrary, EBV-infected NPC43 cells have a slower growth rate. Stimulation of cell proliferation by EGF/EGFR signaling was readily enhanced in EBV-negative NPC43 and to a lesser degree in EBV-infected NPC43 cells resulting in the rapid loss of EBV-infected cells in the population. This may explain the rapid loss of EBV-infected NPC cells after explantation to culture, particularly at early stages of establishment. “Finding 1.3: IL6/IL6R/STAT3 signaling suppressed lytic reactivation of EBV in infected NPC cells.” Our recent results using NPC43 cells strongly indicate an important role of STAT3 activation, a key downstream signaling event of IL6, in suppression of lytic reactivation of EBV in infected epithelial cells. Lytic infection has been postulated to be the default program of EBV infection in pharyngeal epithelial cells. Our results suggest that the ability of cell signaling to suppress lytic reactivation of EBV may play a more important role in EBV persistence in infected NPC cells. Objective 2: To examine the role of p38 MAPK inhibition in EBV persistence in NPC cells. “Finding 2.1: STAT3 suppressed lytic infection of EBV in NPC.” The oropharyngeal epithelium has been postulated to be the site of lytic EBV infection releasing infectious EBV virions into saliva. Premalignant and/or malignant changes kin nasopharyngeal epithelium may alter their differentiation properties to support latent EBV infection. Activation of p38 MAPK has been postulated to be involved in lytic reactivation of EBV and inhibition of p38 MAPK by specific inhibitor (e.g. SB203580) may suppress lytic reactivation of EBV infection in NPC cells. However, we did not observe significant increase of latently infected EBV cells in NPC43 cells aftWIn addition to inhibit p38MAPK using chemical inhibitor, we have examined if manipulation of upstream regulator of p38MAPK e.g. STAT3 may influence the lytic/latent EBV infection in NPC cells. We observed for the first time in NPC cells that STAT3 activation effectively suppressed lytic EBV infection and supported latent EBV infection. “ Finding 2.2 : Regulation of deltaNp63 by STAT3 may play an important on persistence of EBV in NPC cells.” With the responsive NPC43 cell system, we have examined some of the key signaling elements involved in regulating lytic and latent EBV infection. We observed that STAT3 is involved in the activation of deltaNp63 which regulates p38MAPK. Furthermore, we observed that activation of STAT3 signaling suppressed epithelial differentiation of NPC43 cells. Expression of Np63 appears to be an essential regulator of latent EBV infection. Objective 3: To investigate the role of anti-differentiation capacity of NPC cells in EBV retention. “Fikndikng 3.1: Specific differentiation property and signaling of NPC support persistence of EBV.” In contrast to the continuous loss of EBV monolayer culture of EBV-infected NPC, NPC xenografts passaged in athymic nude mice were able to maintain EBV copy in infected NPC cells. EBV-infected NPC cells may have selective growth advantages in xenograft and were selected. The observations in Objective 2 have already suggested the importance of differentiation of NPC cells to support EBV persistence in them. Our hypothesis is that the specific differentiation property and signaling in patient NPC may be preserved in 3D growth environment in xenograft. The special differentiation property of NPC may suppress lytic reactivation of EBV and support latent/persistent EBV infection. To test this hypothesis, we included a Rho kinase inhibitor (Y-27632) in our culture media and successfully established two EBV-positive NPC cell lines, NPC43 and C17. The EBV copy in NPC43 continues to lost and stabilizes at around 150-200 population doublings (PD) in monolayer culture. We performed various experiments to dissect the essential factors in NPC xenografts that select EBV-infected NPC to grow. First of all, we injected NPC43 at around 150 PD into NOD/SCID mice and allow them to grow as NPC xenografts for around 3 months, then the NPC43 cells were re-established in culture (explant culture 1). Interestingly, we observed that NPC43 cells grown as xenografts increase the EBV copy in cells (at least 2 folds) when they were explanted in culture. We repeated the procedures and injected the explanted NPC43 cells to grow as xenograft again for three months and re-established the NPC43 line (explant culture 2) again. We again observed increased EBV copy in explant culture 2 of NPC43 after passaged twice as xenografts. These experiments clearly demonstrated a selective growth advantage of EBV-infected NPC cells as xenografts. We then performed RNA profiling of NPC43 cells in xenografts (after removal of mouse stromal cells). Interestingly, we found profound differences in RNA profiles of NPC43 harboring low and high copy of EBV when grown as xenografts. Apparently the selective environment is maintained only in NPC43 cells grown as xenografts but not in monolayer culture. This may explain the difficulty in establish EBV-infected NPC cell lines in monolayer culture environment. Among the differential genes expressed in NPC43 cells to support high copy of EBV, the most prominent ones are those related to undifferentiation including low expression of several keratins, and involucrin. These observations suggest to us that EBV persistence in NPC is correlated and probably dependent on poor differentiation cell environment of malignant NPC. “Finding 3.2: Organoid culturing condition supports persistence of EBV in infected NPC cells.” We have explored the growth of EBV-infected NPC cells in 3D growth conditions similar to organoid culture of human. Interestingly, we observed that growing NPC43 and C17cells in 3D organoid cultures could double the EBV copy per cell. Using the full formula organoid growth medium which support tumour stem cells further increased the EBV copy in NPC cells suggesting an intracellular environment of tumour stem cells is supportive of growth of EBV-infected NPC in organoids. We have applied these new information in the establishment of more NPC cell lines from our established NPC and were able to establish two more EBV-infected NPC cell lines from NPC xenograft 76 and 43. Their characterization studies are ongoing.

17104617.label: Major findings and research outcome
17104617.value: EBV infection is commonly associated with nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) in patients. The role of EBV infection in NPC pathogenesis remains obscure. A major reason is the difficulty to establish EBV-positive NPC cell lines in culture which greatly hamper the study of pathogenic mechanism of EBV infection in NPC (Yip YL … Tsao SW, Book Review 2019) The default mechanism of EBV in pharyngeal epithelial cells is postulated to be lytic. Malignant changes in nasopharyngeal epithelium may support latent EBV infection in NPC. We have established two EBV-positive NPC cell lines (NPC43 and C17) (Lin WT … Tsao SW, Nature Comm 2018; Yip YL .. Tsao SW., Lab Investigation. 2018) which enable us to examine how growth conditions and signaling may influence latent/lytic EBV infection and persistence in NPC cells. An efficient cell-free EBV infection of NPC has also been developed (Pang … Tsao SW, J. Gen. Virology).The special differentiation environment of NPC, which is predominantly undifferentiated host cell environment was shown to support EBV persistence in NPC cells. In particular, the activation of STAT3 and inactivation of NF-kB which could be activated by malignant transformation of NPC cells (Bruce JP… Tsao SW et al., Nature Comm 2021) in combination of cytokine stimulation by stromal cells in the tumour microenvironment (TME) to suppress lytic EBV infection and support latent EBV infection. Downstream events including activation of deltaNp63, suppression of p38MAPK and KLF4 are involved. Suppression of lytic infection and expression of latent EBV genes, e.g. BART-microRNA, could contribute to the malignant transformation of NPC cells. Most interestingly, we observed that propagation NPC cells as xenograft effectively facilitate the selection of EBV-infected NPC cells. The undifferentiated properties of NPC plays an essential role in selection of EBV infection in NPC xenograft. We manage to recapitulate the selective growth advantage of EBV-infected NPC cells in a 3D organoid models which increase the EBV copy in our NPC cell lines (NPC43 and C17) by at least 2 folds. Furthermore, the use of organoid culture medium involving the Noggin signaling which stimulate growth of undifferentiated tumor stem cells has supported the establishment of more EBV-infected NPC cell lines (NPC76 and 47). The elucidation of signaling mechanisms underlying EBV persistence in NPC cells and the development of growth models of EBV-infected NPC will facilitate our understanding of EBV in NPC pathogenesis. The growth models of EBV-infected NPC cells will also facilitate the preclinical evaluation of response of NPC cells to novel therapeutic agents to improve treatment of NPC in patients.

17104617.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17104617.value: The successful establishment of growth models using organoid culture platforms and NPC xenogrfts will enable us to examine the relationship the role of cell signaling in regulating lytic/latent of EBV in NPC. The NPC43 has been unique in its responsiveness to stimulation of lytic and latent infection. The c666-1 NPC cell line has been refractory to stimulation of lytic EBV infection, The lack of responsible models have hampered these studies in the past. Single cell sequencing to define cell signaling to regulate lytic and latent EBV infection in NPC. The use of single cell imaging platforms, such as the Vector Polars and Codex systems, to define the spatial and temporal events regulating EBV infection and their relationships to invasive and other malignant properties of NPC will be particularly useful in the understanding of EBV infection in NPC. The xenograft NPC models and patient NPC can be used to confirm the validity and clinical application of the information obtained.

17104617.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17104617.value: The elucidation of underlying mechanisms for EBV persistence in NPC has contributed to the understanding of EBV infection in NPC pathogenesis and possible involvement in treatment response. Signaling mechanisms notably the STAT3/deltaNp63/p38MAPK/KLF4 axis may strong influence the differentiation properties of NPC cells to support EBV infection. The organoid culture of EBV-infected NPC appears to be able to mimic the growth conditions and undifferentiated cellular environment to support persistence of EBV in infected NPC cells. The knowledge gained in this study has enabled us to establish more EBV-infected NPC cell lines and development of representative (EBV-infected) NPC models for various investigations including preclinical evaluation of novel therapeutic treatment of NPC.

17105917.label: Realisation of objectives
17105917.value: All proposed objectives achieved. Using HCC patient-derived organoids and cells in vitro and positron emission tomography–magnetic resonance imaging (PET-MRI) analysis of xenografted tumors in vivo, we discovered PRMT6 to promote HCC tumor growth and sorafenib resistance by reprogramming oxidative phosphorylation to aerobic glycolysis. Methylation of CRAF at Arg100 by PRMT6 will alter downstream MEK/ERK signaling, thereby regulating the expression and translocation of PKM2 into the nucleus in an ERK-dependent manner. This altered PRMT6-ERK-PKM2 signaling axis was further confirmed in both an HCC mouse model with an endogenous knockout of PRMT6 as well as in HCC clinical samples. We also identified PRMT6 as a target of hypoxia via the transcriptional repressor element 1-silencing transcription factor (REST), linking PRMT6 with hypoxia in driving the Warburg effect. Finally, we showed as a proof of concept the therapeutic potential of using 2-deoxyglucose (2DG), a glycolysis inhibitor, to reverse tumorigenicity and sorafenib resistance mediated by PRMT6 deficiency in HCC. This study reveals a molecular link between a regulator of cell survival and a key enzyme in cancer metabolism with potential therapeutic implications. The above findings are now published in Hepatology. Wong TL, Ng KY, Tan KV, Chan LH, Zhou L, Che N, Hoo RL, Lee TK, Richard S, Lo CM, Man K, Khong PL, Ma S. 17105917.label: Major findings and research outcome
17105917.value: Background and Aims: Most tumor cells use aerobic glycolysis (the Warburg effect) to support anabolic growth and promote tumorigenicity and drug resistance. Intriguingly, the molecular mechanisms underlying this phenomenon are not well understood. In this work, using gain-of-function and loss-of-function in vitro studies in patient-derived organoid and cell cultures as well as in vivo positron emission tomography–magnetic resonance imaging animal models, we showed that protein arginine N-methyltransferase 6 (PRMT6) regulates aerobic glycolysis in human hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) through nuclear relocalization of pyruvate kinase M2 isoform (PKM2), a key regulator of the Warburg effect. Approach and Results: We found PRMT6 to methylate CRAF at arginine 100, interfering with its RAS/RAF binding potential, and therefore altering extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK)-mediated PKM2 translocation into the nucleus. This altered PRMT6-ERK-PKM2 signaling axis was further confirmed in both an HCC mouse model with an endogenous knockout of PRMT6 as well as in HCC clinical samples. We also identified PRMT6 as a target of hypoxia through the transcriptional repressor element 1-silencing transcription factor, linking PRMT6 with hypoxia in driving glycolytic events. Finally, we showed as a proof of concept the therapeutic potential of using 2-deoxyglucose, a glycolysis inhibitor, to reverse tumorigenicity and sorafenib resistance mediated by PRMT6 deficiency in HCC. Conclusions: Our findings indicate that the PRMT6-ERK-PKM2 regulatory axis is an important determinant of the Warburg effect in tumor cells, and provide a mechanistic link among tumorigenicity, sorafenib resistance, and glucose metabolism. This project is done in collaboration with overseas PI Stephane Richard of McGill University; as well as local PIs Ruby Hoo (Pharmacology and Pharmacy, HKU), Terence Lee (PolyU), Chung-Mau Lo (Surgery, HKU), Kwan Man (Surgery, HKU) and Pek-Lan Khong (Diagnostic Radiology, HKU)

17105917.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17105917.value: This PRMT6 project resulted in a spin-off project where we found a novel role of PRMT6 in regulating autophagy. Specifically, we found PRMT6 deficiency to induce autophagy in the hostile microenvironment of hepatocellular carcinoma tumors by regulating BAG5-associated HSC70 stability. This work is now published in Cancer Letters. Che N#, Ng KY#, Wong TL, Tong M, Kau PW, Chan LH, Lee TK, Huen MS, Yun JP, Ma S. 17105917.value: Most tumor cells use aerobic glycolysis (the Warburg effect) to support anabolic growth and promote tumorigenicity and drug resistance. Intriguingly, the molecular mechanisms underlying this phenomenon are not well understood. The findings of this current work indicate that the PRMT6-ERK-PKM2 regulatory axis is an important determinant of the Warburg effect in tumor cells.
