17209917.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17209917.value: 大规模MIMO（多天线）和毫米波（mmWave）通信是5G无线系统的两个关键技术。它们分别利用了大规模阵列中的巨大自由度和mmWave频段的数十GHz可用频谱，共同实现千兆位访问，并应对指数型流量增长。这两种技术的无缝集成称为mmWave大规模MIMO，不仅可以实现高度紧凑的硬件，还可以通过利用mmWave通道中的稀疏性来降低MIMO处理的复杂性。毫米波大规模MIMO的全数字信号处理面临着用于量化基站（BS）的大规模MIMO信号的禁止硬件复杂度的关键障碍。这种传统方法的不切实际性促使了用于BS的混合波束成形架构的最近发展，其中在模拟域中实现了一部分MIMO信号处理，称为模拟波束成形。通过利用所述信道稀疏度，模拟波束成形可以显着降低数字信号维度，从而可以实现所需数量的RF链和ADC。模拟波束成形的关键设计挑战在于典型的相位阵列实现对波束形成器系数施加单模约束，这使得经典的数字MIMO技术不合适。为了解决这一挑战，提出的研究旨在开发一种用于设计mmWave大规模MIMO系统中BS的模拟波束成形的新型系统框架。该框架建立在一种称为Kronecker波束成形的新方法上，其中模拟波束成形向量被分解为向量/矩阵因子的克罗内克乘积，并且它们被单独设计用于消除干扰（传播）路径或相干组合数据路径。在本项目的第一部分，使用Kronecker代数工具，Kronecker波束成形将被开发用于从线性到球形阵列的各种阵列几何形状。在本项目的第二部分，该技术将与正交频分多址（OFDMA）共同设计，实现宽带毫米波通信。具体来说，Kronecker波束成形将与BS的OFDMA资源分配集成，并设计用于减少OFDMA中的循环前缀开销。最后，将开发一种低复杂度的信道估计方案，以实现这些技术。成功完成后，拟议的研究将不仅对毫米波大规模MIMO通信理论作出重大贡献，而且还将在下一代系统中实现理论能力增益。

17209917.label: Realisation of objectives
17209917.value: Objective 1 Develop the design approach of Kronecker analog beamforming for mmWave massive MIMO. The objective has been realized by designing (Kronecker) analog beamforming for mmWave massive MIMO targeting different types of networks such as IoT networks [Paper 8], sensor networks [Paper 2], urban mmWave networks [3], and edge computing networks [4]. In [Paper 8], analog beamforming is designed to support one basic operation of Internet-of-Things (IoT) networks, namely to acquire a function of distributed data collected from sensors over wireless channels, called wireless data aggregation (WDA). The availability of mmWave massive MIMO resolves the channels into spatially separated clusters. Exploiting such channel structures, we proposed a framework supporting low-complexity and low-latency WDA of a vector valued function. First, under the criterion of minimum error, the optimal receive beamformer, called analog aggregation beamformer, is shown to have a Kronecker decomposed architecture: the inner component focuses on channel-dimension reduction and the outer component focuses on joint equalization of the resultant low-dimensional small- scale fading channels. The proposed framework is shown by simulation to substantially reduce AirComp error compared with the existing design without considering channel structures. In [Paper 2], we design analog MIMO beamforming to realize over-the-air computation (AirComp) for mmWave MIMO sensor networks where sensors or even access points can be mounted on ground/aerial vehicles for smart-city surveillance or environment monitoring. AirComp was recently developed to enable a data-fusion center to receive a desired function of sensing data from concurrent sensor transmissions, by exploiting the superposition property of a multi-access channel. We have further developed MIMO AirComp for enabling high-mobility multimodal sensing. Specifically, we design MIMO analog beamforming for spatially multiplexing multifunction computation. Given the objective of minimizing the computation error, a close-to-optimal beamformer is derived in closed-form using differential geometry. The solution can be computed as the weighted centroid of points on a Grassmann manifold, where each point represents the sub- space spanned by the channel matrix of a sensor. The performance of beamforming in mmWave MIMO networks is quantified by modelling and analyzing such a network using a random lattice o a 2D plane in [Paper 3]. We further extend the approach to the emerging mobile-edge computing networks in [Paper 4]. Objective 2 Design the algorithm enabling joint Kronecker analog beamforming and OFDMA resource allocation. The objective has been realized by jointly designing analog beamforming and broadband (i.e., OFDMA) resource allocation targeting emerging federated learning systems [Paper 6], multi-cell networks [Paper 7], IoT networks [Paper 9]. In [Paper 6], to leverage rich data distributed at the network edge, a new machine-learning paradigm, called federated learning, has emerged where learning algorithms are deployed at the edge for providing intelligent services to mobile users. It is proposed that the updates simultaneously transmitted by devices over broadband channels should be analog aggregated “over- the-air” by exploiting the waveform-superposition property of a multi-access channel. In this work, the effects of joint MIMO beamforming and resource allocation on learning performance are quantified targeting a single-cell random network. First, we derive two tradeoffs between communication-and-learning metrics, which are useful for network planning and optimization. The power control required for joint design results in a tradeoff between the update-reliability and the expected update- truncation ratio. Consider the scheduling of cell-interior devices to constrain path loss. This gives rise to the other tradeoff between the receive SNR and fraction of data exploited in learning. Next, the latency-reduction ratio of the proposed BAA with respect to the traditional OFDMA scheme is proved to scale almost linearly with the device population. Building on the results, we further study the design of analog beamforming for a IoT system powered by wireless power transfer in [Paper 9]. In [Paper 7], we studied joint analog beamforming and power control in a two-cell interference system. One common system operation will be the aggregation of distributed data (such as sensor observations or AI-model updates) for functional computation (e.g., averaging) so as to support large-scale sensing and distributed machine learning. AirComp described earlier embeds functional computation into simultaneous access by many edge devices. We aim at realizing joint MIMO AirComp and power control in a two-cell multi-antenna system. To this end, a novel scheme of MIMO simultaneous signal-and- interference alignment (SIA) is proposed that builds on classic IA to manage interference for multi-cell AirComp. The principle of MIMO SIA is to divide the spatial channel space into two subspaces with equal dimensions: one for signal alignment required by AirComp and the other for inter-cell IA. As a result, by performing channel-inversion power control at transmitters, the number of interference-free spatially multiplexed functional streams received by each AP is maximized (equal to half of the available spatial degrees-of-freedom). In addition, the extension to SIA for more than two cells is discussed. Objective 3 Design algorithms for mmWave channel shortening by Kronecker analog beamforming. The objective has been realized by exploiting the low-rank structure embedded in a high-dimensional massive MIMO channel for which a large-scale array resolves the clustering structure of scatterers. To exploit the structure for channel shortening, in [Paper 8], we propose reduced-dimensional analog beamforming allowing efficient acquisition of channel state information (CSI). To this end, we have proposed a low-latency channel feedback scheme by intelligently leveraging the over-the-air data aggregation principle as well as channel shortening exploiting MIMO channel clustering structure to support simultaneous channel feedback by sensors. As a result, the overhead for channel estimation and feedback is shown to dramatically decrease. Objective 4 Design channel estimation algorithms for broadband Kronecker analog beamforming To achieve the objective, efficient channel estimation and feedback algorithms have been designed for broadband analog beamforming. In [Paper 2], we design efficient channel-feedback technique for analog beamforming for MIMO AirComp systems. The technique is for direct acquisition of the beamformer at the access point from simultaneous feedback by all sensors. This overcomes the difficulty of provisioning orthogonal feedback channels for many sensors. Thereby, the channel estimation overhead acquires the much desired scalability in the scenario of massive access by many devices. In [Paper 1, 10, 2], we pursue a more radical approach of minimizing channel estimation overhead by developing blind MIMO transmission. In [Paper 10], we present a novel solution, called fast analog MIMO transmission (FAT), for high-mobility data acquisition in edge-learning systems, which has several key features. First, FAT incurs low-latency. Specifically, FAT requires no source- and-channel coding and no channel training via the proposed technique of Grassmann analog encoding (GAE) that encodes data samples into subspace matrices. Second, FAT supports spa- tial multiplexing by directly transmitting analog vector data over an antenna array. Third, FAT can be seamlessly integrated with edge learning (i.e., training of a classifier model in this letter). In particular, by applying a Grassmannian-classification algorithm from computer vision, the received GAE encoded data can be directly applied to training the model without decoding and conversion. Such a approach has been further developed to enable blind space-time constellation recognition in [Paper 1] and blind distributed inference in [Paper 2].

17209917.label: Major findings and research outcome
17209917.value: The major findings and research outcomes are summarized as follows. 1) Analog beamforming can efficiently realize functional computing in Internet-of-Things (IoT) networks via over-the-air computing. See [Paper 2, 8] for details. 2) Jointly designing analog beamforming and broadband resource allocation can substantially improve the system performance as proven in different contexts including federated learning systems [see Paper 6], multi-cell networks [see Paper 7], IoT networks [see Paper 9]. 3) Overhead for channel estimation and feedback can be reduced by exploiting the clustering structure of mmWave MIMO channels as resolved using large-scale arrays. Relevant techniques are reported in [Paper 8]. 4) The overhead in 2) can be also reduced by designing intelligent channel feedback techniques such as simultaneous feedback exploiting channel waveform superposition property as reported in [Paper 2] or alternative techniques for blind MIMO transmission as reported in [Paper 1, 2, 10].

17209917.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17209917.value: The development of 6G mobile networks is witnessing a paradigm shift towards integration of communication and computing as well as the ubiquitous deployment of AI in mobile networks. The further development of analog mmWave MIMO based on the new integrated approach warrants further investment of research resources.

17209917.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17209917.value: Massive MIMO (multi-antenna) and millimeter-Wave (mmWave) communications are two key technologies for 5G wireless systems. They can be seamlessly integrated to jointly enable gigabit access and cope with the exponential traffic growth. The integration not only results in highly compact hardware but also reduces the complexity of MIMO processing by exploiting the sparsity in mmWave channels. By exploiting the channel sparsity, analog beamforming can achieve dramatic reduction on the digital-signal dimensionality and thus the required number of RF chains and ADCs. The key design challenge for analog beamforming lies in that the typical phase-array implementation places uni-modulus constraints on the beamformer coefficients, which render the classic digital MIMO techniques unsuitable. To tackle the challenge, the research aims at developing a novel systematic framework for designing analog beamforming for BSs in mmWave massive MIMO systems. The framework builds on a novel decomposition approach, called Kronecker beamforming, where the analog beamforming vector is decomposed into vector/matrix factors and they are individually designed for low complexity. The project has been successfully completed, yielding significant contributions not only to the mmWave massive MIMO communication theory but also to materializing the theoretic capacity gains in next- generation systems.

17210017.label: Project Objectives
17210017.value: To study the offline and online problems of searching by mobile robots and to obtain solutions that are optimal or near-optimal in time and energy consumption (Problem 1). The robots will communicate by either meeting or via localized wireless communication, and all must terminate in the end. To investigate the search and evacuation problem with respect to velocities, considering different maximal speeds (Problem 2) and different search and move speeds (Problem 3). To consider the search problems with respect to the energy consumption (Problem 4) and cases where some of robots could be faulty or fail (Problem 5). To implement the solutions (or a representative one) that can demonstrate the feasibility of the solutions and their superiority to brute-force or naive solutions to the problems (Problem X).

17210017.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17210017.value: 各式各样的机器人正在成为商品，并且非常实惠。它们可以大量的部署，以便在人类无法或难于处理的情况下执行协作任务，同时也可以替代人类处理大大小小的各种任务。虽然单机器人搜索并不新鲜，作为一个团队合作的机器人的这个主题还在很大程度上未被探索。这个项目研究通过协作式移动机器人搜索的问题（对于一个隐藏的目标领域），在实践中其实是非常常见的问题。我们提出一种包含一系列基本属性的移动机器人模型，包括自主性，有限的通信，可靠性和搜索/移动速度。我们首先考虑最简单的场景（例如，街道，岸线），然后是2D场（例如，地雷区）。我们的重点是在搜索策略的算法方面，我们的目标是在时间和能量消耗方面提出最优的算法。假设其中一个机器人将首先击中目标，与大多数其他现有解决方案不同，我们认为必须在所有机器人已被告知并能够终止和撤离之后任务才告完成。这增加了机器人的负担因为他们将需要在搜索过程中保持连接。要搜索的路段可以是充满障碍，这将是上述基本解决方案的延伸;同时也会考虑一些机器人可能有故障的情况。我们的研究将涵盖离线和在线的变化问题，后者意味着机器人的数量是事先未知的，实际上它们是可以的在任意时间和地点加入。我们计划实施解决方案（或选一个代表）作为演示，以展示我们的解决方案的实用性和优越性。我们也有协议与一家机器人公司使用他们的机器人测试我们的解决方案。

17210017.label: Realisation of objectives
17210017.value: My last report covered our work called Alano which addressed Objective 1 but with only a minor treatment on energy consumption (Objective 3) [MASS]. We subsequently designed an algorithmic framework for neighbor discovery in WSN called Spear that can handle communication collisions, get around latency constraints, while conserving energy [Sensors]. We however could only carry out computer simulation of the framework as implementation and experimentation in a real environment near the end of the project was not affordable. As wireless robot coordination often has to rely on data dissemination operations in a possibly noisy environment, we delved into the fundamental problems of dominating sets at the low level, which are important components for building higher-level information dissemination operations. We proposed several optimal or near-optimal algorithms that can work effectively under SINR constraints, constraints that correspond more closely to real physical conditions [IPDPS]. This work contributed to both Objectives 1 & 2. We also noted that 3D terrains can actually be wrapped inside a sphere or a partial sphere, and then robots one after another can choose their optimal locations on the surface of the sphere when carrying out coordinated searching or surveillance. We came up with an optimal algorithm to do location selection, which can be executed by the robots themselves or a commander in an online fashion [Algorithms]. Of all the 4 objectives, we could not address the issues of fail-safeness or fault-tolerance (Objective 3 / Problem 5) during the course of the project. For the rest of the problems/objectives, I think we have done most of what we intended, with reasonably good results. I would not however claim 100% for all of them as there are still related unsolved problems in the back of my mind that could have been tackled if we had more time and resources. In fact, looking at the rather ambitious list of items we set out to achieve, we suffered immensely from a low budget (which was less than half of what we asked for initially).

17210017.label: Major findings and research outcome
17210017.value: We designed an efficient multi-agent navigation algorithm that can avoid collisions by adjusting the agents' speeds as well as trajectories [ICSSE]. We designed efficient/optimal algorithms for neighbor discovery in a large-scale network where energy consumption is restrictive and carried out extensive experiments with them [MASS]. To support efficient communication between agents/robots in a wireless/mobile environment, we came up with optimal distributed algorithms for dominating set formation [IPDPS]. To be able to assign robots to locations that can cover a target 3D terrain effectively and optimally, we proposed encapsulating the terrain in a sphere or partial sphere, and came up with an online optimal algorithm for the robots' placements [Algorithms]. We further extended our work on neighbor discovery for WSN and suggested a framework that addresses all three critical concerns at the same time: communication collisions, latency constraints, and energy consumption limitations [Sensors].

17210017.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17210017.value: This project focused on the coordination and communication aspects of multi-robots in search operations. By adding AI (big data) and computer vision to the solution, a fleet of flying robots (drones) could be deployed to search for objects efficiently in a large area (2D or 3D) provided that the objects are not completely obstructed. Disasters like the one that happened in Lantau Island, Hong Kong not long ago could have been avoided (sadly, it took them 5 days to locate the victim while pictures showed that the victim was clearly visible from even a distance): https://hongkongfp.com/2018/07/27/hong-kong-paraglider-missing-since-sunday-found-dead-lantau-island/ To arrive at a practical solution that can quickly discover an target such as a human object in the above scenario in a very short time would be very meaningful. That's something we are thinking of doing in the future.

17210017.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17210017.value: This project aimed at designing efficient algorithms for multiple robots engaging in a search operation (e.g., to look for some target object) over a 2D area or a 3D terrain. It is obvious that in order to achieve an effective search, the robots must be properly coordinated and be able to communicate efficiently among themselves. Additionally, we also would like the robots to use as little energy as possible and be able to still operate despite being situated in a noisy or faulty environment. Assuming that only wireless communications (which could subject to noise and interference) are possible, we came up with provably efficient (sometimes optimal) algorithms for the robots' coordination and communication, which include an algorithm to assign robots to optimal locations in an area under search.

17210217.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17210217.value: The advancement of the structural steel manufacturing industry has expanded the family of structural hollow sections and led to the recent emergence of semi-oval and oval hollow sections. The aesthetically pleasing appearance of such sections is favoured by architects and prominent structural efficiency of the section shapes with different flexural rigidities in major and minor axes will be attracted by design engineers. Despite the recent interest in adopting semi-oval and oval hollow sections in design and construction, there is a lack of investigation on these newly developed section shapes. Therefore, there is no design rule for such sections in the current international design specifications. The structural behaviour of members under combined axial load and bending, which is one of the basic and essential structural components in a structure, will be studied through experimental and numerical investigations on cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections in this research project. The objectives of this research project are to generate experimental and numerical data on load carrying capacities and load displacement responses of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections, and thereafter, to propose new design rules for these sections under combined axial load and bending. 随着结构钢制造业的发展，结构空心管材的种类日益增加，半椭圆和椭圆空心截面近年也开始在市场上出现。半椭圆和椭圆空心截面具有不同强轴弱轴的特性，其展现的建筑美观性及出色的结构效能受到了建筑师及工程师们的青睐。尽管设计师们对半椭圆和椭圆空心截面在工程项目上的应用产生了浓厚的兴趣，但是对这些新研发的截面形状的研究依然十分匮乏，以致现今国际上仍未有针对冷弯型钢半椭圆和椭圆空心截面的设计条例。压弯构件是结构的基本受力构件之一，冷弯型钢半椭圆和椭圆空心截面的压弯力学性能将在本项目中通过试验与数值分析得以研究。本项目将生成一系列关于冷弯型钢半椭圆和椭圆空心截面的承载能力及荷载位移关系的试验及数值研究数据。这些试验和数值研究的结果将被用来制定设计条例和公式。这些新提出的条例和公式将为冷弯型钢半椭圆和椭圆空心截面结构构件在轴力及弯矩组合荷载下的设计提供依据。

17210217.label: Realisation of objectives
17210217.value: The behaviour of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections under combined axial load and bending (beam-columns) has been investigated. A series of beam-column tests loaded between pinned ends was conducted. The loading eccentricity was applied in order to induce the uniform bending moment about the minor axis of the sections. Furthermore, the corresponding concentric compression tests on pin-ended column members and pure bending tests were also conducted in order to obtain the full beam-column interaction curves. The test specimens were fabricated by hot-extruded seamless steel circular hollow sections and then cold-formed into semi-oval and oval hollow sections. The failure loads of the semi-oval and oval hollow sections under combined axial load and bending were obtained. The full load-displacement responses of the structural members were also obtained from the beam-column tests. Finite element analyses were performed on cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow section beam-column members. The finite element models were developed and validated against the beam-column test results. An extensive parametric study for beam-columns with wider range of cross-section slenderness, member slenderness, steel grade and loading eccentricity was performed. Therefore, a large data pool of numerical data was obtained. Furthermore, the test results and numerical results were used to compare the design strength predictions by international design codes. The comparisons show that the existing design methods provide quite conservative and scattered design strength predictions for cold-formed steel elliptical hollow sections subjected to combined compression and minor axis bending. Modifications are proposed on the Australian Standard and the American Specification by adopting the modified Direct Strength Methods for the nominal flexural and compressive strength calculations of the members. Design rules for cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow section beam-columns have been proposed. The objectives of this project have been achieved.

17210217.label: Major findings and research outcome
17210217.value: A series of tests on cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections under combined axial load and bending was conducted. The test specimens of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections were fabricated. Tests on concentric compression of pin-ended columns and pure bending were also conducted. The test strengths, failure modes and load-displacement curves were obtained from the test program. In addition, finite element models of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow section beam-columns was developed and also verified against the test results. The parametric study of the beam-columns was performed. Hence, finite element results were obtained from the parametric study. Design rules for cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow section beam-columns have been proposed. Four high quality journal papers have been published. A PhD student has been trained from this research project.

17210217.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17210217.value: Further development of this research could be focused on non-uniform bending of the cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow section members. In addition, the members under fire condition could be also considered.

17210217.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17210217.value: Owing to the rapid development of cold-forming technology, new sections such as semi-oval and oval hollow sections have been recently emerged with requirements for both structural efficiency and architectural appearance. Furthermore, their aesthetically pleasing appearance and superior structural efficiency by offering different geometric properties lead to an innovative and efficient steel structure design. However, the design rules for these newly developed sections are not available. The objectives of this research project are to generate experimental and numerical data on load carrying capacities and load displacement responses of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections under combined axial load and bending. Therefore, the structural behaviour of such members was investigated. The findings of this research project are able to enhance the understanding on the behaviour of cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections. The research project allows new design rules for cold-formed steel semi-oval and oval hollow sections under combined axial load and bending.

17210617.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17210617.value: 使用不相交交集類型的基於多形態委託的語言的基礎

17210617.label: Project Objectives
17210617.value: To study the interaction between disjoint intersection types and commonly used programming language features such as polymorphism and union types. To study the elaboration and compilation of a polymorphic delegation based OO source language into a core language based on disjoint intersection types. To implement and conduct an empirical evaluation of the resulting delegation based OO language. Case studies will include various mixin-based programs ported from JavaScript, and modular implementations of programming languages.

To study the elaboration and compilation of a polymorphic delegation based OO source language into a core language based on disjoint intersection types.

To implement and conduct an empirical evaluation of the resulting delegation based OO language. Case studies will include various mixin-based programs ported from JavaScript, and modular implementations of programming languages.

17210617.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17210617.value: JavaScript是當今世界上使用最廣泛的編程語言之一。儘管它在Web編程方面具有靈活性和廣泛的用途，但許多人已經指出，JavaScript有一些限制。特別地，缺乏靜態類型的系統使得難以開發和維護較大的程序，同時保持可靠性和魯棒性。作為對這種限制的反應，幾個主要的IT公司，如微軟，Facebook和Google已經著手開發改進或替代JavaScript。諸如Microsoft的TypeScript或Facebook的Flow之類的改進可以通過某種形式的靜態類型檢查來擴展JavaScript，以便開發大型Web應用程序。 類型檢查JavaScript程序遠不是一件簡單的任務。 JavaScript的動態打字屬性鼓勵不能用眾所周知的類型系統輕鬆進行類型檢查的編程模式。特別地，JavaScript與其他主流OO語言不同，因為它使用委託（或基於原型的繼承）OO模型。然而，與靜態類型的基於類的OO模型（在文獻中得到很好的研究）相反，靜態類型的基於代表的OO模型迄今為止受到的關注較少。 此提案側重於在對JavaScript程序進行類型檢查時發生的一個特殊問題：如何靜態鍵入檢查多態，基於代理的OO程序。我們的目的是研究靜態類型的基於委託的面向對象編程語言的語言支持。我們強調，我們的目標不是為所有類似JavaScript的類型檢查問題提供解決方案（除了類型檢查基於代理的程序之外，JavaScript中還有很多其他問題）。然而，代理/原型繼承是JavaScript中的一個普遍特性，它本身是重要和有趣的。我們將提供一種靈活實用的語言和類型系統，可以對基於授權的語言（如JavaScript）使用的常用編程模式進行類型檢查。

17210617.label: Realisation of objectives
17210617.value: This project has been highly successful, with many research publications related to it. Regarding Objective 1, we have managed to study and publish several results about the interaction between polymorphism and disjoint intersection types including, for instance our ESOP 2019 paper on "Distributive Disjoint Polymorphism for Compositional Programming" and ECOOP 2020 paper on "Row and Bounded Polymorphism via Disjoint Polymorphism". One important theme that appeared during the research on this project was distributivity, which plays a fundamental role in the type systems that we have been investigating. Our paper at ECOOP 2018 on "The Essence of Nested Composition" was a key result on this topic. Regarding Objective 2, our paper at ECOOP 2018 entitled "Typed First Class Traits" showed how to compile a source language with traits (an OO feature used in many languages) to our core calculi. Additionally our ECOOP 2020 paper on "Row and Bounded Polymorphism via Disjoint Polymorphism" shows that features such as bounded quantification (which many mainstream OOP languages have) can be compiled into calculi with disjoint polymorphism. Additionally, our OOPSLA 2020 paper on "Resolution as Intersection Subtyping via Modus Ponens" has shown how an extension of calculi with disjoint intersection types that can model a form of Scala-style implicits. Regarding Objective 3, in several of the papers described in the previous two paragraphs we have conducted many case studies to illustrate the benefits of our new calculi and techniques for the development of new programming languages and programming language features. For example in our ESOP 2019 paper on "Distributive Disjoint Polymorphism for Compositional Programming" we have shown how to modularise the interpreters that are presented in the draft book "Anatomy of Programming Languages". In addition to the work on the 3 objectives above, we have started developing new techniques that facilitate the development of calculi with disjoint intersection types. In particular, the paper "A Type-Directed Operational Semantics for a Calculus with a Merge Operator" at ECOOP 2020 has presented a new way to give a direct operational semantics to calculi with a merge operator and disjoint intersection types.

17210617.label: Major findings and research outcome
17210617.value: There were several research outcomes, which I summarise here: 1) ECOOP 2018, "The Essence of Nested Composition": Describes a calculus with disjoint intersection types and distributivity. 2) ECOOP 2018, "Typed First Class Traits": Describes how to translate high-level OO features to a calculus with disjoint intersection types. 3) ESOP 2019, "Distributive Disjoint Polymorphism for Compositional Programming": Studies the interaction between polymorphism, distributivity and disjoint intersection types. 4) ECOOP 2020, "Row and Bounded Polymorphism via Disjoint Polymorphism": Describes how common language features such as bounded quantification and row polymorphism can be encoded in a calculus with disjoint polymorphism. 5) OOPSLA 2020, "Resolution as Intersection Subtyping via Modus Ponens": Describes how to model a form of Scala-like implicits with an extension to calculi with disjoint intersection types. 6) ECOOP 2020, "A Type-Directed Operational Semantics for a Calculus with a Merge Operator": has presented a new way to give a direct operational semantics to calculi with a merge operator and disjoint intersection types.

17210617.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17210617.value: We are actively exploring ways to extend this research. In particular, in the last 1.5 years we have been exploring a new programming paradigm called "Compositional Programming" that is built on top of calculi with disjoint intersection types.

17210617.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17210617.value: This work has studied foundational languages that will enable more powerful forms of Object-Oriented Programming in a flexible and fully statically typed manner. In particular, it will enable some of the techniques that programmers currently employ in dynamically typed languages such as JavaScript to be fully typed checked. The type system will greatly reduce the number of bugs that can happen, without getting in the way of flexibility.

17210817.value: 移動設備在日常生活中廣泛應用。它們是由處理器，傳感器，執行器，通信電子和能量存儲器組成的嵌入式系統。這些小型電子設備涵蓋廣泛的社交通信，個人管理和娛樂應用，物聯網，醫療保健，環境和基礎設施監控和防禦系統。微電子技術的進步，移動設備的體積在過去十年中急劇下降。另一方面，這些設備的計算能力和功耗也呈指數級增長。移動設備通常由內部電池供電。更換或充電這些電池是一個問題。為了方便和安全，許多移動設備的充電器已改為非接觸式感應充電。使用中距離感應式電力傳輸技術可以增加發射機和接收機之間的空間距離，可同時為一個或多個移動負載供電。將來，使用集成感應式收發器以及雙向功率流控制器，移動設備能夠執行主和從屬角色，可以與其他人共享電源。沒有了電源線，中距離感應式電力傳輸使用共享電源控制技術可使移動設備的充電過程快速，輕鬆和靈活。中距離感應式電力傳輸系統使用磁共振來產生空間自由度。多設備感應式電力傳輸系統是一個多諧振系統，其構成多個可能的工作點。這些工作點隨相互耦合，諧振電容和接收器負載而相應變化。沒有關於系統模型的信息，可能無法識別系統的正確工作點。在這個項目中，我們試圖在設計控制系統時解決這個根本問題。 1）我們將製定數值擬合方法，從測量的頻率響應中識別多設備中距離感應式電力傳系統的參數。系統模型將通過計算機模擬和實驗測量進行驗證。 2）明確記錄和製定導出多設備中距離感應式電力傳系統模型識別方法的知識和程序。 3）將構建硬件原型來演示系統模型識別方法。 這個為期兩年的項目的成功完成無疑將推動中距離感應式電力傳輸技術的研究和開發邁上新台階。多設備中距離感應式電力傳輸技術系統模型識別方法和共享電源控制技術，可滿足未來大量移動設備供電的需求。這個項目的成果有兩個方面： 1）開發的新理論將提供新的見解，知識和啟發技術創新。學生和工作人員將獲得新的知識和技能，振興無線電力傳輸領域。 2）項目開發的原型將為行業和從業者帶來新的應用。多設備中距離感應式電力傳輸技術的不斷發展必將有利於各行各業，從而促進人的生活。

17211017.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17211017.value: Shape modeling is a fundamental task in computer graphics. In this project we shall study efficient methods and develop user-friendly interactive systems for modeling 3D free-form objects, such as animals or shows, clothes, using only a single 2D drawing or photo as guidance. This problem of modeling 3D shapes from a single image arises in many scenarios. For example, there is a need for fabricating (i.e. with a 3D printer) 3D imaginative animal characters depicted in kids' drawings. When the kids see tangible 3D realizations of the objects, they would be more motivated and encouraged for further developing their artistic creativity. Another application is in computer animation, where efficient methods and systems are needed for creating 3D models of articulated characters depicted in 2D drawings by an animation designer. These 3D models can then be further edited to add more geometric details for use in games or films. Modeling 3D free-form objects from a single image is challenging due to the lack of depth information. This is in contrast with the problem of reconstructing 3D shapes from multiple views where stereoscopic vision can be explored for depth estimation. Obviously, shape priors must be provided for 3D modeling when only a 2D image is available as input. We argue that interactive sketch-based modeling systems would leverage the recognition ability of the human user in accomplishing this task. Specifically, we will develop novel methods and friendly human-computer interface to allow the user to communicate her recognition of perceived 3D shapes to the modeling system to facilitate the task of 3D modeling. Our key innovations include (1) a set of novel techniques and a sketch-based system that require only simple user interaction for modeling complex articulated free-form characters; (2) A comprehensive solution to the texture generation issue when mapping partially observed texture in the input image to the entire surface of the reconstructed 3D object; (3) A novel annotation based on curvature lines and a user-friendly sketch-based system that allow the user to efficiently model unstructured free-form shapes. Preliminary studies have confirmed the feasibility and superiority of the proposed methodology. The outcomes of the project represent significant advances in interactive shape modeling of complex 3D free-form objects. 三维建模在计算机图形学领域有着十分重要的地位。本项目将围绕自由曲面（如动物、衣服等）快速建模方法展开研究，旨在设计、开发一个易用的交互式三维建模系统使得用户能够快速地将一张手绘草图或者照片转换成对应的三维模型。 基于单张图片的三维建模有着十分广泛的应用。许多孩子喜欢绘画，倘若能将其富有想象力的绘画转换成三维模型并打印，将有助于培养孩子的创造能力，激发其艺术灵感；在三维动画领域，该技术将有助于动画设计师把手绘二维卡通角色转化成三维模型。在此基础上，设计师能够进一步对模型进行编辑，丰富其几何细节，达到电影或游戏中想要呈现的效果。 与多视图三维重建问题不同，由于缺乏深度信息，基于单张图片的三维模型建模一直以来都是一个较有挑战性的课题。针对该问题，关于形状的先验知识必不可少。在基于草图的交互式三维建模系统中，用户对形状的认知能够帮助解决此类问题。本项目将致力于开发一个新颖、易用的交互式三维建模系统，使得普通用户能够快速地将二维草图转化成三维模型。 本项目主要贡献如下： 1）提出一系列的三维建模算法，开发一个基于草图的三维建模系统，能够将复杂的卡通图画转化成三维模型。 2）针对三维模型纹理问题，提出新的解决方案。

17211017.label: Realisation of objectives
17211017.value: Sketch-based modeling provides a powerful paradigm for geometric modeling. Recent research had shown, sketch based modeling methods are most effective when targeting a specific family of surfaces. A large and growing arsenal of sketching tools is available for different types of geometries and different target user populations. Our work augments this arsenal with a new and powerful tool for modeling complex freeform shapes by sketching sparse 2D strokes; our method complements existing approaches in enabling the generation of surfaces with complex curvature patterns that are challenging to produce with existing methods. To model a desired surface patch with our technique, the user sketches the patch boundary as well as a small number of strokes representing the major bending directions of the shape. Our method uses this input to generate a curvature field that conforms to the user strokes and then uses this field to derive a freeform surface with the desired curvature pattern. To infer the surface from the strokes we first disambiguate the convex versus concave bending directions indicated by the strokes and estimate the surface bending magnitude along the strokes. We subsequently construct a curvature field based on these estimates, using a non-orthogonal 4-direction field coupled with a scalar magnitude field, and finally construct a surface whose curvature pattern reflects this field through an iterative sequence of simple linear optimizations. Our framework is well suited for single-view modeling, but also supports multi-view interaction, necessary to model complex shapes portions of which can be occluded in many views. It effectively combines multi-view inputs to obtain a coherent 3D shape. It runs at interactive speed allowing for immediate user feedback. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method through a large collection of complex examples created by both artists and amateurs. Our framework provides a useful complement to the existing sketch-based modeling methods.

17211117.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17211117.value: Gaussian models for pollutant plume dispersion is well received in the industry for decades. The key components, near-field plume rise and pollutant dispersion, are parameterized empirically by considering the momentum and buoyancy fluxes in uniform flows over aerodynamically smooth surfaces. Urban areas are seldom smooth. A typical example is the flows over different urban morphologies. Recent studies there exists a characteristic roughness sublayer (RSL) right over the buildings in which the turbulent length scale is different from that of the prevailing atmospheric boundary layer (ABL) flows. Under this circumstance, the flows and transport processes are substantially modified and the applicability of the conventional plume rise/dispersion modes is questionable, resulting in uncertain air-quality assessments. The drawback is indeed more complicated because most pollutants are chemically reactive. To bridge the aforementioned knowledge gap, this project is conceived to elucidate the dynamics and near-field plume rise/dispersion in the RSL over urban areas together with the subsequent modification on the chemical composition of reactive pollutants. As a pilot attempt, single idealized chimney, hypothetical urban morphology and generalized chemistry mechanism will be employed to address the core scientific question: “How the RSL dynamics changes the near-field plume rise/dispersion over urban areas from that estimated from the classic models assuming uniform flows over smooth surfaces”. In particular, we will extend our analytical findings to the parameterizations of plume rise, handling the physics/chemistry nonlinearity in near-field plume dispersion in the RSL over rough surfaces. A complementary approach, by employing both wind tunnel measurements and mathematical modeling, will be sought for an in-depth, fundamental understanding. Sensitivity to the source configuration, environmental conditions and aerodynamic resistance will be tested using large-eddy simulation (LES) with gas-phase chemistry to formulate a solid knowledge base. This project will arouse the scientific community by the unprecedented findings of pollution physics/chemistry in the near-field plume rise/dispersion in response to surface roughness. The improved plume-rise model will provide more accurate information (effective plume rise) to the professions. The data archives will refine the current practice, serving society well by innovations in urban planning guidelines and environmental management strategies. The research output will address our major technical concern: Improvement to the classic parameterization for more reliable plume rise calculations in the RSL over urban areas. 污染物羽流分散的高斯模型在業界受到好幾十年的歡迎。其中的關鍵部件，近場羽流的上升和污染物的分散，大都靠通過考慮空氣動力學平滑表面均勻流動的動量和浮力通量而經驗參數化。市區很少平面光滑。一個典型的例子是不同城市形態的流動。最近的研究表明，在建築物上粗糙度子層（RSL）中的湍流尺度與當前大氣邊界層（ABL）流動中不同。在這種情況下，流量和運輸過程被大大修改。傳統羽流上升/分散模式的適用性是有問題的而導致不確定的空氣質量評估。 其中的缺點確實更複雜，因為大多數污染物是化學反應性的。 為了彌合上述知識差距，本項目旨在闡明粗糙度子層在城市地區的動態和近場羽流的上升/分散，隨後對反應性污染物的化學成分進行修改。作為試點嘗試，將採用單一理想化煙囪，假設城市形態和廣義化學機制來解決核心科學問題：”利用傳統模型假定在平滑表面上均勻流動，研究粗糙度子層的動態如何改變城市地區近場羽流的上升/分散”。特別地，我們將會把分析結果擴展到羽流升高的參數化，處理在粗糙表面上的粗糙度子層中的近場羽流分散中的物理/化學非線性最感興趣。將尋求通過採用風洞測量和數學建模兩者的補充方法進行深入的基礎理解。使用具有氣相化學的大渦模擬（LES）來測試對源配置，環境條件和空氣動力學阻力的靈敏度，以形成一個可信任的知識庫。 這個項目將通過前所未有的污染物理/化學發現在近場羽流的上升/分散響應表面粗糙度引起科學界的興趣。改進的羽流模型將為專業界別提供更準確的信息（有效羽流升高）。數據檔案將完善現行做法，通過城市規劃指導方針和環境管理戰略創新，為社會服務。研究成果將解決我們的主要技術問題：改進傳統參數化，以實現粗糙度子層在城市地區更可靠的羽流升高計算。

17211117.label: Realisation of objectives
17211117.value: Objective #1 In this study, the large-eddy simulation (LES) was conducted by the open-source computational fluid dynamics (CFD) code OpenFOAM 6. The flows are calculated by the filtered incompressible Navier–Stokes equation and the continuity The turbulence kinetic energy (TKE) conservation is handled by the one-equation TKE model. The filtered pollutant transport equation is solved for the filtered pollutant concentration. The high-fidelity, real light-duty truck model is placed in a computational domain of size 100h (streamwise) x 11.2h (spanwise) x 18.7h (vertical). Here, h is the vehicle height that is commonly used as the characteristic length scale. In the current coordinate system, the origin is set at the rear bottom of the vehicle. The prescribed inlet boundary conditions (BCs) are uniform incoming winds and free of pollutant. The truck model and ground surfaces are defined as no-slip walls where the logarithmic law-of-the-wall (log-law) is applied. The zero Neumann BCs are applied at the top and the sides of the spatial domain. A pollutant source is placed at the tailpipe exhaust with a constant emission rate. The effect of tailpipe discharge, both momentum and buoyancy, is limited to the proximity that is not considered. An open BC is prescribed at the outflow so all the pollutants are removed from the computational domain by the prevailing flows without any reflection. Zero Neumann BCs for pollutants are adopted on all the solid boundaries. Grid sensitivity tests were performed by varying the number of cells in all directions. The cells are refined toward the truck surfaces and the ground by the mesh generation utility snappyHexMesh. The Courant–Friedrichs–Lewy (CFL) number is kept below 0.35 by setting the time step increment at 0.0001 sec. The finite volume method (FVM) is used to solve the governing equations. The implicit, second-order-accurate backward differencing is employed in the time integration. The gradient, divergence, and Laplacian terms are integrated by the second-order-accurate Gaussian FVM based on the summation on cell faces. The pressure-implicit with splitting of operators (PISO) approach is used to handle the pressure-velocity coupling in incompressible flows. The preconditioned conjugate gradient (PCG) method is used to solve the symmetric equation system of pressure, and the preconditioned bi-conjugate gradient (PBiCG) method is used to solve the asymmetric systems of other variables. After initialization, data sampling is performed at a frequency of 100 Hz that lasts for 90 sec. The LES results are validated by experimental measurements. The dimensionless profiles of time averaged streamwise and vertical velocities at different downstream locations on the geometric symmetry plane are compared. It is evident that the results obtained from different spatial resolution do not have much discrepancy. The near-wake velocities agree reasonably well with each other except the stronger underbody flows in the LES. The LESs show a large, lower separation bubble, dominating the near-wake region. The different vehicle topology leads to the slight variation in the locations of vortex core and the vertical velocity component within the near wake. Objective #2 The dynamics and transport mechanism discussed above facilitate our interpretation of tailpipe dispersion after an on-road vehicle. The distribution of mean pollutant concentration after a heavy-duty truck is quite different from that calculated by the Gaussian models. Within the major recirculation, the tailpipe emission is homogeneously mixed that results in a rather uniform mean pollutant concentration. Instead of an infinitely small pollutant point source, the size of the major recirculation is comparable to the truck height h. Under this circumstance, the conventional Gaussian models are no longer applicable to the near-wake dispersion calculation. Besides, turbulent transport is required to remove the pollutant from the major recirculation to the far field. The pollutant concentration drops sharply in the streamwise direction and a noticeable concentration gradient is developed in between. After the major recirculation, the flows gradually resume to the prevailing ones so the Gaussian models are applicable. It is noteworthy that tailpipe emission is driven to a higher level in the major recirculation before being removed to the upper recirculation and the far field. The plume trajectory is escalated but not at the tailpipe level so the emission height should be adjusted accordingly for far-field dispersion. The horizontal, crosswind plume dispersion also differs from the Gaussian theory. In view of the trailing vortices and the nonuniform pollutant advection, the maximum pollutant concentration is not along the centreline but shifts sideward. The peaks of fluctuating pollutant concentration are shifted as well. Objective #3 The above findings help refine the practice of remote sensing. We reported before that a long sampling duration is unfavourable to remote sensing accuracy. The different diffusion coefficients of nitric oxide (NO) and CO2 in air lead to different dispersion patterns. Under this circumstance, the assumption of constant NO-to-CO2 ratio (the only parameter that is measured in remote sensing) is valid only in a short distance after the tailpipe exit. The ratio then reduces further downstream. The aerodynamics after a heavy-duty truck reported in this paper shed some light on the reliable range of remote sensing (short sampling duration) as well. The LES results show that the major recirculation is enclosed by dividing streamlines. The pollutant removal from the major recirculation to the far field is governed by turbulent pollutant fluxes (across the streamlines), which, however, are much weaker (about an order of magnitude) than the mean pollutant flux. A noticeable difference in pollutant concentration is therefore developed. Despite the chemical composition, the pollutant concentrations drop sharply after the near wake (an order of magnitude). A long sampling duration would be prone to underestimating the tailpipe emission. Besides, the sharp drop in pollutant concentrations demands a higher detection sensitivity, which might stretch the capability of remote sensing to the limit. It in turn adversely affects the signal collected and measurement accuracy. The far-field plume trajectory is escalated from the tailpipe to a higher level which is unfavourable to sampling confidence. In the current practice, remote sensing focuses at tailpipe level. Far-field plume ascent implies that accurate remote sensing would demand even more sensitive detection. According to the above analysis, the best sampling range should be smaller than the major recirculation within which the pollutant mixing is more homogeneous and the concentration is more uniform. The corresponding sampling duration is therefore ≤ h/U where U is the vehicle speed. Taking an on-road truck of size 3 m at speed 30 km an hour as an example, the sampling duration should be less than 0.4 sec. The current practice of remote sensing (0.5 sec) is marginally acceptable. The sampling time would be shortened for smaller vehicles (e.g. light-duty lorry) and faster driving speeds (e.g. 80 km an hour on most of the highways in Hong Kong). Apparently, slower driving speed would help improve the remote sensing accuracy. Otherwise, a shorter sampling duration is more favourable. There exists another technical difficulty for shorter sampling duration. Unlike the usual turbulence intensities (approximately 10%), the current LES unveils that the fluctuating pollutant concentrations is up to 20% of the mean pollutant concentration in the major recirculation. It is thus expected that the signal data are noisy such that the conventional turbulence measurements should be implemented cautiously. One of the solutions could be prolonged sampling time, which, however, is unlikely practicable in remote sensing.

17211117.label: Major findings and research outcome
17211117.value: The wake after an on-road vehicle substantially influences the tailpipe pollutant dispersion. Remote sensing is the most practicable solution to large-scale emission control. Its reliability, however, is largely dictated by how well the complicated vehicular flows and instrumentation constraint are tackled. Specifically, broad-range motion scales and short sampling duration (< 1 sec) are the most prominent ones. Their impact on remote sensing has not been studied. Large-eddy simulation (LES) was employed to look into the dynamics and the plume dispersion after an on-road heavy-duty truck at speed U so as to elucidate the transport mechanism, examine the sampling uncertainty and develop the remedial measures. A major recirculation of size comparable to the truck height h is induced collectively by the roof-level prevailing flows, side entrainment and underbody wall jet. The tailpipe is enclosed by dividing streamlines so the plume is carried back to the truck right after emission. The recirculation augments the pollutant mixing, resulting in a more homogeneous pollutant distribution together with rather high fluctuating concentrations (> 20% of the time-averaged concentrations). The plume ascends mildly before being purged out of the major recirculation to the far field by turbulence, reducing substantially the pollutant concentration (10 times) outside the near wake. In the far field, the plume is higher than the tailpipe, dispersing in a conventional Gaussian manner. Under this circumstance, a sampling duration for remote sensing longer than h/U would be prone to underestimating the tailpipe emission. Apart from tailpipe dispersion, the time-averaged mean wake and dominant global flow instabilities are compared with the results of simplified square-back vehicle models in the literature. In addition to the ring-shape mean wake topology, by proper orthogonal decomposition (POD), the near-wake flow instabilities unveil the primary flow instabilities in the vertical and horizontal directions with a (dimensionless) characteristic frequency of 0.13 to 0.14 and 0.19 to 0.20, respectively. Besides, the vertical flow instability shows its maximum impact on the wake above the separation while pumping works significantly below. The coherence analysis demonstrates the strong modulation behavior via symmetry preserving dynamics. In addition, the near-ground, lower vortex system evolves spirally and in-phase with a dimensionless characteristic frequency centered at 0.6. The extended POD is employed to build up a two-way velocity-concentration analysis framework with the temporal correlation as the link. The spatial concentration patterns associated with those energetic large-scale motions and the corresponding extreme events are revealed and reconstructed as a typical example.

17211117.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17211117.value: Source control is the most cost-effective solution to poor air quality. According to the results obtained from the completed project, reliable identification of heavy on-road emitters is utmost important. Remote sensing has long been employed to screen out dirty vehicles. Its deployment, however, is limited to single-lane traffic because of the (pollutant) interference from the vehicles nearby in multilane configurations. Its accuracy and flexibility are thus substantially degraded, weakening the applicability. The aforementioned findings characterized the aerodynamics after a single truck, both flows and pollutant transport, refining remote-sensing practice (short sampling duration within the near wake). By looking into the transient flows and dispersion, Further development could be elucidating the transport processes after two vehicles in multilane. Both laboratory experiments (model validation exercise) and mathematical modelling (detailed spatio-temporal flows and dispersion) could be adopted for the fundamental understanding of cross-lane pollutant transport and their influence on remote sensing. In particular, the high-fidelity computational fluid dynamics (CFD) data would be post-processed to determine the higher-order statistics, intermittency and coherence so as to filter out the interference and to develop an end-user model for multilane remote sensing. The outcome will bridge the current weaknesses for more reliable on-road deployment of remote sensing.

17211117.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17211117.value: According to our mathematical modelling and laboratory experimental results, the flows after a truck can be divided into the near-wake and far-field regions. The near wake is composed of the major recirculation and the upper recirculation while the far field consists of two trailing vortices. The upper shear layer not only induces the upper recirculation but also modifies the flows in the trailing vortices. It entrains into the trailing vortices finally. Tailpipe emission is carried toward the truck following the major recirculation. In view of the rapid mixing, the pollutants are more homogeneous and the concentrations are more uniform within the major recirculation. In the far-field, the pollutant transport gradually follows the conventional Gaussian theory. Substantial turbulent transport is found across these two regions. The current finding complements our previous results that a shorter sampling duration favours remote sensing accuracy. It is thus proposed that the sampling coverage should not extend beyond the major recirculation after the truck. Otherwise, the remote sensing signal would underestimate the pollutant concentrations. It is caused by the sharp drop in pollutant concentration (an order of magnitude) after the near wake. Nonetheless, the sampling time (0.5 sec) adopted in remote sensing nowadays is marginally acceptable.

17300117.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17300117.value: The Badain Jaran Desert (BJD) in Inner Mongolia is characterized by the world's tallest sand dunes and numerous groundwater-fed lakes, despite the prevailing dry condition. Studies of deserts with such features should provide important information on the evolution of both modern and ancient global environments and on long-term and short-term climatic oscillations. The available evidence demonstrates that the lakes are sensitive to climate change and that the water level in some lakes is declining gradually. There are concerns that some lakes could vanish in the near future due to global climate change and local human activities, leading to adverse consequences such as the deterioration or even permanent devastation of the oasis ecology and environment. Understanding the fate of the lakes during future climate change is key to ensure sustainable development in the ecologically sensitive area. Recent studies indicate that precipitation recharge is a major source of the lake water but there is not a clear relation between the long-term lake water level and precipitation. We hypothesize that this may be caused by delayed recharge through the thick unsaturated zones of the sand dunes. The lag time between the potential precipitation recharge and the actual recharge to the water table may be tens of years. It can be speculated that the lakes with delayed recharge from major sand dunes will tend to be more stable and have greater resilience to short-term climate change. This makes the assessment of impact of climate change on lake regimes difficult because the current lake water level can be influenced by climatological factors in the past many years and climate changes at the present may have no immediate effect on the lake water regimes. We will investigate the temporal and spatial characteristic of delayed recharge through the sand dunes, quantify the climate change under different climatic scenarios, construct a regional numerical model and calibrate it against the current climate conditions, finally use the model to predict the response of the groundwater flow to climate change with the 21st century. This study will present the first comprehensive numerical model in the BJD to integrate all the existing geological and hydrogeological data and to simulate the evolution of the groundwater flow system in response to future climate. The findings of this project will have broad scientific importance not only for the BJD but also for other climate-sensitive desert lakes in the world. 內蒙古巴丹吉林沙漠的特點是擁有世界上最高的沙丘和眾多地下水補給的湖泊。研究具有這些特點的沙漠將會為全球古、現代水文地質環境演化和長、短期氣候振盪對水文和地貌的影響提供重要信息。現有證據表明，這些沙漠湖泊對氣候變化非常敏感，並且部分湖泊的水位正在逐漸下降。有人擔心，由於全球氣候變化和當地人類活動的影響，一些湖泊將在近期消失，這將導致沙漠綠洲生態環境的惡化甚至永久破壞。因此，研究在未來氣候變化過程中的湖泊演化過程對確保沙漠生態脆弱地區的可持續發展有重要意義。最近研究表明，降雨補給是沙漠湖水地下水的主要來源，但湖泊的長期水位變化與降水之間並沒有明確的關係。我們猜測這可能是由於沙丘巨厚的非飽和帶的降雨延遲補給造成的。潛在的降雨補給與實際到達地下水水位的補給之間的滯後時間可能有數十年。我們推測，這種通過沙丘延遲補給的湖泊可能會相對穩定，並對短期氣候變化具有較大的抵禦能力。延遲補給對評估氣候變化對湖泊地下水系統影響較為困難，因為目前湖泊水位可能受到過去多年來氣候因素的影響，以及目前氣候變化可能對當前湖泊水位並沒有立即的影響。 我們將通過沙丘研究延遲補給的時空特徵，量化不同氣候條件下的氣候變化，構建區域尺度的地下水數值模型，並根據當前氣候條件對其進行校正，最後用它來預測地下水流系統對21世紀氣候變化的響應。本研究將建立巴丹吉林沙漠的綜合數值模型，以整合所有現有的地質和水文地質資料，並模擬地下水流系統隨未來氣候變化的演化。這個項目的結果不但對巴丹吉林沙漠湖泊也對世界其他氣候敏感的沙漠湖泊具有重要的科學意義。

17300117.label: Major findings and research outcome
17300117.value: 1) The results of numerical simulation of three-dimensional groundwater-lake water flow show that the lake water is mainly recharged by groundwater and miserly recharged by direct rainfall to the lake surface. Groundwater recharge to the lake water is mostly from the mountain block and partly from the local water mound inside the sand dunes. It indicates that the nested groundwater flow systems exist in the hyper dry area. When the climate was much wetter than the present, the lake area was expanded and the water mound inside the sand dunes rose. The recharge from the water mound to the lake water also increased. 2) The boron contents, and boron, hydrogen, and oxygen isotopic compositions in saline lake water, fresh and saline groundwater in South Sumujaran Lake are measured and analyzed. It is found that the boron contents and isotopic compositions in fresh groundwater are mainly dominated by dissolution process. Boron contents and isotopic compositions in saline groundwater are controlled by the mixing process and calcite digestion. Boron contents and isotopic compositions in lake water of South Sumujaran are controlled not only by water sources, but also calcite digestion. 3) Based on the high-resolution sampling in the South Sumujaran Lake and regional sampling in the whole BJD, the nutrient status and cycle in the desert are investigated. The results show that about 76% of the lakes are N-limited. Mountain block recharge and local groundwater flow contribute a dominant amount of water to sustain the lake water, but the nutrients in lake water are mainly supplied by mountain block recharge and lakebed diffusion. The nutrients in local groundwater are highly variable and contribute relatively much less part to the nutrient cycling. 3) Numerical simulation on a theoretical Toth composite basin shows that the downward intrusion of salt plumes modulates local‐scale groundwater flow, and local hydraulic perturbation propagates to the other subsystems of the nested groundwater flow systems. By adding a specified salinity boundary condition in the discharge zones of the classic Tóth model, density effects on the evolution of nested groundwater flow systems were numerically analyzed. The influx of saline lake water into the nested groundwater flow systems leads mainly to changes in the freshwater‐equivalent head and hydraulic conductivity. Local flow systems retreat upward, and the velocity magnitude is reduced with the increase of the lake salinity in the discharge zones.

17300117.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17300117.value: 1). The multi-depth monitoring system for unsaturated zone has been installed and is now recording the moisture content, temperature, and water potential inside a sand dune of the desert. Our future work is to utilize a data-calibrated numerical model to simulate heat and moisture coupled flow inside the sand dune and try to have better knowledge of the recharge process in the thick sand dune. 2). Our future research on the three-dimensional groundwater-lake water flow model is about salt transport process when the lake became salty due to intense evaporation and intrude downward into the lakebed aquifer. This model can tell us how the salt plume develops and expands in the nested groundwater flow systems. 3). The three-dimensional groundwater-lake water flow model is also useful to investigate how a three nested groundwater flow systems look like. In previous theoretical two-dimensional models, the subsystems of nested groundwater flow systems cannot be crossed. We will test if the definition of subsystems in two-dimensional model is applicable for three-dimensional one.

17300117.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17300117.value: Groundwater resources are the most precious water resources in hyper/semi-arid areas. The preservation of fragile ecosystems and lakes and prevention of transports of dust and sand are closely relied on groundwater. Decline of groundwater table due to climate change or anthropogenic activities will certainly cause the shrinking of lakes, more severe desertification in local environment, and expansion of desertification to other areas. This research mainly investigates how lake water and groundwater response to climate change, the factors that dominate the recharge and discharge processes, and how groundwater-lake water interaction affects solute circulation. This study can help people to have a better understanding about how groundwater flow systems look like in the desert and how the lake water is recharged. The salinization of lake water does not only reduce the fresh water resources in surface water reservoir but also the groundwater reservoir.

17300217.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17300217.value: Since the early 21st century, well-preserved plant mega-fossils have been reported from the Miocene Fotan Group in Fujian, China. The discovery of the tropical forest taxon Dipterocarpaceae indicates that a typical Asian tropical rainforest prevailed in China during the Miocene. In addition to the plant fossils, abundant insect-bearing ambers have been found in coal seams and sand layers just beneath the Dipterocarpaceae-bearing beds. Although most plant and insect fossils have not yet been studied or classified, the Fotan biota have great potential for expanding understanding of Miocene ecosystems and paleogeography. The abundant fossils found in the Fotan Group demonstrate that highly diverse animal and plant communities existed during the early Neogene in SE China. Volcanic units interbedded within the Fotan Group can potentially provide radiometric age constraints for these unique ecosystems. Precise ages can help constrain questions of 1) when the first Dipterocarpaceae arrived in China, 2) when tropical forest ecosystems developed in China, 3) whether the Fotan flora temporally overlapped with the oldest known Asian tropical forest in India and whether the out-of-India hypothesis for Dipterocarpaceae requires revision. Finally, precise age constraints on Fotan units can also address questions of 4) when Miocene insect taxa populated and thrived in SE China. 自二十一世紀以來，保存完整的植物化石及含昆蟲的琥珀在中國福建省大量出土，這些化石代表著這裡曾經是物種多元的熱帶雨林。根據初步的地層對比，這些化石的年代大約是中新世，研究這裡的地質年代及化石分佈，能夠讓我們重建當地的古生態和古環境，但截至前為止，過去所有的研究都集中在化石鑑定，並未有人仔細探究這裡的化石確切年代。在這裡，我們的團隊期望透過詳細的地質調查，和高精確的訂年方法，建立這些化石層可靠的年代。

17300217.label: Major findings and research outcome
17300217.value: This study reports a robust 40Ar/39Ar age of 14.7 ± 0.4 Ma for two basaltic samples collected from the newly discovered outcrops of the Fotan Biota in Fujian Province, SE China. In the past few years, abundant tropical fossils, mainly including insects and plants, have been reported from this area. Based on the discovery of fossil winged fruits belonging to the mega-plant Dipterocarpaceae in the Fotan Biota, previous studies suggested that Asian tropical rainforests appeared in China during the Miocene. Discoveries from SE China also represent a highly diverse paleobiotic assemblage. Fotan fossils can help constrain plant evolution and diversification over a critical interval of Earth history. Our geochronological result constrains interpretations of 1) when tropical rainforest ecosystems developed in China, 2) whether the Fotan flora temporally overlapped with the Asian tropical forest in India, and 3) whether the Middle Miocene Climatic Optimum triggered expansion of tropical rainforests in Asia. Our study also suggests that the ecosystem was very different in this region during Miocene and allows to reconstruct the biodiversity back to that time period. This study has been published (Zheng et al, Palaeo^3, 2019) and gained wide attentions.

17300217.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17300217.value: Just few weeks ago, a paper (Wang et al., Science Advances, 2021) reports the outstandingly rich rainforest biome in East Asia. Based on our high-precision age determination for the Fotan Biota, Wang et al. (2021) calibrates evolutionary history of several key groups within this oldest known tropical rainforest in China. Our age data from this supported project has allowed other researchers to understand Cenozoic life in general and to correlate the Miocene warming event globally. To further understand the early-middle Cenozoic climatic and biological events, we aim to date more fossil-rich formations in well-studied and newly discovered outcrops in Asia, especially in East and South Asia. For example, we have already started a new collaboration with geologists in Sri Lanka. We expect to establish a high-resolution chronostratigraphy of Miocene limestone in Jaffna, northern Sri Lanka. Our new project will enable to understand how climatic changes affected biodiversity during this critical time period.

17300217.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17300217.value: This study reports a high-precision age of 14.7 ± 0.4 Ma for the first tropical rainforest in China. A precise age for fossil-rich Fotan units in SE China provides important constraints on the biogeographic history of the field area and paleographic models linking Asian and Indian biota. Our study indicates the Middle Miocene Climatic Optimum triggered expansion of tropical rainforests in Asia. Our work will further help improve general understanding of middle Miocene ecosystems, including the co-evolutionary history of insects and plants.

17300317.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17300317.value: The ability to reliably store quantum information is crucial for the development of quantum communication networks and quantum computers. Steady progress has been made in recent years, with the realization of quantum memories in solid state and atomic systems. However, quantum memories are still limited in their scalability and lifetime, and they are expected to remain an expensive resource in the foreseeable future. In this scenario, it is essential to design and implement new devices that use the smallest amount of quantum memory to demonstrate quantum advantages. Very recently, our group developed new protocols to compress streams of identical particles into an exponentially small amount of memory. Our results, published in two companion PRL papers, open up a new line of research to determine the shortest physical description of quantum states and processes, with implications that go far beyond the original problem of compressing identical particles. The goal of this project is to take full advantage of our new findings by using them as a stepping-stone to advance three fundamental topics in quantum information: 1) Storing quantum states and processes in the smallest amount of memory space 2) Designing machines that can be controlled by quantum signals 3) Simulating large physical systems with small quantum simulators. We will establish the ultimate information-theoretic limits on the size of quantum processors required to implement a desired set of operations, opening the door to the implementation of realistic devices that achieve quantum-enhanced performance using minimum amounts of quantum memory. Our results will enable the realization of control mechanisms at the ultimate limit of miniaturization, and of new quantum machines capable of learning and emulating unknown physical processes. By leveraging on the power of small quantum processors, we will extend the reach of present experiments, eventually contributing to the investigation of new materials, chemical reactions, quantum fields, and even alternative physical theories. This project will impact diverse areas of physics and computer science, providing a flexible information-theoretic toolbox that can be applied to a variety of scenarios. In synergy with the CIFAR-Azrieli Global Scholars Program, recently joined by the PI, our agenda is to actively promote Hong Kong as an international hub for quantum information science and to cultivate a new generation of quantum information theorists in the region. 儲存量子信息是量子通訊網絡和量子計算機發展的關鍵。近年來，該技術得到了長足的發展，量子記憶體已在固體和原子系統中得到了實現。然而，受限其於較差的穩定性和較短的存儲時間，量子記憶體在短期內仍將是一種昂貴的資源。在這種情況下，設計和實現最小化記憶體需求的新設備成為了展示量子優越性的關鍵。 最近，本研究組發展了一系列新技術，可以對長串全同粒子進行指數程度的壓縮。我們發表于《物理評論快報》的兩篇文章創立了關於量子態及過程的最小描述長度的全新研究方向，有著超越原本問題的長遠意義。本項目的目的是充分利用這些新成果，將其作為研究以下三個量子信息學基本問題的踏板： 1) 與最小記憶空間中存儲量子態及過程 2) 設計由量子信號操控的機器 3) 通過微型量子模擬器模擬大型物理系統。 我們將探求實現指定操作的量子處理器理論上的最小尺寸，為以最小的量子記憶體達到量子增益的表現打開大門。我們的結果將在微小尺寸的極限下實現操控機制和能夠學習模仿未知物理過程的新型量子儀器。我們將利用小型量子處理器的能力拓展現有實驗的界限，并最終對材料、化學反應、量子場甚至物理理論的發展做出貢獻。 本項目將推動物理和計算機科學等多個不同領域的發展，為眾多應用場景提供一套靈活的信息學理論工具。通過與本項目負責人近期加入的CIFAR-Azrieli國際學者項目的通力合作，我們將積極推動本港發展成為量子信息科學的國際中心，并在區域內培養一批下一代的量子信息理論學者。

17300317.label: Realisation of objectives
17300317.value: Objective 1 [Optimal storage of quantum data] has been fully achieved with a derivation of the ultimate limits for the compression of large statistical ensembles of quantum states. We considered the general problem of compressing an ensemble of identically prepared quantum systems. Our results identified the minimum amount of quantum memory needed to store the systems’ state, establishing a fundamental relation between the amount of memory and the number of free parameters in the manifold of possible states. Specifically, the central result is that the state of n identically prepared systems can be compressed into approximately [f log(n)]/2 quantum bits, where f is the number of free parameters characterising the manifold. This is a form of equipartition theorem, which assigns a memory cost log(n)/2 to every free parameter. Our general result can be applied to problems in quantum metrology, such as the storage and transmission of the quantum states of many identical probes. In addition to quantifying the total memory, we have shown that that a large part of it can be stored into classical digital memories. The ratio between the amount of quantum and classical memory can be made arbitrarily small, while still obtaining a vanishing error in the large n limit. Practically, the amount of quantum memory controls the speed at which the error decays with n, and therefore every realistic application with finite n has to use a sufficient amount of quantum memory in order to reduce the compression error below a desired threshold. The research has been conducted in collaboration with Prof. Masahito Hayashi (Nagoya University and CQT Singapore) and the results have been published in IEEE Transactions in Information Theory [IEEE TIT 64, 4766-4783 (2018)], the premier journal in information theory. Building on this work, we developed protocols for the compression of clock states. The simplest example of a quantum clock is a quantum system (typically, an ion or an atom), that oscillates periodically between two energy levels. Highly precise time measurements are then obtained by performing measurements on large numbers of identical quantum clocks. Traditionally, the time information is extracted by measurement and stored classically. However, this approach is not suitable for tasks where different pieces of time information have to be combined together. For example, one may have to compute the total duration of a sequence of events. The traditional method is to measure the duration of each event individually, store the outcomes in a classical memory, and then compute the sum on a classical computer. This approach, however, leads to an accumulation of the errors with the number of measurements. Instead of measuring the clocks, we proposed to store the time information in a coherent way, using a quantum memory. By swapping the time information back and forward from the clock to the memory, we showed how to realise a “quantum stopwatch” mechanism, that achieves the maximum precision allowed by quantum mechanics. The initial findings on the compression of quantum clocks have been published in the Proceedings of the 2018 International Symposium on Information Theory (the proceedings paper can be found among the outputs of this project under "Conference Presentations"). The quantum stopwatch design and the memory/accuracy tradeoff have been published in Proceedings of the Royal Society A [Proceedings of the Royal Society A 474, 20170773 (2018)]. This paper attracted significant attention in the popular press, including highlights on NewScientist and InsideScience. Finally, we developed protocols for learning quantum states in the presence of noise, introducing a general statistical technique for achieving the ultimate precision limits set by quantum theory. This work was published in Communications of Mathematical Physics. While this work addressed the general estimation problem, we also focussed on the specific problem of learning the causal structure of quantum processes. We showed that quantum mechanics can be used to design strategies that are exponentially more efficient than their classical counterparts. This work has been published in Nature Communications. Objective 2 [Optimal Programmable processors] We identified the ultimate limit to the size of quantum programs for executing arbitrary unitary gates, and we showed that the limit can be achieved using a suitable design of quantum processors. This work was published in Physical Review Letters as an Editors' Suggestion. In addition, we identified a quantum advantage in the task of programming quantum gates. We analysed the problem of programming rotations around an unknown direction, encoded in the state of a quantum particle with spin, serving as the quantum program. We identified the optimal input states for encoding the direction, and determined how the accuracy of the gates grows with the size of the program spin. Then, we compared our quantum programmable gate with a classical machines, where the program spin is measured and the outcome of the measurement is used to classically control the rotation axis. We found out that a coherent interaction between the target system and the program spin outperforms every classical strategy for every finite value of the spin. This work has been published in New Journal of Physics. Objective 3 [Compressed simulations] We determined the minimum amount of resources needed to simulate a general quantum dynamics on a quantum system of smaller size. This task has applications in distributed quantum computing, where a client asks a server to perform a quantum computation on a remote computer. Reproducing the desired computation on a smaller system is then a way to minimize the amount of communication between the client and the server. In our work we determined the minimum amount communication needed by a server in order to accurately reproduce a desired quantum process. Notably, we stablished a relation between the compressed simulation of a quantum process and the precision limits of quantum metrology: if a family of quantum processes can be estimated with Heisenberg limited precision, then the communication cost (equal to the minimum size of the simulating system) is at least f log N qubits, where f is the number of free parameters describing the given processes, and N is the number of executions of the processes that the simulator is required to perform. Instead, if the processes can be estimated at the standard quantum limit, the communication cost is f/2 log N. In general, we showed that processes that can be estimated with higher precision require a higher communication cost, meaning that any simulator will require a larger system size. This work has been published in IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Information Theory. [Note on grant acknowledgement] Due to a confusion with grant numbers, Outputs 3 and 4 of this project acknowledge another GRF project active in our group at the moment of publication (GRF 17326616). For Output 4, the acknowledgment was later corrected with an Erratum. For Output 3, unfortunately the editors did not permit any correction. We stress that, however, both Outputs 3 and 4 were not claimed as outputs in the completion report of GRF 17326616.
