25216617.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25216617.value: A plethora of consumer and industrial applications are placing intense pressure on the race to develop lithium batteries with ever-increasing volumetric capacities, in addition to superb reliability and safety. First generation Li-batteries used metallic Li-anodes, but were quickly precluded from consumer devices because of their propensity to rapidly degrade and ignite into flames. Second generation Li-ion batteries have powered the ‘smartphone’ era and have even been put to use in some emerging technologies, like electric vehicles. However, these cells typically employ carbon-based anodes which have plateaued in their capacity to store Li and in their ability to rapidly recharge without sacrificing cell stability. Recently, a third generation of Li battery anode materials have been identified which could potentially replace the status quo. In these cells, materials like silicon, germanium, or aluminum can be employed as the active material in the Li-ion cell anode. These materials have the potential to increase the anode storage capacity by a factor of 10, both gravimetrically and volumetrically, in the case of Si. This order of magnitude performance increase could translate into significant reductions in the form factor of Li-ion batteries, or dramatically enhance the range and run-time of electric vehicles and portable electronic devices. Although the anodes have obvious advantages over the current state of the art, they are not without their challenges. Perhaps the most formidable obstacle is the intense mechanical deformation and volumetric expansion of the host material as it alloys with Li. While a number of studies have been carried out over the past few years to characterize and mitigate this deformation during alloying, significant questions remain about the underlying stability and safety of the anode materials, particularly as it applies to alloys and composites under fast-charging conditions. Binary, or even ternary, alloys of Si, Al, and other materials may be stoichiometrically tuned in an anode to optimize the mechanical stability, rate performance, and safety of the cell so as to enable this dramatic increase in cell capacity. This proposal aims to employ synergistic in situ methods to investigate the nature of the mechanical stability and alloying pathways in silicon-based anode materials. By understanding the fundamental principles which govern the mechanical properties, physical deformation, and lithiation pathways, this research is poised to unlock a third wave of Li-ion battery technology which will revolutionize mobile energy storage for years to come. 现今社会，锂电池产品已很难满足广泛的的行业应用和消费者日渐增大的需求。除了追求更高的比电容，可靠性和安全性也需要得到进一步的提升。因此研发新一代锂电池势在必行。 追溯到锂电池的历史轨迹，第一代锂电池使用金属锂负极，但由于它易燃的不安全性和充放电过程中比电容的快速衰减，因此很快就被电池市场所淘汰。第二代锂离子电池不仅大大推动了“智能手机”的发展和普及，而且也常被应用于电动汽车等新兴技术领域。然而，负极通常在使用碳材料保证电池稳定性的同时也大大限制了负极的比电容。 最近，新型的第三代锂电池负极材料已经被开发和研究，诸如硅，锗或铝等可以被用作锂离子电池负极中的活性材料。这些材料有机会让负极的比电容提高10倍左右。以硅为例，由于比电容的提高，不仅能显著降低锂离子电池的外形尺寸，也可以大大提高电动车辆和便携式电子设备的行驶里程和运行时间。虽然这种负极相比与现有裁量具有明显的优势，但它也不乏挑战。其中最大的障碍也许就是与锂与主体活性材料形成合金时所导致的强烈机械形变和体积膨胀。虽然在过去几年中许多研究被用于表征和缓和这种合金化过程中的形变与膨胀，然而，特别是在快速充电的时候，由形变所导致的稳定性和安全性的问题仍是一大隐患。根据化学计量学，由硅铝组成的二元合金，甚至硅与其他金属形成的三元合金，有可能使负极在形变过程中更加稳定，在优化电池的功率和安全性的同时，也显著提高电池比电容。 该计划书旨在采用协同原位方法来研究硅合金负极材料稳定性的机理。通过理解机械性能，物理形变和锂化途径等基本原理，本研究将有望推动第三波锂离子电池技术浪潮，在未来几年内引领移动储能的变革。

25222717.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25222717.value: 多云区域重建高质量卫星影像时间序列的新方法研究

25222717.label: Project Objectives

25222717.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25222717.value: 跨越不同季节的卫星影像时间序列对研究自然或人为因素引起的城市问题至关重要，以便发展可持续性城市。然而卫星影像常常受云，云的阴影，以及其他噪声影响，导致很难获取高质量的时间序列影像，特别是像香港这样的多云区域。尽管当前新遥感技术的发展，比如无人机和微小卫星技术可以为传统卫星数据提供很好的补充，但是当我们研究过去长时间的城市环境变化的时候仍然面对以上困难，因为早期只有传统卫星数据可用。比如Landsat数据就是研究过去40年城市环境变化的唯一数据源，因为Landsat数据具有较高的空间分辨率并且从1972年开始收集数据。因此，如何处理这些历史卫星数据是很紧要的任务。 一般说来，重建高质量卫星影像时间序列涉及到两个步骤：云和阴影的自动探测和对这些污染像素值的插补。虽然已经有一些算法用于这两个步骤，但是我们初步研究结果表明这些已有算法在多云区域比如香港难以得到好的结果，主要原因包括：（1）这些算法需要很多根据各地区特点预先设定的参数；（2）需要很多无云覆盖的图像作参考；（3）大多只利用了时间信息而忽略了空间信息；（4）大多只利用局部特征；（5）大多只利用单一卫星数据。 为了解决以上问题，本项目将开发一套新的自动算法用于在多云区域重建高质量的卫星影像时间序列。我们将开发两项新技术：（1）基于时间序列特征的卫星影像云和阴影的自动探测技术；（2）自适应的整合多源数据融合和缺失值插补的时间序列重建技术。不同与现有方法，我们的新方法具有较少的预设参数，较少的人机交互，对于输入数据的质量要求较低等优点，可以被不同领域的研究人员使用。为了检验我们方法的适用性和有效性，我们将在包括香港在内的多云地区开展实验。 该项目开发的方法将支持对1970年代以来的香港环境问题进行研究，比如城市热岛、海岸带水质污染、空气污染、绿地变化等，帮助我们为香港市民建设一个更好的城市。

25222717.label: Realisation of objectives
25222717.value: Our research team has carried out research in each objective listed in the proposal and achieved good research outcomes. Objective 1: Develop a new algorithm to screen clouds and cloud shadows accurately in satellite time-series images for cloudy areas To complete objective 1, this project has developed a new cloud and cloud shadow detection algorithm, named as Automatic Time-Series Analysis (ATSA), to screen clouds and cloud shadows in multi-temporal optical images. Compared with the existing methods, ATSA needs fewer predefined parameters, does not require a thermal infrared band, and is more suitable for areas with persistent clouds. The performance of ATSA was tested with Landsat-8 OLI images, Landsat-4 MSS images, and Sentinel-2 images in three sites. The results were compared with a popular method, called Function of Mask (Fmask). ATSA can consistently obtain high accuracy in all images, while Fmask has large omission or commission errors in some images. ATSA is a valuable supplement to the existing cloud screening methods. This work was published in Remote Sensing of Environment (the top 1 remote sensing journal) (Zhu and Helmer, 2018). The principle and idea of the ATSA algorithm was further used by the project team to investigate the pixels contaminated by blooming effect in the nighttime light (NTL) satellite images. Blooming effect smooths light intensity through diffusing the brightness from the bright area to the dark areas. The blooming effect blurs the images which has similar effect with clouds. Therefore, this effect could be quantified by the alteration of spatial heterogeneity in light intensity. This work was published in Annals of GIS (Shen et al., 2019). Objective 2: Develop a new adaptive method through integrating current cutting-edge methods of cloud removal, missing data interpolation, and spatiotemporal data fusion into one automated system to predict values of contaminated pixels in the time-series To complete objective 2, this project has done the several studies: (1) reviewed the current progress in spatiotemporal data fusion and improved a spatiotemporal fusion method for reconstructing high-quality vegetation index time series; (2) developed an automatic system to remove clouds and fill missing data in a time series; and (3) developed automatic methods to correct pixels contaminated by blooming effect in nighttime satellite images. First, spatiotemporal data fusion is currently a popular way to produce seasonal satellite images by fusing two types of satellite images, frequent coarse-resolution images and sparse fine-resolution images. These methods were designed based on different principles and strategies, and therefore show different strengths and limitations. This diversity brings difficulties for users to choose an appropriate method for their specific applications and data sets. To this end, this project investigates current spatiotemporal data fusion methods, categorizes existing methods, discusses the principal laws underlying these methods, summarizes their potential applications, and proposes possible directions for future studies in this field. This study was published in Remote Sensing (Q1 SCI journal) (Zhu et al., 2018a). Based on the review of current spatiotemporal data fusion methods, this project improved a spatiotemporal fusion method for reconstructing high-quality vegetation index time series (Liu et al., 2019). Second, seasonal Landsat time-series data are very useful to study land surface dynamics at a relatively high spatial resolution. However, Landsat images are contaminated by clouds, cloud shadows, and for Landsat 7, scan line corrector (SLC) failure in 2003. These sources of image contamination severely reduce the chances of obtaining a high-quality time series. To address this problem, this project developed an automatic system to interpolate contaminated pixels in all images of a time series, which is based on the Neighborhood Similar Pixel Interpolator method and an iterative process. The real and simulation experiments show that the proposed method can reconstruct dense Landsat time series successfully. This new method was published as a book chapter (Zhu et al., 2018b). Third, this research developed a self-adjusting model (SEAM) to correct blooming effects in NTL data based on a spatial response function and without using any ancillary data. SEAM was applied to all of China, and its performance was assessed for twelve cities with different population sizes. The results show that SEAM can largely reduce the blooming effect. SEAM method was published in Remote Sensing of Environment (the top 1 remote sensing journal) (Cao et al, 2019). Then, we further improved the SEAM model by considering spatial heterogeneity of blooming distance and published this improved model in IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing (Zhuo et al., 2021). Objective 3: Conduct pilot studies to test the feasibility and effectiveness of developed techniques in one cloudy region To test the feasibility of developed techniques for producing satellite time series, we conducted three practical studies: (1) reconstructing a 31-year Landsat time series to monitor the desertification process in North China; (2) reconstructing a dense time series by fusing Sentinel-2 and Landsat to investigate the urban effect on vegetation phenology; and (3) reconstructing seasonal Landsat time series to study the forestland parcelization problem. First, this study applied the developed technology to reconstruct a high-quality Landsat annual time series in North China to investigate the desertification. The land cover map and the enhanced vegetation index (EVI) were derived from all reconstructed images. The change of vegetation coverage and EVI values over the 31 years were analyzed. The results show that the total vegetation coverage and greenness increased during the 31 years. Linking this change trend to other factors suggests that vegetation in Minqin County is highly affected by agriculture and groundwater supply rather than by climate. These findings were published in International Journal of Digital Earth (Zhu et al., 2019). Second, we generated a dense 10 m vegetation index time series through harmonizing Sentinel-2 and Landsat-8 images by data fusion method. Then, we investigated the impact of spatial resolution on the rural–urban difference of vegetation spring phenology using the 10 m data to simulated data with coarse resolutions. We also used the reconstructed 10-m time series investigated the urban-induced microclimate effects on winter wheat spring phenology (i.e., the regreen-up date, RGUD) in three cities spanning a range of sizes in northern China. The findings of these two studies were published in Remote Sensing (Tian et al., 2020) and Agricultural and Forest Meteorology (Tian et al., 2020) respectively. Last, this study employed the reconstructed Landsat time series and land ownership data in Hocking County, Ohio to examine the relationship between forestland parcel size and forest attributes, including forest composition and structure. Our results show that compared with private lands, public lands have higher values in all forest attributes, including forest coverage, abundance of oak-dominant stands, canopy height and aboveground biomass. These results were published in Remote Sensing (Zhu and Liu, 2019) In summary, all three objectives have been completed and 10 peer-reviewed journal papers and one peer-reviewed book chapter were published from this project.

25222717.label: Major findings and research outcome
25222717.value: Major findings from this project include: (1) developed a new cloud and cloud shadow detection algorithm, named as Automatic Time-Series Analysis (ATSA), to screen clouds and cloud shadows in multi-temporal optical images; (2) reviewed the current progress in spatiotemporal data fusion and improved a spatiotemporal fusion method for reconstructing high-quality vegetation index time series; (3) developed an automatic system to remove clouds and fill missing data in a time series; (4) developed automatic methods to correct pixels contaminated by blooming effect in nighttime satellite images; and (5) assessed the feasibility of developed techniques for producing satellite time series to solve real-world problems through three practical studies: monitoring the desertification process in North China, investigating the urban effect on vegetation phenology, and studying the forestland parcelization problem. Research outcomes from this project includes: (1) 10 peer-reviewed journal papers, among which 7 were published in JCR Q1 journals; (2) 1 peer-reviewed book chapter; (3) 2 presentations in international conferences; and (4) training of one PhD student and three undergraduate students.

25222717.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
25222717.value: This project discovered several challenges for generating high-quality satellite images. First, it is very difficult to address the cloud problems in satellite images with only optical bands in regions with persistent clouds, such as tropical regions. The cloud-free data is very rare in any season, so the further development should consider the combination of optical satellite images with radar images which are less affected by clouds. Second, the performance assessment of data fusion technology is difficult because it has multiple aspects that correspond to different applications. We do not know which fusion methods are appropriate for different applications if there are no good accuracy assessment technologies, so further development should focus on developing a comprehensive way to assess performance of fusion technology. To keep solving these challenges after this project, I have successfully secured external research project to support these new studies. Specifically, I have received RMB 1,200,000 from NSFC for a project titled “Remote Sensing: time-series image processing” (period 2021.1-2023.12).

25222717.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
25222717.value: We can observe that plants sprout, leaves unfurl, flowers blossom in spring and many trees lose their leaves in autumn. We know summer is the warmest time of the year and winter is the coldest. Our earth has strong seasonality not only in the nature systems but also in the social systems. Observations of these seasonal patterns from the space can help us better know the response of our earth to the changes caused by climate and human activities. Since 1970s, images from Landsat satellites have been widely used to monitor the seasonal patterns of land surface, but it faces several challenges. Images affected by clouds and small number of images collected per year are two hardest problems. This project developed cutting-edge technologies to automatically screen clouds in Landsat images, fuse Landsat images with other satellite data to increase the number of images in each year, and finally use the generated Landsat data to study vegetation for a sustainable development under the pressure of urbanization and future climate change.

25222917.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25222917.value: 散射遇感知：運動信號的無源被動感知研究

25222917.label: Project Objectives
25222917.value: The motion displaces the backscatter device attached on a moving object, leading to changes of backscatter signals. Our first objective is to abstract any kind of motion into a uniform representation, called as motion signal, namely, the changes of backscatter signals. Backscatter devices operate in a sequence of charge-discharge cycles since there is too little energy to continually operate the device. Meanwhile, they adopt random access protocol for channel competition. As a result, the sampled motion signals are composed of a series of discrete and random samples. The previous works based on these discrete samples suffer from many severe imperfections, like limitations on moving speed or rotating frequency. In this proposed investigation, we plan to synthesize the recent advances of compressive sensing and the inherent backscatter's characteristics (like randomness) to recover motion signals. The ultimate goal of motion sensing is to obtain specific motion variables, however, which are application-requirement dependent. Our second objective is to retrieve motion variables from the recovered motion signals. In this proposal, we discuss three representative motion applications, from which we can derive other general cases. First, we track the trajectory of high-speed movement to high precision. Second, we propose enhanced fast folding to discover the period of high-frequency spinning. The third application refers to the movements where the moving objects are not equipped with any IoT devices (namely, non-invasive). We can still perceive these non-invasive objects through their RF reflections, which are received by the ambient backscatter devices. The important outcome of this project is the implementation of the recognition framework. Our third objective is to develop the recognition framework for current predominate backscatter platforms (including RFID, WISP or Ambient Backscatter) for prototyping, debugging and testing. It provides research community a novel way and proven experience in supporting practical implementation.

25222917.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25222917.value: 在數年熱情得討論物聯網所帶來的機遇之後，很多現實的問題開始浮出水面。例如最關鍵的問題是:物聯網節點變得越來越小且數量巨大，如何才能為連接這些節點並持續為它們提供能量？學術界廣泛認為無源散射通信是最具有競爭力的解決方案。散射通信能夠讓物聯網節點從空中電磁波中獲取能量，並選擇性的反射電磁波以達到通信的目的。這個解決方案節能、有效，但卻引發了另外一個潛在的問題：如何能夠讓這些物聯網節點變得可感知？傳統的無線傳感器網絡通過擴展板可以集成各種各樣的傳感器組件，但是這種方案在無源散射網絡中並不可行，因為即使是能量高效的傳感器組件所消耗的能量也遠遠大於散射節點從空中吸收的能量。針對這個問題本方案轉向了最近學術界熱門的話題：被動感知。被動感知把無線信號擴展成感知媒介，通過研究通信信號的變化來達到感知環境的目的。被動感知相關的研究目前主要針對有源節點（例如WiFi和藍牙），本方案提出將被動感知技術運用到散射節點上，開發無源被動感知平台（BSSP）。這並不是說直接把被動感知和無源散射簡單的結合起來就可以了，研究這樣的平台是一個相當挑戰性的任務， 因為散射節點具有各種內在的缺陷，例如能量預算緊張、低通信率、有限的通信距離、很弱的計算能力等。日常生活面臨各種各樣的運動感知需求，本方案提出通過BSSP平台來感知各種運動。相比較已經存在的有源方案，本方案具有多種優勢：遠程供電可持續，易維護，並且可大規模部署。此外，我們甚至可以利用已經大規模部署的散射節點建立無源感知平台，而無需再專門部署新的傳感器網絡。我們可以充分利用他們去建立一個零成本的感知基礎網絡。利用散射信號感知運動優勢明顯，但同時又面臨的很多挑戰。針對這些挑戰，本方案提出以下三個目標：第一，通過散射信號對運動進行建模。現實生活中的運動有很多形式，如加速運動和勻速運動。我們將所有的運動全部抽象為一種統一的表達，即運動信號；第二， 通過運動信號進行運動感知。儘管運動信號具有通用的表達形式，但是如何從運動信號中抽取運動特徵不能一概而論，需要具體問題具體分析。本方案就典型的幾種運動展開討論；第三、為調試和測試開發運動感知原型系統 。本方案開啟了一種新的無線傳感器網絡範式，它結合了目前散射通信和被動感知兩種比較主流的研究，為物聯網落地到現實生活中開啟了新的大門。

25222917.label: Realisation of objectives
25222917.value: In this project, we proposed sensorless sensing into backscatter-driven IoT devices, making a batteryless and sensorless sensing platform. To this end, we achieved the following accomplishments. 1. Sensing Tasks First, we leveraged the sensing platform to accomplish two main sensing tasks including vibration/spinning sensing and location sensing. 1.1. Vibration/Spinning Sensing: Traditional vibration inspection systems, equipped with separated sensing and communication modules, are either very expensive (e.g., hundreds of dollars) and/or suffer from occlusion and narrow field of view (e.g., laser). In this project, we made effort to exploit a batteryless RFID-based solution to inspect mechanical vibration using COTS RFID tags and readers. Specifically, vibration displaces the tag attached to the vibrating surface within a small range, resulting in a regular change pattern of backscatter signals. We can reveal the relevant vibration information like frequency or period by discerning such communication patterns without specialized sensors. The related works have been published in IEEE INFOCOM 2018 (“Robust Spinning Sensing with Dual-RFID-Tags in Noisy Settings”), IEEE INFOCOM 2019 (“Towards Physical-Layer Vibration Sensing with RFIDs ”), IEEE TMC (“RFID Harmonic for Vibration Sensing”) and IEEE TMC (“Robust Spinning Sensing with Dual-RFID-Tags in Noisy Settings ”). 1.2. Location Sensing: Tracking smart devices, such as phones or wearables, inside buildings where the GPS is not available has become a growing business interest. Indoor localization enables users to navigate indoor spaces similar to the function provided by GPS for outdoor environments. It prompts a series of key mobile applications, namely, indoor navigation (e.g., malls, factories, and airports), augmented reality, location-aware pervasive computing, advertising, and social networking. In this project, we deploy batteryless sensors (RFID tags or acoustic tags) indoors to detect the location of a subject or an object. The related works have been published in ACM MobiCom 2019 (“Rebooting Ultrasonic Positioning Systems for Ultrasound-incapable Smart Devices”), IEEE INFOCOM 2018 (“RF-Dial: An RFID-based 2D Human-Computer Interaction via Tag Array”), and IEEE TMC (“Revitalizing Ultrasonic Positioning Systems for Ultrasound-Incapable Smart Devices”) 2. Performance Improvement Second, sensorless sensing extends the role of wireless signals from communication to a sensing medium. Many backscatter-based applications like sensing are highly rely on reading rates. The challenge is that backscatters can collide and cancel each other out, resulting in wastage of bandwidth and an increase in the total delay. Other sophisticated communication mechanisms (e.g., CDMA or FDMA) are unsuitable due to their high energy demand. Worsely, backscatters merely rely on the reader to schedule their medium access with the framed-slotted ALOHA protocol because they cannot “hear” from each other. These limitations force the reader to go through a time-consuming inventory procedure. To improve the performance, we made the following efforts in this project: 2.1. Hash-based Anti-collision Algorithm: The deployment of billions of commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) radio frequency identification (RFID) tags has drawn much of the attention of the research community because of the performance gaps of current systems. In particular, hash-enabled protocol (HEP) is one of the most thoroughly studied topics in the past decade. HEPs are designed for a wide spectrum of notable applications (e.g., missing detection) without the need to collect all tags. HEPs assume that each tag contains a hash function, such that a tag can select a random but predictable time slot to reply with a one-bit presence signal that shows its existence. However, the hash function has never been implemented in COTS tags in reality, which makes HEPs a ten-year untouchable mirage. In this project, we designed and implemented a group of analog on-tag hash primitives (called Tash) for COTS Gen2-compatible RFID systems, which moves prior HEPs forward from theory to practice. In particular, we designed three types of hash primitives, namely, tash function, tash table function, and tash operator. The related works have been published in IEEE/ACM TON (“Tash: Toward Selective Reading as Hash Primitive for Gen2 RFIDs”), IEEE INFOCOM 2019 (“Embracing Tag Collisions: Acquiring Bloom Filters across RFIDs in Physical Layer ”) and IEEE/ACM TON (“Acquiring Bloom Filters Across Commercial RFIDs in Physical Layer”). 2.2 Mobility Adaptive Reading: All sensing applications forcedly require a much higher reading rate (i.e., sampling rate) such that any fast movement of target objects can be accurately captured in a timely manner through backscatter readings. However, the current systems suffer from an extremely low individual reading rate when multiple backscatters are present, due to their intense channel contention in the link layer. In this project, we designed a holistic system, called Tagwatch, a rate-adaptive reading system for backscatter systems. This work revisits the reading rate from a distinctive perspective: mobility. We observe that the reading demands of mobile backscatter are considerably more urgent than those of stationary backscatter because the states of the latter nearly remain unchanged; meanwhile, only a few tags (e.g., < 20%) are actually in motion despite the existence of a massive amount of backscatter in practice. Thus, Tagwatch adaptively improves the reading rates for mobile backscatter by cutting down the readings of stationary backscatter. Our main contribution is a two-phase reading design, wherein the mobile tags are discriminated in Phase I and exclusively read in Phase II. The related works have been published in IEEE TMC (“Revisiting Reading Rate with Mobility: Rate-adaptive reading of COTS RFID Systems”). 3. Cross-Technology Communication Finally, based on the developed platform, we also explore other interesting. Recent advances in Cross-Technology Communication (CTC) have improved efficient cooperation among heterogeneous wireless devices like between WiFi and ZigBee. In this project, we also made efforts to allow the 2.4G WiFi end to receive the sensing results outputted by a UHF backscatter system like an RFID system. It would allow the sensing results can be captured by more mobile devices. However, even the most effective CTC systems require these devices to operate in the same ISM band (e.g., 2.4GHz) because of the conventional wisdom that wireless transceivers with different (fundamental) frequencies cannot communicate with one another. Our work, which is called TiFi, challenges this belief by allowing a 2.4GHz WiFi receiver (e.g., a smartphone) to identify UHF RFID tags, which operate at the spectrum between 840∼920MHz. TiFi does not require changing current smartphones or tags. Instead, it leverages the underlying harmonic backscattering of tags to open a second channel and uses it to communicate with WiFi receivers. We design and implement TiFi with commodity WiFi chipsets (e.g., Broadcom BCM43xx, Murata KM6D280 40, and Qualcomm WCN3990). Our comprehensive evaluation shows that TiFi allows WiFi receivers to identify UHF RFID tags within the range of 2 m and with a median goodput of 95%, which is comparable to today’s mobile RFID readers. The related work has been published in IEEE/ACM TON (“Identifying UHF RFIDs in range of Readers with WiFi”).

25222917.value: The research outcome can be categorized into three groups. The first group is to study various sensing tasks by using the backscatter signals. The research outcome includes four conference papers and three journal papers. Specifically, they have been published in IEEE INFOCOM 2018 (“Robust Spinning Sensing with Dual-RFID-Tags in Noisy Settings”), IEEE INFOCOM 2019 (“Towards Physical-Layer Vibration Sensing with RFIDs ”), ACM MobiCom 2019 (“Rebooting Ultrasonic Positioning Systems for Ultrasound-incapable Smart Devices”), IEEE INFOCOM 2018 (“RF-Dial: An RFID-based 2D Human-Computer Interaction via Tag Array”), IEEE TMC (“RFID Harmonic for Vibration Sensing”), IEEE TMC (“Robust Spinning Sensing with Dual-RFID-Tags in Noisy Settings ”), and IEEE TMC (“Revitalizing Ultrasonic Positioning Systems for Ultrasound-Incapable Smart Devices”). The second group is to improve the sensing performance of large-scale sensing tasks. The research outcome includes one conference paper and three journal papers. Specifically, they have been published in IEEE INFOCOM 2019 (“Embracing Tag Collisions: Acquiring Bloom Filters across RFIDs in Physical Layer”), IEEE/ACM TON (“Tash: Toward Selective Reading as Hash Primitive for Gen2 RFIDs”), IEEE/ACM TON (“Acquiring Bloom Filters Across Commercial RFIDs in Physical Layer”), and IEEE TMC (“Revisiting Reading Rate with Mobility: Rate-adaptive reading of COTS RFID Systems”). The third group is to explore cross-technology communication. The research outcome includes one journal paper, IEEE/ACM TON (“Identifying UHF RFIDs in range of Readers with WiFi”). Finally, we developed a prototype based on the RFID system and released the open-source on Github: https://github.com/tagsys/tagbeat.Through this platform, any researcher of interest can take advantage of our outcome to further study the backscatter based sensorless sensing.

25222917.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
25222917.value: Measurement of motion purely on backscatter signal is a challenging technical problem. We believe our project has taken an important step toward addressing this issue. However, a few points are still worth discussing: (1) Sensing range. The prototype inherits the shortcoming that its sensing range is limited within dozens of meters, from the backscatter technology. Such relatively short range is apparently insufficient for the measurement in the wild, but our prototype provides a potential way for this purpose when integrating with ambient communication technology. (2) Anti-interference. The anti-interference can be achieved in three levels. Bit level: the reader usually calculates the phase value over 96-bits and reports the average value. The impact from sudden signal interferences can be smoothed. Packet level: packets from different tags will be discarded, ensuring the packet interferences are not propagated to upper layer. Channel level: there are dozens of frequency hopping channels available. we can view the reading over different channel as independent observations and fuse the inspecting results, to avoid the enduringly inferences at one specific signal channel.

25222917.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
25222917.value: It has been of rising demand to sense motion in our everyday life. This project targeted at fundamentally sensing various kinds of motions through a batteryless and sensorless platform. Compared with the existing battery-powered and motion sensor-based solution, our approach offers many appealing features: remote power supply makes it sustainable, maintainable, and scalable even for large-scale deployment. It is extremely cost-effective to reuse the wireless transceiver for sensing purposes with no need for dedicated sensors. A vast number of backscatter devices (e.g. RFID tags) have been already deployed in our surroundings. We can exhaust their potential to build a perception infrastructure with zero start-ups. This project initiated a new paradigm of wireless sensor networks enabled by recent advancements in backscatter communication and sensorless sensing technologies. This project provided a fundamental understanding of backscatter communication, lightweight sensorless sensing, and a set of strategies for managing such systems. It would have major impacts on smart home, smart cities, power grids, aerial/ground transportation systems, and the sort.

25301217.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25301217.value: 基于不精确信息的非线性优化算法研究

25301217.label: Project Objectives
25301217.value: Analyze the behavior of nonlinear optimization methods (trust-region method, adaptive cubic regularization method, etc.) when function values and gradients are evaluated by inaccurate oracles with bounded inaccuracies. We will investigate both the asymptotic convergence and the non-asymptotic complexity of the methods. We will not require the inaccuracies to fade away as iterations proceed. Conduct the same analysis as above under the assumption that the inaccurate oracles are random and their inaccuracies are bounded only with a certain probability. We will not require the inaccuracies to have zero means or finite variances. Besides, our assumption will allow the oracles to fail with constant probability, and our analysis would consequently shed light on the fault tolerance properties of the optimization methods under investigation. Study the situation where we have access to a hierarchy of inaccurate oracles and discuss how nonlinear optimization methods should exploit the hierarchy to yield a desirable solution with few evaluations of high-accuracy oracles. Accordingly, we will design robust and efficient algorithms for solving optimization problems based on inaccurate oracles.

25301217.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25301217.value: How does inaccuracy in function values and gradients influence the asymptotic convergence and non-asymptotic complexity of optimization algorithms that are developed without considering the inaccuracy? How should optimization algorithms exploit inaccurate function values and gradients to solve problems to desirable precision at low cost? This project will investigate these two questions with special considerations on highly regarded nonlinear optimization methods such as trust-region method and cubic regularization method. Our project is motivated by applications including meteorological forecasting, reservoir oil well placement, and environmental engineering, where information like objective function values and gradients is often contaminated by various inaccuracies. With inaccurate information, it is certainly nontrivial to guarantee the quality of computed solutions and keep computing expenses low. This urges a timely investigation into the two questions posed above. In contrast to many existing works, we will not require the information inaccuracy to fade away as iterations proceed. Both deterministic and stochastic inaccuracies will be studied. In the stochastic case, we will not require the inaccuracy to have zero mean or finite variance but only assume its magnitude is below some bound with a certain probability. This would make the analysis highly challenging, but it is worthwhile because it embraces the situation where the function/gradient evaluation involves a numerical process that outputs reasonable results with high probability and fails occasionally, which is becoming common in the Big Data age as computations are often done by randomized methods. Our analysis would also shed light on the fault tolerance properties of optimization algorithms. Concerning the exploitation of inaccurate information, we will consider the situation where we have access to a hierarchy of inaccurate oracles with increasing accuracies and discuss how to exploit the hierarchy dynamically to obtain a desirable solution with minimal evaluations of high-accuracy oracles. This is motivated by mixed precision algorithms that have been highly successful in scientific computing but barely discussed in nonlinear optimization. Solving problems in such a way would lead to significant saving in computing resources since less accurate oracles are generally (much) less expensive to evaluate. Based on this study, we will develop software for optimization based on inaccurate oracles, which would benefit applications like meteorological forecasting, where exploitation of inaccurate information is profitable as the accurate information can be quite expensive. 传统上，大部分数值优化算法的设计和分析都假设计算中用到的函数值或梯度信息是精确的。然而，在实际应用中，这些信息很少能够精确地获取。那么，这些信息的不精确性会如何影响算法的收敛性和收敛速度？基于这些不精确的信息，优化算法又该如何以最小的代价得到具有合理质量的解？本课题将针对这些问题展开研究。与目前已有的工作不同，我们不假设信息的不精确性会随着迭代的进行逐步降低直至消失。我们将就确定性误差和随机性误差分别展开讨论。特别地，在随机性误差的情形下，我们不假设误差具有零均值和有限方差，而仅仅假设误差以一定的概率低于某个非零阈值。这就允许函数值或梯度值的计算以一定的概率失败。因此，我们的研究也将对优化算法的容错 (fault tolerance) 性质提供理论上的洞见。在算法设计方面，我们假设函数值或梯度值能够以有限个不同的精度计算，研究优化算法如何自适应地选择计算精度，以在保证计算结果质量的前提下最大限度地降低计算代价。随着实际问题规模的增大，越来越多的优化问题中函数值或梯度信息仅仅能够近似地计算，并且计算代价会随精确性的提高而明显上升。本课题将帮助我们理解优化算法在求解实际问题时的表现，并且对优化算法在实际计算中如何有效利用不精确信息作出指引。

25301217.label: Realisation of objectives
25301217.value: 1. Analyze the behavior of nonlinear optimization methods when function values and gradients are evaluated by inaccurate oracles with bounded inaccuracies. For direct search methods based on inaccurate function values, we proved global convergence of the methods up to a tolerance related to the magnitude of the inaccuracy, and established the worst-case complexity to achieve an approximate solution. For trust-region methods based on inaccurate gradients, requiring that the relative error in the inaccurate gradients is below a certain bound (but does not decay when the iterations proceed), we demonstrated the methods are globally convergent and enjoy the same global convergence rate as when the gradients are accurate. 2. Analyze the behavior of nonlinear optimization methods when function values and gradients are evaluated by inaccurate oracles with stochastic inaccuracies. In this part, we focused on direct search based on inaccurate function values generated from Monte Carlo simulations. We analyzed the behavior of direct search in such a scenario, and design strategies to adjust the stencil size of direct search according to the sample size of the simulation. We established the convergence of direct search equipped with such strategies. Moreover, our method can deal with nonsmooth problems with a smoothing technique. A strength of this work is that we do not require the noise to follow a particular distribution. Our analysis is applicable as long as the noise satisfies a sub-exponential condition, which can be fulfilled by a large class of distributions. Such a condition is much weaker than requiring the noise to be Gaussian or sub-Gaussian, which is often assumed in the literature. 3. Study the situation where we have access to a hierarchy of inaccurate oracles and discuss how nonlinear optimization methods should exploit the hierarchy to yield a desirable solution with few evaluations of high-accuracy oracles. In this part, we studied direct search methods based on inaccurate function values. For both deterministic and stochastic noise, we designed strategies of adaptively choosing oracles of difference accuracies (indicated by the magnitude of the inaccuracy in the deterministic case and the sample size in the stochastic case), aiming at obtaining high-accuracy solutions while using low-accuracy oracles as much as possible. Our algorithm has been applied to problems arising from machine learning (in particular, censored regression), where a significant portion of the learning process can be accomplished with relatively low sample sizes.

25301217.label: Major findings and research outcome
25301217.value: 1. Direct search methods based on inaccurate function values. Direct search represents a major class of optimization methods used in industry and engineering when it is impossible to obtain accurate derivatives of the objective function or even to approximate them. Such methods do not use derivatives but work based on the function values, which are often contaminated by noise. As stated in Objective 1, we analyzed the behavior of direct search when the function values contain deterministic noise and proved that direct search methods can converge up to a tolerance determined by the noise magnitude. As mentioned in Objective 2, we then studied the behavior of direct search method when it is provided with function values subject to stochastic noise. Based on the theoretical analysis, we developed a smoothing direct search algorithm for nonsmooth nonconvex problems with bound constraints, requiring not the accurate objective function values but only Monte Carlo simulations of them. In the algorithm, we devised a rule of adjusting the stencil size of direct search and the smoothing parameter so that the algorithm is adapted to the level of the inaccuracy and capable of exploiting a hierarchy of oracles with different accuracies (corresponding to a hierarchy of different sample sizes) as intended in Objective 3. We have proved that with probability one any accumulation point of the sequence generated by the algorithm is a Clarke stationary point. 2. Trust-region methods based on inaccurate gradients. We have investigated the behavior of trust-region methods assuming that the objective function is smooth yet its gradient information available to us is inaccurate or even completely wrong. We show sharp bounds on the gradient inaccuracy that can guarantee the convergence of trust-region methods, and establish worst-case complexities for trust-region methods based on inaccurate gradients. Interestingly, this investigation reveals an unexpected connection between optimization based on inaccurate gradients with optimization based on space decomposition (the topic of a GRF project being conducted by the PI). This connection leads us to a unified framework of "Optimization by Space Transformation", which will be further investigated in our GRF project. 3. Th PDFO package (https://www.pdfo.net). The investigation of this project provides a solid foundation for the development of the PDFO package, which has been downloaded more than 16,000 times. PDFO plays a significant role in GEMSEO (https://gemseo.readthedocs.io/en/stable), a piece of industrial software developed by engineers from aerospace industry.

25301217.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
25301217.value: 1. Optimization by space transformation. While studying optimization methods based on inaccurate gradients, we have discovered an unexpected connection of such methods with optimization based on space decomposition, which leads us to a framework of "Optimization by Space Transformation". At each iteration of the framework, the gradient of the objective function is mapped by a forward transformation to an auxiliary (possibly lifted) space, in which a model is established based on the transformed gradient and a step is obtained by minimizing this model. A backward transformation then maps the step back to the original space, where the iterate is updated accordingly. This framework opens an exciting and broad research avenue to explore. It will be further investigated in our GRF project "Derivative-free Optimization with Space decomposition, Coarse Space Correction, and Randomization". 2. PDFO package for optimization with missing or inaccurate information. The numerical and algorithmic development of this project has laid a solid foundation for the development of PDFO (https://www.pdfo.net), a package for optimization problems where the first-order information is missing while the function evaluations may be inaccurate. The development of PDFO is a long-term effort and it is continued under the PolyU project "Software Development for Derivative-Free Optimization".

25301217.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
25301217.value: Traditional study of optimization methods usually assumes that the information needed by the algorithms can be obtained accurately. In industrial and engineering applications, however, such an assumption fails very often. Indeed, all numerical optimization methods are running based on inaccurate information due to the finite arithmetic of computers. This project studies nonlinear optimization methods based on inaccurate information, particularly trust-region methods and direct search methods. The theory established in this project helps us to understand the behavior of nonlinear algorithms in real-world computation. We also devise algorithms based on inaccurate information, and they have been successfully applied to optimization problems arising from statistical learning and finance. The theoretical and algorithmic developments lay a solid foundation for the development of PDFO (https://www.pdfo.net), a piece of software that aims to tackle optimization problems where critical information such as derivatives or function values is missing or inaccurate. The software has become a significant component of GEMSEO (https://gemseo.readthedocs.io/en/stable), an industrial package for MDO (Multidisciplinary Design Optimization) with applications in aerospace engineering.

25301517.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25301517.value: In order to develop next generation, wearable and stretchable electronic devices, it is critical to improve the control of the electronic properties of ultra-thin materials. Transition metal dichalcogenides (TMD) are 3-atoms thick, layered materials with semiconducting properties that have the potential to replace silicon in a near future. However, additional research needs to be performed in order to overcome the performances of current technology. The principal strength of silicon lies in its stability and, across the years, researchers have developed various doping techniques in order to control its carrier concentration with precision, critical to enable digital electronics. By contrast, doping TMDs is challenging and only few successful cases have been reported in the literature. For example, doping TMDs can be achieved by substituting some of its constituting atoms with other elements during synthesis of the materials. However, the synthesis of pristine TMD itself is challenging and, incorporating dopants imposes additional complexity. In this project, we introduce a new type of doping corresponding to the insertion of interstitial atoms inside layers of TMDs. We have demonstrated from first principle calculations that a wide range of elements are energetically stable inside layers of various TMDs. Our preliminary results suggest that this new type of doping could be achieved post-synthesis, eliminating most of the current experimental challenges. The small energy needed for insertion of atoms inside TMDs could enable “electrochemical printing” of the monolayer. Furthermore, the change in the physical and chemical properties of interstitial doped TMD provides novel routes to tune charge carrier concentrations, to improve its catalytic activity, to lower contact resistance with metals, and to propose novel magnetic semiconductors. Due to the large number of TMDs and dopants we propose to use predictive computational techniques to narrow down experimental studies to the most promising candidates. 為了發展下一代的可穿戴和可伸縮電子器件，提高超薄材料電子結構的可控性十分重要。過渡金屬硫化物是三原子層厚度的層狀材料，它具有半導體特性因此有在未來取代硅材料的潛力，但是我們對此需要進行更多的研究以獲得超過現有技術的優越性能。硅材料的主要優勢是其穩定性，另外這些年裡人們發展的各種摻雜技術能夠對其載流子濃度精確調控，從而實現當今數字電路。相對來說，對過渡金屬硫化物進行摻雜非常有挑戰性，迄今也就僅有幾例成功的報道。比如，能夠在該材料合成過程當中進行替代原子的摻雜。但是，合成本征過渡金屬硫化物也非常有挑戰性，如果要加進摻雜那就更增加複雜度。在這個項目中，我們將引進一種新的摻雜手段，即在原子層間插入間隙原子。我們利用第一性原理計算得到有很多的元素可以在過渡金屬硫化物層間穩定存在。我們前期的工作表明這種新的摻雜形式可以在樣本合成之後實現，從而克服現在實驗上的大多數挑戰。在過渡金屬硫化物中間插入間隙原子只需要很小能量因此可以用來實現單層的電化學印刷。進一步，通過間隙摻雜過渡金屬硫化物改變的物理和化學性質提供了調控載流子濃度的一種新方法，從而提高其催化活性，降低與金屬的接觸電阻，和預測新的磁性半導體。由於有大量的過渡金屬硫化物和摻雜元素種類，我們建議使用可預測的計算模擬方法來縮減實驗範圍已獲得最佳候選材料。

25301617.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25301617.value: Water splitting using renewable energy provides a sustainable solution for producing the clean hydrogen fuel to replace fossil fuels, with promising industrial potential such as industrial photosynthesis and hydrogen economy. Current water-splitting technology relies on precious metals to catalyze the sluggish and energy-demanding water oxidation reaction. Large-scale water splitting requires non-precious catalysts, among which 3d transition metal oxides (TMOs) are highly attractive for their abundance and low cost. However, the progress of optimizing the catalytic activity of 3d TMOs is currently hindered by the limited understanding of the atomic and electronic structures at 3d TMO surfaces and how they influence water oxidation. Conventional mechanistic studies do not have sufficient spatial resolution to directly probe catalyst surfaces. Novel high-resolution microscopy techniques are thus needed to clarify the nature of the active reaction sites and the optimal surface structure, which will further lead the way to better catalysts suitable for industrial water-splitting applications. The aim of this project is to address this immediate need, by developing a high-resolution characterization scheme combining both in situ and ex situ transmission electron microscopy (TEM). Our expertise in cutting-edge TEM techniques, especially their applications on TMOs, grants us an edge to reveal unprecedented information of catalyst surfaces, including local atomic structure, lattice strain, composition, and cation oxidation states. Furthermore, the recently-developed TEM liquid holder allows us to perform, for the first time, direct observation of water oxidation at catalyst surfaces in real time. Even though the spatial resolution will be limited to nanoscale due to electron scattering in liquid, such an in situ TEM study will unambiguously pinpoint the active reaction sites as well as degradation pathways at catalyst surfaces. Atomic-scale structure characteristics of the identified reaction sites and pathways will further be retrieved using ex situ TEM observation in vacuum right after in situ reactions. Such an in situ and ex situ combined characterization scheme will offer us a unique opportunity to understand water-oxidation catalysis at the atomic level. By demonstrating it on manganese-oxide-based nanocatalysts, we will derive the optimal atomic and electronic structures at surfaces, which will resolve the controversy in this promising material. The exclusive information achieved from this work will offer timely guidance for designing and synthesizing more efficient catalysts for large-scale water splitting. Finally, the developed characterization scheme will be widely applicable and may open an exciting new route to comprehend chemical and electrochemical reactions at the atomic scale. 利用可再生能源進行水分解是可持續生產氫燃料，以取代石油燃料減少碳排放的有效途徑。水分解的工業化需要物美價廉的催化劑來加速水氧化反應的進行，其中儲量豐富的過渡族氧化物最有應用前景。然而目前人們對過渡族氧化物的表面結構以及其對水分解的影響所知甚少，限制了其開發應用的進程。傳統的催化機理研究不具備足夠高的分辨率來直接探索催化劑的表面結構。為了解決這一問題, 本項目基於新湧現的液相電子顯微鏡技術，旨在開發一套能夠分辨催化劑表面結構並原位觀測其變化的表徵方法。原位液相電子顯微鏡為實時觀測催化劑表面的水分解反應提供了實驗平台，同時結合具有原子分辨率的非原位電子顯微鏡表徵，這一新的表徵方法可望在原子尺度上充分理解水分解反應的催化機理，進而為優化過渡族氧化物的催化性能提供指引。

25301617.label: Realisation of objectives
25301617.value: Objective 1: We have fully achieved this objective, by demonstrating the first direct observation of water-oxidation reactions on MnOx catalyst surface at nanoscale using the in situ liquid TEM holder [Nano Lett. 21, 7012 (2021)]. Water-oxidation reactions are explicitly indicated by the development of oxygen bubbles around nanocatalysts. The corresponding active sites and associated reaction rates on the surface of catalysts have also been identified successfully. Objective 2: We have designed and fabricated a special sample holder which can transfer the in situ liquid TEM sample chip directly into vacuum and perform atomic-scale ex situ TEM characterization right after in situ observation. Detailed atomic structure, chemical composition and bonding states have been successfully achieved using high-resolution TEM imaging and electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS), as reported in Nano Lett. 21, 7012 (2021). Therefore this objective has been fully realized. Objective 3: From a comparison of structure and morphology of nanocatalysts with different activities, we identified the active phase on the surface of MnOx catalysts to be the amorphous MnOx with mixed Mn valence of +2, +3, and +4. This phase can form spontaneously during the water-oxidation reactions. In addition, another critical factor is the morphology, especially the exposed surface area of nanocatalysts determined by the particle radius. Commercial catalysts are found to be mostly micrometer in size, which show much lower catalytic activity than the specially prepared nanocatalysts. This objective has thus been achieved. Objective 4: We have compared the surface structure of Mn2O3, Mn3O4 and Mn5O8, and discovered that all samples exhibit surface restructuring during water oxidation reactions, reflecting flexible Mn valence which affects Mn-O bonding strength and charge transfer on the surface. Mn3+ cations have been identified on nearly all the active sites, confirming their significant role in catalytic reactions, presumably due to the associated Jahn-Teller distortions. Thus this objective has been fully accomplished. Objective 5: We have achieved this objective by revealing the detailed dopant structure and valence states of Ce-doped Mn3O4 using ex situ TEM and EELS, especially on the catalyst surface. A correlation between structure characterization and catalytic activity has enabled us to derive the catalytic mechanism for doped Mn3O4 nanocatalysts, which has been reported in Chem. Mater. 31, 5769-5777 (2019).

25301617.label: Major findings and research outcome
25301617.value: Through accomplishing this project, we have successfully demonstrated the first real-time nanoscale observation of chemical water oxidation on MnOx nanocatalyst surface using in situ liquid holder in a transmission electron microscope (TEM). The water oxidation process is directly indicated by the development of oxygen bubbles around nanocatalysts, which has never been observed for liquid water oxidation before. Moreover, the nanoscale resolution of liquid TEM allows us to unravel the real-time formation of a surface layer on MnOx, whose thickness oscillation reflects a reversible surface restructuring relevant to water oxidation catalysis. Ex situ atomic-resolution TEM further reveals the amorphous nature of the surface layer with reduced Mn valence arising from the introduction of oxygen vacancies. The demonstrated in situ liquid TEM, supplemented by atomic-resolution ex situ TEM, presents a powerful tool for mechanistic study on various chemical reactions in liquid, which should greatly impact the fields of catalysis and energy-related research. This result has been published as Nano Lett. 21, 7012, 2021 (C: Research Output No. 4). To identify the dopant structure and oxidation states in doped MnOx catalysts, we have performed quantitative dopant-atom counting and oxidation-state mapping using the state-of-the-art electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) in scanning TEM. Our technique is applied on Ce-doped Mn3O4 nanoparticles <10 nm in size (C: Research Output No. 2). The achieved quality of atomic-resolution EELS mapping on such ultrafine nanoparticles is unprecedented, allowing us to reveal various characteristic structure and oxidation states of Ce dopants. These experimental observations are further rationalized by density functional theory (DFT) calculations and lead to an atomic-scale oxygen-exchange mechanism which explains the remarkably enhanced redox efficiency and oxygen-exchange capacity due to Ce doping. This result has been published as Chem. Mater. 31, 5769, 2019 (C: Research Output No. 3).

25301617.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
25301617.value: With the established in situ and ex situ TEM techniques, we wish to apply them to exploring the reaction mechanisms of various other chemical processes. We plan to start with the water oxidation reaction on Ni(OH)2 catalyst surface, aiming to identify the active sites and potential degradation pathways through the combination of in situ and ex situ TEM observation. The achieved insight may not only advance the current mechanistic understanding on water oxidation catalysis, but also extend the impact of our demonstrated techniques to the wide field of catalysis and energy-related research.

25301617.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
25301617.value: Water splitting using renewable energy provides a sustainable solution for producing the clean hydrogen fuel to replace fossil fuels, with promising potential such as industrial photosynthesis and hydrogen economy. Current water-splitting technology relies on precious metals to catalyze the sluggish water oxidation reaction. Large-scale water splitting requires non-precious catalysts, among which transition metal oxides (TMOs) are highly attractive for their abundance and low cost. However, the progress of optimizing catalytic activity of TMOs is currently hindered by the limited understanding of TMO surface structures and how they influence water oxidation. Conventional mechanistic studies do not have sufficient spatial resolution to directly probe catalyst surfaces. To address this immediate need, we have developed a high-resolution characterization scheme by exploiting the recently-advent in situ liquid holder, which allows us to directly observe water oxidation in real time, together with atomic-resolution ex situ electron microscopy. Such a combined scheme has enabled us to directly monitor nanoscale water oxidation in liquid, and identify the nature of the active reaction sites and the optimal TMO surface structure. The achieved result has shed light on the catalytic mechanism of water oxidation at nanoscale, and paved way for further optimizing catalytic performance for industrial water-splitting applications.

25304217.value: 联合卫星雷达数据，光学遥感和地震波数据精化2001年7.8级可可西里地震的滑动分布模型

25304217.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25304217.value: On 14 November 2001, one of the largest continental strike-slip earthquakes (Mw 7.8) known as the Kokoxili earthquake ruptured a 426 km portion of the Kunlun Fault system (EKF). This earthquake provides a good opportunity to study the rupture mechanisms and processes of large continental strike slip earthquake. Numerous work has been carried out to estimate the co-seismic fault slip distribution using seismological data, high-resolution optical imagery and space geodetic data, but none of these data have been comprehensively combined to resolve the spatio-temporal kinematic characteristics of this earthquake. In the proposed study, we plan to utilize seismic data, which have high temporal resolutions, to understand the dynamics of the earthquake. We will use geodetic data and optical imagery, which have strong spatial resolution, to generate a complete coseismic ground deformation map covering the whole rupture with emphasis on the retrieve of near field deformation using the image cross correlation method. Finally, we plan to jointly analyze, validate and invert these data sets for the fault-slip distribution. The improved source model will help to better understand how this earthquake nucleated and ruptured on the EKF in the Tibet Plateau as well as to better understand the accommodation of the ongoing northward penetration of Indian plate into the Eurasian plate. Moreover, this project's holistic approach will provide key insights into the physics of earthquakes in the interior of continents and the role played by continental deformation within the theory of plate tectonics. 2001年11月14日，昆仑断裂带发生了近年来中国内陆最大的走滑型地震可可西里地震（震级7.8级），该地震破裂了426公里并提供了一次研究地震破裂机理和过程的机会。很多研究利用地震波数据，高分辨率光学数据和空间大地测量数据研究了此次地震的同震分布，但是没有尚无联合这些数据估计此次地震的滑动时空分布的研究。本提案计划利用高时间分辨率的地震波数据估计地震的破裂过程，利用大地测量数据和遥感数据生成覆盖整个同震形变场。最后，我们计划联合分析、校正和反演这些数据来估计断层的滑动分布。这个精化的模型能够帮助我们更好的理解可可西里地震的破裂过程。本项目也将为深刻理解内陆地震的物理特性和大陆地表形变在板块运动学理论中扮演的角色提供重要见解。

25500517.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25500517.value: This study plans to investigate whether the fivefold increase in the notional size of the KOSPI 200 index option contract in 2012 affected investor behavior, and, if so, adversely impacted its liquidity and pricing efficiency. Concerns over speculative trading by retail investors led the Korea Exchange (KRX) to increase the multiplier to discourage speculation by retail investors. Not surprisingly, the increase in contract size succeeded in reducing the share of trading volume attributable to retail investors. Most prior studies on the effect of changes in contract size focus on ascertaining the impact of a decrease in the notional value or minimum trading unit of a security because decreases are more common (Huang and Stoll (1986); Karagozoglu and Martell (1999); and Amihud, Mendelson, and Uno (1999)). The principal motivations for changing contract size are to: enhance market liquidity; increase investor interest; or otherwise make the security more attractive to trade. As noted above, this study proposes to examine an instance where contract size is increased to achieve a regulatory objective. It makes three principal contributions to the literature. First, I intend to conduct research on which types of investors actually exit/enter the market and the difference in their trading strategies by following orders and observing the whole limit order book before and after the change. This is possible by using a novel dataset that includes account-level data for both futures and options. This allows us to evaluate the impact of a change in contract size on investor behavior. Second, I propose to work on the analyses of market efficiency in terms of price disagreement among futures, options, and the underlying index. Individual investor behavior is often considered to be noisy, but nonetheless the collective behavior of noisy individual investors can increase market liquidity, price discovery and market efficiency as suggested by Black (1986). Applying Muravyev, Pearson, and Broussard (2013), price disagreement frequency and time to agreement can be measured. Third, I intend to study how informed trading activity changes before and after the increase in KOSPI 200 index option contract size. It is known that the trading behavior of informed traders changes when they face a different environment with different levels of asymmetric information and market liquidity (Chung, Park, and Ryu (2016)). I plan to examine this in more detail by studying how the permanent price impact of each trade changes in time series analysis. 2012年，韓國交易所（KRX）為了抑制個人投資者的投機交易行為，出台了相關政策，使得KOSPI200指數期權合約的名義規模增長到原來的5倍。一方面，合約規模的增加確實能夠有效減少個人投資者的投機交易量份額；然而，另一方面合約規模的增加是否會降低市場流動性以及降低市場定價效率呢？在這一背景下，本項目研究合約規模的變化是否會對投資行為產生影響，並進一步研究其對市場流動性和定價效率是否會產生不利影響。 針對合約規模變化的經濟後果研究主要關注於證券的名義價值或最低交易單位減少的經濟後果（Huang and Stoll（1986）; Karagozoglu and Martell（1999）;和Amihud，Mendelson和Uno（1999））。改變合約規模的主要動機在於：提高市場流動性;增加投資者利益;或以其他方式使證券更具吸引力。不同於以往研究，本項目以政策制定者為了達到監管目的而增加合約規模為實例，研究其經濟後果。本項目預期在如下叁方面做出了一定的補充貢獻： 首先，本項目通過比較在合約規模改變前後，實際退出或者進入市場的不同類型的投資者、追踪訂單，以及觀測限價委託書，來研究合約規模的變化對投資者交易策略的影響。本項目通過構建一個包括期貨和期權賬戶級數據的新數據集，來檢驗合約規模變化對投資者行為的影響。 第二，本項目通過分析期貨，期權和相關指數之間的價格分歧來研究市場效率。個人投資者的行為通常被認為是有噪音的，但是儘管如此，這些噪音交易者的集體行為仍然能夠提高市場流動性，價格發現以及市場效率（Black 1986）。本項目參照Muravyev，Pearson和Broussard（2013）的方法來測度價格分歧的頻率以及消除價格分歧的時間。 第三，本項目研究KOSPI200指數的期權合約規模增加前後知情交易活動變化。以往研究發現在不同環境下，如不同的信息不對稱程度以及不同的市場流動性水平下，知情交易者的交易行為是否發生變化（Chung，Park，and Ryu（2016））。

25500517.label: Realisation of objectives
25500517.value: First, we found that our original plan to work with the time-series structural analysis failed due to the data being high-frequency but still having data points at the same milliseconds. Thus, instead of working with the objectives that cannot be found, we added another objective to link the option market behavior with the equity market behavior. We contribute to the literature by showing that the effects of contract size increases on trading activity differ depending on investor characteristics and details. Surprisingly, we find that retail investors’ trading volume increases after the increase in the multiplier. However, these results are driven by retail investors who trade in both options and futures, while we do not find that retail investors who only trade in the options market increase their trading activity. Local institutional investors who trade in both options and futures also increase their trade more than those who only trade options. This result aligns with the policy’s objective of making traders who participate in both markets relatively more active. The policy makes it easier for such traders to create a portfolio of derivatives because the multipliers are matched. We also find that, regardless of investor type (local retail, local institution, or foreign), options investors who have a larger inventory decrease their trading activity after the multiplier increases. Our result showing that option-only traders account for a smaller fraction of the trading volume implies that there are relatively fewer speculators in the options market. A reduction in speculators’ fraction of the trading volume may affect the efficiency of the underlying market. To test whether market efficiency is affected, we measure the frequency of put-call parity violations over time. Because the index is not directly traded, we treat futures with the same maturity as the underlying asset. We find that put-call parity violations are less severe after the options multiplier increases, implying that speculators may have caused price discrepancies among options and futures. However, we also show that put-call parity violations could increase when the market is more volatile. This outcome could arise because reduced participation in options markets causes liquidity to dry up when the market is volatile, leading prices to deviate from their fundamental values. We also contribute to the literature by linking options market activity to lottery stocks in equity markets. We observe that investors trade lottery stocks more actively after the reform, suggesting that the speculators who are crowded out of the options market turn to the equity market. Our results are robust to controlling for market-wide and stock-specific factors.

25503317.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25503317.value: The prevalence of information technology is dramatically changing the way consumers shop globally. China has become the most dynamic e-commerce market in the world and its volume of online sales has exceeded that in the US. To capitalize on the e-commerce growth, more and more manufacturers or suppliers are introducing their own direct online selling channels, which compete with their retail partners. Traditionally, the online channel has been treated as a separate way to sell products and firms often offer different products or charge different prices through multiple channels, which is called as "multi-channel" retailing. Nowadays, there is an emerging focus on "omni-channel" retailing, which means providing consumers with a seamless shopping experience across channels by offering consistent products and pricing and many other services through multiple channels. Although some existing studies clarify the benefits of multi-channel retailing and suggest efficiency and strategic difference between channels, there is virtually no theoretical work that offers rationales on benefits outweighing costs and challenges of omni-channel. This proposed project targets to close this gap with a theoretical study that compares the traditional multi-channel and omni-channel retailing with a focus on consistent product and pricing. To do this, we develop a game-theoretical model where there is a single manufacturer who is capable of producing up to two versions of products and sells his products through his own online channel and a retailer's brick-and-mortar store. The two channels compete against an exogenous retail market and face stochastic demand. We consider two channel strategies that the manufacturer and the retailer can adopt: (1) A dual-channel strategy, under which the products and retail prices offered at the online and brick-and-mortar stores are allowed to be different; (2) an omni-channel strategy, under which both channels are required to offer the same product at the same price. We will compare the two strategies and characterize conditions under which an omni-channel strategy could benefit the manufacturer and/or the retailer. We will first study the two strategies in a centralized supply chain where the manufacturer and the retailer are owned by an integrated firm; then we will study the two strategies in a decentralized supply chain where the manufacturer and the retailer are independent. 信息技术的普及正在极大地改变消费者的购物方式。中国已成为世界上最具活力的电子商务市场，其在线销售量已超过美国。为了利用电子商务发展的时机，越来越多的制造商或供应商正在引入自己的直接在线销售渠道，与其传统的零售商合作伙伴竞争。 传统上，在线渠道被视为产品销售的一种独立方式，企业通常会通过多渠道提供不同的产品或收取不同的价格，这被称为“多渠道”零售。如今， “全渠道”零售开始新兴，这意味着通过多渠道提供一致的产品和定价以及其他服务，为消费者提供无缝的渠道购物体验。虽然一些现有的研究表明多渠道零售的好处，并提出不同渠道之间的效率和战略差异，但实际上没有任何理论上的研究可以解释“全渠道”零售的优势和劣势。此科研项目的目标在于通过理论模型来研究对比传统的多渠道和全渠道零售，重点研究不同销售渠道间产品和价格的统一性。 为了研究这些问题，我们建立了一个博弈理论模型。在模型中，我们考虑存在一个制造商，其能够生产两个不同之量的同类产品。制造商可以通过自己的在线渠道和零售商的实体店出售产品; 并且，这两个销售渠道都与外部市场竞争。我们考虑制造商和零售商有两种渠道策略：（1）传统的双渠道策略，这意味着在线提供的产品和零售价格可与实体店中提供的产品和零售价格不同; （2）全渠道策略，这意味着在线渠道和实体店必须以相同的价格销售相同的产品。我们将首先研究集中型供应链，其中制造商和零售商由一家公司所拥有；然后我们研究分散型供应链，其中制造商和零售商独立做决策。此科研项目将有助于运营和营销文献中多渠道零售的研究。它旨在帮助多渠道企业深入了解全渠道零售的优缺点，并为企业提供有关渠道管理策略的强有力的管理见解和建议。

25503317.label: Realisation of objectives
25503317.value: All the four objectives have been fully achieved. This research project focuses on product and price consistency in a supply chain setting. We aim to answer the following research questions: (1) Under what conditions can firms benefit from omni-channel strategy by offering consistent price? (2) What are the effects of online fulfillment efficiency and demand uncertainty on firms' pricing strategies? In our study, omni-channel strategy refers to the case that consistent product and price are offered across different channels; dual-channel strategy refers to the case that either product or price is inconsistent across channels. To answer the above questions, we have developed a game-theoretical model, in which there is a single manufacturer capable of producing up to two product versions with high or low quality. The manufacturer sells his output through his own online channel and a retailer's brick-and-mortar store. The game sequence is as below: First, the manufacturer decides which product version to offer for each channel. Second, the manufacturer and brick-and-mortar retailer decide whether or not to offer consistent price if the same product is offered in two channels. Third, the manufacturer sets the wholesale price. Fourth, the retailer decides how much inventory to stock before demand uncertainty is resolved. Finally, after demand is realized, the manufacturer and retailer simultaneously set the retail prices for their own store conditional on whether consistent price is offered. In what follows, I will elaborate how we achieve each objective and what are the findings. 1. For Objective 1: We have studied a centralized supply chain and find that the centralized manufacturer always prefers dual-channel strategy (i.e., not offering consistent product or price) rather than omni-channel strategy (i.e., offering consistent product and price). This is because consistent product and price policy restricts the manufacturer’s choices and thereby reduces the payoff he can obtain. 2. For Objective 2: We have studied a decentralized supply chain and find that whenever the manufacturer or the retailer holds a competitive advantage, the manufacturer offer the same product in both channels. If the retailer holds an advantage, it offers consistent price (i.e., offers price matching) to obtain favorable wholesale pricing from the manufacturer. Finally, when neither manufacturer nor retailer has a clear advantage, the manufacturer mitigates price competition by offering different products across channels. (Please see the details in the paper attached in part C). 3. For Objective 3: We have conducted the sensitive analysis to examine the effects of some key parameters, including the online fulfillment cost and demand volatility. We find that when the online fulfillment cost is low, the manufacturer prefers to offer consistent product across both channels, while consistent price will not be offered. When the online fulfillment cost is high and demand variability is low, both consistent product and price will be offered through both channels (i.e., omni-channel strategy is preferred by the manufacturer and retailer). When the online fulfillment cost is high and demand variability is high, the manufacturer would offer different product versions through the two channels. (Please see the details in the paper attached in part C). 4. For Objective 4: We have investigated consumers’ total surplus and find that consumers could be worse off or better under omni-channel strategy compared to the dual-channel strategy. This is because the price might be higher or lower under omni-channel strategy. All other above four objectives have been fully achieved. Based on the finding in this research project, we have completed an academic paper, titled “Pricing, Quality, and Stocking Decisions in a Manufacturer-Centric Dual-Channel”, which has been accepted by Manufacturing and Service Operations Management in Nov 2021 (see the paper in part C). Originally, the focus of this paper is on the two channel strategies: (1) A dual-channel strategy, under which the product and retail price could be different for the online and brick-and-mortar stores; (2) an omni-channel strategy, under which consistent product and price should be offered across the two stores. In the process of revising this paper for journal publication, according to the review team’s comments, we have revised the paper title and the whole paper to focus on the pricing-matching strategy, which also replaces the term of omni-channel strategy. However, the base model and key results of the paper are still about whether the manufacturer and retailer should offer the same product and same price across different selling channels. And, also as requested by the review team, we only present part of the findings related to Objectives 2 and 3 in this paper. This paper contributes to the literature by studying consistent product and price in a supply chain setting, and obtains some initial insight into what products a manufacturer operating a manufacturer-centric dual-channel should design for each store in the dual-channel, how much the stores should stock/sell, and whether or not they should offer consistent price.
